The paper integrates recent empirical findings from Malaysia and comparable emerging economies, proposes an extended conceptual model that positions DFL as both a direct antecedent and a moderator linking UTAUT constructs to e-commerce adoption and wealth outcomes, and outlines policy and platform-level interventions aligned with Malaysia’s National Strategy for Financial Literacy 2026–2030 (NS2.0) (Securities Commission Malaysia, 2025; OECD, 2026). Implications for inclusive growth, strengthened consumer protection, and future empirical testing of the proposed pathways are discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇概念性研究文章，探讨数字金融素养（DFL）如何通过UTAUT/UTAUT2理论框架影响马来西亚B40收入群体与Z世代的电子商务平台使用行为及家庭财富积累。文章提出DFL既作为直接影响因素，又作为调节变量，连接UTAUT构念与电商采纳及财富结果，并提出扩展概念模型与政策干预建议。
AI.research_question: 数字金融素养（DFL）如何塑造B40收入群体中Z世代的行为意图与电子商务平台的实际参与度，进而影响负责任的平台使用、安全的信贷决策及家庭财富的渐进积累？
AI.motivation: 马来西亚电商行业高速扩张，数字支付与BNPL等新金融形态深入消费生活，但B40群体与Z世代在面对近于普遍的数字化接入和智能手机高渗透率时，仍易受冲动消费、网络诈骗与财富结果欠佳的影响，亟需从数字金融素养角度解释并缓解这一脆弱性。
AI.theoretical_framework: UTAUT/UTAUT2（技术接受与使用统一理论）与数字金融素养（DFL）研究框架，DFL涵盖数字产品与服务知识、数字金融风险意识、风险控制能力，以及消费者权利与救济程序的理解。
AI.method: 概念性文章（Conceptual article），综合马来西亚及可比新兴经济体的近期实证研究，进行文献整合与理论模型构建，提出扩展概念模型。
AI.findings: 提升B40 Gen Z的数字金融素养能够增强绩效期望与便利条件，同时降低感知风险，从而支持更负责任的平台使用、更安全的信贷决策以及家庭财富的渐进积累。
AI.theory_contributions: 将DFL定位为UTAUT构念与电商采纳、财富结果之间的直接前因和调节变量，构建了扩展概念模型，丰富了数字金融素养在电商采纳情境下的理论整合。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出与马来西亚《2026-2030年国家金融素养战略》（NS2.0）相一致的政府与平台层面干预措施，为包容性增长、消费者保护强化及后续实证验证提供政策参考。

title: When Does Enterprise AI Pay? Threshold Conditions and Qualitative Regimes in a Deterministic Firm-Level Scenario Model
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: When Does Enterprise AI Pay? Threshold Conditions and Qualitative Regimes in a Deterministic Firm-Level Scenario Model

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author designed and implemented the open-source calculator whose calculation engine is analyzed in this paper, and is a founder of Protico, which operates the calculator's hosted instance (all4.ai). This paper is therefore the model designer's analysis of his own artifact and claims no independence. In place of that independence, every proposition is machine-verified at machine precision against the unmodified, MIT-licensed implementation; the verification and experiment scripts are part of the paper's replication package (Appendix B). The author has no other personal or financial relationships that could be perceived to have influenced this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study involves no human participants, no animal subjects, and no personal data. All results are deterministic computations on synthetic firm parameterizations and on figures drawn from publicly disclosed company filings.
declarations.funderStatement: None. This research received no external funding, and no grant, sponsorship, or commercial support of any kind was provided for it.

detail.abstract: Enterprise adoption of generative artificial intelligence (AI) is widespread, yet most firms report no measurable profit-and-loss (P&L) impact, and large laboratory productivity gains attenuate to near-zero field effects. We analyze the calculation engine of a deterministic, opensource firm-level scenario calculator of the author's own design, which nets a one-sided quality discount and review, rework, and AI-operations overheads from task-level speed gains, caps monetization at validated demand, and adds cash timing and a workforce-attribution solver. All capability inputs act through one sufficient statistic, the time-release rate τ = xa(γ-H), partitioning the uplift-overhead plane into regimes bounded by vertical translates of a saturating Amdahl-type hyperbola: a viability threshold s * = H/(1-H), an economic break-even s * * , a demand-cap kink τ * with exactly zero marginal return to capability above it, and a capability ceiling τ max that model upgrades alone cannot move. Closed forms extend to the first-year cash shortfall-unrealized first-year value plus unamortized transformation cost-with its three-regime J-curve classification, a minimum efficient scale, and the workforce solver's exact affine geometry, in which AI relieves target-margin pressure only if its profit delta exceeds the target margin levied on its own revenue: a strictly stronger requirement than profitability, so profitable but margin-dilutive AI rationally increases required cuts. All twelve results (one lemma and eleven propositions) are machine-verified at machine precision against the MIT-licensed implementation, and calibration exercises show the identity can inhabit the lab-to-field attenuation range and-under a documented two-component demand-evidence mixture with unimodal capability inputs-the skewed practitioner outcome split. The framework is normative-diagnostic rather than causal: it orders managerial levers-demand evidence before capability spending, overhead reduction over model upgrades at rate (1 + s) 2-and separates AI-justified from margin-driven restructuring.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个确定性的开源企业级场景计算器，通过单一充分统计量（时间释放率τ）统一刻画生成式AI的能力投入，将提升-开销平面划分为受饱和度影响的Amdahl型双曲线约束的多个区间，推导出包括可行性阈值、经济盈亏平衡点、需求上限拐点、能力天花板、现金流J曲线和劳动力归因求解器在内的十二个机器验证命题，解释了实验室生产率收益为何在实地衰减为零。
AI.research_question: 为什么企业广泛采用生成式AI却报告无可测量的损益影响，以及实验室生产率收益在实地衰减到接近零效应的根本机制是什么？如何构建一个能够诊断和排序企业AI部署管理杠杆的规范性框架？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI的企业采用已十分普遍，但大多数企业报告无可测量的损益影响，实验室的大幅生产率提升在实地效应中衰减至接近零。这一矛盾缺乏一个统一的解析框架来解释和指导企业决策，现有的经验研究无法揭示导致这种衰减的根本结构性原因。
AI.theoretical_framework: Amdahl型饱和双曲线理论、充分统计量框架（时间释放率τ）、J曲线理论、劳动力归因求解的仿射几何、盈亏平衡分析、需求上限理论
AI.method: 作者自研的确定性开源企业级场景计算器，包含单边质量折扣、评审/返工/AI运营开销、需求约束下的货币化上限、现金时间以及劳动力归因求解器；所有十二个结果通过MIT许可实现进行机器精度验证，并辅以校准实验。
AI.findings: 所有能力输入通过单一充分统计量（时间释放率τ）起作用，将提升-开销平面划分为受垂直平移的饱和Amdahl型双曲线约束的多个区间：可行性阈值s*=H/(1-H)、经济盈亏平衡s**、需求上限拐点τ*（超过此点能力边际回报恰好为零）、能力天花板τmax（模型升级无法移动）。闭式解扩展到首年现金短缺的三区间J曲线分类、最小有效规模以及劳动力求解器的精确仿射几何。AI缓解目标利润率压力仅在利润增量超过其自身收入上征收的目标利润率时才成立，这一条件比盈利性更严格。所有十二个结果均经机器验证，校准实验显示该恒等式可解释实验室到实地衰减区间。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了统一的充分统计量框架，将生成式AI价值捕获分解为结构性约束（需求、开销、时间），推导出能力天花板τmax这一不可移动的内生限制，明确了盈利性与利润率稀释之间的严格区分，建立了可行的规范性诊断框架而非因果框架，并为实验室-实地衰减之谜提供了机制性解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了管理杠杆的排序指导：先获取需求证据再投入能力；以速率(1+s)²优先削减开销而非升级模型；区分AI合理化的重组与利润率驱动的重组；为企业在部署生成式AI时评估可行性、盈亏平衡和现金流提供精确的定量工具和开源实现。

title: From Forensics to Ecosystems: Rethinking Watermarks for Generative AI Oversight
affiliations: Cornell University, Cornell University and Harvard University - Department of the History of Science

detail.title: From Forensics to Ecosystems: Rethinking Watermarks for Generative AI Oversight

publicationDetails.detailsText: Forthcoming in the Proceedings of the 2026 AAAI/ACM Conference on AI, Ethics, and Soceity (AIES)

detail.abstract: The arrival of generative AI as a cheap, widely accessible commercial service, and the tidal wave of AI-generated synthetic content it has unleashed, have provoked deep epistemic and social anxieties and raised difficult governance questions that policymakers are struggling to address. One approach that has attracted both enthusiasm from regulators and skepticism from researchers is digital watermarking. Signals embedded in a synthetically-generated piece of content indicating that it was AI-generated-possibly even identifying the specific systems that generated it-appear to offer a path toward mitigating risks of genAI that avoids the downsides of more interventionist strategies. But critics warn that watermarks may prove technically brittle, epistemically ambiguous, and politically ineffectual tools. In this paper, we explore the challenges and opportunities of using digital watermarking for AI governance, paying special attention to the specific problem of watermarking AI-generated text. We argue that such critiques often treat the problem of identifying synthetic content as an isolated forensic question. Instead, we propose reconceptualizing digital watermarks as tools for understanding the impacts of synthetic content on media ecosystems, rather than reliably identifying individual pieces of synthetic content. Such an "ecosystems approach" more effectively utilizes the features of watermarks. And while this approach raises its own governance challenges, we argue that they are more tractable than the challenges of using watermarks for digital forensics.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了将数字水印作为AI治理工具的挑战与机遇，特别聚焦于AI生成文本的水印问题。作者批评现有讨论将合成内容识别视为孤立的取证问题，提出应将数字水印重新概念化为理解合成内容对媒体生态系统影响的工具（"生态系统方法"），而非可靠识别单条合成内容的手段。作者认为这种方法能更有效地利用水印特性，虽然也面临治理挑战，但比将水印用于数字取证更具可操作性。
AI.research_question: 如何重新构想数字水印在AI治理中的角色，使其超越单一内容取证的功能定位？具体而言，相较于将被批评为技术脆弱、认知模糊和政治无效的取证式水印方法，"生态系统方法"能否为AI治理提供更可行的路径？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI的普及导致AI合成内容大量涌现，引发了深层的认知与社会焦虑，政策制定者面临困难的治理问题。数字水印作为监管者青睐且研究者质疑的治理工具，其有效性受到"技术脆弱、认知模糊、政治无效"等批评，需要重新审视其治理潜力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生态系统方法（Ecosystems Approach）：将数字水印视为理解合成内容对媒体生态系统影响的工具，而非可靠识别单个合成内容的取证手段。该框架基于对现有水印批评的反思，主张从整体生态视角（内容分布、传播模式、影响评估）而非孤立取证视角理解水印的价值。
AI.method: 概念分析/规范性论证：本文通过批判性分析现有关于数字水印用于AI治理的争论，识别其认识论局限（将合成内容识别视为孤立取证问题），并在此基础上提出替代性概念框架（生态系统方法）。
AI.findings: 1. 现有对数字水印的批评（技术脆弱、认知模糊、政治无效）在某种程度上混淆了取证目的与生态目的；2. 将水印重新概念化为生态系统监测工具，能够更有效地利用水印的特性；3. 生态系统方法虽产生新的治理挑战，但这些挑战比数字取证路径更具可解性。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文提出了"生态系统方法"这一新的概念框架，将数字水印的治理功能从传统的单一内容取证定位，拓展为对媒体生态系统影响的监测与理解工具，为AI治理中的数字水印讨论提供了全新的认识论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了一种更具可操作性的水印治理策略，使其从追求"确定性识别"转向"趋势性理解"，降低了对水印技术精确度的过高要求，为AI生成文本的治理提供了切实可行的路径建议。

title:
Why can Sameness become Difference? 
Branching, Differentiation, and the Problem of a Differentiation-permitting Universe

detail.title:
Why can Sameness become Difference? 
Branching, Differentiation, and the Problem of a Differentiation-permitting Universe

declarations.declarationOfInterest: none
declarations.ethicsApproval: not applicable
declarations.funderStatement: none

detail.abstract: This essay argues that modern science explains many ways in which differences grow, organize, and sometimes branch, but does not explain why reality is capable of becoming different at all. A universe can be conceived that changes uniformly through time while remaining identical from place to place; ours is not such a world. The essay begins with branching, which makes differentiation visible, then moves beneath it to difference itself. Its thesis is that instability, symmetry breaking, quantum fluctuation, natural selection, and cosmological perturbation explain what happens once a differentiation-permitting framework is in place, and therefore leave unanswered the prior question of why reality has laws, states, and boundary conditions under which sameness can become difference. Two objections are met directly: that the question is one more instance of why the laws are as they are, and that the homogeneous-universe counterfactual is incoherent. If the question is ever resolved, the resolution most likely lies in the direction of necessity. The essay claims no new physical law and no demonstrated cosmic purpose. Its contribution is a bounded reframing that separates mechanisms of differentiation from the condition that differentiation be possible, and asks where competing explanations terminate.

AI.tldr: 本文论证现代科学解释了差异如何增长、组织并偶尔分支，但未能解释为何实在本身具有产生差异的能力。论文主张不稳定性、对称性破缺、量子涨落、自然选择和宇宙学扰动都只是在"允许差异的框架"已就位的前提下解释差异的发生机制，而未能回答更根本的问题：为何宇宙的定律、状态和边界条件使得"相同"能够转化为"差异"。论文直面两个反驳（即此问题不过是"定律为何如此"的又一实例，以及均匀宇宙反事实是不连贯的），并认为如果该问题能解决，最可能的方向是必然性（necessity）。论文不声称发现新物理定律或证明宇宙目的，其贡献在于一种有界的重新框定：将差异的机制与差异得以可能的条件分离开来。
AI.research_question: 现代科学能否解释为何实在本身具有产生差异的能力？或者更精确地说，为何宇宙的定律、状态和边界条件允许"相同"转化为"差异"这一根本条件？
AI.motivation: 尽管现代科学在解释差异如何增长、组织和分支方面取得了巨大成功（如自然选择、对称性破缺等），但这些解释都预设了一个允许差异发生的框架。论文试图追问这个框架本身为何存在，即差异的可能性条件问题，这是一个被主流科学解释所忽略的先在问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 论文同时涉及多个理论背景：分支（branching）理论使差异可见化；不稳定性、对称性破缺、量子涨落、自然选择、宇宙学扰动等差异生成机制；以及关于定律为何如此的形而上学讨论和必然性（necessity）概念。
AI.method: 本文为哲学性论证文章，采用概念分析的方法：首先从"分支"现象切入使差异可见化，然后深入到差异本身；接着论证已知科学机制只能解释框架内差异的发生而非框架的存在；再逐一回应两个主要反驳（定律为何如此问题、均匀宇宙反事实的不连贯性）；最后提出可能的解决方向——必然性。
AI.findings: 论文的核心发现是：所有已知的科学解释机制（不稳定性、对称性破缺、量子涨落、自然选择、宇宙学扰动）都具有一个共同的局限——它们都预设了一个允许差异发生的框架。因此，现代科学并未回答"为何实在能够产生差异"这一更根本的问题。论文认为此问题区别于一般性的"定律为何如此"问题，且均匀宇宙反事实并非不连贯的思维实验。若此问题可解，最可能的方向是必然性。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献在于提供一种有界的重新框定（bounded reframing），将"差异生成的机制"与"差异可能性的条件"这两个层次明确区分开来，并追问竞争性解释在何处终止。论文不声称发现新物理定律或证明宇宙目的，其价值在于划清科学解释的边界并指出现有解释框架的深层预设。
AI.practical_contributions: 本文的实践贡献主要体现在哲学层面：为科学解释划定了边界，使研究者意识到现有科学机制的适用范围，并将"实在为何具有产生差异的能力"作为独立的研究问题提出，为未来的形而上学和基础物理学研究提供了问题框架。

title: Holographic Anti-Entropy: The Physics Constitution of Open Complex Giant Systems - A Paradigm Shift from Emergent Self-Consistency to Will-Governed Mastery
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Holographic Anti-Entropy: The Physics Constitution of Open Complex Giant Systems - A Paradigm Shift from Emergent Self-Consistency to Will-Governed Mastery
detail.abstract: This paper presents a formal systems science framework, Holographic Anti-Entropy Theory (HAET), that bridges the gap between systems physics (Prigogine's dissipative structures, Friston's variational free energy principle) and digital value chain management. We outline the eight fundamental laws of systems engineering, formalize the prior boundary projection operator and second-order metacognitive operator , and demonstrate how distributed systems collapse factorial complexity into computable, low-entropy steady states. We highlight the empirical validation in Lenovo's proprietary manufacturing networks, achieving automated decision-making.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个形式化的系统科学框架——全息反熵理论（HAET），将系统物理学（普里戈金的耗散结构理论、弗里斯顿的变分自由能原理）与数字价值链管理相连接，概述了系统工程八大基本定律，形式化了先验边界投影算子和二阶元认知算子，并展示了分布式系统如何将阶乘复杂性压缩为可计算的低熵稳态，最后通过联想专有制造网络的实证验证实现了自动化决策。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个形式化的系统科学框架，将系统物理学原理与数字价值链管理相连接，从而将复杂分布式系统压缩为可计算、低熵的稳态并实现自动化决策？
AI.motivation: 系统物理学与数字价值链管理之间存在理论鸿沟，缺乏一个形式化框架来弥合两者，使得复杂分布式系统的熵减机制和自动化决策缺乏统一的理论基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全息反熵理论（HAET）；普里戈金的耗散结构理论；弗里斯顿的变分自由能原理；系统工程八大基本定律；先验边界投影算子；二阶元认知算子。
AI.method: 本文采用理论建构与形式化推演的方法，提出并形式化了HAET框架，包括系统工程八大定律、先验边界投影算子与二阶元认知算子，并在联想专有制造网络中进行了实证验证。
AI.findings: HAET框架成功将阶乘复杂性压缩为可计算、低熵稳态，并在联想专有制造网络中实现了自动化决策，验证了该框架的实证有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文通过提出全息反熵理论（HAET），将系统物理学（耗散结构理论、变分自由能原理）与数字价值链管理在形式化层面进行理论整合，填补了两者之间的理论鸿沟，并为系统工程提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: HAET框架在联想专有制造网络中实现了自动化决策，展示了该理论在工业场景中的实际应用价值，为数字价值链管理提供了可操作的熵减与决策优化工具。

title: Perception of Lecturers on the Core Curriculum Minimum Academic Standard (CCMAS) at Tai Solarin Federal University of Education
affiliations: Tai Solarin Federal University of Education, Tai Solarin University of Education, Tai Solarin Federal University of Education, Tai Solarin Federal University of Education and Tai Solarin Federal University of Education

detail.title: Perception of Lecturers on the Core Curriculum Minimum Academic Standard (CCMAS) at Tai Solarin Federal University of Education

publicationDetails.detailsText: Osiyemi, E. S., Imoh, S. I., Olusanya, K. J., Adebayo, O. R., & Agbajeola, R. O. (2026). Lecturers’ perception on the core curriculum minimum academic standard (CCMAS) at Tai Solarin Federal University of Education. International Journal on Education Insight, 7(2), 189-198.

detail.abstract: The Core Curriculum Minimum Academic Standard (CCMAS) is a framework introduced by the Nigerian National Universities Commision in which 30% of the curriculum content can be defined by universities. The framework has attracted the attention of lecturers on whether a 30% flexibility can be really practicable within universities. This study examined the perception of lecturers on the CCMAS at Tai Solarin Federal University of Education using a descriptive survey research design. The study population comprised all lecturers at Tai Solarin Federal University of Education (NUC) with a sample of 61 lecturers. The data were collected using Lecturers’ Perception of CCMAS Questionnaire (LP-CQ) with a reliability coefficient of 0.75. The results indicated that the level of lecturers’ awareness and understanding was high (mean = 3.12), perceptions of academic autonomy and curriculum flexibility was moderate (mean = 2.78), perceived benefits of implementing CCMAS was moderate (mean = 2.80), and perceived challenges of implementing CCMAS was moderate (mean = 2.89). The study concluded that the effective implementation of CCMAS is not the sole issue related to the policy design, but also to sustain professional growth, sufficient institutional commitment, and real flexibility of the curriculum that enables the universities to innovate within their unique environments. It was recommended, among others, that NUC should increase institutional contribution beyond 30 percent whereas universities must make use of its contribution to the maximum to demonstrate local realities, industry demands and new global tendencies.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过描述性调查设计，调查了尼日利亚塔伊索拉林联邦教育大学讲师对核心课程最低学术标准（CCMAS）的认知，发现讲师对CCMAS的认识和理解水平较高，但对学术自主权、课程灵活性、实施收益和挑战的认知均处于中等水平。
AI.research_question: 讲师如何看待CCMAS框架的实施？30%的课程灵活性在大学中是否真正可行？
AI.motivation: 尼日利亚国家大学委员会推出的CCMAS框架允许大学自主定义30%的课程内容，但讲师们对这一灵活性是否真正可行存在争议，需要实证研究来检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 课程自主权与灵活性的理论框架；政策实施理论
AI.method: 采用描述性调查研究设计，以塔伊索拉林联邦教育大学61名讲师为样本，使用讲师CCMAS认知问卷（LP-CQ）收集数据，信度系数为0.75。
AI.findings: 讲师对CCMAS的认识和理解水平较高（均值3.12）；对学术自主权和课程灵活性的认知为中等（均值2.78）；对实施CCMAS的收益认知为中等（均值2.80）；对实施CCMAS的挑战认知为中等（均值2.89）。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了CCMAS有效实施不仅关乎政策设计本身，还涉及专业成长、机构承诺及课程真正灵活性的多重因素，丰富了课程政策实施的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议NUC将机构贡献比例提高至30%以上，同时建议大学充分利用其自主贡献部分，以体现本地现实、行业需求和全球新趋势。

title: Adversarial-cost Screening: A Validation Framework for Export Control, Sanctions, and Supply-chain Counterparty Programs
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Adversarial-cost Screening: A Validation Framework for Export Control, Sanctions, and Supply-chain Counterparty Programs

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Declaration of interest. The author is the principal of Sanctir LLC, an independent research and advisory practice that provides services in the compliance domains this paper analyzes, including CMMC / NIST SP 800-171, export controls, and sanctions. This paper is independent analysis; it was self-funded, was not commissioned or funded by any client or third party, and reflects no client or agency position. The author has no other financial or non-financial interests to disclose. No party reviewed or approved the paper prior to submission.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval. This study did not involve human participants, animal subjects, or the collection of personal or identifiable data, and therefore no ethics committee or institutional review board approval was required. The research is based solely on publicly available statutes, regulations, court records, and government enforcement releases.
declarations.funderStatement: Funding. This research received no specific grant or financial support from any funding agency, commercial entity, or not-for-profit body. The work was conducted independently and self-funded by the author through Sanctir LLC.

detail.abstract: Working paper-SCREEN-01, version 1.5 • August 8, 2026 Preliminary draft; comments welcome. This version supersedes internal drafts 1.0-1.4. License: CC BY 4.0 Abstract. Counterparty screening programs in export control, sanctions, and defense supply-chain compliance are validated almost exclusively by process metrics-alert volume, clearance rate, list-coverage currency, screening latency. None of these measure whether the program detects the conduct it exists to detect. This paper identifies three structural defects common to these programs and specifies a validation framework that corrects them. The defects are: (1) endogenous label generation, in which outcome data is observable only for counterparties the program already flagged, making measured performance a function of the screening policy rather than of the threat; (2) entity resolution as the unmeasured binding constraint, in which screening accuracy is capped by the ability to recognize that nominally distinct counterparties are one operation, a capability no program reports on; and (3) adversary-controlled attribute dependence, in which screening weight concentrates on attributes the screened party can change at negligible cost while structurally costly attributes go unused. The framework specifies an exogenous sampling requirement, an entity-resolution maturity measure, an attribute-cost tiering scheme, and an evaluation battery that produces defensible estimates of screening effectiveness. It applies the result to reasonable-care determinations under EAR §732, to sanctions-compliance testing under OFAC's Framework, and to scienter and materiality analysis under the False Claims Act, including cybersecurity certification under the Civil Cyber-Fraud Initiative, where recent settlements supply worked illustrations of each failure mode.

AI.tldr: 本文指出出口管制、制裁和国防供应链合规中的交易对手筛查项目普遍仅以流程指标（如警报量、清关率）验证有效性，而非以实际检测能力为标准。作者识别了三个结构性缺陷：内生标签生成、实体解析作为未测量的绑定约束、以及受对手控制的属性依赖，并提出一套包含外生抽样要求、实体解析成熟度度量、属性成本分层和评估电池的验证框架，适用于EAR、OFAC和FCA等多种合规场景。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一套能够真实衡量交易对手筛查项目有效性的验证框架，以取代现有的流程指标验证方式？
AI.motivation: 现有筛查项目验证几乎完全依赖流程指标（警报量、清关率等），但这些指标无法衡量项目是否检测到了其本应检测的行为，导致合规验证存在系统性盲区。
AI.theoretical_framework: 筛查有效性理论、内生标签问题（标签选择偏差）、实体解析理论、属性成本经济学
AI.method: 结构性缺陷识别与分类、验证框架设计（包含外生抽样、实体解析成熟度度量、属性成本分层、评估电池），并结合具体法规场景（EAR、OFAC、FCA/CCFI）进行应用分析及案例验证。
AI.findings: 识别出三个结构性缺陷：内生标签生成导致测量偏差、实体解析能力未被报告且构成筛查精度的绑定约束、筛查权重集中于对手可低成本更改的属性。提出的验证框架可产生可辩护的筛查有效性估计，并在多种法规场景下适用。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地将筛查有效性从流程合规问题重构为可测量的检测能力问题，建立了外生抽样、实体解析成熟度和属性成本分层的理论框架，连接了合规验证与政策目标。
AI.practical_contributions: 为出口管制、制裁和国防供应链合规项目提供了具体的验证框架和实施指南，可直接应用于EAR合理注意判定、OFAC制裁合规测试、以及FCA和网络安全认证（CCFI）中的明知和实质性分析。

title: Determinants of Mobile Travel Application Adoption - A Causal Examination of Technology Acceptance Factors Among Diverse Consumer Segments

detail.title: Determinants of Mobile Travel Application Adoption - A Causal Examination of Technology Acceptance Factors Among Diverse Consumer Segments
detail.abstract: Aim : This research aims to identify, examine, and establish causal relationships between various technology acceptance factors and the adoption of mobile travel applications across different consumer segments. The study seeks to provide a comprehensive understanding of how perceived usefulness, perceived ease of use, trust, perceived risk, social influence, and other relevant factors differentially impact adoption decisions among diverse user groups. Methodology : This study employed a quantitative research design using primary data collected through pre-structured questionnaires from 209 multi-occupational participants via random sampling. The research instrument utilized multiple scale types including dichotomous questions, frequency-based and behavior-based Likert scales, ordinal scales, and rank-order questions covering four critical domains: factors influencing adoption decisions, features encouraging use, trust-related factors, and technology-related factors affecting continued usage. Demographic data including age, gender, and profession enabled segmentation analysis. Data analysis techniques combined descriptive statistics (mean, median, mode, standard deviation, variance) and single-factor ANOVA to examine relationships between variables and identify patterns across segments. Key Findings : Results revealed that the sample was gender-balanced (50.2% female) with majority (50.2%) aged 18-24, predominantly students (56.9%). Near-universal internet access (100%) and mobile app awareness (97.6%) were observed, with 85.6% preferring mobile travel apps over traditional agents. Perceived ease of use received highest positive response (122 "Always"), while trust showed more conservative patterns (103 "Always"). Ease of use garnered most first-rank selections (92), followed by accuracy of travel information (67). Online booking convenience overwhelmingly dominated feature preferences (100 first ranks), while secure payment gateway led trust factors (85 first ranks). App reliability emerged as critical for continued usage (87 first ranks). High within-group variance (4,972-7,582) indicated diverse opinions even within segments. Younger users prioritized social influence and perceived usefulness, while trust and security showed increasing importance with age. Implications : The research establishes that no single determinant universally drives adoption; different factor combinations create sufficient conditions within specific segments. For developers, findings indicate core functionality priorities (booking convenience, app reliability) while revealing segment-specific opportunities: social features for younger users, simplified interfaces for less tech-savvy segments. Trust-building requires comprehensive approaches addressing payment security, pricing transparency, data privacy, and support availability. Marketers should leverage social influence through reviews and user-generated content, while employing segment-tailored messaging. The 14.4% preferring traditional agents represent an addressable segment requiring hybrid models and educational interventions. These insights enable practitioners to develop targeted strategies addressing segment-specific barriers and motivators, while advancing theoretical understanding of technology acceptance in high-involvement mobile commerce contexts.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过定量方法（209名多职业受访者）调查移动旅游应用的技术接受因素，发现感知易用性、信任、在线预订便利性等不同因素在不同消费者细分群体中对采纳决策具有差异化影响，没有任何单一决定因素能普遍驱动采纳行为。
AI.research_question: 不同技术接受因素（感知有用性、感知易用性、信任、感知风险、社会影响等）如何在不同消费者细分群体中对移动旅游应用的采纳产生差异化影响？
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏对移动旅游应用采纳中多因素跨细分群体差异化影响的全面理解，需要识别不同用户群体中技术接受因素与采纳决策之间的因果关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术接受模型（TAM），涵盖感知有用性、感知易用性、信任、感知风险、社会影响等扩展因素。
AI.method: 定量研究设计，通过预结构化问卷收集209名多职业参与者的主要数据，采用随机抽样，使用多种量表类型（二分法、李克特量表、顺序量表、排序问题），结合描述性统计和单因素方差分析（ANOVA）进行数据分析。
AI.findings: 样本性别均衡（50.2%女性），以18-24岁（50.2%）和学生（56.9%）为主；互联网接入率100%，85.6%偏好移动旅游应用；感知易用性获得最高正面响应，信任表现较保守；在线预订便利性主导功能偏好，安全支付网关主导信任因素；组内方差大（4,972-7,582）表明细分群体内意见多样；年轻用户优先考虑社会影响和感知有用性，信任和安全性随年龄增长重要性增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 证实没有任何单一决定因素能普遍驱动采纳行为，不同因素组合在特定细分群体中构成充分条件，推进了高参与度移动商务情境下的技术接受理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为开发者提供核心功能优先级（预订便利性、应用可靠性）和细分群体特定机会（年轻用户的社会功能、简化界面）；为信任建设提供综合路径（支付安全、定价透明度、数据隐私、支持可用性）；为营销者提供社交影响利用和细分定制信息传播策略；识别14.4%偏好传统代理人群体的混合模式和教育干预机会。

title: Research State: A Candidate Semantic Abstraction for Knowledge Continuity in AI-Native Research Operating Systems
affiliations: and

detail.title: Research State: A Candidate Semantic Abstraction for Knowledge Continuity in AI-Native Research Operating Systems
detail.abstract:
The increasing use of large language models, research agents, scientific knowledge graphs, and workflow automation is transforming how scientific investigations are conducted. These technologies provide capable mechanisms for memory, provenance, knowledge representation, workflow execution, and agent interaction. Yet these mechanisms remain distributed across different system abstractions. Persistent agent-state research addresses durable operational state and governance (Ding et al., 2026); workflow-provenance systems represent execution and data lineage (Souza et al., 2025); scientific knowledge-orchestration systems represent entities, claims, evidence, methodological relations, and increasingly, research-agent workflows and executable tool interfaces (Cao et al., 2026); and knowledge-continuity frameworks address the preservation of actionable knowledge across organizational transitions (Türüc, 2026). What remains insufficiently specified is a common abstraction for the evolving semantic condition of a scientific investigation itself-an abstraction that explicitly integrates the multiple dimensions of research continuity within a single, model-agnostic construct.
This paper proposes Research State as a candidate semantic abstraction for AI-native Research Operating Systems. Drawing on design theory (Gregor & Jones, 2007; Walls et al., 1992), Research State is defined as a persistent, research-semantic, and model-agnostic representation of the evolving condition of a scientific investigation. The construct explicitly integrates eight dimensions—identity, knowledge, evidence, governance, workflow, execution, interaction, and recovery—within a single abstraction designed to preserve coherence across the entire research lifecycle. Following the principle of separation of concerns (Dijkstra, 1982) and the tradition of abstract data types (Liskov & Zilles, 1974), we distinguish Research State as a conceptual construct from Research State Object (RSO) as one possible concrete representation.
The construct is developed through a targeted construct-boundary mapping across four adjacent domains. The resulting analysis identifies integration, purpose, semantic, explicitness, and independence gaps within the reviewed corpus. We formulate three candidate system-level properties—cross-dimensional consistency, model-agnostic resumability, and research-lifecycle coherence—as testable design propositions rather than empirical findings. Two analytical walkthroughs, following the analytical evaluation tradition in design science (Hevner et al., 2004), illustrate how these propositions can be evaluated after implementation. 
 The contribution of this paper is a design-theoretical proposal. Within the reviewed corpus, we did not identify a construct that explicitly defines all eight dimensions as an integrated, research-semantic state abstraction whose persistent unit is the scientific investigation and whose semantic interpretation is intended to remain independent of a particular reasoning model. This work builds on two prior contributions: KAMDOL Academic OS (Sutrisno & Lastriyanto, 2026a), which validated a research risk intelligence capability, and KamiOS (Sutrisno & Lastriyanto, 2026b), which proposed the Research Operating System architecture. The present paper formalizes the candidate semantic state abstraction that such a Research Operating System manages—a contribution that is conceptual and definitional rather than architectural or capability-specific.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"研究状态"（Research State）作为一种AI原生研究操作系统（Research Operating Systems）的语义抽象构念，将科学调查的八维度（身份、知识、证据、治理、工作流、执行、交互和恢复）整合为一个持久化、研究语义化且模型无关的单一抽象，并基于设计科学理论提出三个可测试的设计命题。
AI.research_question: 如何在AI驱动的科学研究生态中，构建一个统一的语义抽象构念，以整合科学调查演化状态的多重维度（身份、知识、证据、治理、工作流、执行、交互、恢复），从而实现研究连续性的持久化表示？
AI.motivation: 现有技术（大语言模型、研究代理、科学知识图谱、工作流自动化）提供了记忆、溯源、知识表示、工作流执行和代理交互等分布式机制，但这些机制分散在不同系统抽象中，缺乏一个能够整合研究连续性多维度、模型无关的统一抽象构念。
AI.theoretical_framework: 设计理论（Gregor & Jones, 2007; Walls et al., 1992）、关注点分离原则（Dijkstra, 1982）、抽象数据类型传统（Liskov & Zilles, 1974）、设计科学研究中的分析性评估传统（Hevner et al., 2004）。
AI.method: 通过跨四个相邻领域的定向构念边界映射（construct-boundary mapping），识别综述语料中的整合、目的、语义、明确性和独立性差距；提出三个候选系统级属性作为可测试的设计命题；采用设计科学的分析性评估传统，通过两个分析性走查（analytical walkthroughs）说明命题如何在实现后被评估。
AI.findings: 在综述语料中未识别出能够将八个维度显式定义为一个整合的、研究语义状态抽象的构念；确定了相邻领域中的整合、目的、语义、明确性和独立性五类差距；提出了跨维度一致性、模型无关可恢复性和研究生命周期连贯性三个候选系统级设计命题。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"研究状态"（Research State）作为设计理论性概念贡献，将八维度（身份、知识、证据、治理、工作流、执行、交互、恢复）整合为单一、持久化、研究语义且模型无关的状态抽象；区分Research State（概念构念）与Research State Object/RSO（具体表示），遵循关注点分离原则；在综述语料中填补了缺乏整合研究连续性多维度统一抽象的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI原生研究操作系统的设计和实现提供了概念基础——明确定义了系统应管理的语义状态抽象的性质和边界；建立了三个可测试的设计命题（跨维度一致性、模型无关可恢复性、研究生命周期连贯性），为后续实现和实证评估提供了评估框架；为研究风险智能能力（KAMDOL Academic OS）和研究操作系统架构（KamiOS）提供了正式的语义状态基础。

title: PALISADE: A Passive-Acoustic Silent Wall for Low-Cost, Rapidly-Fieldable Counter-UAS Defence of Critical Infrastructure on NATO's Eastern Flank

detail.title: PALISADE: A Passive-Acoustic Silent Wall for Low-Cost, Rapidly-Fieldable Counter-UAS Defence of Critical Infrastructure on NATO's Eastern Flank

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest. This work is independent and unfunded. It was not commissioned, sponsored, or financially supported by any government body, defence contractor, or commercial entity, and the author has no financial or commercial interest in the concept described. The system concept is offered for the benefit of national and allied defence; no product is being sold.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This is a conceptual and policy study involving no human participants, patients, or personal data; no ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Small, low-flying, low-observable uncrewed aerial systems (UAS) are penetrating the airspace of NATO's eastern flank and reaching critical energy and transport infrastructure while remaining undetected by conventional, radar-centric integrated air and missile defence (IAMD). The economics compound the problem: intercepting a drone that costs hundreds to tens of thousands of euros with a surface-to-air missile that costs a seven-figure sum is not sustainable at scale, and adversaries exploit precisely this cost asymmetry. This study proposes PALISADE, a passive-acoustic-led, multi-sensor, layered and highly automated counter-UAS (C-UAS) architecture designed for the affordable, rapid protection of fixed critical infrastructure and border sectors. The core detection layer is passive: distributed acoustic sensor arrays perform wide-area cueing without emitting, making them resilient to electronic warfare and to anti-radiation targeting; acoustic cues are fused with radio-frequency, passive-radar and electro-optical/infrared sensing and classified by an on-edge and central artificial-intelligence layer. Engagement is human-on-the-loop and doctrinally confined to pre-designated neutralisation zones to eliminate risk to population and infrastructure. The paper argues that such a system is deployable within approximately twenty-four months at a small fraction of the capital cost of missile-based coverage, and positions PALISADE not as a substitute for the EU's Readiness 2030 / SAFE and European Drone Defence Initiative trajectory or NATO IAMD, but as a fast, low-cost national accelerator that de-risks and complements them. Selected technical specifications are restricted and available to vetted partners on request.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PALISADE架构，一种以被动声学为主导、多传感器融合、分层且高度自动化的反无人机（C-UAS）系统，旨在以低成本快速保护关键基础设施和边境区域，应对北约东翼小型低空隐身无人机渗透威胁，并解决导弹拦截成本不对称的经济问题。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一套经济上可持续、部署快速且能在电子战环境中生存的被动式反无人机系统，以保护关键基础设施免受低成本无人机渗透威胁？
AI.motivation: 小型低空隐身无人机能够穿透北约东翼领空，并绕过依赖雷达的传统综合防空反导系统（IAMD）命中关键能源和交通基础设施。同时存在严重的经济不对称问题：用七位数成本的防空导弹拦截仅花费数百至数万欧元的无人机在经济上不可持续，敌方正利用这一成本不对称进行攻击。
AI.theoretical_framework: 被动声学探测理论、多传感器数据融合理论、人工智能边缘计算与集中推理、人机协同（human-on-the-loop）指挥控制理论、分层防御架构理论。
AI.method: 提出PALISADE架构设计：以分布式声学传感器阵列为核心进行广域提示（cueing），融合射频、无源雷达和光电/红外传感数据，通过边缘与中心AI分层进行分类决策；拦截采用人在回路机制，且在预定中和区内执行以消除对民众和基础设施的风险。
AI.findings: 该架构可在约24个月内部署，资本成本仅为导弹拦截方案的极小部分；PALISADE定位为欧盟Readiness 2030/SAFE、欧洲无人机防御倡议及北约IAMD的低成本、快速国家加速器，而非替代方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种以被动声学为主导替代雷达中心论的C-UAS架构范式，论证了被动式传感器网络在电子战抗毁性和反辐射定位规避方面的理论优势，并将成本不对称问题纳入防御架构设计的核心考量。
AI.practical_contributions: 为北约东翼国家和欧盟提供了一套可在24个月内快速部署、低成本的反无人机保护方案，可加密钥基础设施和边境区域；该方案与现有欧盟和北约防御倡议形成互补和加速作用。

title: Blockchain-Enabled Audit Infrastructure and the Feasibility of Restaurant-Level Public Listing: A Conceptual Framework and Research Agenda
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Blockchain-Enabled Audit Infrastructure and the Feasibility of Restaurant-Level Public Listing: A Conceptual Framework and Research Agenda
detail.abstract: Single-unit restaurants are among the most operationally tight retail supply chains in the economy, yet they almost never reach public-market scale as standalone entities. The conventional explanation is cost: the fixed costs of going public are high, and restaurants' historical reliance on cash and paper-based settlement makes financial-statement audit disproportionately expensive relative to firm size. Two developments motivate a reconsideration of this constraint: the near-complete digitization of restaurant point-of-sale payments, and the emergence of blockchain-based distributed ledgers, which proponents argue can lower the marginal cost of audit verification by design. This paper synthesizes three literatures that bear on this question but have not previously been connectedblockchain/triple-entry accounting research, the economics of going public, and behavioral finance research on local investor bias and dynamic market formation-and evaluates them specifically against the operational and financial characteristics of the restaurant industry. It proposes a five-layer reference architecture for restaurant-scale ledger infrastructure, derives four testable propositions, and positions the argument relative to adjacent 2025-2026 developments in SME asset tokenization and institutional tokenized-IPO infrastructure. The paper's central claim is that a purely static cost-benefit framing-the dominant mode in both the accounting and corporate-finance literatures-is insufficient to evaluate this question, because investor demand for restaurant equity is plausibly governed by dynamic, expectation-driven, and locally-biased behavior that a fixed-parameter cost model cannot capture.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨单店餐厅几乎无法以独立实体达到公开市场规模的原因，认为传统解释（上市固定成本高、现金/纸质结算导致审计成本过高）已因POS支付数字化和区块链分布式账本的发展而需重新审视。论文整合了区块链/三式记账会计研究、上市经济学、行为金融学（本地投资者偏好与动态市场形成）三大文献，针对餐饮业运营与财务特征提出五层参考架构和四个可检验命题，并主张静态成本收益分析不足以评估该问题，因为投资者对餐饮股权的需求受动态、预期驱动和本地偏好行为支配。
AI.research_question: 在支付数字化和区块链账本技术背景下，单店餐厅是否可能突破上市约束？评估这一问题的框架应如何超越传统的静态成本收益分析？
AI.motivation: 单店餐厅作为运营最紧凑的零售供应链，几乎从未以独立实体达到公开市场上市规模。传统解释集中于上市固定成本和审计成本过高，但POS支付全面数字化和区块链分布式账本的出现使这一约束需要重新评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 区块链/三式记账会计理论；上市公司经济学；行为金融学中的本地投资者偏差和动态市场形成理论。
AI.method: 文献综述与理论综合，提出五层参考架构，推导四个可检验命题，并结合2025-2026年SME资产代币化和机构代币化IPO基础设施发展进行定位分析。
AI.findings: 核心主张是：静态成本收益框架（会计和公司金融文献的主导分析模式）不足以评估餐厅上市问题，因为投资者对餐饮股权的需求受动态、预期驱动和本地偏差行为支配，这是固定参数成本模型无法捕捉的。
AI.theory_contributions: 将区块链/三式记账会计、上市经济学与行为金融学三大此前未关联的文献首次连接起来；挑战了静态成本收益分析的支配地位，提出动态、行为驱动的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为餐厅级账本基础设施提出五层参考架构；推导四个可检验命题；与2025-2026年SME资产代币化和机构代币化IPO基础设施的最新发展对接，为餐饮业上市可行性提供实践指引。

title: Health Data Work: An Activity-Theory-Based Qualitative Study of Health Data Professionals
affiliations: , McGill University, University of Toronto and University of Toronto

detail.title: Health Data Work: An Activity-Theory-Based Qualitative Study of Health Data Professionals

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflict of interest
declarations.ethicsApproval: The study was approved by the University of Toronto Research Ethics Board, protocol #45480
declarations.funderStatement: Social Sciences and Humanities Research Council of Canada, Reference #430-2023-00178)

detail.abstract:
Introduction: Data work, performed by data professionals, is at the center of the learning cycle of learning health systems. It has the potential to help improve health care, patient and population health, clinicians’ wellbeing, cost efficiency, and health equity. Better understanding of data work and the contextual factors that affect it may help reveal best practices, required skills, and barriers; streamline policies; design better tools for health DS; improve workflow; and inform education and training. 

Methods: We conducted semi-structured interviews with 11 participants, collected activity diaries from 3 participants and analyzed the data qualitatively using a Cultural Historical Activity Theory framework. 

Results: Our findings suggest that health data work involves four interconnected activities with a shared goal of providing data-informed solutions to clinical or administrative problems: 1) model and product development, 2) project management, 3) communication, and 4) education and change management. Key tensions and challenges emerged related to data availability, privacy regulations, and interdisciplinary collaboration. 

Discussion: Whereas communication is widely recognized as an essential skill for data professionals, competencies of project and change management were critical yet underdeveloped. Improving healthcare data work would require policies that promote data sharing and collaboration while protecting privacy, and training in project management, change management, and applicable regulations.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过半结构化访谈和活动日记，运用文化历史活动理论框架，揭示了健康医疗数据工作涉及四个相互关联的活动（模型与产品开发、项目管理、沟通、教育与变革管理），并识别出数据可用性、隐私法规和跨学科协作方面的关键张力与挑战。
AI.research_question: 健康医疗数据专业人员的数据工作包含哪些活动？影响数据工作的情境因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 数据工作是学习型健康系统学习循环的核心，理解数据工作及其情境因素有助于揭示最佳实践、所需技能和障碍，改进流程、政策、工具设计与教育培训。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文化历史活动理论（Cultural Historical Activity Theory, CHAT）
AI.method: 对11名参与者进行半结构化访谈，收集3名参与者的活动日记，并使用文化历史活动理论框架进行定性数据分析。
AI.findings: 健康数据工作包含四个相互关联的活动：1）模型与产品开发，2）项目管理，3）沟通，4）教育与变革管理。关键张力与挑战涉及数据可用性、隐私法规和跨学科协作。
AI.theory_contributions: 运用文化历史活动理论框架系统性地描绘了健康数据工作的活动结构及其内在张力，揭示了数据工作不仅是技术任务，还涉及项目管理、沟通和变革管理等社会性活动。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议制定促进数据共享与协作同时保护隐私的政策，并加强数据专业人员在项目管理、变革管理及相关法规方面的培训。

title: Eclectic Intelligence - Toward a Meta-Skill for Leading Through Chaos, Confusion, and Confluence

detail.title: Eclectic Intelligence - Toward a Meta-Skill for Leading Through Chaos, Confusion, and Confluence
detail.abstract: Leadership scholarship has produced a series of named intelligences, emotional, cultural, and, drawing on Aristotle, practical intelligence, each capturing a real and distinct capability. This paper argues that none of these constructs alone, accounts for how leaders actually move through simultaneous chaos, confusion, and conflict, because each is bounded to a single domain: feeling, culture, or ethical judgement. It proposes Eclectic Intelligence as a meta-skill positioned above these domain-specific intelligences: the concurrent and permutable combination of linguistics, psychology, political science, and pan-cultural, indigenous and principle-based wisdom, applied to curate, aggregate, integrate and regenerate wisdom in order to lead self and others at a given moment. The paper positions this construct against emotional intelligence, cultural intelligence, phronesis, entrepreneurial bricolage, and adaptive leadership theory, arguing that its distinguishing features are concurrency, drawing on more than one discipline at once rather than sequentially, and permutability, letting the moment rather than a fixed process determine which discipline leads. The paper closes by noting the construct's current conceptual status and the empirical work required to operationalize it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"折中智能"（Eclectic Intelligence）作为一种超越特定领域智能的元技能，主张领导者需要同时运用语言学、心理学、政治学及跨文化智慧等多个学科，以并发性和可置换性为特征，应对混沌、混乱和冲突并存的复杂领导情境。
AI.research_question: 现有的领导力智能（情绪智能、文化智能、实践智能等）各自局限于单一领域，那么是否存在一种能够整合多领域智慧的元技能来解释领导者如何在混乱、混乱与冲突并存的情境中有效领导？
AI.motivation: 领导力研究已经产生了多种冠名智能（情绪智能、文化智能、实践智能），但每种智能都局限于单一领域（感觉、文化或伦理判断），无法单独解释领导者在面对同时出现的混乱、混乱和冲突时如何有效行动。因此需要提出一个概念上更高层次的、跨领域整合的智能构念。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以亚里士多德的实践智能（phronesis）传统为基础，对情绪智能、文化智能、实践智能、企业家拼凑（entrepreneurial bricolage）和适应性领导理论等现有框架进行批判性梳理与理论定位，提出"折中智能"这一新的元技能构念。
AI.method: 概念性/理论性论文：通过理论辨析与构念建构，将折中智能与现有智能构念进行对比分析，界定其独特特征（并发性与可置换性），并讨论其概念地位及未来实证研究需求。
AI.findings: 提出"折中智能"作为定位在领域特定智能之上的元技能，其独特特征包括：（1）并发性——同时而非依序运用多个学科；（2）可置换性——由当下情境而非固定流程决定哪个学科起主导作用。该构念区别于情绪智能、文化智能、实践智能等现有框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 在领导力理论上贡献了一个新的元技能构念"折中智能"，弥补了现有领域特定智能（情绪智能、文化智能、实践智能）在解释复杂多域领导情境上的不足，为领导力智能研究提供了更高层次的整合性理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为领导者提供了一种理解如何在多元、动态和冲突情境中灵活调动多领域智慧的认知框架，提示领导力教育和发展应重视跨学科智慧的同时调用与情境驱动的灵活应变能力。

title: A Model-Agnostic Level-Set Approach for Prescriptive Analytics
affiliations: Julius-Maximilians-University Wuerzburg and Business Administration & Economics

detail.title: A Model-Agnostic Level-Set Approach for Prescriptive Analytics
detail.abstract: Data-driven approaches that leverage machine learning for stochastic optimization with contextual information ('prescriptive analytics') have received considerable attention in recent years. However, existing approaches often rely on the inherent properties of specific models or require problemspecific modifications and training. Motivated by this limitation, we propose a novel framework that allows practitioners to leverage any machine learning model for prescriptive analytics. We introduce a new class of kernel functions that measure similarity through proximity in the prediction space ('level-set approach'). The resulting kernel values can be integrated into existing data-driven optimization techniques that rely on sample weighting or kernel-based transformations. We establish asymptotic optimality under mild assumptions when our method is applied to weighted sample average approximation and demonstrate consistent translation of predictive into prescriptive performance through various numerical experiments on synthetic and real-world data. Our experiments show that using state-of-the-art models within our framework yields substantial cost reductions relative to existing benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种新的预测性分析框架，通过引入"水平集"核函数来测量预测空间中的相似性，使得任何机器学习模型都可以直接用于随机优化的数据驱动求解，并证明了加权重样本平均近似下的渐近最优性。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个通用框架，使得任意机器学习模型都能直接用于带上下文信息的随机优化（预测性分析），而不需要针对特定模型或问题做特定的修改和训练？
AI.motivation: 现有的数据驱动优化方法通常依赖于特定模型的固有属性，或需要针对具体问题进行专门的修改和训练，缺乏通用性。这限制了预测性分析在实际应用中的灵活性和可扩展性，因此需要一种能够即插即用地整合任意机器学习模型的通用框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 水平集（level-set）核函数方法、加权重样本平均近似（weighted sample average approximation）、预测性分析（prescriptive analytics）、数据驱动随机优化
AI.method: 提出一类新的核函数，通过预测空间的邻近性（level-set approach）来衡量样本相似性，将生成的核值整合到基于样本加权或核变换的现有数据驱动优化技术中；并利用多种机器学习模型在合成数据和真实数据上进行数值实验验证。
AI.findings: 在温和假设下，该方法应用于加权重样本平均近似时具有渐近最优性；数值实验表明预测表现能一致地转化为决策表现，使用最先进的机器学习模型在该框架内相比现有基准可带来显著的成本降低。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出一种与模型无关（model-agnostic）的预测性分析框架，通过水平集核函数将任意机器学习模型与数据驱动优化桥梁化，为预测到决策的转化建立了通用的理论基础，并在理论上证明了其渐近最优性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实践者提供了即插即用式的预测性分析工具，可以直接使用最新最先进的机器学习模型无需额外修改，从而显著降低实施成本并提升决策优化的经济效果。

title:
Who Will Defend Nigeria?
The Recruitment and Retention Crisis Facing the Nigerian Army

detail.title:
Who Will Defend Nigeria?
The Recruitment and Retention Crisis Facing the Nigerian Army

declarations.ethicsApproval: This brief does not report findings from a formal study involving identifiable patients or participants. It draws on publicly available secondary sources and the author's informal community engagement, and no personally identifying information was collected. No formal ethics approval was required or sought.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was self-funded by the author.

detail.abstract: Nigeria is expanding its military footprint at the same moment it is struggling to fill its ranks. New recruit training depots have opened, national recruitment intakes have been launched, and army chiefs have repeatedly appealed to parents and traditional rulers in the SouthEast to send their children to enlist. At the same time, entire battalions have suffered attacks that left dozens of soldiers unaccounted for, and the Army has had to publicly deny viral claims of mass desertion even as it manages real, documented cases of personnel declared absent without leave. This brief argues that Nigeria's security crisis is not simply a question of how many soldiers the country can recruit on paper. It is a question of whether military service, as currently structured, is trusted, respected, and rewarded enough to attract and retain the people the country needs to defend it. Two arguments sit at the centre of this brief, developed from the author's own community engagement and field observation across SouthEast Nigeria: first, that public trust in the Army has been eroded by the perception that troops are deployed as often against manufactured political threats as against genuine national ones; and second, that the enlisted recruit, the backbone of the fighting force, is treated as institutionally disposable compared to the officer produced through the Nigerian Defence Academy. The brief closes with a policy action matrix mapping each identified problem to a specific institutional response, timeline, and expected outcome.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨尼日利亚军队面临的核心困境：在招募困难与安全危机并存的背景下，军队服务是否被信任、尊重和回报，足以吸引并留住国家所需的兵力。作者通过尼日利亚东南部的社区参与和实地观察，提出两大核心论点：公众对军队的信任因军队被用于对付政治威胁而非真正的国家威胁而受到侵蚀；士兵（enlisted recruit）相对于军官被制度性地视为可弃置的。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚军队在面临招募困难和频繁人员损失的背景下，军事服务作为一项制度安排，是否被公众信任、尊重和奖励到足以吸引和保留维持国家安全所需的人员？
AI.motivation: 尼日利亚正在扩大军事足迹，但同时面临新兵招募困难、士兵失踪、大规模脱逃传闻等多重危机。传统上将安全问题简化为"能招募多少士兵"的量化问题，无法解释军队人员短缺的深层制度性原因。
AI.theoretical_framework: 军事社会学中关于军事服务的信任、尊重与奖励机制的理论视角，强调军事招募与保留不仅是一个数量问题，更是一个制度合法性与激励结构问题。
AI.method: 基于作者在尼日利亚东南部的社区参与和实地观察所开展的定性研究，采用政策简报（policy brief）的形式呈现论证。
AI.findings: 两大核心发现：(1)公众对军队的信任因军队频繁被用于对付受到制造的政治威胁而非真正的国家威胁而受到侵蚀；(2)作为战斗力量支柱的应征士兵相较于通过尼日利亚国防学院培养的军官，在制度上被视为可弃置的，二者待遇存在结构性不平等。
AI.theory_contributions: 将尼日利亚军事危机从"招募数量"问题重新框定为"军事服务的制度合法性"问题，提出军事服务作为一种社会契约的信任、尊重和回报三个维度，丰富了军事社会学对后殖民国家军队人员危机的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供一个政策行动矩阵，将每个识别出的问题映射到具体的制度应对措施、时间线和预期结果，为尼日利亚国防决策者提供了可操作的政策建议框架。

title: Business Strategy and Artificial Intelligence

detail.title: Business Strategy and Artificial Intelligence

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no conflicts of interest that could have influenced the research, analysis, or conclusions presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study because it is based on analysis of published literature, comparative research, and publicly available case studies and does not involve human participants, personal data, or animal subjects.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific funding from any public, commercial, or not-for-profit organization.

detail.abstract: AI is a high-tech technology that is rapidly emerging as an important force in the competitive nature of businesses today. This study examines what the emerging application of AI tools, specifically machine learning, data analytics, and predictive modeling, are doing to the process of making, implementing, and evaluating strategic decisions made by companies. This paper will explore the strategic advantage, problem and the impact of applying AI in the business processes based on the analysis of multiple literature sources, comparative research and case studies. The results suggest that AI is much faster and more accurate in decision-making compared to the conventional strategic planning approach, which encourages innovation by transforming raw data into meaningful information that can be taken by leaders. Also, organizations that are utilizing AI technologies are more flexible, efficient, and competitive in comparison to conventional companies. However, the study concludes that the main areas of concern that continue to limit the use of AI sustainably are ethical transparency, data bias, and data governance. Digital illiteracy and cultural opposition among the employees also contribute greatly to the negative aspects of AI implementation and alignment to the strategic intent. The proposed conceptual framework connects three key components, such as AI Integration Layer, Strategic Alignment and Performance Outcomes, that proves the contribution of intelligent systems to the creation of strategic coherence. The reallife examples of converting AI and business strategy have been demonstrated to possess a realistic value in such companies like Amazon, Tesla, or Google. These findings are considered to be useful in the development of a single model of AIbased strategic management, and the focus on the continuation of evaluation, ethics governance, and defining dynamic capabilities is the key to the success of the digital era.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过文献综述、比较研究和案例分析法，探讨了AI工具（机器学习、数据分析、预测建模）在企业战略决策制定、实施与评估过程中的作用。研究表明，AI相比于传统战略规划方法在决策速度和准确性上更具优势，能够将原始数据转化为有用的信息以促进创新。采用AI的企业在灵活性、效率和竞争力方面均优于传统企业，但伦理透明度、数据偏见、数据治理、数字文盲和员工文化抵触等问题仍制约着AI的可持续应用。文章提出了连接AI集成层、战略对齐和绩效结果的 conceptual framework，并以亚马逊、特斯拉和谷歌等公司为案例验证了AI与商业战略结合的现实价值。
AI.research_question: 新兴AI工具（机器学习、数据分析、预测建模）如何影响企业战略决策的制定、实施与评估过程？以及它们在提供战略优势的同时面临哪些挑战？
AI.motivation: AI正迅速成为影响企业竞争态势的重要力量，但学术界对其在战略管理中的实际应用效果、优势与挑战缺乏系统性的整合分析。本研究旨在通过多源文献、比较研究和案例分析，构建一个理解AI在战略决策中作用的统一框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文提出一个将AI集成层（AI Integration Layer）、战略对齐（Strategic Alignment）与绩效结果（Performance Outcomes）三个关键组成部分相连接的概念框架，用以解释智能系统如何促进战略一致性的形成。
AI.method: 采用多源文献分析、比较研究法以及案例分析法（以亚马逊、特斯拉、谷歌为典型案例），综合探讨AI在战略管理中的应用。
AI.findings: （1）AI在决策速度和准确性上显著优于传统战略规划方法；（2）AI能将原始数据转化为有意义的信息，促进领导者创新；（3）采用AI的组织在灵活性、效率和竞争力上优于传统企业；（4）伦理透明度、数据偏见和数据治理是限制AI可持续应用的主要问题；（5）数字文盲和员工文化抵触是AI实施与战略意图对齐的主要障碍。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了连接AI集成层、战略对齐与绩效结果的三元概念框架，为AI驱动的战略管理提供了理论模型，强调了持续评估、伦理治理和动态能力定义在数字时代战略成功中的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 通过亚马逊、特斯拉、谷歌等真实案例展示了AI与商业战略融合的现实价值，为企业在数字化转型中开发和实施基于AI的战略管理模型提供了具有参考意义的实践指导。

title: AI Governance Is Failing Because It Eliminates Opportunity: A Hybrid Organisational Governance Model Using Bayesian Reasoning

detail.title: AI Governance Is Failing Because It Eliminates Opportunity: A Hybrid Organisational Governance Model Using Bayesian Reasoning

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author serves as AI Transformation Director of AI Organisational Design (In Formation, Edinburgh). AI Organisational Design operates as an emerging research and practice initiative and is not yet established as a formal legal entity. In addition to this role, the author provides independent consulting on AI operating models, including the development of architectural concepts and governance frameworks that align with the principles discussed in this manuscript. Neither the initiative nor the consulting activities involve the operation of production systems, and neither exerts influence over the research presented here. These professional responsibilities may reasonably be perceived as informing the conceptual framing or strategic positioning of AI Governance Is Failing Because It Eliminates Opportunity within broader AI and governance domains.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research is theoretical and architectural in nature. It does not involve human subjects, personal data, behavioural tracking, experimentation or clinical procedures. No private, sensitive or identifiable human information was collected or processed. In accordance with standard academic practice, institutional review board (IRB) approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The work was conducted independently by the author in his capacity as AI Transformation Director of AI Organisational Design (In Formation), Edinburgh). The organisation did not provide financial support for the research, and no institutional resources were used that could influence the findings or conclusions presented in this manuscript.

detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence governance remains dominated by deterministic controls that rely on fixed rules, binary thresholds and procedural workflows. These mechanisms create stability and predictability, but they suppress uncertainty (Knight, 1921), eliminate variance (Holland, 1998) and constrain opportunity (Schumpeter, 1934). Deterministic governance is structurally incapable of supporting outcome optimisation because it treats uncertainty as failure, interprets variance as instability and prevents organisations from learning from deviation (Argyris and Schön, 1978; March, 1991). Opportunity is inherently unexpected. When uncertainty is eliminated, opportunity is eliminated with it. This paper presents an architectural governance model grounded in Bayesian reasoning. Bayesian networks treat variance as information, represent causal dependencies and evaluate expected outcomes (Pearl, 2009; Koller and Friedman, 2009; Savage, 1954). They provide a structural mechanism for governing uncertainty rather than eliminating it. This enables organisations to quantify uncertainty, propagate risk (Fenton and Neil, 2018), simulate alternative futures and improve decision quality over time (Simon, 1955). The architectural model formalised in this paper is not theoretical. It is informed by empirical observation and operational experience gained in environments where uncertainty, complexity and risk required governance models capable of representing causal structure and optimising outcomes (Simon, 1962; Gell‑Mann, 1994). The specific implementation context cannot be referenced due to national security constraints. However, the architectural principles presented here reflect practices validated in real‑world conditions where deterministic governance was insufficient (Power, 1997; Hood, 2011) and Bayesian reasoning was required. The paper demonstrates that deterministic governance eliminates opportunity through structural, procedural and epistemic mechanisms (Bovens and Zouridis, 2002; Hale and Borys, 2013; Dekker, 2011), and that Bayesian networks restore opportunity by enabling organisations to govern uncertainty, represent causality and optimise outcomes. It outlines implications for regulators, enterprises and system designers, and identifies a research agenda for advancing architectural governance in complex socio‑technical environments (Leveson, 2011; Hollnagel, 2012).

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于贝叶斯推理的架构治理模型，主张用贝叶斯网络替代确定性治理机制，将不确定性视为信息而非失败，从而保留机会、传播风险、模拟未来并持续优化决策质量。该模型源自真实环境中（因国家安全限制无法披露具体场景）的经验验证，并讨论了其对监管者、企业和系统设计者的启示。
AI.research_question: 确定性治理机制为何无法支持结果优化？贝叶斯推理能否以及如何提供一种架构治理模型，在治理不确定性的同时恢复机会空间？
AI.motivation: 现行人工智能治理过度依赖确定性控制（固定规则、二元阈值、程序化流程），虽然带来稳定与可预测性，但抑制不确定性、消除方差、限制机会，结构性地阻碍了组织从偏差中学习与结果优化。作者认为机会本质上是意外的，消除不确定性即消除机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝叶斯推理与贝叶斯网络理论（Pearl, 2009; Koller & Friedman, 2009）、不确定性经济学（Knight, 1921）、组织学习理论（Argyris & Schön, 1978; March, 1991）、有限理性与决策理论（Simon, 1955）、风险传播模型（Fenton & Neil, 2018）、复杂系统与社会技术系统理论（Leveson, 2011; Hollnagel, 2012）等。
AI.method: 概念架构建模与理论推演方法。本文不是实证研究，而是基于作者在高度不确定、复杂、高风险环境中获得的经验观察与运营实践（具体背景因国家安全限制无法披露），形式化构建了一个基于贝叶斯网络的架构治理模型，并通过结构性、程序性和认知性三个机制维度论证确定性治理如何消除机会。
AI.findings: （1）确定性治理通过结构性、程序性和认知性三种机制从根本上消除机会；（2）贝叶斯网络能够将方差视为信息、表征因果依赖、评估期望结果，为治理不确定性提供结构性机制；（3）贝叶斯治理使组织能够量化不确定性、传播风险、模拟替代性未来并随时间改进决策质量；（4）该架构原则已在确定性治理失效的实战环境中得到验证。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）将贝叶斯推理从统计工具提升为治理架构的理论基础，拓展了人工智能治理的理论框架；（2）从不确定性治理的视角重新审视治理与机会创造的关系，提出"消除不确定性即消除机会"的理论命题；（3）整合不确定性经济学、组织学习与贝叶斯决策理论，构建了跨学科的架构治理理论。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为监管者提供替代确定性控制的基于不确定性的治理原则；（2）为企业提供能够量化风险、模拟情景并持续优化决策的治理架构蓝图；（3）为系统设计者提供在复杂社会技术环境中设计适应性治理机制的方向；（4）提出推进架构治理的后续研究议程。

title: Beyond Cost Savings: A Hybrid ML-OR Pipeline for Risk-Quantified IOL Inventory Management in a Resource-Constrained LMIC Eye Hospital
affiliations: Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology, Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology and Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology

detail.title: Beyond Cost Savings: A Hybrid ML-OR Pipeline for Risk-Quantified IOL Inventory Management in a Resource-Constrained LMIC Eye Hospital
detail.abstract: High-value, clinically non-substitutable, and expiry-sensitive medical devices create a difficult inventory problem in resource-constrained logistics systems: stockouts disrupt service delivery while overstocking locks scarce working capital and generates waste. This paper presents a transferable, end-to-end hybrid Machine Learning and Operations Research (ML-OR) pipeline integrating demand forecasting (ARIMA and Random Forest), continuous-review (s, Q) policy design, discrete-event simulation with FIFO consumption and batch-level expiry, Monte Carlo risk evaluation, grid-based optimization, sensitivity analysis, and a differentiated capital-versus-expiry sustainability diagnostic. The pipeline is demonstrated on a real 24-month intraocular lens (IOL) inventory dataset from a high-volume eye hospital in Bangladesh performing cataract surgery, a representative resource-constrained LMIC setting. Five Class-A lenses accounted for approximately 78% of total IOL use, and Random Forest reduced total-demand forecast error (MAE) by 41.5% relative to ARIMA. The RF+RMSE baseline policies achieved a median service level of 100% for all five lenses, with no replication below the 95% target and negligible stockout probability. Optimization yielded additional savings (0-5.1% across lenses), for an overall portfolio saving of about 1.9%. The sustainability diagnostic showed significantly higher working-capital exposure for Class-A lenses, with potential capital release of around 6.17 million BDT, while genuine expiry risk was limited to slower moving tail. The primary contribution is a replicable, open-source template that hospitals and logistics systems managing high-value, perishable devices can adapt using only standard ledger data. The framework shows that where service continuity is clinically non-negotiable, analytics add the most value through risk quantification and differentiated decision rules, not large cost reductions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个可迁移的端到端混合机器学习与运筹学（ML-OR）流水线，用于解决资源受限物流系统中高价值、临床不可替代且易过期医疗设备的库存管理问题。该流水线在孟加拉国一家大型眼科医院24个月的晶状体（IOL）库存数据上进行了验证，随机森林将总需求预测误差（MAE）相对ARIMA降低了41.5%，优化后实现了100%的中位数服务水平，同时释放约617万孟加拉塔卡的营运资金。核心贡献在于提供了一个可复制的开源模板，通过风险量化和差异化决策规则而非大幅成本削减来增加价值。
AI.research_question: 在资源受限的物流系统中，如何设计一个可迁移的端到端方案来有效管理高价值、临床不可替代且易过期的医疗设备库存，在保证服务水平的同时平衡营运资本占用与过期风险？
AI.motivation: 高价值、临床不可替代且对过期敏感的医疗设备在资源受限系统中面临两难困境：缺货会中断服务交付，而过量库存会锁定稀缺营运资金并造成浪费。现有研究缺乏针对此类医疗器械的、可复制的端到端整合方案，尤其是在低收入和中等收入国家（LMIC）情境下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将其归纳为传统的库存管理理论，具体包括：需求预测理论（ARIMA与随机森林）、连续盘点（s, Q）库存策略、离散事件仿真（FIFO消耗与批次级过期）、蒙特卡洛风险评估、基于网格的优化方法，以及资本与过期可持续性诊断框架。
AI.method: 采用混合ML-OR流水线：(1) ARIMA和随机森林进行需求预测；(2) 设计连续盘点(s, Q)补货策略；(3) 使用离散事件仿真模拟FIFO消耗和批次过期；(4) 蒙特卡洛方法评估风险；(5) 基于网格搜索进行优化；(6) 敏感性分析和差异化资本-过期可持续性诊断。案例为孟加拉国一家高流量眼科医院的24个月IOL库存真实数据。
AI.findings: (1) 五类A类（高价值）晶状体占总使用量约78%；(2) 随机森林将总需求预测MAE较ARIMA降低41.5%；(3) RF+RMSE基准策略在所有五种镜片上实现100%中位服务水平，无任何复制低于95%目标，缺货概率可忽略；(4) 优化后实现每类0-5.1%的额外节约，整体投资组合节省约1.9%；(5) 可持续性诊断显示A类镜片营运资金暴露显著更高，可释放约617万BDT资金，而真正的过期风险仅限于慢速动销的尾部产品。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 提供了一个可复制的开源ML-OR整合框架，将需求预测、库存策略、仿真与优化有机结合；(2) 揭示了在临床服务连续性不可妥协的背景下，分析的价值主要体现在风险量化与差异化决策规则而非成本削减；(3) 提出了资本暴露与过期风险的差异化诊断方法，区分了高价值快动销与慢速动销产品的不同管理重点。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 医院和物流系统可使用仅含标准账本数据的方式适配此模板，无需额外数据基础设施；(2) 实证证明可释放约617万BDT的营运资金，同时维持100%服务水平；(3) 为LMIC情境下的高值易逝医疗器械库存管理提供了可直接落地的决策工具和开源代码。

From Crime to Economy: Understanding Nigeria's Kidnapping-for-Ransom Industry
How Ransom Financing, State Negotiation, and Digital Visibility Sustain Nigeria's Kidnapping-for-Ransom Industry A Security Analyst's Brief
