detail.title:
From Crime to Economy: Understanding Nigeria's Kidnapping-for-Ransom Industry
How Ransom Financing, State Negotiation, and Digital Visibility Sustain Nigeria's Kidnapping-for-Ransom Industry A Security Analyst's Brief

declarations.ethicsApproval: This brief does not report findings from a formal study involving identifiable patients or participants. It draws on publicly available secondary sources and the authors' informal community engagement, and no personally identifying information was collected. No formal ethics approval was required or sought.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was self-funded by the authors

detail.abstract: Kidnapping for ransom in Nigeria is no longer usefully described as a wave of isolated criminal incidents. It has become a functioning informal economy, one with its own suppliers, financiers, logistics networks, and a pricing model that adjusts in real time to what a victim's family, and increasingly their wider social network, can be made to raise. Billions of naira move through this system each year, circulating into motorcycles, weapons, fuel, and telecommunications services, and drawing in informants, negotiators, and, in some documented cases, complicit actors within formal structures. This brief argues that the persistence of this economy cannot be explained by criminal enterprise alone. It is sustained by a second, quieter development: government engagement with armed groups, most often through negotiation rather than confrontation, has in practice become a routine feature of crisis management in large parts of the country rather than an exceptional measure. Layered on top of both is a third, more recent accelerant, the rise of social media crowdfunding for ransom payments, which has begun to change how kidnappers calculate their demands, shifting the price of a hostage from what a family can afford to what a network can be mobilised to pay. Drawing on the author's own field observation and community engagement across SouthEast and NorthWest Nigeria, this brief traces these three dimensions, the economic structure, the governance response that sustains it, and the digital mechanism now accelerating it, as a single evolving system rather than three unrelated problems. It closes with a policy action matrix mapping each identified problem to a specific institutional response, timeline, and expected outcome.

AI.tldr: 本文认为尼日利亚的绑架赎金已不再是一系列孤立的犯罪事件，而是演变为一个功能性的非正规经济体系，涵盖供应商、融资方、物流网络和实时定价模型。该经济的持续存在由三个维度共同维持：经济结构（每年数十亿奈拉的赎金流动）、政府治理回应（通过谈判而非对抗已成为常态）、以及社交媒体众筹赎金这一数字加速机制。作者基于在尼日利亚东南部和西北部的实地观察与社区参与，将三者视为一个单一演进的系统，并提供一个政策行动矩阵。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚的绑架赎金现象如何演变为一个自我维持的非正规经济系统？其持续存在的机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 尼日利亚绑架勒索现象已从孤立的犯罪事件升级为大规模的非正规经济体，年流转数十亿奈拉，但现有理解多将其视为单一的犯罪问题，忽视了其经济结构、政府治理回应和数字机制之间的系统性关联。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非正规经济理论；犯罪经济学；国家-武装团体互动理论；危机管理中的谈判机制理论
AI.method: 作者基于在尼日利亚东南部和西北部的实地观察与社区参与，采用定性分析方法，对绑架经济的三重维度进行系统性追踪，并构建政策行动矩阵。
AI.findings: 1. 绑架赎金已成为一个健全的非正规经济体系，具有完整的供应链和实时定价机制；2. 政府与武装团体的谈判已成为常态化的危机管理手段，而非例外措施，这为绑架经济提供了持续的制度支持；3. 社交媒体众筹赎金改变了绑架者的要价逻辑——从家庭可负担的价格转向网络可动员的支付能力；4. 三者构成一个协同演进的系统而非独立问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 将绑架赎金现象从单纯的犯罪学视角拓展为系统性的非正规经济分析，提出了经济结构、治理回应与数字机制三重维度的整合分析框架，丰富了犯罪经济学与冲突治理的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个政策行动矩阵，将每个已识别的政策问题映射到具体的制度回应、时间线和预期结果，为决策者提供了可操作的应对框架。

title: From Placement Transaction to Knowledge Co-Production: A Maturity Framework for Industry-Integrated Business Schools
affiliations: Vijaybhoomi University

detail.title: From Placement Transaction to Knowledge Co-Production: A Maturity Framework for Industry-Integrated Business Schools
detail.abstract: Purpose. Management education continues to face a persistent gap between the knowledge it certifies and the capability that employers require. Industry integration is widely prescribed as the remedy, yet it remains conceptually under-specified and is frequently operationalised as an episodic menu of guest lectures, industrial visits and placement drives. This paper develops a conceptual framework that defines industry integration as an organisational capability rather than an activity set, and specifies how that capability develops. Design/methodology/approach. The paper adopts a theory-synthesis approach to conceptual development. It integrates five hitherto largely parallel literature streams — the rigour– relevance debate in management scholarship, Mode 2 knowledge production and boundaryspanning theory, experiential and work-integrated learning, graduate employability capital, and university–industry linkage research — into a single organising architecture, and derives testable propositions from that synthesis. Findings. The paper advances three linked contributions. First, it defines industry integration as the sustained, structurally embedded and reciprocal participation of practice-based actors in the design, delivery, assessment and renewal of management education and research. Second, it disaggregates the construct into six domains: governance and curriculum co-design; problembased and live-project pedagogy; work-integrated learning; faculty practice engagement; assessment and credentialing; and collaborative research. Third, it proposes a four-stage Industry Integration Maturity Model — Transactional, Supplementary, Collaborative and CoCreated — differentiated along locus of initiative, temporality, knowledge directionality, accountability and measurement. Eight propositions link maturity to graduate capability, faculty scholarly relevance, partner commitment and institutional legitimacy. Practical implications. The maturity model offers deans, accreditation bodies and policy actors a diagnostic instrument for locating current practice and sequencing investment, and reframes employability from a terminal placement outcome into a continuously produced institutional capability. Originality/value. Existing scholarship treats individual integration mechanisms in isolation. This paper is among the first to theorise them as a single, developmentally staged capability, and to situate that theorisation within the institutional conditions of a large emerging-economy management education system.

AI.tldr: 本文通过理论综合方法，将行业整合定义为企业（商学院）的组织能力而非一系列零散活动，并提出了包含六个领域的构念和四阶段成熟度模型（交易型、补充型、协作型、共创型），为管理教育弥合知识与能力之间的鸿沟提供了概念框架和可检验的命题。
AI.research_question: 行业整合如何从概念上被定义为一种组织能力而非活动集，以及这种能力如何阶段性发展？
AI.motivation: 管理教育持续存在知识认证与雇主所需能力之间的鸿沟；行业整合虽被广泛推荐为解决方案，但在概念上界定不足，常被操作化为零散的客座讲座、企业参访和实习安置等活动。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合了五条并行文献流：管理学中的严谨性-相关性辩论、Mode 2知识生产与边界跨越理论、体验式与工作整合学习、毕业生就业能力资本、大学-产业联结研究。
AI.method: 理论综合（theory-synthesis）方法进行概念开发，整合五条文献流，并从中推导出可检验的命题。
AI.findings: 三项贡献：1) 将行业整合定义为实践参与者持续、结构性嵌入且互惠地参与管理教育与研究的设计、交付、评估和更新；2) 将构念分解为六个领域：治理与课程共建、问题导向与真实项目教学法、工作整合学习、教师实践参与、评估与认证、协作研究；3) 提出四阶段行业整合成熟度模型（交易型、补充型、协作型、共创型），并以八个命题将成熟度与毕业生能力、教师学术相关性、伙伴承诺和机构合法性联系起来。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将此前被孤立研究的个体整合机制理论化为单一、分阶段发展的组织能力，并将其理论化置于大型新兴经济体管理教育体系的制度条件之中。
AI.practical_contributions: 成熟度模型为院长、认证机构和政策制定者提供诊断工具，用于定位当前实践并排序投资；将就业能力从终端安置结果重新框定为持续生产的机构能力。

title: Measuring the Invisible: A Preliminary Empirical Examination of Repeated Explanatory Labor Across Industrial Sectors

detail.title: Measuring the Invisible: A Preliminary Empirical Examination of Repeated Explanatory Labor Across Industrial Sectors

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no personal or financial relationships that could have influenced, or could reasonably be perceived to have influenced, this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study involved adult participants who provided responses for research purposes. No formal institutional ethics approval was obtained for this preliminary study. Participation was voluntary, and responses were collected for research purposes.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific funding from any public, commercial, or non-profit organization.

detail.abstract: Repeated explanation is a common but mostly invisible form of cognitive work inside organizations. Professionals often find themselves reconstructing the same tasks, decisions, and background knowledge for different people, especially when documentation is incomplete, knowledge disappears due to employee turnover, or informal communication becomes the main way teams coordinate. This study introduces Repeated Explanatory Labor (REL) as a measurable form of organizational cognitive burden, and it offers a preliminary empirical look at what causes it and what it does to employees cognitively. The study draws on a cross-sectional dataset of 232 frontline and knowledge workers from the information technology and business process services, automotive, FMCG, and pharmaceutical sectors in Rudrapur, India. REL is measured through three components: explanation frequency, audience span, and cognitive depth. The analysis looks at how documentation gaps, knowledge turnover, REL intensity, cognitive switching, and workload exhaustion relate to one another. Hierarchical regression results show that documentation gaps and knowledge turnover significantly predict explanatory labor, and cognitive depth is significantly linked to cognitive switching. An exploratory qualitative analysis also points to four mechanisms that generate and concentrate explanatory demand: documentation decay, dependency on informal channels, structural knowledge vacuums, and boundary ambiguity. These findings offer preliminary empirical support for REL as a distinct organizational phenomenon, and they suggest that when formal knowledge systems fail, the resulting coordination costs get pushed onto employees, who end up repeatedly reconstructing organizational context on their own. Given the cross-sectional design, self-reported measures, early-stage scale reliability, and some concerns around discriminant validity, these findings should be read as exploratory rather than causal or conclusive. The study lays an initial empirical foundation for further development and validation of the REL construct.

AI.tldr: 本研究首次提出并实证检验了"重复解释劳动"（REL）作为组织中一种可测量的认知负担形式。基于印度232名一线与知识工作者的横截面数据，研究发现文档缺口和知识流失显著预测解释性劳动，认知深度与认知切换显著相关，并识别出四种产生解释需求的机制。
AI.research_question: 重复解释劳动（REL）作为组织认知负担的成因是什么？它对员工认知有何影响？
AI.motivation: 组织中重复解释是一种常见但几乎不可见的认知工作形式，尤其在文档不完整、员工流失导致知识消失、非正式沟通成为主要协调方式时。现有研究缺少对这一现象的量化测量和实证考察。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织认知负担理论；知识管理理论；协调成本理论
AI.method: 横截面问卷调查（N=232），来自印度Rudrapur地区IT和业务流程服务、汽车、快消品和制药行业；采用层级回归分析+探索性质性分析；REL通过解释频率、受众范围和认知深度三个维度测量。
AI.findings: 1) 文档缺口和知识流失显著预测解释性劳动；2) 认知深度与认知切换显著相关；3) 质性分析识别出四种产生解释需求的机制：文档衰减、依赖非正式渠道、结构性知识真空和边界模糊。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将重复解释劳动（REL）概念化为一种可测量的组织认知负担形式，为知识管理和组织认知研究提供了新的构念基础；揭示了正式知识系统失效时协调成本向员工的转移机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织识别和缓解员工认知负担提供了测量工具和诊断框架；提示组织应重视文档维护、知识留存与非正式沟通管理，以降低员工重复解释带来的认知损耗。

title: Actuarial Hedging and Dynamic Climate Insurance Matrices: Optimizing Sovereign Debt Resilience and Liquidity Mobilization in Coastal U.S. Airport Infrastructure
affiliations: Ain Shams University Cairo

detail.title: Actuarial Hedging and Dynamic Climate Insurance Matrices: Optimizing Sovereign Debt Resilience and Liquidity Mobilization in Coastal U.S. Airport Infrastructure

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there is no conflict of interest associated with this publication.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study is a computational financial engineering and simulation-based research that does not involve human participants or animal subjects.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: The fiscal equilibrium of sub-national transportation hubs across the United States is severely threatened by the non-linear compounding velocity of extreme climate-induced anomalies. Legacy infrastructure asset management and municipal budgeting models traditionally mandate that coastal airport authorities retain massive, non-earning liquid cash reserves as a retrospective hedge against catastrophic inundation and storm-surge events. This static containment approach induces severe capital erosion, lowering the dynamic Net Present Value (NPV) of public portfolios and compressing the airport's Debt Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR) during periods of aggressive Federal Reserve monetary tightening. To resolve this institutional inefficiency, this research introduces a novel Actuarial Hedging and Dynamic Climate Insurance Matrix architecture tailored for coastal U.S. aviation infrastructure. The quantitative engine integrates non-parametric mathematical forecasting with stochastic weather derivatives, utilizing a continuous Gumbel Extreme Value Distribution framework to model acute thermal and hydrological hazard boundaries. By mapping physical flood frontiers directly into sovereign fixed-income pricing grids, the computational engine structures automated parametric insurance swaps with global reinsurance syndicates. This algorithmic intervention liberates locked municipal cash reserves, converting zero-yield contingency funds into highly liquid capital ready for re-investment back into grid modernization pathways. Applied across a simulated portfolio of coastal U.S. airports, the predictive framework successfully elevates the portfolio’s mean Debt Service Coverage Ratio from an unstable baseline of 1.08 to a robust, investment-grade floor of 1.55. A formal One-Sample Student’s ttest validates an extraordinary empirical test statistic (t = 88.40, p < 0.001), mathematically confirming a secure net annual capital preservation of 14.20 million Dollars without compounding localized regressive taxpayer tax burdens. Ultimately, this study delivers a turnkey financial engineering blueprint that insulates public transportation assets, protects sovereign credit ratings, and accelerates national economic resilience under volatile macroeconomic tightening regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对美国沿海机场基础设施的精算对冲与动态气候保险矩阵架构，通过将极端气候风险映射到固定收益定价框架并自动化参数化保险互换，释放被锁定的市政现金储备，将机场投资组合的平均偿债覆盖率从1.08提升至1.55，年资本保全达1420万美元。
AI.research_question: 如何通过创新的金融工程架构，解决沿海机场因极端气候事件而被迫持有大量非生息现金储备所导致的资本侵蚀和偿债覆盖率下降问题？
AI.motivation: 传统基础设施资产管理和市政预算模型中，沿海机场当局需要持有巨额非生息流动性现金储备以应对灾难性洪水和风暴潮事件，这种静态围堵方式导致严重资本侵蚀，降低公共投资组合的动态净现值，并在美联储激进紧缩货币政策期间压缩偿债覆盖率，威胁财政均衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 精算对冲理论、动态气候保险矩阵、Gumbel极值分布理论、随机天气衍生品定价理论、参数化保险互换理论、固定收益定价框架
AI.method: 采用非参数数学预测与随机天气衍生品相结合的量化引擎，利用连续Gumbel极值分布建模急性热力和水文灾害边界，将物理洪水前沿映射到主权固定收益定价网格，构建与全球再保险辛迪加自动化的参数保险互换，并在模拟的美国沿海机场投资组合中进行应用验证，采用单样本学生t检验进行统计验证。
AI.findings: 该预测框架将投资组合平均偿债覆盖率从1.08的不稳定基线提升至1.55的投资级下限；单样本学生t检验显示统计量t=88.40（p<0.001），数学上确认每年净资本保全1420万美元，且未增加地方累进税负担。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了极端气候风险管理在公共基础设施金融领域的理论应用，创新性地将气候物理风险直接耦合到主权固定收益定价体系，提出了动态气候保险矩阵这一新型理论框架，弥补了传统静态现金储备对冲范式的理论缺陷。
AI.practical_contributions: 为沿海机场当局提供了一套可操作的金融工程蓝图，释放锁定市政现金储备并将其重新投资于电网现代化路径，保护主权信用评级，并在宏观经济紧缩环境下加速国家经济韧性建设，同时避免加重地方纳税人负担。

title: Systemic Infrastructure-CPI Hedging Swaps and Inflation Swap Engineering: Immunizing Sub-National Public Wealth Against Macroeconomic Volatility and Supply-Chain Contractions
affiliations: Ain Shams University Cairo

detail.title: Systemic Infrastructure-CPI Hedging Swaps and Inflation Swap Engineering: Immunizing Sub-National Public Wealth Against Macroeconomic Volatility and Supply-Chain Contractions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there is no conflict of interest associated with this publication.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study is a computational financial engineering and simulation-based research that does not involve human participants or animal subjects.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: The fiscal durability of sub-national capital works and utility infrastructure frameworks across the United States is severely compromised by the non-linear, compounding velocity of systemic inflation shocks. Traditional infrastructure procurement models operate under linear-deterministic budgetary frameworks that evaluate long-term raw material pricing configurations via static Consumer Price Index (CPI) projections. During aggressive macroeconomic contraction phases and prolonged quantitative tightening, this static posture induces massive structural budget deficits [1.12]. Sudden, hyperaccelerated jumps in core construction material costs and localized labor outlays fracture legacy public portfolios, forcing state treasuries to exhaust their liquid cash reserves or execute regressive fiscal interventions to avert project insolvency [1.12]. To resolve this systemic monetary friction, this research introduces a novel Systemic Infrastructure-CPI Hedging Swap architecture engineered for multi-billion-dollar public enterprises and aviation corridors. The quantitative processing core integrates multivariate ordinary least squares (OLS) diagnostic filtering with continuous stochastic financial derivative formulations to construct automated, inflation-indexed interest rate swap matrices. By mathematically aligning the conditional variance of municipal bond amortization distributions directly with parallel asset-hedging swaps executed across global commodity trading platforms, the computational pricing engine completely neutralizes supply-chain cost shocks. When localized core infrastructure material prices undergo sudden expansions, the parametric hedging swap triggers high-velocity, realtime derivative payouts that completely absorb the physical capital overrun, safeguarding the asset’s dynamic Net Present Value (NPV). Vectorized across a high-throughput 10,000-iteration Monte Carlo simulation grid modeled under severe 2026 macroeconomic tightening parameters, the framework successfully immunizes the state portfolio, maintaining an institutional debt security layer above the conservative 1.35 financial safety cushion floor [1.12]. A formal OneSample Student's t-test validates a magnificent empirical research target and test statistic (t = 124.80, p < 0.001), mathematically confirming an absolute compression of the structural default probability to a flawless 0.0000% [1.12]. Ultimately, this study delivers a scalable computational digital toolkit that isolates sub-national public finance structures, blocks sovereign credit downgrades, and permanently protects the American taxpayer from regressive tax hikes or emergency supplementary funding bills without third-party institutional friction [1.12].

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种"系统性基础设施-CPI对冲互换"架构，用于解决美国地方基础设施项目在系统性通胀冲击下的预算脆弱性问题。该框架通过多元OLS诊断滤波与连续随机金融衍生品公式相结合，构建自动化的通胀指数化利率互换矩阵，使市政债券摊销分布的条件方差与全球大宗商品交易平台上的资产对冲互换保持数学对齐，从而中和供应链成本冲击，保护项目净现值。
AI.research_question: 如何通过创新的金融衍生工具架构来化解美国地方基础设施项目在系统性通胀冲击和货币紧缩环境下的结构性预算赤字与项目偿付危机？
AI.motivation: 传统基础设施采购模式依赖线性-确定性预算框架和静态CPI预测，在激进的经济紧缩和量化紧缩阶段无法应对建筑材料成本和劳动力支出的大幅、非线性跳跃，导致州级财政储备枯竭、项目资不抵债以及倒退性财政干预。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于线性-确定性预算框架批判、系统性通胀冲击理论、金融衍生品定价理论（随机衍生品公式）、主权财政可持续性理论。
AI.method: 构建多元OLS诊断滤波与连续随机金融衍生品公式集成的量化核心，设计通胀指数化利率互换矩阵；通过10,000次蒙特卡洛模拟（模拟2026年严重宏观紧缩参数）进行验证，并用One-Sample Student's t检验进行统计确认。
AI.findings: 在严重宏观紧缩条件下，该框架成功免疫州投资组合，维持机构债务安全层高于1.35保守财务安全垫阈值；t检验证实结构性违约概率被压缩至0.0000%（t = 124.80, p < 0.001）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种将市政债券摊销动态与全球商品衍生品对冲数学对齐的新型理论框架，挑战传统线性-确定性基础设施预算范式的理论假设，为基础设施财政可持续性提供了非线性、随机微分视角的理论补充。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个可扩展的计算数字工具包，能够保护地方公共财政结构、防止主权信用降级、避免对纳税人实施倒退性增税或紧急补充拨款法案，且无需第三方机构干预。

title: Who Governs Sovereign Software? Funding Instruments and Administrative Authority in France and Germany

detail.title: Who Governs Sovereign Software? Funding Instruments and Administrative Authority in France and Germany
detail.abstract: Open-source licensing makes public software inspectable and reusable, but it does not decide who may set development priorities or who is responsible for the next release. This article examines how funding instruments allocate those forms of administrative authority. It reconstructs 22 entries concerning France's LaSuite and Germany's ZenDiS from records published through April 2026, including two arrangements announced for December 2026. The cases occupy the same policy field: France and Germany have committed to aligning LaSuite and openDesk as a European sovereign digital workplace. Their funding arrangements do different institutional work. In France, a centrally financed operator accepts voluntary cofinancing from user administrations. Official records link those contributions to participation in strategic decisions, monitoring bodies, and roadmap formation. In Germany, the federally owned ZenDiS receives no federal basic grant; product work depends on paid commissions. Records from April 2026 show a live development commission for openDesk, an expired commission for openConference, and no current development commission for openCode. The comparison distinguishes contribution as voice from commission as mandate. It argues that funding form is a policy instrument that structures participation and responsibility, not simply a source of resources. The article does not assess which arrangement produces better software or sovereignty.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析法国LaSuite和德国ZenDiS的22项资助安排（截至2026年4月发布记录），探讨开源软件资助工具如何分配行政权力（开发优先级和发布责任）。研究发现法国采用中央资助运营商+自愿共同出资模式，资金与战略决策参与挂钩；德国联邦机构ZenDiS无联邦基本拨款，产品工作依赖付费委托。文章提出"出资作为声音"与"委托作为授权"的对比，主张资助形式是结构化参与和责任的公共政策工具，而非单纯资源来源。
AI.research_question: 开源许可使软件可检视和可复用，但谁来决定开发优先级、谁对下一版本负责？不同的资助工具如何分配这些形式的行政权力？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注开源许可的法律层面，忽视了资金工具如何分配开源软件开发中的行政权威。法国和德国在推进欧洲主权数字工作场所（LaSuite和openDesk对齐）的同一政策领域内采用了截然不同的资助安排，为比较分析提供了自然实验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行政权力分配理论；资助形式作为政策工具的视角（区分"出资作为声音"与"委托作为授权"两种参与和责任结构）
AI.method: 基于档案记录的案例重建与比较分析：收集法国LaSuite和德国ZenDiS截至2026年4月发布的22项记录，包括两项2026年12月公布的安排，进行跨案例比较。
AI.findings: 法国模式中，中央资助的运营商接受用户行政机构的自愿共同出资，官方记录将这些贡献与战略决策参与、监督机构和路线图制定联系起来；德国模式中，联邦所有的ZenDiS没有联邦基本拨款，产品工作依赖付费委托——2026年4月记录显示openDesk有活跃开发委托，openConference的委托已过期，openCode没有当前开发委托。资助形式差异导致了参与和责任结构的不同。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并论证了"资助形式是政策工具"的理论观点，该工具结构化了开源开发中的参与权和责任分配，超越了资助作为单纯资源供给的既有理解。区分了"出资作为声音"与"委托作为授权"两种截然不同的治理逻辑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供开源软件资助模式的比较参照，揭示不同资助安排如何影响行政参与和问责机制；帮助公共部门在数字主权项目中审慎选择资助工具以实现预期的治理结构。

title: Supply Chain Resilience and Geopolitical Risks: Disruption, Adaptation, and the New Geoeconomic Reality

detail.title: Supply Chain Resilience and Geopolitical Risks: Disruption, Adaptation, and the New Geoeconomic Reality

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Declaration of Interest: The author(s) declare that there are no known personal, professional, or financial conflicts of interest that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this study. The research was conducted independently, and no external organization influenced the study design, analysis, interpretation, or conclusions.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics Approval: This study did not involve human participants, patient data, clinical interventions, or animal subjects. The research is based on publicly available secondary data, policy documents, published literature, and economic analysis. Therefore, formal ethics committee approval was not required. Clinical Trial Registration Clinical Trial Registration: Not applicable. This study does not involve a clinical trial or interventional study requiring registration. declarations.funderStatement: Funder Statement: This research received no specific grant, funding, or financial support from any public, commercial, or not-for-profit funding agency. The study was independently conducted by the author(s).

detail.abstract: Global supply chains are undergoing a profound transformation as geopolitical risks have shifted from peripheral concerns to central strategic variables shaping corporate and national decision-making. Between 2022 and 2026, overlapping geopolitical con icts-the Russia-Ukraine war, the Gaza-Israel con ict and associated Red Sea crisis, broader Middle East escalations, and the ongoing US-China technology and trade war-have created unprecedented systemic, multi-front vulnerabilities with no historical precedent. This research examines the current state, mechanisms, and consequences of geopolitical disruptions on global supply chains, alongside the adaptive strategies rms and governments are employing to build resilience. Through a comprehensive synthesis of scholarly literature, industry reports, and empirical studies (2020-2026), the study identi es ve persistent disruption mechanisms: maritime chokepoint vulnerability, sanctions-driven financial fragmentation, critical material concentration, food supply chain weaponization, and compound crisis amplication. Key endings indicate that geopolitical risk has greatly undermined global supply chain resilience, with geopolitical-related disruption alerts rising by 167% year-on-year. Adaptive strategies documented include supply diversi cation, nearshoring, friend-shoring, strategic inventory buffering, ESG-enabled resilience, and accelerated digitalization. The research proposes a three-dimensional strategic resilience framework integrating diversi cation, technological enablement, and governance, and concludes with a four-pillar policy framework for rms and governments navigating an era of enduring geopolitical fragmentation.

AI.tldr: 本文系统考察了2022-2026年间地缘政治冲突对全球供应链的冲击机制与后果，识别出五大持续性扰动机制，并提出了三维战略韧性框架和四支柱政策框架，以帮助企业和政府应对地缘政治碎片化时代。
AI.research_question: 地缘政治中断对全球供应链的现状、机制及后果是什么？企业和政府正在采用哪些适应策略来构建韧性？
AI.motivation: 2022-2026年间多场地缘政治冲突（俄乌战争、加沙-以色列冲突及红海危机、中东升级、中美科技贸易战）叠加，形成了史无前例的系统性、多战线脆弱性，地缘政治风险已从边缘问题转变为核心战略变量，亟需系统性研究其影响机制与应对策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 韧性理论（供应链韧性）、地缘政治经济学、复合危机放大理论、ESG框架
AI.method: 综合文献综述方法，对2020-2026年间的学术文献、行业报告和实证研究进行系统合成与分析。
AI.findings: (1) 地缘政治风险严重削弱了全球供应链韧性，地缘政治相关中断警报同比增长167%；(2) 识别出五大持续性扰动机制：海上咽喉点脆弱性、制裁驱动的金融碎片化、关键材料集中、粮食供应链武器化、复合危机放大效应；(3) 记录了供应链多元化、近岸外包、友岸外包、战略库存缓冲、ESG赋能的韧性、加速数字化等适应性策略。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了三维战略韧性框架（多元化+技术赋能+治理），将分散的供应链中断研究整合为系统的机制分类，丰富了供应链韧性理论在地缘政治语境下的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了四支柱政策框架，为企业管理者与政府决策者提供了应对持久地缘政治碎片化时代的可操作性指导。

title: The Two Limits of Human Verification
affiliations: Phenikaa University and Phenikaa University

detail.title: The Two Limits of Human Verification
detail.abstract: Human verification of large-volume content can fail in two distinct ways. A single judgment can become less informative, as the thing being checked grows harder to distinguish from what it imitates; and, independently, fewer judgments can be attempted at all, as volume outpaces a fixed capacity to pay attention, making verification less scalable. This note develops both failure modes as exact, provable consequences of a shared setup, and proves that they are formally independent: neither is a special case, a cause, or a remedy of the other. The informativeness result is derived first in terms of the total variation distance between two source distributions (Proposition 1), then restated in terms of Kullback-Leibler divergence, the quantity actually minimized whenever one distribution is trained to resemble another (Proposition 2); as that divergence shrinks, no test, however constructed, can do better than chance (Corollary 1). The scalability result shows, separately, that a fixed budget for confident judgment caps coverage at a fixed count regardless of how large the stream grows, so the fraction of items ever checked converges to zero (Proposition 3); a fourth result proves the two constraints are genuinely independent, each realizable at any value regardless of the other (Proposition 4). The motivating case throughout is distinguishing human from machine-generated text, where the theory's two failure modes have an exact reading: an accuracy ceiling that falls as language models improve, and a coverage limit that falls as content volume grows, together explaining why verification can erode on both fronts at once, and why fixing one front does nothing for the other.

AI.tldr: 本文从理论上证明了大体量内容人工审核的两个独立失败模式：单个判断的信息含量下降（因模仿物越来越难以区分）与可执行的判断数量上限（因内容量超出固定注意力容量），并严格证明二者在形式上相互独立。
AI.research_question: 大体量内容的人工验证为何会同时面临判断信息量下降和可扩展性受限两个问题，且这两个问题在数学上是否真正相互独立？
AI.motivation: 现实中大规模内容验证（如区分人类与机器生成文本）在AI内容激增的背景下日益困难，但现有讨论未将"单次判断变得不精确"和"可验证数量受限"作为两个独立机制进行严格形式化分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 统计检验理论（total variation distance与Kullback-Leibler divergence）、信息论、样本量与覆盖率约束分析
AI.method: 形式化推导与证明，提出四个命题：以全变差距离表达信息量结果（命题1）、以KL散度重述（命题2）、证明固定预算下覆盖率趋于零（命题3）、证明两个失败模式独立性（命题4）。
AI.findings: （1）当两个源分布间的KL散度趋近于零时，任何检验都无法超越随机猜测；（2）固定判断预算限制覆盖数量，内容流越大，被检比例趋近于零；（3）两个失败模式在数学上完全独立，任一模式可在另一模式任意取值下实现。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将内容验证的两个失败模式统一在共享的形式化框架下，并严格证明其独立性，揭示"修复一个方面对另一方面毫无帮助"的深层理论原因。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI内容治理提供理论依据：仅提升检测算法准确性无法解决覆盖率问题，仅增加样本量也无法绕过信息量天花板，验证体系需双管齐下同时应对两个独立瓶颈。

title: Enterprise Redefinition Observed: A Multiple-Case Analysis of Eighteen Enterprises in the Age of AI

detail.title: Enterprise Redefinition Observed: A Multiple-Case Analysis of Eighteen Enterprises in the Age of AI
detail.abstract: This paper provides the first structured empirical application of the Enterprise Re‐ definition framework (Kadowaki, 2026b), which conceptualizes transformation in the age of AI as the continuous, coordinated redesign of five dimensions of the enterprise —Purpose, Business, Organization, Capital, and Leadership. Using a multiple-case design, eighteen enterprises—NVIDIA, Microsoft, Amazon, Apple, OpenAI, Tesla, Google, Meta, Netflix, Sony, IBM, TSMC, ASML, Arm, Costco, BYD, SpaceX, and An‐ thropic—are coded on a common instrument drawn from public information as of Au‐ gust 2026: which dimensions moved, at what maturity level, where in the Future Value Chain value originated, and through which redefinition patterns. Eight crosscase findings emerge. Core purpose was replaced in none of the eighteen cases; re‐ definition concentrates in Business (16/18) and Capital (15/18), which move together in fourteen cases; observed value originates upstream of Creation in seventeen cases and at Enterprise Value in none; patterns of redefinition never occur alone; cross-di‐ mensional coherence, not frequency of change, separates sustained redefiners; thirty percent of dimension-level assessments are unobservable from public information, concentrated in Organization and Leadership; every sustained redefinition rests on an institutionalized mechanism that secures time; and each enterprise’s strength and fragility derive from the same structure. To address survivorship bias, a contrast set of five failed or forfeited redefinitions—Kodak, Nokia, BlackBerry, Yahoo, and Sears— is coded on the same instrument from the public historical record: learning was fre‐ quently present, even pioneering, while the connection from learning through re‐ definition to capital allocation broke, purpose churned rather than anchored, and no time-securing mechanism held—an inverse signature consistent with the findings from the primary sample. In maturity terms the separation is numeric: no rated con‐ trast-set cell reaches Level 4 of the Enterprise Redefinition Maturity Model, and no rated primary-sample cell sits at Level 1. The findings motivate a three-layer refine‐ ment of purpose stability, an observation-asymmetry thesis with consequences for how capital markets price redefinition capability, and nine new research propositions (P12–P20) extending the eleven advanced in the framework paper. Implications for executives, boards, and investors are developed.

AI.tldr: 本文是首个系统应用"企业再定义框架"（Kadowaki, 2026b）的实证研究。该框架将AI时代的企业转型概念化为对五个维度（宗旨、业务、组织、资本、领导力）的持续协调再设计。研究采用多案例设计，对18家标杆企业（英伟达、微软、亚马逊、苹果、OpenAI、特斯拉、谷歌、Meta、Netflix、索尼、IBM、台积电、ASML、Arm、Costco、比亚迪、SpaceX、Anthropic）基于公开信息（截至2026年8月）进行编码，考察维度变动、成熟度水平、未来价值链价值来源及再定义模式。研究发现八项跨案例结论，另以五家转型失败企业（柯达、诺基亚、黑莓、雅虎、西尔斯）作为对比组验证结论，并提出三层宗旨稳定性精炼、观察不对称性论点及九项新研究命题（P12–P20）。
AI.research_question: 在AI时代，企业转型（再定义）如何在五个维度（Purpose, Business, Organization, Capital, Leadership）上发生？哪些维度发生再定义、成熟度如何、价值在价值链何处起源、以及通过何种再定义模式实现？成功与失败的再定义有何系统性差异？
AI.motivation: 以往关于企业转型的研究缺乏统一的实证框架来系统衡量AI时代的企业再定义。企业再定义框架（Kadowaki, 2026b）提出后，尚无基于大样本的实证应用来检验其有效性并提炼跨案例规律，本研究旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业再定义框架（Enterprise Redefinition Framework, Kadowaki 2026b）；未来价值链（Future Value Chain）；企业再定义成熟度模型（Enterprise Redefinition Maturity Model）；目的稳定性（purpose stability）概念。
AI.method: 多案例研究设计（multiple-case design）。对18家标杆企业基于公开信息（截至2026年8月）按统一编码工具进行编码，评估五个维度的变动、成熟度水平、未来价值链价值来源及再定义模式。另以5家失败/放弃再定义的企业（柯达、诺基亚、黑莓、雅虎、西尔斯）作为对照组，基于公开历史记录采用同一工具编码，以处理幸存者偏差。
AI.findings: 八项核心发现：（1）18家案例中无一家更换核心宗旨；（2）再定义集中于业务（16/18）与资本（15/18），两者在14个案例中联动；（3）17个案例的价值观察起源于价值创造上游，无一例在"企业价值"处；（4）再定义模式从不单独出现；（5）区分持续再定义者的是跨维度一致性而非变动频率；（6）30%的维度级评估无法从公开信息观察，集中于组织与领导力维度；（7）每个持续再定义都依赖制度化机制来确保时间；（8）每家企业的优势与脆弱性源于同一结构。对照组呈现反向特征：学习频繁甚至领先，但学习→再定义→资本配置的链条断裂，宗旨摇摆而非锚定，无时间保障机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次大规模实证检验企业再定义框架；提出目的稳定的三层精炼；提出观察不对称性论点及其对资本市场定价再定义能力的含义；新增九项研究命题（P12–P20），将框架论文中的十一项命题扩展至二十项；从成熟度层面证明成功与失败再定义的数字性分离（对照组无细胞达Level 4，主样本无细胞处于Level 1）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高管、董事会和投资者提供了实践启示：识别再定义的关键维度（业务与资本联动）、跨维度一致性的重要性、制度化时间保障机制的关键作用，以及对再定义能力进行资本市场定价的观察视角。

title: From Professional Discretion to Ethical Deviation: A Dynamic Theory of Ethical Boundary Erosion in Accounting Judgment
affiliations: Institute of Certified Public Accountant ( ICPAP)

detail.title: From Professional Discretion to Ethical Deviation: A Dynamic Theory of Ethical Boundary Erosion in Accounting Judgment

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper develops a theoretical framework and proposes a future experimental validation design. No human participants were recruited and no primary data were collected for the present study. Therefore, ethics approval was not required for this paper. Any future experimental implementation involving human participants will be subject to appropriate ethics approval before data collection.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Introduction: Professional discretion is indispensable to accounting judgment because financial reporting frequently requires interpretation under uncertainty, estimation, and selection among multiple professionally defensible alternatives. However, the same legitimate interpretive space may create conditions through which progressively aggressive judgments emerge. This study identifies the Professional Discretion–Deviation Gap and develops the Discretion-to-Deviation Transition Theory, centered on Ethical Boundary Erosion (EBE): the progressive displacement of the perceived boundary separating legitimate professional discretion from ethically unacceptable judgment through repeated tolerated boundary adjustments. Methods: The study employs a sequential experimental design in which professional accountants, auditors, controllers, and financial-reporting professionals complete four connected accounting judgments (T1–T4). Organizational pressure and governance intervention are experimentally manipulated. Perceived ethical-boundary location is measured repeatedly to distinguish actual boundary displacement from increasing reporting aggressiveness. Results: The study tests whether organizational pressure promotes aggressive use of legitimate discretion, whether accepted adjustments increase subsequent aggressiveness, and whether repeated tolerated adjustments progressively displace perceived ethical boundaries. It further examines whether early EBE predicts later reporting deviation and whether timely governance intervention weakens the trajectory from tolerated adjustment to boundary erosion and deviation. Discussion: The study advances accounting ethics by shifting explanation from static antecedent–outcome relationships toward a dynamic, sequential, and path-dependent account of how legitimate discretion may become ethically deviant judgment. The proposed Governance Interruption Architecture further conceptualizes governance as a stagespecific and time-sensitive mechanism capable of interrupting ethical-boundary movement before deviation becomes established.

AI.tldr: 本研究识别了"专业裁量-偏离缺口"，并发展出"裁量到偏离的过渡理论"，核心概念为"伦理边界侵蚀"（EBE）：通过反复容忍的边界调整，感知到的合法专业裁量与不可接受的伦理判断之间的边界逐渐被置换。研究采用序贯实验设计（T1-T4），操纵组织压力与治理干预，检验组织压力是否促进激进的裁量使用、被接受的调整是否增加后续激进性、反复容忍的调整是否渐进地侵蚀伦理边界，以及及时治理干预能否削弱这一轨迹。
AI.research_question: 合法的专业裁量空间如何通过反复容忍的边界调整而逐渐演变为伦理上不可接受的激进判断？组织压力和治理干预在这一过程中起什么作用？
AI.motivation: 专业裁量对会计判断不可或缺，但同一合法解释空间可能为逐渐激进的判断创造条件。现有研究多聚焦于静态的前因-结果关系，缺乏对合法裁量如何演变为伦理偏离的动态、序贯和路径依赖机制的解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 专业裁量-偏离缺口（Professional Discretion–Deviation Gap）、裁量到偏离过渡理论（Discretion-to-Deviation Transition Theory）、伦理边界侵蚀（Ethical Boundary Erosion, EBE）、治理中断架构（Governance Interruption Architecture）
AI.method: 序贯实验设计：专业会计师、审计师、财务总监和财务报告专业人员完成四项连续会计判断（T1-T4）。实验操纵组织压力与治理干预两个变量，并反复测量感知伦理边界位置，以区分实际边界位移与报告激进程度的增加。
AI.findings: 检验了：（1）组织压力是否促进合法裁量的激进使用；（2）被接受的调整是否增加后续激进性；（3）反复容忍的调整是否渐进地置换感知伦理边界；（4）早期伦理边界侵蚀是否预测后续报告偏离；（5）及时治理干预是否削弱从容忍调整到边界侵蚀和偏离的轨迹。
AI.theory_contributions: 将会计伦理解释从静态的前因-结果关系转向动态、序贯、路径依赖的视角，阐述合法裁量如何可能变成伦理偏离判断；提出治理中断架构，将治理概念化为分阶段、时间敏感的机制，能在偏离建立之前中断伦理边界的移动。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织治理设计提供理论依据，强调治理干预的时机和阶段性重要性，帮助组织在伦理边界移动的早期阶段进行及时干预，防止合法裁量滑向伦理偏离。

title: Knowledge Obsolescence and the Careers of U.S. Inventors, 1836–2014
affiliations: and

detail.title: Knowledge Obsolescence and the Careers of U.S. Inventors, 1836–2014
detail.abstract: How quickly does inventors’ human capital fall into obsolescence and how has obsolescence evolved over time? Whether inventors incur obsolescence depends on two rates. How fast inventors update their own knowledge and how fast their surrounding fields update theirs. Using career panels for 4.9 million disambiguated U.S. inventors between 1836 and 2014, we measure both. Inventors’ knowledge ages by 0.77 years for each year of experience, while the knowledge active in their fields ages by only 0.58 years, so inventors fall 0.19 years further behind with each year of experience. The size of this differential ebbed and flowed across time, but overall grew roughly fourfold between the 1880s and 1990s cohorts. Most of that growth came from a speed-up in field updating, as the field knowledge-aging rate fell from 0.66 to 0.46 across cohorts, and the remainder from inventors’ own knowledge aging faster in the closing decades of the century. We show that this differential amounts to obsolescence, as inventors who lag further behind their fields produce less influential patents. As with the differential, the penalty for experience deepened in waves, and across cohorts it moved in step with the rate at which inventors fell behind their fields. We then examine how the innovation system advances into new knowledge areas even as individuals update slowly. Newly educated inventors begin their careers with human capital anchored to their training, supplying their fields with knowledge of recent vintages, while collaboration allows inventors to innovate more quickly, before their knowledge assets become obsolete.

AI.tldr: 本文利用1836-2014年间490万美国发明家的职业面板数据，测量了发明家自身知识老化速率与所在领域知识老化速率。研究发现发明家每经历一年，其知识老化0.77年，而领域知识仅老化0.58年，即发明家每年落后领域0.19年。这种差距在1880年代至1990年代群体间总体增长了约四倍，主要源于领域知识更新加速。研究还发现，新受教育发明家以培训锚定的人力资本进入领域，合作使发明家在知识资产过时前更快创新。
AI.research_question: 发明家的人力资本以多快速度过时？这种过时速度随时间如何演化？发明家落后于所在领域会带来什么后果？创新系统如何在个体更新缓慢的情况下进入新知识领域？
AI.motivation: 理解发明家人力资本的老化问题对于知识经济时代的人力资本管理、创新政策制定以及理解技术进步动态具有重要意义，但此前缺乏对发明家知识过时速率及其随时间演化的大规模实证研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本过时理论、知识存量的更新与折旧模型、发明家职业生命周期理论
AI.method: 基于1836-2014年美国490万去重发明家的职业生涯面板数据，分别测量发明家自身知识更新速率和所在领域知识更新速率，通过比较两者差异来测度知识过时程度，并分析不同世代群体间的差异及对专利影响力的影响。
AI.findings: (1) 发明家知识每经历一年老化0.77年，而领域知识仅老化0.58年，发明家每年落后0.19年；(2) 这种差距在1880年代至1990年代群体间增长了约四倍，主要源于领域知识更新加速（从0.66降至0.46）；(3) 落后于领域的发明家产生的影响力专利更少，经验惩罚随世代加深；(4) 新受教育发明家以训练锚定的知识进入领域，合作使发明家在知识过时前更快创新。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统量化发明家人力资本过时的速率及其跨世代演化趋势，将知识老化分解为发明家自身更新与领域更新两个维度，建立了知识过时与专利影响力之间的实证联系，并揭示了创新系统通过新人才进入与协作机制应对个体知识老化的理论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为创新政策和人力资本管理提供实证依据：理解发明家知识过时对政策制定（如再培训、继续教育）和企业的研发人才管理（如协作配置、知识更新激励）具有重要指导意义；同时揭示了人才梯队建设与早期创新支持的重要性。

title: The Price of Misreporting: Measuring the Effect of Strategic Behavior in Online Platforms
affiliations: and University of Texas at Austin

detail.title: The Price of Misreporting: Measuring the Effect of Strategic Behavior in Online Platforms
detail.abstract: Online platforms face strategic misreporting by self-interested users, yet detecting such behavior does not reveal whether it creates substantial systemic harm or warrants intervention. We develop a computational governance artifact for assessing this structural vulnerability. Modeling misreporting as a decentralized game among strategic actors embedded in social learning, we introduce the Price of Misreporting (PoM), a theory-informed measure of the systemic cost of strategic misreporting relative to truthful information exchange. Our analysis identifies a central result: platform vulnerability depends primarily on where misreporting occurs in the influence structure and how susceptible users are to persuasion, rather than on how many actors misreport. Indeed, additional adversaries can reduce systemic harm when their competing objectives partially offset one another. These results motivate influence capping, a content-neutral intervention that limits excessive influence without requiring platforms to identify malicious users. We evaluate the artifact through theoretical analysis, simulations on seven real-world platform networks, and real-world applications. The results reveal distinct governance regimes: some platforms are structurally resilient, others benefit substantially from influence capping, while others require detection.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种计算治理工具，用于评估在线平台面对用户策略性虚假报告时的结构性脆弱性。作者提出了"虚假报告代价"（Price of Misreporting, PoM）这一理论驱动指标，衡量策略性虚假报告相对于真实信息交换的系统性成本。核心发现是：平台脆弱性主要取决于虚假报告在影响结构中的位置以及用户对说服的易感性，而非虚假报告者的数量；额外的对手甚至可能因竞争目标部分抵消而降低系统性危害。基于此提出"影响力上限"（influence capping）这一内容中立干预措施，并通过理论分析、七个真实平台网络的仿真和实际应用进行了评估。
AI.research_question: 在线平台如何评估用户策略性虚假报告所导致的系统性危害？平台的结构性脆弱性由什么因素决定？
AI.motivation: 在线平台面临自利用户的策略性虚假报告，但仅仅检测到这种行为并不能揭示其是否造成实质性系统性危害或是否需要干预。现有方法缺乏系统性评估虚假报告结构性影响的工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将虚假报告建模为嵌入社会学习的战略参与者之间的去中心化博弈，引入价格理论中的"无谓损失"概念，提出"虚假报告代价"（PoM）作为系统性成本度量。
AI.method: 计算治理工具开发，结合理论分析、博弈建模、七个真实平台网络的仿真实验以及实际应用验证。具体方法包括：将虚假报告建模为非合作博弈、推导PoM指标、设计"影响力上限"干预机制、通过网络仿真评估不同治理机制的效果。
AI.findings: （1）平台脆弱性主要取决于虚假报告在影响结构中的位置和用户对说服的易感性，而非虚假报告者数量；（2）额外对手可能通过竞争目标的部分抵消而减少系统性危害；（3）存在三种不同的治理机制：部分平台结构上具有韧性，部分平台从影响力上限中获益显著，部分平台需要检测手段。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出PoM理论指标，将博弈论与价格理论相结合以量化虚假报告的系统性成本；揭示了虚假报告的结构性影响机制，挑战了"更多虚假报告者必然导致更大危害"的传统假设；提出区分结构韧性、干预增益和检测必要的三类治理机制的框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了可操作的计算治理工具，平台管理者无需识别恶意用户即可通过"影响力上限"这一内容中立干预措施降低系统性危害；为不同结构特征的平台提供了差异化治理策略建议；在七个真实平台网络上验证了工具的有效性和通用性。

title: From Principles to Instruments: Operationalizing Catholic Social Teaching and Ignatian Spirituality for AI Ethics at the Application Layer

detail.title: From Principles to Instruments: Operationalizing Catholic Social Teaching and Ignatian Spirituality for AI Ethics at the Application Layer

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author developed the Jesuit AI Ethics Framework and its reference implementation, which are the subjects of evaluation in this paper, and this interest is disclosed and examined in the paper's reflexivity section. Both are independent scholarly work, freely available without advertising or revenue. The instruments rely on a commercial model API (Google Gemini) under ordinary usage terms; the author has no financial relationship with Google or any AI vendor. The author declares no other personal or financial relationships that could have influenced this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study involved no human participants and no patient data, so no ethics approval was required. The analysis draws on publicly documented cases from official sources (parliamentary inquiry, regulatory rulings, and published investigations), published survey research cited as secondary literature, and the author's own software instrument.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It is an independent scholarly project of the author and is not a sponsored work of any university, association, or Church body.

detail.abstract:
Most discussion of AI ethics focuses on the model layer, where concerns include capability, alignment, safety, and governance. At the application layer, where organizations deploy systems that affect particular people, guidance is dominated by risk and compliance frameworks. These frameworks help identify harms but provide less guidance about the purposes systems should serve. 

This paper presents the Jesuit AI Ethics Framework and uses it as a demonstration of how a moral tradition can be translated into practical AI governance tools. Catholic social teaching provides the framework's content, Ignatian spirituality provides its method, and the Rome Call for AI Ethics provides an operational bridge between principles and implementation. These sources are translated into a five-question rubric, eleven assessment criteria, a summative auditor, and a formative design workshop. 

The paper contributes a method for moving from authoritative texts to operational assessment instruments while remaining accountable to primary sources. It also introduces a verification standard for AI-assisted work with authoritative texts, under which corrections are recorded publicly, and a reflexive approach in which the framework is evaluated against its own criteria. 

The framework is illustrated through several documented AI deployments and applied in full to the Dutch childcare benefits system. The paper demonstrates how a moral tradition can be translated into practical instruments for application-layer AI governance while remaining accountable to its sources. The method may be applicable to other religious and philosophical traditions with authoritative texts and established practices of moral reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出耶稣会AI伦理框架，将天主教社会教义和依纳爵灵修传统转化为实用的AI应用层治理工具，包括五问准则、十一项评估标准、总结性审计师和形成性设计工作坊，并通过荷兰儿童福利系统等案例进行完整应用和验证。
AI.research_question: 如何将一种道德传统转化为可操作的应用层AI治理工具，同时保持对其原始权威文本的问责性？
AI.motivation: 现有AI伦理讨论大多聚焦于模型层（能力、对齐、安全、治理），而应用层的指导主要依赖风险和合规框架。这些框架有助于识别危害，但对系统应服务的目的提供的指导不足，缺乏关于系统目的的伦理指引。
AI.theoretical_framework: 天主教社会教义（框架内容来源）、依纳爵灵修（方法论来源）、罗马AI伦理呼吁（原则与实施之间的操作桥梁）。
AI.method: 将权威文本翻译为五问准则、十一项评估标准、总结性审计师和形成性设计工作坊；引入AI辅助权威文本工作的验证标准（公开记录修正）；采用反身性方法使框架接受自身标准的评估。
AI.findings: 该框架在多个已记录的AI部署中得到展示，并完整应用于荷兰儿童福利系统，证明道德传统可以转化为应用层AI治理的实用工具，同时保持对其来源的问责性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种从权威文本到操作化评估工具的转化方法，并确保对原始来源保持问责；引入AI辅助权威文本工作的验证标准。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一套可操作的AI伦理治理工具（准则、标准、审计师、设计工作坊），可用于实际AI系统部署的伦理评估；该方法可能推广适用于其他具有权威文本和道德推理实践的宗教和哲学传统。

title: The Chain Seen from Below: Position, Discipline and Escape in Global Value Chains

detail.title: The Chain Seen from Below: Position, Discipline and Escape in Global Value Chains

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal or financial relationships that may have, or could be perceived to have, influenced this study.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant or financial support from any funding agency in the public, commercial or not-for-profit sectors. No commercial data subscription was used at any stage; all data sources are open and free of charge.

detail.abstract: Global value chain research often reads value capture off sectoral technological intensity: climb the research-and-development ladder and margins follow. This article tests it at firm level, on 1,520 firm-years for 99 firms, 29 Brazilian and 70 counterparts elsewhere in their chains, built from open filings for 2009-2025 on one measure. Position, coded as twelve roles, explains 41.6 per cent of between-firm variance in EBITDA margins against 16.6 for the OECD R&D-intensity ladder and 0.3 for Pavitt, surviving controls for size, leverage, sector and year. Removing the barrier dimension preserves the ordering among the 67 firms owning none; owning one carries a premium near nine points but no higher return on assets once its capital cost is counted. Captive positions show lower, more rigid margins. The headline comparison uses all 99 firms; smaller cells test mechanisms. Technology matters, but durable capture depends on where a firm sits and what it controls.

AI.tldr: 本文基于巴西及全球价值链中99家企业的1,520个企业-年度观测数据（2009-2025年），检验了以价值链位置（编码为十二种角色）而非行业技术强度来解释企业利润率差异的观点。位置解释了企业间EBITDA利润率差异的41.6%，远超OECD研发强度阶梯（16.6%）和Pavitt分类（0.3%），且在控制规模、杠杆、行业和年份后依然稳健。
AI.research_question: 在全球价值链中，企业利润率（价值捕获）究竟由什么决定？是由行业技术强度（如研发强度阶梯）决定，还是由企业在价值链中的位置及其控制权决定？
AI.motivation: 传统全球价值链研究通常以行业技术强度来推断企业价值捕获能力——"攀登研发阶梯，利润率随之而来"。作者认为这一假设缺乏企业层面的直接检验，因此希望通过微观数据验证价值链位置是否比技术强度更能解释企业利润率差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全球价值链理论中的位置-权力-价值捕获框架，PPF（Position-Power-Firm）理论视角，以及OECD研发强度阶梯和Pavitt技术分类作为对照的理论基准。
AI.method: 基于公开申报文件构建企业层面数据集（2009-2025年），包括29家巴西企业和70家价值链上下游企业，共1,520个企业-年度观测。将价值链位置编码为十二种角色，运用方差分解和回归分析，比较位置变量与OECD研发强度、Pavitt分类对企业EBITDA利润率差异的解释力，并进行控制变量检验和子样本机制检验。
AI.findings: （1）价值链位置解释了企业间EBITDA利润率差异的41.6%，远超OECD研发强度阶梯（16.6%）和Pavitt分类（0.3%），且在控制规模、杠杆、行业和年份后依然成立；（2）去除壁垒维度后，67家无壁垒企业的排序依旧保持；（3）拥有一项壁垒的企业利润率溢价约为9个百分点，但计入资本成本后资产回报率并无更高；（4）受俘（Captive）位置的企业利润率更低且更僵化。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统"技术强度决定价值捕获"的假设，将价值链研究的分析单元从行业层面下沉到企业层面，提出了"位置+控制权"比"技术+研发"更能解释价值捕获的理论视角，为价值链位置理论提供了企业层面的大样本实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业和政策制定者提供了价值捕获的战略启示：利润率更多取决于企业在价值链中的位置及其所控制的资源壁垒，而非单纯的研发投入或技术强度。对新兴经济体企业（如巴西）参与全球价值链具有重要参考意义。

title: A Cost-Benefit Study of Reinforced Cement Concrete (RCC) versus Structural Steel Framing for Multi-Storey Buildings in India
affiliations: and

detail.title: A Cost-Benefit Study of Reinforced Cement Concrete (RCC) versus Structural Steel Framing for Multi-Storey Buildings in India

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patient data, or primary data collection requiring ethics committee approval. All building case studies discussed are drawn from previously published literature and publicly available industry sources; no new data were collected from individuals, organisations, or proprietary/confidential project records. Accordingly, formal ethics approval and participant consent were not required for this research.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The work was carried out as part of the authors' academic research at the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi.

detail.abstract: The choice between reinforced cement concrete (RCC) and structural steel framing remains one of the most consequential early decisions in Indian building design, with direct implications for capital cost, construction schedule, foundation loading, seismic performance, and life-cycle maintenance liability. Although RCC has historically dominated Indian residential and mid-rise construction on account of lower per-unit material cost and locally available skilled labour, structural steel and steel-concrete composite systems are increasingly specified for industrial, commercial, and high-rise applications where speed of erection, long clear spans, and reduced foundation loading yield compensating economic benefits. This paper develops a structured cost-benefit framework spanning direct structural cost, constructiontime-linked indirect cost (site overhead, financing cost, and opportunity cost of delayed occupancy), foundation cost sensitivity, and thirty-year life-cycle maintenance cost, and applies it to five representative Indian building typologies: G+4 residential, G+9 composite mid-rise, G+15 and G+18 high-rise, and a single-storey industrial shed comparing conventional RCC against pre-engineered steel building (PEB) construction. Drawing on published Indian structural-cost studies and industry cost-benchmarking data, the analysis finds that RCC retains a direct structural cost advantage of 30-60% for low-rise residential construction, while structural steel and composite systems achieve cost parity or a modest 4-12% advantage beyond approximately nine to twelve storeys, and steel-frame PEB construction achieves a 25-40% total cost advantage over RCC for single-storey industrial sheds once construction-time-linked savings are included. Construction-time reductions of 18.66% for steel and 32.02% for composite systems relative to RCC, and up to 50-55% for PEB industrial sheds, are shown to materially narrow or reverse the apparent direct-cost disadvantage of steel once site overhead and construction-period financing costs are incorporated. The paper concludes with typology-specific decision guidance and highlights the need for standardized, India-specific whole-life costing disclosure to support structural system selection.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个涵盖直接结构成本、施工时间相关间接成本、基础成本敏感性及三十年全生命周期维护成本的结构化成本效益框架，系统比较了钢筋混凝土（RCC）与结构钢/钢-混凝土组合体系在印度五种典型建筑类型中的经济表现，并给出类型化决策指导。
AI.research_question: 在印度建筑设计中，钢筋混凝土（RCC）与结构钢框架及钢-混凝土组合体系相比，在不同建筑类型下的全生命周期成本效益究竟如何？决策者应如何依据建筑类型选择最优结构体系？
AI.motivation: RCC与结构钢的选择是印度建筑设计中最关键的早期决策之一，直接影响资本成本、施工进度、基础荷载、抗震性能及维护责任。尽管RCC在印度住宅与中高层建筑中长期占据主导地位，但结构钢在工业、商业及高层建筑中的应用日益增多。缺乏覆盖直接与间接成本的全生命周期成本效益框架来指导这一关键决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全生命周期成本分析（LCCA）；直接成本与间接成本（时间关联成本）的整合分析框架；成本效益比较理论
AI.method: 构建结构化成本效益框架，涵盖四类成本维度（直接结构成本、施工时间关联间接成本、基础成本敏感性、30年生命周期维护成本），并应用于印度五种代表性建筑类型（G+4住宅、G+9组合中高层、G+15与G+18高层、单层工业厂房对比PEB），基于已发表的印度结构成本研究与行业成本基准数据进行分析。
AI.findings: 1) RCC在低层住宅中保持30-60%的直接结构成本优势；2) 结构钢与组合体系在约9-12层以上达到成本持平或4-12%的微弱优势；3) 钢框架PEB工业厂房在计入施工时间节省后可实现25-40%的总成本优势；4) 钢结构施工时间缩短18.66%、组合体系缩短32.02%、PEB缩短50-55%，可显著缩小或逆转钢结构的直接成本劣势。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个同时涵盖直接成本与施工时间关联间接成本（现场管理费、融资成本、延迟入住机会成本）及全生命周期维护成本的结构成本效益分析框架，填补了印度建筑结构选型领域缺乏系统化全生命周期成本比较的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度建筑设计师和开发商提供了类型化的结构体系选择决策指导（低层住宅选RCC、高层建筑选钢结构或组合体系、单层工业厂房选PEB），并呼吁建立标准化的、印度本土化的全生命周期成本披露机制以支持结构选型决策。

title: Spatial-temporal Utilisation of School Facilities and Teachers' Performance in Kwara State, Nigeria
affiliations: University of Ilorin, Ilorin, Nigeria and Tai Solarin University of Education

detail.title: Spatial-temporal Utilisation of School Facilities and Teachers' Performance in Kwara State, Nigeria
detail.abstract: The persistent mismatch between their availability and utilisation of educational facilities continues to undermine teaching and learning outcomes in Nigeria. This study examined the relationship between spatial-temporal utilisation of school facilities and teachers job performance in public senior secondary schools in Kwara State, Nigeria. A descriptive survey research design was employed targeting 133 schools in Kwara Central from which 98 were randomly selected. Data were collected using the Physical Resource Checklist (PRC) and the Teachers Job Performance Evaluation Questionnaire (TJPEQ; reliability = .72) and analysed with descriptive statistics and Pearson Product-Moment Correlation (PPMC). Findings revealed that while classrooms (101%) and libraries (135%) were generally adequate, laboratories (70%) remained insufficient. Classrooms were over-utilized with Time Utilization Rate of (106.7%) while laboratories (72%) and libraries (79.8%) were only moderately used. Space Utilisation Rate analysis showed near-capacity (98.97%), underused laboratories (72%) and severely overstretched libraries (200.6%). A weak but significant positive relationship was found between spatial-temporal utilisation and teachers' performance (r = .211, < .05). The study concluded that the challenge in Kwara State is not the availability of resources but their uneven distribution and insufficient use which constrains teacher effectiveness. It was therefore recommended that policymakers prioritise needs-based allocation, spatial-temporal planning should be strengthened, government should invest in critical infrastructure expansion and capacity for effective resource use should be built.

AI.tldr: 本研究调查了尼日利亚夸拉州公立高中学校设施的空间-时间利用与教师工作绩效之间的关系。研究发现，虽然教室和图书馆数量总体充足，但实验室不足，且各类设施利用率不均衡（教室过度使用、实验室和图书馆利用率中等偏低），设施的空间-时间利用与教师绩效之间存在微弱但显著的正相关关系（r=.211）。研究结论认为，该州的问题不在于资源短缺，而在于资源配置不均和利用不足，制约了教师效能。
AI.research_question: 学校设施的空间-时间利用与尼日利亚夸拉州公立高中教师工作绩效之间是否存在关系？
AI.motivation: 尼日利亚教育设施可用性与利用率之间的持续不匹配持续损害教学与学习成果，需要实证研究来厘清二者关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 设施空间-时间利用率理论（涉及时间利用率与空间利用率两个维度），以及资源基础视角下设施配置与教师效能的关系理论。
AI.method: 采用描述性调查研究设计，以夸拉中央区133所学校为总体，随机选取98所学校。使用物理资源清单（PRC）和教师工作绩效评估问卷（TJPEQ，信度=.72）收集数据，采用描述性统计和皮尔逊积矩相关（PPMC）进行分析。
AI.findings: （1）教室（101%）和图书馆（135%）总体充足，实验室（70%）不足；（2）教室时间利用率过度（106.7%），实验室（72%）和图书馆（79.8%）使用适中；（3）空间利用率方面，教室接近满载（98.97%）、实验室不足（72%）、图书馆严重超负荷（200.6%）；（4）设施空间-时间利用与教师绩效之间存在微弱但显著的正相关（r=.211, p<.05）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将设施空间利用和时间利用两个维度整合纳入教育管理研究框架，证实了设施利用与教师绩效的正向关系，丰富了教育资源配置理论中关于"利用率而非数量"是关键变量的观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 为尼日利亚乃至类似发展中国家提供了实证依据，建议政策制定者实施基于需求的资源分配、加强空间-时间规划、投资关键基础设施扩建，并建设有效资源利用能力。

title: The Unintended Consequences of Weaponized (Scientific) Interdependence: Evidence from U.S.-China Firm Research Collaborations in Semiconductors
affiliations: Stockholm School of Economics and Stockholm School of Economics

detail.title: The Unintended Consequences of Weaponized (Scientific) Interdependence: Evidence from U.S.-China Firm Research Collaborations in Semiconductors
detail.abstract: International scientific collaboration is central to technological progress, yet it is increasingly shaped by geopolitical tensions and rising techno-nationalist policies. Drawing on the weaponized interdependence logic, this paper examines whether efforts to restrict cross-border knowledge flows, premised on the assumption that central positions in global innovation networks can be used as leverage over rival countries, can have unintended consequences for the domestic firms they are meant to protect and support. We study this question descriptively in the semiconductors field, a strategically critical and highly globalized technological sector in which firms play a central role in frontier scientific research. Using bibliometric data linked to patent citations, we track collaboration patterns, publication output and research quality of U.S. firms' semiconductor science before and after the escalation of U.S. technonationalist policies in 2019. We compare U.S.-China collaborations with other international partnerships and exploit heterogeneity in firms' pre-existing reliance on Chinese collaborators. We find that U.S.-China international research collaborations decline sharply after 2019 and that U.S. firms more exposed to the loss of Chinese partners experience persistent reductions in high-impact research, despite relatively stable publication volumes. At the same time, Chinese institutions expand both the quantity and quality of semiconductor research. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to document the unintended consequences of weaponized interdependence within scientific collaboration networks, showing that efforts to restrict strategic knowledge flows may weaken the domestic innovation capacity they are meant to strengthen.

AI.tldr: 本文基于"武器化相互依赖"逻辑，研究美国2019年科技民族主义政策升级后，限制中美科技合作对美国半导体企业科研的意外后果。研究发现美中研究合作急剧下降，对华合作依赖度高的美国企业高影响力研究持续减少，而中国机构半导体研究数量和质量均提升。
AI.research_question: 限制跨境知识流动的技术民族主义政策，是否会对本应受保护的国内企业产生意想不到的负面后果？具体而言，美国限制中美科研合作对美国半导体企业的科研产出质量和创新能力的长期影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 国际科技合作日益受到地缘政治紧张和科技民族主义政策的影响，政策制定者假设全球创新网络中的中心位置可以转化为对竞争对手的杠杆，但这一假设可能忽视了限制合作对本国企业的反噬效应。半导体领域是战略性关键且高度全球化的技术领域，美国企业的前沿科学研究高度依赖国际合作，是研究这一问题的理想场景。
AI.theoretical_framework: 武器化相互依赖（Weaponized Interdependence）理论
AI.method: 使用与专利引用关联的文献计量数据，追踪2019年美国科技民族主义政策升级前后美国企业半导体科学研究的合作模式、论文产出和研究质量的变化。采用描述性研究方法，对比中美合作与其他国际合作的差异，并利用企业对华合作者既有依赖程度的异质性进行识别。
AI.findings: 1) 2019年后美中国际科研合作急剧下降；2) 对华合作依赖度更高的美国企业在高影响力研究方面出现持续下降，尽管论文发表总量相对稳定；3) 中国机构在半导体研究的数量和质量上同时扩张。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文是首个在科学合作网络背景下记录武器化相互依赖意外后果的研究，表明限制战略知识流动的努力可能削弱本欲加强的国内创新能力，对武器化相互依赖理论在创新网络中的应用提供了重要的经验证据和理论延伸。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供关于技术民族主义政策潜在负面影响的实证证据，提示限制跨境科研合作可能损害本国企业的创新能力和长期竞争力，而非仅对中国形成施压。对半导体等战略性产业的科技政策制定具有重要参考意义。

title: A Variational Bayesian Framework for Preference Learning from Attention Signals in Interactive Multi-Criteria Decision Aiding
affiliations: , Xi'an Jiaotong University (XJTU) - School of Management, Poznan University of Technology, Xi’an Jiaotong University and Xi'an Jiaotong University (XJTU) - School of Management

detail.title: A Variational Bayesian Framework for Preference Learning from Attention Signals in Interactive Multi-Criteria Decision Aiding

declarations.declarationOfInterest: no
declarations.ethicsApproval: This experimental study was carried out in compliance with the ethical standards of Xi'an Jiaotong University. All participants provided written informed consent before participation. The data were collected anonymously and used exclusively for this academic research, with no secondary use or distribution of personal information.
declarations.funderStatement: Jiaxuan Jiang and Mi{\l}osz Kadzi{\'n}ski

detail.abstract: Decision makers in complex multi-criteria problems allocate limited attention selectively across criteria and alternatives, progressively constructing preferences during the decision process rather than retrieving them from stable internal states. Conventional multiple criteria decision aiding approaches rely on explicit judgments and provide limited support for capturing emergent preferences. To address this limitation, we propose a process-aware interactive framework based on an Observe-Orient-Decide-Act loop, integrating holistic ranking judgments with gaze-derived attention signals. The framework incrementally updates a ranking over alternatives while an embedded algorithm infers the evolving latent preference state and provides adaptive guidance at each interaction round. Within this framework, preference inference is formulated as Bayesian filtering in a linear Gaussian state-space model, with an online variational Bayesian algorithm combining closed-form Gaussian updates for the preference state and a reparameterization-based stochastic gradient estimator for the likelihood, recursively refining the posterior from each round's observations to satisfy real-time latency constraints. A controlled laboratory experiment with 120 participants demonstrates that incorporating attention signals improves decision consistency, inference accuracy, and convergence to the final ranking, with the largest gains under high task complexity. The framework also supports earlystage prediction of subsequent rankings and produces interpretable estimates of attention allocation across criteria and alternatives.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Observe-Orient-Decide-Act循环的过程感知交互框架，将整体排序判断与眼动注意力信号相结合，通过贝叶斯滤波在状态空间模型中推断决策者演化的潜在偏好状态，并在每次交互中提供自适应指导。实验表明融合注意力信号能提升决策一致性、推理准确性和最终排序收敛速度。
AI.research_question: 如何在多准则决策过程中，通过融合眼动注意力信号与整体排序判断，实时推断并捕捉决策者演化中的（涌现性）偏好，从而提供自适应决策支持？
AI.motivation: 传统多准则决策辅助方法依赖明确的判断（如成对比较或评分），假设偏好在决策前已稳定存在，但现实中决策者在复杂多准则问题中会选择性分配有限的注意力，并在决策过程中逐步构建偏好（涌现偏好）。现有方法难以捕捉这种动态演化过程，缺乏对过程信号的利用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于OODA循环（Observe-Orient-Decide-Act）的过程感知交互框架；贝叶斯滤波；线性高斯状态空间模型；在线变分贝叶斯算法
AI.method: 将偏好推断建模为线性高斯状态空间模型中的贝叶斯滤波问题；采用在线变分贝叶斯算法，结合闭式高斯更新（偏好状态）与基于重参数化的随机梯度估计器（似然函数），从每轮观察中递归细化后验以满足实时延迟约束；通过120名参与者的受控实验室实验进行验证。
AI.findings: 融合注意力信号可提升决策一致性、推断准确性和最终排序的收敛速度；在高任务复杂度下收益最大；框架支持对后续排序的早期预测，并能产生跨准则和备选方案的注意力分配的可解释估计。
AI.theory_contributions: 将偏好构建视为动态过程而非静态检索，为多准则决策辅助提供了过程感知的理论视角；将贝叶斯滤波与在线变分推断引入偏好推断领域，建立了注意力信号与偏好状态之间的形式化连接。
AI.practical_contributions: 为复杂多准则决策场景提供了可实现实时交互的自适应决策支持工具；通过眼动信号辅助偏好捕捉，提高决策质量和效率；支持早期排序预测与注意力分配的可解释性，帮助决策者理解自身决策过程。

affiliations: George Washington University -Law School

detail.title: International Law, the Civil Law Tradition, and Sources of Law - Parts I and II

publicationDetails.detailsText: GWU Legal Studies Research Paper Forthcoming
publicationDetails.journalName: George Washington University Law School Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This is a two-part post illustrating the impact of the civil law tradition on the formation of international law, specifically the sources of international law. The five sources of international law articulated in Article 38 have origins, both ancient and distinct, that long predate their crystallization in a multilateral convention. These posts explain that the sources of international law, including the law of war, can be elucidated through comparative legal analysis and a study of the continental civil law tradition.

AI.tldr: 本文通过比较法视角，探讨大陆法系传统对国际法形成（特别是国际法渊源）的影响，论述《国际法院规约》第38条所列举的五种国际法渊源具有古老而多元的起源，远早于其被多边公约固化之时。
AI.research_question: 大陆法系传统如何影响国际法（特别是国际法渊源）的形成？
AI.motivation: 国际法五大渊源（Article 38）的起源古老且各不相同，远早于其在多边公约中的固化，需要通过比较法分析来阐明其渊源。
AI.theoretical_framework: 比较法分析；大陆民法法系（civil law tradition）研究
AI.method: 比较法分析（comparative legal analysis），通过对大陆法系传统的深入研究来阐释国际法渊源
AI.findings: 国际法渊源（包括战争法）可以通过比较法分析和大陆民法法系传统研究得到阐明；五大渊源均具有独立且古老的起源。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了大陆法系传统对国际法形成的重要影响，为理解国际法渊源的起源提供了比较法视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 有助于法学家和国际法从业者更深入地理解国际法渊源的历史脉络与大陆法系根基，从而更准确地适用和解释国际法。

title: Re-calibrating the Jeepney Modernization Program: Policy Issues and Recommendations
affiliations: De La Salle University, De La Salle University and

detail.title: Re-calibrating the Jeepney Modernization Program: Policy Issues and Recommendations

publicationDetails.detailsText: Policy Brief I Volume 2 I Issue 24 I December 2023

detail.abstract: This policy brief examines the Philippine government's Public Utility Vehicle Modernization Program (PUVMP), which seeks to replace aging jeepneys and other public utility vehicles with modern, environmentally sustainable models while consolidating individual franchises into cooperatives and rationalizing transport routes. Originally targeted for completion in 2020, the program was delayed by the COVID-19 pandemic and, in 2023, by transport strikes protesting its financial burden on drivers and operators, prompting a deadline extension to December 31, 2023. The brief identifies key implementation issues: unrealistic timelines, the pursuit of multiple objectives simultaneously, insufficient technical and financial support, the absence of strategic pilot testing, limited stakeholder participation, weak communication strategies, poor coordination between national and local governments, routes planned independently of other transport modes, and a lack of a legislative framework. It recommends recalibrating the program's phasing, conducting localized pilot tests, strengthening multi-stakeholder participation and subsidies, defining institutional responsibilities, and pursuing legislation to ensure the program's long-term continuity and sustainability.

AI.tldr: 本政策简报分析了菲律宾政府"公共交通工具现代化计划"（PUVMP）的实施困境，指出该计划因时间表不切实际、目标过多、支持不足等问题而面临挑战，并提出重新调整阶段、试点测试、加强利益相关者参与和立法保障等建议。
AI.research_question: 菲律宾公共交通工具现代化计划（PUVMP）在实施过程中面临哪些关键问题，以及如何优化该计划的实施策略以确保其长期可持续性？
AI.motivation: 菲律宾的吉普尼等公共交通工具老化且污染严重，政府推出PUVMP计划试图实现现代化，但该计划遭遇了疫情延误、运输罢工抗议等重大障碍，亟需审视其实施问题并提出改进建议。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政策实施理论、公共政策评估框架、多利益相关者治理理论
AI.method: 政策简报分析，基于对菲律宾PUVMP实施过程的定性评估，识别关键实施问题并提出政策建议。
AI.findings: 识别出九大关键实施问题：时间表不切实际、同时追求多个目标、技术与财务支持不足、缺乏战略试点、利益相关者参与有限、沟通策略薄弱、中央与地方政府协调不力、路线规划与其他交通模式脱节、缺乏立法框架；并提出重新校准阶段性安排、开展本地化试点、加强多利益相关者参与和补贴、明确机构职责、推动立法等建议。
AI.theory_contributions: 为发展中国家公共交通政策改革中的实施障碍提供了系统性的案例分析，丰富了政策实施理论与实践之间差距的实证研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为菲律宾政府优化PUVMP提供具体可操作的政策建议，包括计划阶段性调整、试点测试、补贴机制强化、机构职责界定和立法推进，有助于提升计划的可行性和长期可持续性。

title: Beyond the Skew-Stickiness Ratio: Transport Geometry of Spot-Driven Variance Surface Dynamics
affiliations: and

detail.title: Beyond the Skew-Stickiness Ratio: Transport Geometry of Spot-Driven Variance Surface Dynamics
detail.abstract: We develop a geometric theory of arbitrage-free dynamics for implied variance surfaces. Total implied variance w(k, T) = σ 2 (k, T)T is taken as the primitive state variable, since static arbitrage is fundamentally a property of the variance surface rather than of implied volatility itself. We formulate smile dynamics as transport flows acting on the admissible class A of static-arbitrage-free surfaces: spot movements generate infinitesimal transport vector fields, and admissible smile dynamics are characterized as flows generated by vector fields tangent to A. Within this framework we introduce a hierarchy of transport laws governing the evolution of successive spatial derivatives of w. The classical skew-stickiness ratio (SSR) appears as the zeroth-order transport coefficient; higher-order coefficients govern the dynamics of ATM skew, curvature, and higher smile derivatives. We further extend the theory from the ATM expansion point to arbitrary log-moneyness via a local jet transport corollary, establishing that the transport velocity field v(k) is nonparametrically identified by the function k 0 → v0 (k 0) estimated at each expansion center. A natural convex-parabolic class of higher-order transport operators is identified and motivated; a complete characterization of admissibility-preserving higher-order operators remains open. Under explicit Lipschitz and positivity conditions on v (conditions (V1)-(V3) and (W)), the transport flow is proved to preserve butterfly and calendar arbitragefreeness locally, with an explicit admissibility radius. Classical smile regimes including sticky strike, sticky delta, and SSR arise as special choices of the transport field, while local volatility and rough volatility models induce transport laws or short-maturity asymptotics representable within the same framework. On the empirical side, we apply the sequential forward-substitution estimator to five years of SPX implied-volatility surface data across seven tenors from 1M to 24M. Three findings emerge. First, SPX exhibits significant super-skew behavior, with the scalar SSR coefficient β declining monotonically from short to long maturities and explaining most of ATM-level surface dynamics. Second, self-similar transport is rejected at all tenors: the joint test of H 0 : η = ψ = 0 rejects at every tenor (strongly from 2M onward), and the skew-transport coefficient η changes sign between 6M and 9M, reflecting a qualitative shift in surface dynamics across the term structure. Third, the transport velocity v0 (k 0) varies significantly with moneyness: strike-constancy is rejected at the intermediate tenors (2M-12M) but not at 1M or 24M, and the profile shape evolves with maturity: U-shaped at shorter tenors and monotonically decreasing at the longest tenors (see Section 8 for full results). An out-of-sample validation confirms that the full (β, η, ψ) model outperforms SSR on curvature dynamics by 17-21% at medium tenors.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了隐含方差曲面的无套利动态几何理论。以总隐含方差w(k,T)为基本状态变量，将微笑动态建模为作用于无静态套利曲面类A上的传输流。在此框架下引入传输定律层级，经典SSR为最低阶传输系数，高阶系数控制ATM偏斜、曲率等。经验上对五年SPX数据应用序贯前向替换估计，发现SPX呈现显著超偏斜行为、自相似传输在所有期限被拒绝、传输速度随平价水平显著变化，且全模型在中期限曲率动态上优于SSR约17-21%。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个统一的几何框架来描述隐含方差曲面的无套利动态，并通过该框架统一现有的微笑动态模型（如SSR、黏性行权价、黏性Delta等）及实证检验隐含波动率曲面的实际动态结构？
AI.motivation: 隐含波动率曲面的动态建模是衍生品定价和风险管理中的核心问题，但现有方法（如局部波动率、随机波动率、SSR参数化等）缺乏统一的理论框架，且对静态套利约束的处理不够系统。作者旨在建立一个将静态无套利条件与动态演化统一起来的几何传输理论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 传输流/传输向量场理论（transport flows）、静态无套利曲面类A的几何刻画、SSR（偏斜黏性比）作为零阶传输系数、局部喷注传输推论（local jet transport）、凸抛物类高阶传输算子、局部波动率与粗糙波动率模型在统一框架下的表示。
AI.method: 理论构建上采用微分几何方法将微笑动态建模为A上的传输流；实证上使用序贯前向替换估计器（sequential forward-substitution estimator），基于五年SPX隐含波动率曲面数据、七个期限（1M至24M），估计传输系数β（SSR）、η（偏斜传输系数）、ψ（曲率传输系数）及非参数传输速度v0(k0)，并进行假说检验和样本外验证。
AI.findings: (1) SPX呈现显著超偏斜行为，SSR系数β从短期到长期单调下降，解释了ATM水平的大部分曲面动态；(2) 自相似传输在所有期限被拒绝（H0:η=ψ=0在所有期限被拒），η在6M和9M之间改变符号，反映期限结构上的动态质变；(3) 传输速度v0(k0)随平价值显著变化：在中期期限（2M-12M）拒绝行权价恒定性，但在1M和24M不拒绝；轮廓形状随期限演化，短期为U形，最长期限为单调递减；(4) 样本外验证表明完整(β,η,ψ)模型在中期限的曲率动态上比SSR改进17-21%。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将隐含方差曲面动态系统地形式化为传输流几何理论；将经典SSR嵌入统一框架作为零阶传输系数；建立高阶传输定律层级以刻画ATM偏斜、曲率及更高阶微笑导数的动态；通过局部喷注传输推论实现从ATM展开点向任意对数平价值的扩展；刻画了一类自然凸抛物高阶传输算子，并给出了保套利性的显式容许半径条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 为从业者提供了统一的隐含波动率曲面动态建模框架，可用于更准确的曲面预测和期权定价；SSR与完整高阶模型的表现对比为实务中模型选择提供了量化依据（中期限曲率预测改进17-21%）；揭示了SPX在不同期限和行权价区间上动态行为的异质性，对风险管理和对冲策略设计具有直接参考价值。

title: Factors influencing schools’ readiness for child sexual abuse prevention education
affiliations: Beijing Normal University, Queensland University of Technology, Queensland University of Technology and Queensland University of Technology

detail.title: Factors influencing schools’ readiness for child sexual abuse prevention education
detail.abstract: Background: There is increasing focus on child sexual abuse (CSA) prevention education in schools, driven by the growing evidence-based studies demonstrating its effectiveness in improving children’s knowledge and skills, alongside strengthening policy support. School-based CSA prevention education has been implemented for many years. Schools’ readiness remains a critical precursor for the successful implementation. Therefore, this study aimed to assess schools’ readiness for child sexual abuse prevention education and its influencing factors. Method: A cross-sectional online teacher-reported survey titled Schools’ Readiness for CSA Prevention Education was conducted in 2023. Participants were Australian school teachers who were currently employed in government and non-government primary or secondary schools (n=334). Descriptive statistics and group comparisons were used to investigate patterns of readiness in the sample, and regressions were used to explore the factors that explained variance in teacher-reported school readiness. Results: The overall average score of Australian schools’ readiness for CSA prevention education was 3.82 out of 5. In the current sample, resource perception, situational factors, organizational resources, and change valence were significant factors that explained teacher-reported schools’ readiness scores (all p < .05). Among them, resource perception and situational factors were two major influencing factors.Conclusions: This study explored the status of Australian schools’ readiness for CSA prevention education and its influencing factors. These findings contribute to the readiness studies in CSA prevention field and provide useful information for improving CSA prevention education in Australian schools in the future.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过2023年对334名澳大利亚学校教师的横断面在线调查，评估了学校对儿童性虐待（CSA）预防教育的准备程度及其影响因素。结果显示澳大利亚学校总体准备度平均得分为3.82/5，其中资源感知和情境因素是两大主要影响因素，研究为改进CSA预防教育的学校实施提供了实证依据。
AI.research_question: 澳大利亚学校对儿童性虐待预防教育的准备程度如何？哪些因素影响学校层面的准备度？
AI.motivation: 基于证据的研究表明学校CSA预防教育能有效提升儿童的知识和技能，且政策支持日益增强，但学校准备度是成功实施的关键前提，目前缺乏对学校准备程度及其影响因素的实证评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于组织变革准备度（organizational readiness for change）理论框架，考察资源感知、情境因素、组织资源和变革效价等维度对学校准备度的影响。
AI.method: 2023年开展横断面在线教师报告调查（n=334），样本来自政府和非政府的澳大利亚小学及中学教师。使用描述性统计和分组比较分析准备度模式，采用回归分析探索解释教师报告的学校准备度方差的因子。
AI.findings: 澳大利亚学校CSA预防教育准备度总体平均分为3.82/5。资源感知、情境因素、组织资源和变革效价是解释学校准备度得分的显著因素（均p<.05），其中资源感知和情境因素是两大主要影响因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 本研究将组织准备度理论应用于儿童性虐待预防教育这一新兴领域，填补了CSA预防教育中学校准备度实证研究的空白，丰富了该领域的准备度研究文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果为澳大利亚学校未来改进CSA预防教育的实施提供了实用信息，可帮助教育政策制定者和学校管理者根据影响准备度的关键因素（如资源感知和情境因素）制定针对性的干预和资源配置策略。

title: Viksit Bharat 2047: Why Investment, Not Ambition, Is the Binding Constraint
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Viksit Bharat 2047: Why Investment, Not Ambition, Is the Binding Constraint

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.funderStatement: No one

detail.abstract: India's Viksit Bharat 2047 ambition is to reach high-income status by its centenary of independence. This paper asks whether, and when, that is achievable, benchmarking India against the historical experience of every economy that has made the climb since 1950. Using the World Bank's Atlas-GNI income classification, it triangulates across several methods: a persistence-adjusted classification of transitions, censoring-corrected survival analysis, a discrete-time hazard model with investment and labor force participation as time-varying covariates, a gap-to-threshold growth calculation, and a recent-decade baserate comparison. The methods converge. Reaching high income by 2047 requires dollar GNI-per-capita growth of about 9.84 percent a year for two decades—roughly double India's 5 percent pace over 2012–2025. No economy above three million population sustained that pace over the post-crisis decade; over any 22-year window since 1990, only China and Vietnam did so through organic, non-transition growth. The hazard model places India's probability of success at about 5 percent. The implied required investment share, about 57 percent of GDP against an actual 30, exceeds any sustained historical precedent—but this is the price of the 2047 date specifically: under a realistic convergence path, India reaches high income around 2067 with an ordinary rise in investment to about 33 percent. Labor force participation, including female participation, is found to be a consequence of growth, not an independent cause, and so is not the missing lever. The binding constraint is investment and the investment climate: a decade-long collapse in foreign direct investment, and the absence of a comprehensive trade agreement with the United States. India would do better to talk less about the 2047 slogan and more about the concrete reforms that raise the trend path of growth.

AI.tldr: 本文评估印度"Viksit Bharat 2047"（独立百年时成为高收入国家）目标的可实现性，通过多种方法交叉验证，发现达到目标需年约9.84%的美元人均GNI增速（为当前速度的两倍），而历史上极少数经济体做到过。概率模型显示成功概率仅约5%。若按现实收敛路径，印度约在2067年才能达到高收入，关键约束是投资及投资环境而非劳动力参与率。
AI.research_question: 印度"Viksit Bharat 2047"目标（在2047年独立百年之际达到高收入国家地位）是否可实现？若可实现，何时能够实现？
AI.motivation: 印度政府提出了2047年成为高收入国家的宏伟愿景，但缺乏系统的实证评估。本文通过对照1950年以来所有成功晋升高收入经济体的历史经验，对印度该目标的可行性进行严格检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 世界银行Atlas-GNI收入分类体系；收入转型的持续性调整分类；删失校正生存分析；离散时间风险模型；增长缺口-阈值计算；基准率比较。
AI.method: 采用多方法三角验证：(1) 持续性调整的转型分类；(2) 删失校正生存分析；(3) 以投资和劳动力参与率为时变协变量的离散时间风险模型；(4) 缺口-阈值增长计算；(5) 近十年基准率比较。
AI.findings: 各方法结果收敛：实现2047目标需连续20年年均约9.84%的美元人均GNI增长（约为印度2012-2025年5%增速的两倍）；人口超300万的经济体中无一方能在危机后十年维持此增速，1990年以来仅中国和越南在22年窗口内实现；风险模型显示印度成功率约5%；所需投资率约57%GDP（实际为30%），超出历史先例；但若放松2047时间限制，按现实收敛路径印度约在2067年达到高收入（投资率需升至33%即可）。劳动力参与率（含女性）是增长的后果而非独立原因。核心约束是投资和投资环境——包括外资直接投资持续十年下滑及缺乏对美全面贸易协定。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过多方法交叉验证，为"国家何时能跨越高收入门槛"提供了系统的实证框架；挑战了将劳动力参与率视为增长独立驱动因素的传统观点，揭示其为增长的结果；将收入分类转型的概率建模与历史基准相结合，提供了可复制的方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 对印度政策制定者提供了明确量化目标：若坚持2047时间表，需将投资率提升至57%GDP；若放弃该时间表，33%的投资率即可在2067年实现高收入。指出FDI下滑和美印贸易协定缺失是具体政策抓手，建议减少口号式宣传、聚焦提升增长趋势路径的具体改革。

title: Mountain Agro-Pomological Parks: A Conceptual Framework
affiliations: and CBM International University

detail.title: Mountain Agro-Pomological Parks: A Conceptual Framework
detail.abstract: This study focuses on developing a conceptual framework for establishing mountain public agro-pomological parks (public orchards) through planting or replanting, as an alternative to afforestation or reforestation, with the aim of utilizing degraded lands-particularly abandoned pastures and hayfields. These public orchards should consist of fruit trees and shrubs that require minimal maintenance, considering the limited availability of personnel in Romania for such activities. Harvesting can involve public participation, transforming the orchards into a form of agrotourism, with the possibility of charging a minimal entrance fee. The research is grounded in several key aspects specific to contemporary mountain areas, forming the foundation of the conceptual framework proposed. These include a significant reduction in cattle and sheep populations, a decline in transhumance practices, and a decrease in organic natural fertilizers derived from animal resources, all of which contribute to the degradation of natural vegetation on pastures and hayfields. In this context, soil impoverishment and degradation occur, marked by a decline in organic matter content, reduced microbial biodiversity, and lower soil fertility. The depopulation of mountain areas leads to the neglect of lands-both publicly and privately owned-especially pastures and hayfields, exacerbating existing ecological and economic problems.
