title: Pricing and Profiting in Copyright: Introducing an Islamic Perspective

detail.title: Pricing and Profiting in Copyright: Introducing an Islamic Perspective

declarations.funderStatement: Research for this article was fully supported by the Small Research Grant awarded by the University of Malaya, Malaysia (Project no: BK024-2017).

publicationDetails.detailsText: This paper has been published in QMJIP Vol 10, No 2, 2020, p 152

detail.abstract:
The economic rights granted to copyright holders are, at times, an obstacle to the public’s right of access to knowledge as the works are priced beyond the means of their consumers. Recognizing this, the three-step test in Article 13 of the Trade-Related Aspects of Intellectual Property Rights Agreement provides exceptions and limitations to the copyright holders’ economic rights. It is, however, arguable that the test is inadequate in balancing the rights and interests of the copyright holders and the public.
It is observed that majority of the available literature on this issue are based on Western principles and thought. The article, therefore, proposes that scholarship from an alternative set of knowledge could potentially shed some light onto the matter. In particular, the article suggests that an Islamic perspective on pricing and profiting could provide a more appropriate balance that would grant equitable access to knowledge, research and education to the general public and yet, ensuring that copyright holders (and authors) remain incentivized to produce high quality literary work. In so doing, the article introduces one of the first steps to applying Islamic economic principles to contemporary copyright issues.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了TRIPS协议第13条三步检验法在平衡版权持有人经济权利与公众知识获取权方面的不足，并提出从伊斯兰经济原则中汲取灵感，以提供更适当的平衡方案，既保障公众公平获取知识、研究和教育的机会，又维持版权持有人（作者）创作高质量文学作品的激励。这是将伊斯兰经济原理应用于当代版权问题的初步尝试之一。
AI.research_question: 三步检验法是否足以平衡版权持有人与公众之间的权利和利益？伊斯兰视角下的定价与获利原则能否为这一平衡提供更优的解决方案？
AI.motivation: 版权持有人享有的经济权利有时会阻碍公众获取知识的权利，因为作品定价超出了消费者的承受能力。TRIPS协议第13条的三步检验法虽提供例外与限制，但被认为在平衡双方权益方面存在不足，且现有文献大多基于西方原则与思想，缺乏来自替代性知识体系的视角。
AI.theoretical_framework: 版权法中的三步检验法（TRIPS协议第13条）；伊斯兰经济原则中关于定价与获利的理论视角。
AI.method: 规范性法律分析；跨文化比较研究——借鉴伊斯兰经济原则审视当代版权问题。
AI.findings: 三步检验法在平衡版权持有人与公众权益方面存在不足；现有文献多基于西方思想体系。伊斯兰经济原则在定价与获利方面的观点，有可能提供更恰当的平衡，在确保版权持有人创作激励的同时，为公众提供公平获取知识、研究和教育的途径。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将伊斯兰经济原则系统性地引入当代版权问题分析，开辟了版权平衡问题研究中替代性知识体系（非西方）的理论路径，丰富了版权法例外与限制的理论探讨维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和立法者提供了一种超越三步检验法的新思路，可能有助于设计更加公平合理（尤其对穆斯林世界及其他发展中国家）的版权例外与限制制度，促进知识获取的普惠性。

title: What does CBAM Actually Cost a Gulf Equity Investor?

detail.title: What does CBAM Actually Cost a Gulf Equity Investor?
detail.abstract: The biggest carbon exposure in the UAE economy is not listed. Seventy per cent of the market that is listed cannot be bought. 0.76% of the portfolio, by weight 23 bps annual cost of screening it out 47.5% of its revenue earned in Europe Transition risk in UAE listed equities, and why the portfolio cannot see it

AI.tldr: 本文研究了阿联酋（UAE）上市股票中存在的转型风险（transition risk）盲区。研究发现，阿联酋经济中最大的碳暴露并不在上市市场中——上市市场中有70%的股票无法被购买，而筛选掉这些股票组合中0.76%的权重每年仅需23个基点的成本，但该组合有47.5%的收入来自欧洲。论文揭示了UAE上市股票中的转型风险，以及为何投资组合无法识别这一风险。
AI.research_question: 阿联酋上市股票市场中的转型风险（碳排放与经济转型风险）是什么？为什么投资组合无法识别并管理这一风险？
AI.motivation: 阿联酋经济高度依赖碳密集型产业，但最大的碳暴露并未在上市市场中体现。投资者需要了解上市股票组合中转型风险的实际程度与其可见性之间的差距。
AI.theoretical_framework: 转型风险理论、碳暴露与投资组合管理理论、ESG/可持续投资框架
AI.method: 对阿联酋上市股票市场进行数据分析，包括市场可投资性评估、组合权重分析、筛选成本计算，以及收入地域来源（欧洲敞口）分析。
AI.findings: 1. 阿联酋经济最大的碳暴露不在上市市场；2. 上市市场中有70%的股票无法被购买（不可投资）；3. 筛选掉组合中0.76%权重的碳暴露仅需每年23个基点的成本；4. 该组合中有47.5%的收入来自欧洲，面临欧盟碳边境调节机制等政策风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了新兴市场（特别是海湾国家）上市股票中转型风险可见性的问题，指出投资组合管理者可能因为市场可投资性限制而无法全面管理碳转型风险，拓展了ESG投资中关于风险可见性与可管理性的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了阿联酋市场中碳转型风险的量化评估，包括筛选成本和地域收入敞口分析，帮助投资组合管理者识别和应对在UAE上市股票中可能被忽视的转型风险。

title:
The Contract Is Not the Model 
Proof-Carrying Exotic Derivatives and the Economics of Model Risk
affiliations: Imperial College London - Department of Mathematics

detail.title:
The Contract Is Not the Model 
Proof-Carrying Exotic Derivatives and the Economics of Model Risk
detail.abstract: Structured-product validation normally begins downstream: practitioners compare prices, Greeks, Monte Carlo engines, calibration choices, or hedge performance. This leaves a logically prior source of risk partly informal: whether the object being priced is in fact the object specified by the legal documentation. We develop a formal methodology that separates five layers-source terms, deterministic contract semantics, lifecycle semantics, stochastic pricing semantics, and numerical risk estimation-and represents the theorem boundaries between them in Lean 4. A deliberately small contract language is paired with a lifecycle state machine tracking outstanding notional and termination. The lifecycle compiles into the payoff language, and the development contains source-level proofs that compilation preserves deterministic cashflows, discounted pathwise value, model price, and central-difference risk. Generic lifecycle results enforce nonnegative and non-increasing outstanding notional and make termination absorbing. The methodology is tested against ten publicly documented structured products: four equity/ETF autocallable or trigger notes, three CMS and range-accrual rate products, an emerging-market FX basket, a daily-monitored gold barrier note, and a single-name creditlinked certificate. These examples force the formalism to accommodate worst-of dependence, contingent coupons, buffers, discrete barriers, issuer exercise, curve spreads, range accruals, quote conventions, credit events, and partial restructuring. The economic contribution is a decomposition of validation risk: contract-semantic risk is distinct from stochastic model risk and numerical approximation risk, and should be controlled before model comparison begins. For repetitive issuance programs, formalization also has a fixed-cost/marginal-cost structure that can make proof-carrying contract templates economically attractive. The present artifact is intentionally conservative: unformalized legal provisions are first-class data, and the current source increment is not described as kernel-certified until a clean Lean build and independent checker run have been completed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种形式化验证方法，将结构化产品的验证分为五个层次（源条款、确定性合约语义、生命周期语义、随机定价语义和数值风险估计），并在Lean 4中表示各层之间的定理边界。通过小型合约语言配合生命周期状态机，并在勒让德（对十种公开记录的结构化产品）上验证了该方法。
AI.research_question: 如何将结构化产品验证的源头（即被定价对象是否与法律文件规定一致）形式化，从而将合约语义风险与随机模型风险和数值近似风险区分开来？
AI.motivation: 传统结构化产品验证从下游开始（比较价格、Greeks、蒙特卡洛引擎、校准选择或对冲表现），这忽略了逻辑上更优先的风险来源：被定价对象是否确实是法律文件规定的对象。这种合约语义风险长期处于非正式状态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 形式化验证理论，基于Lean 4定理证明器，将合约语义分为五个层次：源条款、确定性合约语义、生命周期语义、随机定价语义和数值风险估计。
AI.method: 使用Lean 4开发形式化方法论：设计小型合约语言与生命周期状态机（跟踪未偿名义和终止），生命周期编译为收益语言，并进行源级证明（编译保持确定性现金流、贴现路径值、模型价格和中心差分风险）。在十种公开记录的结构化产品上测试。
AI.findings: （1）五个层次的分离使得合约语义风险可与随机模型风险和数值近似风险明确区分；（2）生命周期通用结果保证未偿名义的非负性和非递增性，并使终止具有吸收性；（3）十种产品案例证实形式化方法能处理worst-of依赖、条件票息、缓冲、离散障碍、发行人行使权、曲线利差、区间计息、报价惯例、信用事件和部分重组等复杂特征；（4）对重复发行项目，形式化具有固定成本/边际成本结构，使带证明的合约模板在经济上具有吸引力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了验证风险分解的理论贡献：合约语义风险与随机模型风险和数值近似风险是三种不同类别的风险，且合约语义风险应在模型比较开始之前就得到控制。同时证明了生命周期语义向收益语言的编译保持各层语义不变性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为结构化产品的发行和验证提供了一种可证明正确的方法论框架；对重复发行项目，形式化模板的固定成本/边际成本结构使其在经济上可行；将未形式化的法律条款作为一等数据（first-class data）处理，保持审慎态度。

title:
Does AI Rate Through the Cycle?

Procyclicality in Credit Assessment
affiliations: Independent Researcher, USA. and

detail.title:
Does AI Rate Through the Cycle?

Procyclicality in Credit Assessment
detail.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly proposed as credit-rating and default-assessment tools, yet whether they rate "through the cycle" or amplify it-a property prudential regulators care about but that has been asserted rather than measured-has remained untested. We hold synthetic firm fundamentals byte-identical across an ordered five-point macroeconomic-severity axis (plus a matched credit-irrelevant placebo axis) and elicit letter ratings and one-year default probabilities from five production-tier models (two families, two capability tiers), so that any rating movement is procyclicality by construction, identified without the unobserved-fundamentals confound that limits the classical Amato-Furfine test. Across 32,000 ratings, every model is significantly procyclical (pooled 0.429 rating notches of downgrade per severity step, 95% CI [0.41, 0.45]; a 1.76-notch boom-to-recession swing), the effect is sharply asymmetric (3.2× steeper into recessions than out of them), an order of magnitude larger than the placebo, and robust to model-version fixed effects and a token-logprobability estimator. An explicit "through-the-cycle" instruction lowers the rating slope but does not restore through-the-cycle behaviour-it anchors the rating while suppressing the point-in-time default probability that should move, whereas a naive "be stable" instruction preserves that distinction better. Because model choice and prompt framing are first-order determinants of the effect, LLM-based credit assessment can silently import the capital-procyclicality channel that regulation seeks to dampen.

AI.tldr: 本文通过严格对照实验设计，证明大型语言模型（LLMs）在信用评级中存在显著且非对称的顺周期性行为，且简单的"穿越周期"指令无法有效修正这一问题。
AI.research_question: 大型语言模型在信用评级和违约评估中是否表现出顺周期性（procyclicality）？即它们的评级行为是"穿越周期"（through-the-cycle）还是放大经济周期波动？
AI.motivation: LLMs正被越来越多地用于信用评级和违约评估工具，但监管机构关心的"穿越周期"性质从未被系统测量过；经典Amato-Furfine检验受未观测基本面混杂因素限制，无法有效识别LLM的顺周期性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 顺周期性/穿越周期理论（通过周期 vs 逐点评级框架）；谨慎监管视角下的资本顺周期渠道理论
AI.method: 实验设计：在有序五级宏观经济严重度轴（加匹配的与信用无关的安慰剂轴）上保持合成企业基本面逐字节相同，向五个生产级模型（两个家族、两个能力层级）获取字母评级和一年期违约概率；共收集32,000个评级；使用评级斜率估计、模型版本固定效应和令牌对数概率估计器进行稳健性检验，并对比"穿越周期"指令与"保持稳定"指令的提示框架效果。
AI.findings: 所有模型均显著顺周期（每严重度步长池化降级0.429个评级档，95% CI [0.41, 0.45]；繁荣到衰退摆动为1.76档）；效应高度不对称（进入衰退比走出衰退陡峭3.2倍）；效应比安慰剂大一个数量级；对模型版本固定效应和令牌对数概率估计器稳健；"穿越周期"指令降低评级斜率但不能恢复穿越周期行为——它锚定评级同时压制了本应变动的逐点违约概率，而朴素的"保持稳定"指令反而能更好地保持这种区分。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统测量和量化LLM信用评级的顺周期性；突破了经典Amato-Furfine检验中未观测基本面混杂因素的局限，提出了新的识别策略；揭示了指令框架与模型选择对评级行为特征的一阶决定作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为审慎监管机构提供实证依据，说明基于LLM的信用评估可能悄然引入监管层试图抑制的资本顺周期渠道；为金融机构在使用LLM进行信用评级时的模型选型和提示词工程提供指导。

title: Lead Independent Directors, Independent Chairs, and Stock-Return Risk: Measurement and Identification Under Sparse Leadership Transitions
affiliations: Fundação Getulio Vargas

detail.title: Lead Independent Directors, Independent Chairs, and Stock-Return Risk: Measurement and Identification Under Sparse Leadership Transitions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses publicly available and archived corporate governance disclosures and market data and does not involve human participants, patient data, or experimental interventions. Ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Independent board leadership is often coded as a categorical governance feature and then related to firm outcomes. That empirical sequence is only informative if the categories represent comparable institutional states and the panel contains enough independent transition variation to distinguish them. This paper studies that prior measurement-and-identification problem in a documentary panel of 30 U.S.listed, SEC-reporting issuers observed through 2025. The analytical file contains 207 lagged firm-years, but only seven firms change the broad leadership architecture and five supply the more homogeneous reciprocal formal Lead Independent Director (LID)-independent-chair contrast. The historical loggedidiosyncratic-volatility estimate is-0.1025 (CR2 95% CI-0.229 to 0.024; p=0.093), approximately-9.7% for the coded architecture contrast, with wild-cluster p-values of 0.083 and 0.080. The original threeoutcome family does not reject after Holm adjustment (p=0.248), and NCSKEW and DUVOL do not show a corresponding downside-asymmetry pattern. Restricting the sample to five reciprocal formal LIDindependent-chair switchers produces a similar point estimate (-0.0965) but substantially wider uncertainty. Influence decomposition reveals offsetting issuer contributions, while a post-estimation event audit identifies no clean LID-only or independent-chair-only changes among the currently outcomeidentifying events. The evidence therefore supports a local architecture-package association, not separate effects of LIDs and independent chairs. The paper contributes a disciplined reporting framework for documentary governance panels: define institutional states before estimation, report switcher and leverage support alongside firm-years, separate construct restrictions from statistical robustness, align outcomes with effective treatment timing, and require orthogonal component variation before assigning componentspecific interpretations. For boards and investors, the implication is diagnostic rather than prescriptive: governance design should be evaluated by the authority supplied by the architecture, not by the title alone.

AI.tldr: 本文研究独立董事会领导结构的测量与识别问题，基于30家美国上市公司的实证面板数据（207个滞后公司年），发现独立董事领导架构与股票特质波动率之间存在局部关联（约-9.7%），但无法区分独立首席董事（LID）与独立董事长的独立效应，证据支持"架构包"效应而非单独头衔效应。
AI.research_question: 独立董事会领导类别（LID与独立董事长）是否代表可比较的制度状态？面板数据中是否有足够的独立转换变异来区分这些类别的独立效应？
AI.motivation: 现有研究常将独立董事会领导编码为分类治理特征并与公司结果相关联，但这一实证路径只有在类别代表可比较的制度状态、且面板具有足够的独立转换变异时才具有信息量。作者旨在解决这一"测量与识别"的前提问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 治理测量理论、识别策略理论、董事会领导架构理论。强调制度状态定义先于估计、组件效应分解所需的正交变异条件等方法论框架。
AI.method: 基于30家美国SEC报告上市公司的文档面板（截至2025年），共207个滞后公司年。使用对数特质波动率估计（系数-0.1025），采用CR2聚类稳健标准误和wild-cluster bootstrap p值；进行Holm多重检验调整、样本限制（5个纯转换者）、影响分解和事后事件审计。
AI.findings: 1) 架构对比的特质波动率估计约为-9.7%（p=0.093），但统计显著性较弱；2) 经Holm调整后原始三结果族不拒绝（p=0.248），且NCSKEW和DUVOL未显示下行不对称模式；3) 限制到5个纯转换者样本估计值相似（-0.0965）但不确定性更大；4) 影响分解显示发行者贡献相互抵消；5) 事件审计未发现干净的单独LID或独立董事长变更。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出一个纪律化的文档治理面板报告框架：估计前定义制度状态、报告转换者与杠杆支持、区分构念限制与统计稳健性、将结果与有效处理时间对齐、在赋予组件特定解释前要求正交组件变异。
AI.practical_contributions: 对董事会和投资者的含义是诊断性而非规定性的：治理设计应依据架构所提供的权威来评估，而非仅依据头衔。揭示将LID与独立董事长视为可分离治理机制的常见做法可能缺乏识别基础。

title: Fundamentally, Momentum Is Fundamental Momentum: Evidence From India
affiliations: QED Capital Advisors and

detail.title: Fundamentally, Momentum Is Fundamental Momentum: Evidence From India
detail.abstract: We implement SUE (Standardised Unexpected Earnings) as outlined in Novy-Marx [1] which posits that earnings momentum explains the performance of strategies based on price momentum (WML). SUE captures the magnitude of a firm's earnings surprise relative to the historical variation in its earning changes. Using data from Indian markets from 2004-2025, we demonstrate that SUE subsumes WML in cross-sectional regression using Fama-French factors as a proxy for firm characteristics. When we control for SUE, the performance of WML reduces significantly, without a reduction in volatility. Controlling for WML does not reduce the performance of SUE but reduces drawdown and volatility. We extend the study by constructing long-only SUE portfolios across three universes: the top 250, 500, and 750 stocks by market capitalisation. We also conduct a size stratification study using K-means clustering into five dynamic buckets. This study demonstrates that SUE is concentrated in small and midcap universe.

AI.tldr: 本文基于Novy-Marx提出的SUE（标准化未预期盈余）指标，利用印度市场2004-2025年数据，验证了盈余动能可以解释价格动能（WML）策略的表现。研究发现SUE在截面回归中吸收了WML的解释力，控制SUE后WML表现显著下降；反之控制WML不会降低SUE表现，但能降低回撤和波动。研究还构建了三种市值范围（前250、500、750只股票）的多头SUE组合，并通过K-means聚类进行五档市值分层，发现SUE效应集中于中小盘股。
AI.research_question: 盈余动能（SUE）能否解释价格动能（WML）策略在印度市场的表现？SUE效应在不同市值范围的股票中如何分布？
AI.motivation: 价格动能（WML）是广为研究的异象，但Novy-Marx提出其表现可能实际由盈余动能驱动。本文旨在印度这一新兴市场中检验该理论，并探索SUE策略的实践应用价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 标准未预期盈余（SUE）理论（Novy-Marx框架）；Fama-French因子模型；盈余漂移异象（PEAD）相关理论。
AI.method: 使用印度市场2004-2025年数据，构建SUE指标；运用Fama-French因子作代理变量的截面回归分析；构建多头SUE组合并进行K-means聚类市值分层研究。
AI.findings: 1) SUE在截面回归中吸收了WML的表现，控制SUE后WML表现显著下降但波动未减；2) 控制WML不降低SUE表现但降低回撤和波动；3) SUE效应在中小盘股中最为集中。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了Novy-Marx的SUE理论在新兴市场（印度）的适用性，为盈余动能与价格动能的关系提供了国际证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供基于SUE的多头组合构建策略，并通过市值分层揭示了策略适用的最佳股票池（中小盘）；同时展示了K-means聚类在投资组合分类中的应用。

title: Adjust and Unwind: Measuring the External Income Position and the Durability of Fiscal Adjustment

detail.title: Adjust and Unwind: Measuring the External Income Position and the Durability of Fiscal Adjustment

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests, financial or personal, that could have influenced this work.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received for this work, which was carried out with the author's own resources.

detail.abstract:
Analyses of fiscal sustainability have shifted attention from the stock of public debt to the flow of debt service. I ask which flow the primary balance tracks, on a panel of 53 to 60 economies over 2000-2023 that contains both high-income and middle-income countries, and document that the answer differs with position in the international financial hierarchy.

 I first measure external income position. Every economy of a commodity-financialized route is a net payer of primary income over the period, while the median high-income economy is approximately balanced. The remuneration gap between the two groups is concentrated entirely on debt liabilities. On direct investment there is no gap at all, and the industrializing Asian economies pay the most of anyone.

 I then estimate fiscal reaction functions and local projections for two candidate services. Public debt interest registers no asymmetry between the groups. The external income drain does, and the asymmetry is one of duration rather than size. High-income economies adjust more on impact and unwind the entire adjustment by the third year; middle-income economies adjust less and sustain it. 

The two halves are compatible rather than connected: the fiscal asymmetry loads on the debt leg, where the price hierarchy sits, but the formal test that the legs differ does not clear, and the paper claims the juxtaposition, not the mechanism. 

The contribution is to the fiscal reaction function: a term the standard specification omits, measured, and a dynamic it cannot see, documented. Six identification strategies for a causal level effect are attempted and fail informatively; the between-group reversal-the object of inference-survives a specification in which every control carries a group-specific coefficient, the condition under which an interaction is identified without exogeneity of the level. Its implication is twofold: a single fiscal reaction coefficient cannot distinguish a government that tightens and holds from one that tightens and stops, and the primary balance consistent with both debt stabilization and external sustainability contains a termthe income drain net of private adjustment-that the debt-dynamics equation omits.

AI.tldr: 本文研究财政可持续性分析中关键问题：初级财政余额追踪的是公共债务利息还是外部收入外流？利用2000-2023年53到60个经济体的面板数据，发现答案取决于经济体在国际金融层级中的位置——高收入经济体与中等收入经济体在财政反应上存在持续性而非规模上的不对称。
AI.research_question: 初级财政余额追踪的是哪种债务服务流量——公共债务利息还是外部收入外流？该答案是否随经济体在国际金融层级中的位置而不同？
AI.motivation: 财政可持续性分析已从关注公共债务存量转向债务服务流量，但哪种具体的流量驱动初级财政余额的调整尚不明确，且国际金融层级中不同位置的经济体可能对此给出不同答案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政反应函数（fiscal reaction function）理论；国际金融层级/商品金融化路径理论；外部可持续性与债务可持续性的区分框架。
AI.method: 基于2000-2023年53至60个经济体的面板数据，测量外部收入头寸（初次收入净支付），估计财政反应函数与局部投影（local projections），比较高收入与中等收入经济体间的财政调整动态；尝试六种因果识别策略，并采用所有控制变量均携带组别特定系数的规格检验组间反转效应。
AI.findings: (1) 商品金融化路径经济体在整个期间都是初次收入的净支付方，而高收入经济体接近平衡；两组间的报酬差距完全集中在债务负债上，直接投资无差距。(2) 公共债务利息在两组间无不对称性，但外部收入外流存在不对称——表现为持续时间而非规模：高收入经济体在冲击当期调整更多但第三年完全回撤，中等收入经济体调整较少但持续。(3) 财政不对称载于债务腿（价格层级所在处），但两腿差异的正式检验未通过，作者只主张并列关系而非机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 对财政反应函数文献的贡献：(1) 识别并测量了标准规格中遗漏的一项（外部收入外流）；(2) 记录了标准财政反应函数无法观察的动态（调整持续性差异）；(3) 证明单一财政反应系数无法区分"收紧并持续"与"收紧即止"的政府；(4) 指出与债务稳定和外部可持续性都一致的初级余额包含债务动态方程遗漏的收入外流（扣除私人调整后）项。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供区分经济体类型（高收入vs中等收入）的财政可持续性分析框架；提示外部收入外流应纳入财政规则设计中；说明不同国际金融层级位置的经济体需要不同的财政调整策略预期。

title: Feedback Control for Adaptive Language Model Routing Under Non-stationary Workloads

detail.title: Feedback Control for Adaptive Language Model Routing Under Non-stationary Workloads
detail.abstract: Serving a stream of requests across large language models (LLMs) of differing cost and quality is an online allocation problem, usually framed as multi-armed bandits. We frame it as feedback control: a direct-acting Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) controller whose setpoint is the running fleet-average performance and whose bounded output adjusts each model's allocation share, with requests routed by weighted sampling over the allocation vector. This work contributes (i) a stability analysis of the closed loop-bounded-input bounded-output behaviour by anti-windup, exponential convergence of the performance estimates via a Lyapunov function, and a persistent-excitation condition guaranteeing recoverability after a regime change; (ii) a closed-form, analysis-grounded automatic tuning rule requiring no per-dataset search; and (iii) an honest head-to-head against static, round-robin, random, epsilon-greedy, UCB1, Thompson sampling, and the non-stationary bandits Sliding-Window UCB and Discounted UCB, on GSM8K with a checkable exact-match reward, reporting inference cost and request latency alongside quality. Under transient drift the auto-tuned controller is statistically tied with the best non-stationary bandit at lower cost; under a persistent regime shift it significantly outperforms both (p < 0.03). We further show the integral term helps only under a persistent shift-a proportional controller suffices for transient drift-and evaluate robustness to noisy rewards. The result is an interpretable, stability-analyzed, auto-tuned routing controller competitive with or superior to non-stationary bandits at lower cost.

AI.tldr: 本文将大语言模型（LLM）请求路由问题从多臂老虎机框架重构为反馈控制问题，提出一种直接作用的PID控制器来动态分配各模型流量份额。论文提供了闭环稳定性分析（包括抗积分饱和的有界输入有界输出行为、Lyapunov函数证明的性能估计指数收敛、以及保证制度变化后可恢复性的持续激励条件），提出无需逐数据集搜索的闭合式自动调参规则，并在GSM8K上与多种静态和非平稳老虎机算法进行公平对比。结果表明：在瞬态漂移下，自动调参控制器以更低成本与非平稳老虎机统计持平；在持续制度转变下显著优于两者（p<0.03）。
AI.research_question: 如何将LLM请求路由这一在线分配问题从多臂老虎机框架重构为反馈控制问题，并设计一个具有稳定性保证、自动调参、且在成本和质量上优于或持平于非平稳老虎机算法的路由控制器？
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM请求路由通常被框架为多臂老虎机问题，但老虎机方法在非平稳环境下表现不佳，且缺乏对系统稳定性的理论保证。同时，自动调参（无需逐数据集搜索）对于实际部署至关重要。作者认为反馈控制理论提供了更自然且可分析的替代框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 反馈控制理论（PID控制）、Lyapunov稳定性分析、抗积分饱和（anti-windup）设计、持续激励条件（persistent excitation）、多臂老虎机理论（作为对比基线）
AI.method: 提出一个直接作用的PID控制器，设定点为运行中的舰队平均性能，有界输出调整每个模型的分配份额，请求通过加权抽样按分配向量路由。方法包括：(1)闭环稳定性分析（BIBO稳定、Lyapunov指数收敛证明、持续激励条件）；(2)基于闭合式解的自动调参规则；(3)在GSM8K上以精确匹配奖励与静态（round-robin、epsilon-greedy、UCB1、Thompson sampling）和非平稳老虎机（SW-UCB、D-UCB）进行公平对比，报告推理成本和延迟。
AI.findings: (1)在瞬态漂移下，自动调参控制器以更低成本与最佳非平稳老虎机统计持平；(2)在持续制度转变下，控制器显著优于非平稳老虎机（p<0.03）；(3)积分项仅在持续制度转变时有帮助，瞬态漂移下比例控制器已足够；(4)控制器对噪声奖励具有鲁棒性；(5)该方法可解释、有稳定性分析、自动调参，成本更低。
AI.theory_contributions: (1)首次将LLM请求路由从老虎机框架重新概念化为反馈控制问题，提供了理论新视角；(2)给出闭环系统的严格稳定性分析，包括BIBO稳定性、Lyapunov函数证明的指数收敛，以及持续激励条件保证制度变化后的可恢复性；(3)提出基于闭合式的自动调参规则，免去逐数据集搜索；(4)对积分项在不同环境（瞬态漂移vs持续转变）下作用的理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: (1)提供一种可解释、可自动调参的路由控制器，可直接部署需无需参数搜索；(2)在真实基准（GSM8K）上证明该方法在成本和质量上具有竞争力，特别在非平稳环境中优于现有老虎机方法；(3)同时报告推理成本和请求延迟，为实际系统部署提供更全面的性能画像；(4)提供鲁棒性评估，增强实际应用信心。

title: Drawdown Mandates and Untradeable Wealth: An Allocation Ceiling for Private Markets

detail.title: Drawdown Mandates and Untradeable Wealth: An Allocation Ceiling for Private Markets
detail.abstract: Institutional investors increasingly write maximum-drawdown mandates on portfolios that contain a large, untradeable private-markets sleeve. We show these commitments are mathematically incompatible: within the admissible class of long-only, bounded-leverage policies, none satises the mandate whenever the two sleeves are less than perfectly negatively correlated. In the GrossmanZhou framework the mandate is enforceable because the investor can drive risky exposure to zero at the barrier; when part of the book cannot be sold, and cannot be hedged by the liquid sleeve, the diusion coecient of wealth has a strictly positive oor and the mandate is breached almost surely. We quantify the resulting second-best. Reparametrising the problem in terms of the controllable and uncontrollable volatility contributions (u, v) yields an exact law P(D > d) = (1-d) η and a ceiling on the attainable drawdown exponent that is exactly hyperbolic in the illiquid share, η * (v) = A/v-1. We prove this ceiling is attained, uniquely, by a constant control over the class of drawdown-monotone feedbacks a broad class of economically natural rules that do not increase risk as the drawdown deepens, containing the GrossmanZhou, CPPI, fractional-Kelly and constantproportion families and we exhibit a non-monotone policy that beats it, which shows that mandates written on the frequency of breach are gameable, while a depth-weighted mandate cuts the gain from that manipulation roughly in half. Inverting the ceiling gives a closedform maximum private-markets allocation under a frozen-share approximation: 12.4% at standard parameters, against reported allocations near 30%. A coupled-model diagnostic indicates the approximation is conservative, so the fully coupled ceiling is, if anything, lower. Finally, appraisal smoothing with Geltner inertia a inates the perceived ceiling by exactly (1 + a)/(1-a); at standard calibration this is by itself sucient to account for most of the gap between the theoretical ceiling and reported allocations, though other explanations are not ruled out.

AI.tldr: 本文证明机构投资者对包含不可交易的私募市场部分的投资组合设定最大回撤授权在数学上是不兼容的：只要两个部分（可交易与不可交易）不是完全负相关，在允许的长期限、有界杠杆政策类中，没有任何政策能满足该授权。作者通过将问题重新参数化为可控与不可控波动贡献（u,v），推导出精确的回撤法则和可达回撤指数的天花板（在不可交易份额上呈双曲线形式），并证明该天花板由常数控制唯一达到。文章还展示了非单调政策可以突破该天花板（表明基于回撤频率的授权是可操纵的），并通过Geltner惯性下的评估平滑解释瞭报告配置与实际理论天花板之间的差距。
AI.research_question: 当投资组合中包含大量不可交易的私募市场部分时，机构投资者设定的最大回撤授权是否在数学上可行？若不可行，最优的第二优方案是什么？报告中的高私募配置如何与理论天花板调和？
AI.motivation: 机构投资者越来越多地在包含不可交易的私募市场部分的投资组合上设定最大回撤授权，但现有理论（如Grossman-Zhou框架）假设所有资产均可交易。当一部分资产既不能卖出也无法被流动性部分对冲时，传统授权理论的前提被打破，需要分析这一实际困境的内在矛盾及其量化后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: Grossman-Zhou最大回撤控制框架；随机控制与最优停时理论；收益过程的扩散系数分析；Geltner评估平滑模型（含惯性参数a）；回撤单调反馈政策类（含Grossman-Zhou、CPPI、分数Kelly和常数比例等子类）。
AI.method: 数学证明方法：证明在长限有界杠杆政策类中，当两资产部分非完全负相关时，财富扩散系数存在严格正的下界，导致回撤授权几乎必然被违反。通过将问题重新参数化为可控/不可控波动贡献（u,v），推导精确回撤法则P(D>d)=(1-d)^η，并构造回撤单调反馈政策类证明天花板η*(v)=A/v-1由常数控制唯一达到。通过反例展示非单调政策可突破天花板。最后结合Geltner惯性平滑模型分析评估平滑对感知天花板的影响。
AI.findings: (1) 最大回撤授权与含不可交易私募部分的组合在数学上不相容，除非两部分完全负相关；(2) 回撤分布满足精确法则P(D>d)=(1-d)^η，可达回撤指数天花板为η*(v)=A/v-1（在不可交易份额上呈双曲线）；(3) 该天花板由常数控制唯一达到；(4) 非单调政策可突破天花板，使基于回撤频率的授权可被操纵，而基于回撤深度的授权可将操纵收益减半；(5) 冻结份额近似下，最大私募配置为12.4%，远低于报告中的约30%；(6) Geltner惯性下的评估平滑将感知天花板放大(1+a)/(1-a)倍，在标准校准下足以解释大部分理论天花板与报告配置之间的差距。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 将最大回撤授权理论从完全可交易资产扩展到包含不可交易部分的情形，揭示其数学上的不相容性；(2) 提出可达回撤指数的双曲线天花板定理，刻画了不可交易份额对回撤控制的根本约束；(3) 定义并分析了"回撤单调反馈"这一广泛的政策类别，证明常数控制在其中是最优的；(4) 揭示基于频率与基于深度的回撤授权在可操纵性上的本质差异；(5) 将评估平滑（Geltner惯性）纳入回撤天花板分析，为理论与实际配置差距提供定量解释。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 为机构投资者在设定最大回撤授权时提供严格的理论约束，指出与私募配置并存时授权的数学不可行性；(2) 提供闭式解形式的第二优配置天花板（冻结份额近似下12.4%），作为实际配置决策的参考基准；(3) 揭示基于回撤频率的授权容易被非单调策略操纵，建议采用基于回撤深度的授权设计；(4) 定量评估Geltner惯性平滑对感知绩效的影响，帮助投资者理解报告配置与理论约束之间差距的来源；(5) 为监管者和投资者设计更稳健的回撤控制机制提供理论基础。

title: Pricing a Financial Instrument: The Economic Value of the Stop-Loss Order

detail.title: Pricing a Financial Instrument: The Economic Value of the Stop-Loss Order

contentType.other: It's a paper I wrote for a client that I couldn't publish due to confidentiality. The NDA was for 10 years, and that period has now expired.

detail.abstract:
This paper addresses a counter-intuitive proposition. Instruments such as the stop-loss are normally discussed purely in terms of risk management, where a well-documented trade-off holds between reducing risk and raising return-higher expected return demands higher risk. The hypothesis advanced here is that the stop-loss order has a special property that lets it do both at once: it can lower risk while simultaneously raising return. In other words, the stop-loss carries a positive economic value.
To establish this, the paper first situates the stop-loss — alongside the take-profit — within the toolkit of technical analysis (Section 1), then reviews the role and evolution of risk management (Section 2), stressing that such instruments rest on assumptions, chiefly the liquidity assumption, whose failure can prevent them from working. Section 3 examines how pre-set, consistently applied stop-loss and take-profit orders counteract the psychological biases that degrade investor performance. Section 4 surveys the empirical literature, where results diverge largely because of the assumed return-generating process of the underlying asset.
The financial model at the core of the paper (Sections 5–6) prices stop-loss orders on futures contracts whose returns are normally distributed, using Monte Carlo simulation to answer the research question: does the stop-loss add value beyond the return of the futures contract itself? Across simulations of thousands of contracts, consistent and repeated use of stop-loss orders not only reduces risk but also raises portfolio return. The economic value is further tested against changes in underlying volatility, loss thresholds, and contract tenors, and compared with other common tactics — rolling forward, position averaging, and take-profit.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了"止损单仅能降低风险但会牺牲收益"的传统观点，提出止损单具有独特属性——能在降低风险的同时提高收益，即具有正的经济价值。论文通过蒙特卡洛模拟对期货合约上的止损单进行定价，结果表明一致且反复使用止损单不仅能降低风险，还能提高投资组合收益。
AI.research_question: 止损单是否能在降低风险的同时提高收益，即是否具有超越期货合约本身回报的额外经济价值？
AI.motivation: 传统金融理论认为风险与收益之间存在权衡关系（更高的预期收益需要承担更高风险），但止损单可能是一个反直觉的例外——它可能同时实现降低风险和提升收益，这一点在现有文献中缺乏系统论证。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术分析理论（止损/止盈工具）、风险管理理论（流动性假设）、行为金融学（心理偏差对投资者绩效的负面影响）
AI.method: 蒙特卡洛模拟方法，对收益率服从正态分布的期货合约上的止损单进行定价，模拟数千个合约，并检验资产波动率、亏损阈值、合约期限等参数的稳健性，同时与展期、持仓平均、止盈等常见策略进行比较。
AI.findings: 一致且反复使用止损单不仅能降低风险，还能提高投资组合收益。该经济价值在改变底层波动率、亏损阈值和合约期限的情况下依然成立，且优于展期、持仓平均和止盈等其他常见策略。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统风险-收益权衡框架，提出止损单作为一个特例可以同时实现降低风险和提升收益，为技术分析工具的经济价值提供了理论层面的论证。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了止损单具有正经济价值的证据，支持其在投资实践中系统性、一致性使用止损单作为风险管理与收益增强的双重工具。

title: Intervention, Not Inference: The Identification of Algorithmic Collusion

detail.title: Intervention, Not Inference: The Identification of Algorithmic Collusion
detail.abstract: Q-learning pricing agents sustain supra-competitive prices in simulation. Whether econometrics can detect such conduct is a separate question, and we answer it in a laboratory where the truth is known by construction: we reproduce Calvano et al. (2020), embed the agents in demand-shifting markets, and grade every method against three regimes of sharply differing true conduct. Detection requires intervention. Mandating a one-week price displacement by one firm and watching the rival yields, from a single market, what passive data never give: five probes detect a rival response with 83% power at a correctly-sized test, against 52% false positives passively, and response depth separates punishment from myopia at AUC 0.96. Direction matters more than the statistic. Since prices are strategic complements, a static best-responder must follow a rival's mandated increase at every marginal cost-the unobservable that defeats every passive method here-so a firm that cuts instead cannot be best-responding at any cost. That sign test separates punishment from a benign menu-cost defendant perfectly (AUC 1.00) under an exact paired counterfactual. Its null is narrow, though: it falsifies static best response, not competition, and memoryless learners, which cannot punish at all, violate it in 51% of markets. The passive toolkit fails instructively: it measures policy effects essentially perfectly-a randomized tax and a transparency mandate, with clean pre-trends and correct inferencebut cannot recover conduct. The collusive path is rationalizable, period by period, as static best response under an unrestricted cost process, so identification rests entirely on what may be assumed about costs. Conduct tests on the estimable transition are uninformative though the same test on an unobservable steady state would work; endogenous adoption defeats modern staggered estimators, a ladder of designs locating the failure in positivity rather than in outcome-dependence; and a screen with 99% held-out accuracy flags benign menu-cost competitors as collusive in 97% of out-of-taxonomy markets. Restricting costs to a constant does yield a genuine identified set-the grid best-response inequalities are linear in cost-recovering known costs to 0.001 and rejecting the collusive panel in every market. But it fails as the sign test does, measuring the precision of optimization rather than the objective-myopic and memoryless learners are rejected just as decisively. Punishment proves a property of the pricing stack, not of prices: it dissolves under function approximation while prices stay high, unmoved by a 32-fold sweep of the training budget. Conduct evidence, in short, has to be manufactured rather than found-and the intervention that works is the one whose null holds for every cost.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实验室实验（嵌入式Q-learning定价代理、需求转移市场）检验计量经济学方法能否检测人工智能定价代理的合谋行为。研究发现被动数据无法识别合谋行为，而干预性方法（强制价格位移）可以显著提高检测效力。方向性符号检验（sign test）在区分惩罚行为与良性菜单成本竞争方面表现完美（AUC 1.00），但无法区分静态最优反应与动态学习。惩罚行为是定价技术栈的属性而非价格本身的属性，且在函数逼近下会消失。
AI.research_question: 计量经济学方法能否在实验室环境中（真实行为已知）检测Q-learning定价代理的合谋行为？在何种条件下（被动数据vs干预）能够实现可靠的检测？
AI.motivation: 已有仿真研究表明Q-learning定价代理能够维持超竞争价格，但计量方法能否检测这种行为是一个悬而未决的独立问题。本文通过实验室设计（真实行为由构造可知）来系统评估各种检测方法的效力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于策略互补性理论：由于价格是策略互补的，静态最优响应者必须在每个边际成本下跟随对手的强制涨价，因此若一方降价则不可能在任何成本下进行最优响应。这一理论为符号检验提供了基础。
AI.method: 实验室实验方法：复现Calvano et al. (2020)的Q-learning代理，嵌入需求转移市场，构建三种行为机制截然不同的制度（惩罚、记忆性学习、菜单成本竞争），并系统比较多种计量检测方法（被动回归、干预实验、符号检验、基于网格最优响应不等式的识别集方法等）的效力。
AI.findings: (1)被动数据无法检测合谋行为，误报率高达52%；(2)干预性方法（强制一周价格位移）可实现83%的检测效力且检验尺寸正确；(3)符号检验在区分惩罚与菜单成本竞争时AUC达1.00，但会误判51%的无惩罚能力的无记忆学习者；(4)被动工具能准确测量政策效应但无法识别行为；(5)限制成本为常数可产生真正的识别集，但同样无法区分最优响应与短视学习；(6)惩罚在函数逼近下消失，与训练预算无关。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文证明了合谋路径在每期都可以被视为不受限制成本过程下的静态最优响应而被合理化，因此识别的关键在于对成本的可假定性。这项研究阐明了行为识别与政策效应估计之间的根本区别，以及干预实验在行为识别中的独特价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 为反垄断监管机构提供了一套可操作的检测方法：建议采用干预式（强制价格位移）检测而非依赖被动数据；方向性符号检验作为有效手段；警示监管者注意现有工具（如99%精确率的筛选器）可能产生大量误报；明确指出行为证据需要"制造"而非"发现"。

title: Exchange-rate Volatility, Firm Expectations, and Propagation through Production Networks
affiliations: Government of the Republic of Turkey - Central Bank of the Republic of Turkey and Nazarbayev University

detail.title: Exchange-rate Volatility, Firm Expectations, and Propagation through Production Networks
detail.abstract: This paper studies how exchange-rate volatility shapes firms' expectations and real activity, and how its effects propagate through domestic production networks. Using matched survey and administrative data for Turkish manufacturing firms from 2009 to 2025, we find that higher FX volatility generates a stagflationary response: firms raise their inflation, own-price, and unit-cost expectations while lowering capacity utilization and becoming more pessimistic about sales, employment, and the macroeconomic outlook. These revisions are accompanied by lower realized activity, with sales falling by 1.2 percent and purchases by 1.5 percent, as well as a decrease in the number of active supplier and customer relationships. Using exact survey response dates and hourly movements in the one-month USD/TRY forward rate, we show that firms update their expectations within days of major intraday volatility spikes and that these revisions remain substantial after conditioning on the signed event-day exchange-rate change. We also find that production networks shape these effects, with firms connected to import-intensive suppliers reporting larger increases in expected costs and prices and sharper reductions in purchases and supplier relationships, while those selling to import-intensive customers report weaker demand and larger declines in sales and customer relationships. Our results suggest that exchange-rate volatility reaches firms not only through what they import themselves, but also through the suppliers they depend on and the customers they sell to.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2009-2025年土耳其制造业企业的匹配调查与行政数据，研究汇率波动如何影响企业预期与实际经济活动，以及这些影响如何通过国内生产网络传导。研究发现汇率波动引发滞胀式反应：企业上调通胀、价格和成本预期，同时降低产能利用率并对销售、就业和宏观前景更加悲观；实际活动中销售额下降1.2%，采购额下降1.5%，供应商和客户关系数量减少。通过精确的问卷回复日期和美元/里拉远期汇率的小时级变动，证明企业在日内波动飙升后数天内即更新预期。生产网络显著塑造这些效应：与进口密集型供应商相连的企业成本与价格预期升幅更大，向进口密集型客户销售的企业需求更弱、销售和客户关系下降更多。
AI.research_question: 汇率波动如何影响企业的预期与实际经济活动？这些影响如何通过国内生产网络在企业间传导？
AI.motivation: 传统文献多关注汇率水平变化对贸易和价格的影响，而汇率波动（而非水平）对企业预期与实际活动的系统性影响研究不足，尤其缺乏企业层面的微观证据；同时生产网络作为传导渠道的作用尚未被充分理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生产网络传导理论；预期形成理论（通胀预期、成本冲击传导）；汇率波动与不确定性理论
AI.method: 匹配调查数据与行政数据；利用精确问卷回复日期和小时级USD/TRY远期汇率变动识别日内波动冲击；事件研究法；基于企业进口密集度的网络传导分析
AI.findings: （1）汇率波动引发滞胀式反应：企业上调通胀、自身价格和单位成本预期，同时降低产能利用率、对销售就业和宏观前景更悲观；（2）实际活动中销售额下降1.2%、采购额下降1.5%，活跃供应商和客户关系数量减少；（3）企业在大幅日内波动后数天内即更新预期，且控制事件日汇率水平变化后仍显著；（4）生产网络放大效应：与进口密集型供应商相连的企业成本价格预期增幅更大、采购和供应商关系削减更明显；向进口密集型客户销售的企业需求更弱、销售和客户关系下降更多。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在企业层面系统识别汇率波动（而非汇率水平）对预期的因果效应；将生产网络纳入汇率波动传导的分析框架，揭示波动通过直接进口、供应商和客户三条渠道的传导机制；区分预期与实际活动两条响应路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行和监管机构理解汇率波动的宏观影响提供微观证据；提示政策制定者关注汇率波动通过生产网络放大经济冲击的机制；为企业风险管理提供关于供应链暴露重要性的启示。

title: Inflation Responses to Monetary Policy under High Temperatures: Evidence from Mexican Cities
affiliations: and

detail.title: Inflation Responses to Monetary Policy under High Temperatures: Evidence from Mexican Cities
detail.abstract: This paper documents that the response of inflation to monetary policy is weaker under high-temperature conditions. Our empirical design combines national monetary policy shocks with local temperature conditions that vary across cities and over time. Using a monthly panel of 55 Mexican cities from 2013 to 2024, we estimate state-dependent local projections and instrument Mexico’s policy-rate changes with a trilemma-based external instrument. A 100-basis-point tightening is nearly one-quarter less effective at lowering consumer prices under relatively hotter than under relatively cooler conditions. We construct city-level core and non-core price indices and find that the attenuation emerges earlier and more strongly in non-core prices, appearing only later in core prices. This timing points to an initial weakening of policy effectiveness in climate-sensitive sectors, followed by propagation to broader price-setting dynamics. A warming world may make it more difficult for monetary policy to stabilize inflation.

AI.tldr: 本文发现，在高温条件下，货币政策对通胀的响应效果会减弱。利用2013-2024年墨西哥55个城市的月度面板数据，结合国家货币政策冲击与城市间气温差异，通过状态依赖的局部投影法估计发现，100个基点的紧缩政策在较热条件下降低消费者价格的有效性比在较冷条件下低近四分之一。这种衰减在非核心价格中更早且更强地出现，随后才传导至核心价格，表明气候变化会削弱货币政策稳定通胀的能力。
AI.research_question: 高温条件是否会削弱货币政策对通胀的调控效果？其传导机制和时间特征是什么？
AI.motivation: 全球变暖加剧的背景下，气候变化可能影响货币政策的传导效率，但目前缺乏系统性的实证证据来量化温度条件对货币政策有效性（尤其是通胀响应）的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于货币政策传导机制理论、气候经济学的价格设定理论，以及三难困境（trilemma）框架下的外部货币政策工具识别方法。
AI.method: 利用2013-2024年墨西哥55个城市的月度面板数据，结合国家层面的货币政策冲击与城市间温度差异，采用状态依赖的局部投影法（state-dependent local projections），并使用基于三难困境的外部工具变量来识别墨西哥政策利率变化的因果效应。同时构建城市层面的核心与非核心价格指数进行异质性分析。
AI.findings: （1）100个基点的紧缩政策在较热条件下降低消费者价格的有效性比在较冷条件下低近四分之一；（2）有效性衰减在非核心价格（气候敏感部门）中更早且更强地出现，随后才传导至核心价格；（3）衰减从气候敏感部门的价格设定逐步扩散至更广泛的价格动态，说明存在传播机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地将温度条件引入货币政策传导效率的分析框架，揭示了气候条件作为货币政策有效性的状态依赖因素，并阐明了气候敏感的实体部门向核心价格传导的时序机制，拓展了气候经济学与货币政策传导理论的交叉研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行在气候变暖背景下重新评估货币政策传导效率提供实证依据，提示政策制定者需要考虑气候条件对货币政策效果的影响，在高温环境下可能需要更大力度的政策响应或辅助工具来实现通胀稳定目标。

title: Bankruptcy's Broken Promises
affiliations: Indiana University Maurer School of Law

detail.title: Bankruptcy's Broken Promises

publicationDetails.detailsText: Indiana Legal Studies Research Paper No. 593
publicationDetails.journalName: Indiana University Maurer School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Should the federal government take over financially struggling states? In Promi$e Land: The Inside Story of the Puerto Rico Debt Crisis, David Skeel gives readers a front-row seat to the political theater that is the Puerto Rico debt restructuring process. Skeel urges Congress to appoint oversight boards like the one he chaired in Puerto Rico to overturn the budgetary decisions of elected officials in financially distressed states such as Illinois, New Jersey, and Kentucky. In exchange for giving up their sovereignty, Congress could offer those states funds to pay off pension obligations and access to bankruptcy (which states currently lack). This Essay argues that states should not accept that bargain. Puerto Rico still struggles to provide electrical power or provide essential services to its population more than ten years after Congress imposed an oversight board over Puerto Rico and provided it with access to bankruptcy. The same macroeconomic issues that have plagued Puerto Rico for decades still plague it. This Essay explores possible future research in sovereign debt restructuring based on Puerto Rico’s unique territorial status before concluding on a religious note. Specifically, Congress could explore radical debt forgiveness in the form of a biblical jubilee as a tool for addressing state indebtedness.

AI.tldr: 本文批评了David Skeel主张的联邦政府接管财政困境州并设立监督委员会的建议。作者以波多黎各债务危机为例，指出国会十多年前对波多黎各强加监督委员会并提供破产途径后，其经济困境并无实质改善，因此主张各州不应接受这种以主权让渡换取资金支持和破产权利的交易。文章还探讨了主权债务重组的未来研究方向，并提出了以圣经中"禧年"概念为基础进行激进债务免除的可能性。
AI.research_question: 联邦政府是否应当接管财政困境的州？各州是否应接受以主权让渡换取联邦资金和破产权利的"交易"？
AI.motivation: 针对David Skeel在其著作《Promise Land》中提出的建议——国会应任命监督委员会（类似他在波多黎各担任主席的委员会）来推翻伊利诺伊、新泽西、肯塔基等财政困境州的民选官员预算决策——作者认为这一建议值得严肃审视，并基于波多黎各十余年的实践经验指出该方案的缺陷。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主权债务重组理论；联邦制下的州主权与财政联邦主义；波多黎各领土地位的特殊性分析；债务免除的伦理与宗教框架（圣经禧年概念）。
AI.method: 基于波多黎各债务危机案例的批判性法律与政策分析，结合对David Skeel著作论点的系统驳斥，并探讨主权债务重组的未来研究方向。
AI.findings: 国会十多年前对波多黎各强加监督委员会并提供破产途径后，波多黎各在提供电力和基本公共服务方面仍然举步维艰；困扰波多黎各数十年的宏观经济问题依然持续存在，表明Skeel建议的联邦接管模式并未取得预期成效，各州不应接受这一"交易"。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文对联邦接管财政困境州的方案提出了基于实证案例的批判性理论反思，将波多黎各独特的领土地位纳入主权债务重组理论框架的分析中，并拓展了债务重组研究的新方向——将宗教/伦理维度的"禧年"式债务免除纳入学术讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者（特别是州政府和国会）提供了关于财政困境州债务处理方案的警示性分析，指出监督委员会模式的实际效果不佳；提出了激进债务免除（类似圣经禧年）作为应对州级债务的政策选项，为债务重组政策开辟了新的思考路径。

publicationDetails.detailsText: The American Review of Public Administration, volume 56, issue 1, 2026[10.1177/02750740251382582]

detail.abstract: The increasing frequency and severity of extreme weather events require organizations to effectively manage the threats these phenomena pose. To respond to these challenges, public agencies often turn to their organizational memories for guidance. Organizational memories support information processing capacity, facilitate sensemaking, and legitimize and speed up decision-making processes. While memories influence different aspects of organizational life, little is known about their antecedents and the mechanisms behind the retrieval of past events. This study contributes to the broader literature on organizational memory by investigating the elements shaping public agencies’ retrieval of extreme weather events. Integrating weather data from the National Center for Environmental Information’s (NCEI) Storm Event Database with a national survey of the 300 largest transit agencies in the US, we find that public agency memories are influenced not only by the nature of the events experienced, but also by the processes that govern organizational attention, storage, and information processing.

AI.tldr: 本研究整合美国国家环境信息中心（NCEI）风暴事件数据库的天气数据与对美国300家最大公交机构的全国调查数据，探讨公共机构如何检索和回忆极端天气事件。研究发现，公共机构的组织记忆不仅受所经历事件本身性质的影响，还受组织注意力、存储和信息处理过程的制约。
AI.research_question: 哪些因素塑造了公共机构对极端天气事件的检索（组织记忆的回忆）？其背后的机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 极端天气事件日益频繁和严重，公共机构常依赖组织记忆来应对这些挑战。尽管组织记忆在支持信息处理、促进意义建构以及合法化与加速决策方面发挥着重要作用，但学界对组织记忆的前因和过去事件检索机制知之甚少。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织记忆理论（Organizational Memory Theory），结合组织注意力、信息处理与存储机制的相关理论。
AI.method: 整合混合数据源：国家环境信息中心（NCEI）风暴事件数据库的客观天气数据，以及针对美国最大的300家公交机构开展的全国性调查。
AI.findings: 公共机构对极端天气事件的记忆检索不仅受到所经历事件本身的性质（如频率、严重程度）的影响，还受到组织注意力分配、信息存储过程和信息处理能力的制约。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了组织记忆理论的边界，揭示了组织记忆检索的前因和机制，表明记忆既受客观事件特征驱动，也受组织内部过程（注意力、存储、信息处理）的中介或调节影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共机构管理者提供了如何更有效地构建和利用组织记忆来应对极端天气事件的实践启示，强调了组织系统与流程设计对记忆检索的重要性。

title: Feasible-path Stability and Stationarity of Threshold Regime-switching Autoregressions
affiliations: Curtin University

detail.title: Feasible-path Stability and Stationarity of Threshold Regime-switching Autoregressions
detail.abstract: Threshold autoregressions with endogenous regime switching are widely used in economics, but their stability is subtle: local stability of every regime is neither necessary nor sufficient for global stationarity. Existing sufficient conditions of the joint spectral radius ignore constraints imposed by endogenous switching and may therefore be conservative. This paper develops a feasible-path stability theory that replaces the joint spectral radius with a boundary-feasible spectral radius derived from the threshold rule. Retaining both branches at threshold equality yields closed polyhedral path cones. Their worst-case restricted gains are submultiplicative, and their asymptotic rate defines a norm-independent spectral radius. We prove that this radius is below one if and only if the weak homogeneous skeleton is uniformly globally exponentially stable, equivalently if and only if a strict finite-step Lyapunov certificate exists. The framework unifies cyclic and non-cyclic dynamics through a hybrid certificate that absorbs verified stable cycles while contracting the residual frontier. This construction reduces to a longer-horizon boundary-complete certificate and implies geometric ergodicity under standard innovation and Markov conditions. Strict certificates are locally robust to coefficient perturbations; consequently, consistent plug-in certification succeeds at interior stable parameters, while uniform certification over a valid confidence set controls false certification at its noncoverage probability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可行路径稳定性理论，用于分析具有内生机制转换的阈值自回归模型。该理论用边界可行谱半径替代联合谱半径，证明了该半径小于1当且仅当弱齐次骨架是均匀全局指数稳定的，并建立了严格的有限步Lyapunov证书。该框架通过混合证书统一了周期性与非周期性动态，并推导出几何遍历性及统计推断的一致性结论。
AI.research_question: 如何为具有内生机制转换的阈值自回归模型建立精确且非保守的全局稳定性条件，并基于此框架进行统计推断？
AI.motivation: 现有阈值自回归模型的稳定性分析存在两大问题：一是每个机制局部稳定性既非全局平稳性的充分条件也非必要条件；二是基于联合谱半径的现有充分条件忽略了内生机制转换所施加的约束，导致过于保守。这需要一种新的稳定性理论框架来精确刻画内生切换系统的全局稳定性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可行路径稳定性理论、边界可行谱半径、Lyapunov稳定性理论、弱齐次骨架、几何遍历性理论
AI.method: 通过阈值规则在阈值等值处保留两个分支来构造闭合多面体路径锥，分析其最坏情形受限增益的次可乘性，定义渐近率作为范数无关的谱半径；建立混合证书机制，吸收已验证的稳定循环的同时收缩剩余前沿；通过有限步边界完备证书实现统一处理，并基于此进行统计推断。
AI.findings: 边界可行谱半径小于1当且仅当弱齐次骨架均匀全局指数稳定，等价于存在严格的有限步Lyapunov证书。该框架统一了周期性和非周期性动态，在标准创新和马尔可夫条件下可推导出几何遍历性。严格证书对系数扰动局部稳健，因此一致插入式认证在内部稳定参数处成功，而均匀认证在有效置信集上可控制非覆盖概率的虚假认证。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了全新的边界可行谱半径概念，替代了保守的联合谱半径方法；建立了边界可行谱半径、弱齐次骨架稳定性和有限步Lyapunov证书三者之间的等价关系；通过混合证书统一了周期性与非周期性动态的稳定性分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为阈值自回归模型的全局稳定性检验提供了可计算且非保守的工具；建立的统计推断框架使得在实际应用中可以通过数据一致地认证模型稳定性，并通过置信集上的均匀认证控制虚假认证风险。

title: Empirical Calibration and Validation of the Livelihood System Integrated Model (LSIM): Evidence from Multi‑Sector Livelihood Shocks in Sierra Leone, 2004–2025
affiliations: Bank of Sierra Leone

detail.title: Empirical Calibration and Validation of the Livelihood System Integrated Model (LSIM): Evidence from Multi‑Sector Livelihood Shocks in Sierra Leone, 2004–2025
detail.abstract: This study presents the first empirical application of the Livelihood Systems Integration Model (LSIM) developed by Jackson (2026) to examine how macroeconomic and sectoral shocks are transmitted through Sierra Leone's livelihood system over the period 2004–2025. The analysis calibrates the LSIM using annual macroeconomic, sectoral and livelihood data, estimates an LSIM-aligned recursive structural vector autoregression (SVAR) to evaluate the dynamic effects of mining and inflation shocks, and examines the relationship between poverty, vulnerable employment, agricultural employment, inflation and mining rents through a welfare equation. Impulse response analysis reveals that mineral-rent shocks stimulate short-term economic growth but generate only limited improvements in employment quality, reflecting weak domestic transmission from extractive activities. Inflation emerges as the most disruptive shock, reducing growth while increasing agricultural and vulnerable employment, thereby intensifying livelihood vulnerability. Remittances provide a modest counter-cyclical buffer but are insufficient to offset persistent structural weaknesses within the labour market. Although limited poverty observations constrain welfare estimation, the findings consistently say that inflation and vulnerable employment remain important channels through which macroeconomic instability influences household welfare. Robustness diagnostics confirm the stability of the estimated recursive SVAR and indicate no evidence of residual serial correlation, strengthening confidence in the empirical results. The study demonstrates that livelihoods are best understood as an interconnected system in which macroeconomic conditions, sectoral performance and household responses continually interact. It concludes that strengthening price stability, improving mining-sector linkages, investing in agricultural transformation, expanding adaptive social protection and enhancing livelihood data systems are essential for building resilience and reducing poverty, while establishing the LSIM as a practical framework for informing development policy in Sierra Leone and comparable resource-dependent economies.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将Jackson（2026）提出的生计系统整合模型（LSIM）实证应用于塞拉利昂，利用2004-2025年数据校准模型，通过递归结构向量自回归（SVAR）分析矿业和通胀冲击对生计系统的动态影响。研究发现矿业租金冲击仅带来短期增长而对就业质量改善有限，通胀是最具破坏性的冲击，汇款虽有缓冲作用但不足以抵消劳动力市场的结构性弱点。文章证明生计是一个相互关联的系统，并提出加强价格稳定、改善矿业联系、农业转型、社会保障和数据系统等政策建议。
AI.research_question: 宏观经济和部门冲击如何通过塞拉利昂的生计系统传导？矿业和通胀冲击对经济增长、就业质量和家庭福利产生怎样的动态影响？
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏将生计系统作为整体框架来理解宏观经济冲击传导的实证分析，特别是对塞拉利昂这类资源依赖型经济体中冲击如何影响生计脆弱性的研究不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生计系统整合模型（LSIM），由Jackson（2026）开发，将宏观经济条件、部门绩效与家庭响应视为相互关联的系统。
AI.method: 利用2004-2025年年度宏观经济、部门及生计数据校准LSIM模型；构建LSIM对齐的递归结构向量自回归（SVAR）评估冲击动态效应；通过福利方程考察贫困、脆弱就业、农业就业、通胀与矿业租金之间的关系；采用脉冲响应分析和稳健性诊断。
AI.findings: （1）矿业租金冲击刺激短期经济增长，但对就业质量改善有限，反映采掘活动国内传导薄弱；（2）通胀是最具破坏性的冲击，降低增长同时增加农业和脆弱就业，加剧生计脆弱性；（3）汇款提供适度的逆周期缓冲，但不足以抵消劳动力市场的持续结构性弱点；（4）通胀和脆弱就业是宏观经济不稳定影响家庭福利的重要渠道；（5）稳健性检验确认递归SVAR稳定，无残差序列相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次实证应用并验证了LSIM框架在资源依赖型经济体中的适用性，证明生计应被理解为宏观经济条件、部门绩效与家庭响应持续互动的互联系统，将LSIM确立为发展政策的实用分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为塞拉利昂及类似资源依赖型经济体提供具体的政策建议：加强价格稳定、改善矿业部门联系、投资农业转型、扩大适应性社会保障以及加强生计数据系统建设，以增强韧性并减少贫困。

title: Consumer Choices: Dining In vs Dining Out
affiliations: , San Juan College and San Juan College

detail.title: Consumer Choices: Dining In vs Dining Out
detail.abstract: Consumer behavior and decision-making are important topics in microeconomics because they explain how people choose what goods and services to buy with limited income. This paper examines the factors that influence consumer choices when it comes to dining out at a restaurant or dining in and cooking at home. Factors include prices, income, preferences, and advertising. This analysis uses a comparison of a restaurant meal versus a home cooked meal and consumer spending data from the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis and the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics to identify trends in household spending. The finding suggests that changes in income and prices significantly affect purchasing decisions, while marketing and consumer preferences also play an important role.

AI.tldr: 本文运用美国经济分析局和劳工统计局的家庭支出数据，研究了消费者在外出就餐与在家烹饪之间的选择，发现收入与价格变化显著影响购买决策，营销和消费者偏好也发挥重要作用。
AI.research_question: 哪些因素（价格、收入、偏好、广告）影响消费者在外出就餐与在家烹饪之间的选择？
AI.motivation: 消费者行为与决策是微观经济学的重要议题，理解消费者如何在有限收入下做出就餐选择，有助于揭示家庭支出行为的内在规律。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于微观经济学中的消费者选择理论，涵盖价格、收入、偏好和广告等核心影响因素。
AI.method: 对比分析法：比较餐厅用餐与在家烹饪两种消费方式，使用美国经济分析局和美国劳工统计局的家庭消费支出数据进行趋势分析。
AI.findings: 收入和价格变化对消费者的就餐购买决策有显著影响；营销（广告）和消费者偏好同样在决策过程中扮演重要角色。
AI.theory_contributions: 在微观经济学消费者选择理论的框架下，实证验证了收入与价格对家庭就餐支出结构的影响，丰富了关于外出就餐与在家烹饪替代关系的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为餐饮行业企业及政策制定者提供参考，帮助他们理解影响消费者就餐选择的驱动因素，从而制定更有效的定价与营销策略。

title: Farming Systems, Agronomic Management, And Post-Harvest Practices of Smallholder Cocoa ( Theobroma Cacao L.) Production in Tanzania
affiliations: Makerere University, Makerere University, The Nelson Mandela African Institution of Science and Technology, University of Bern - Institute of Plant Sciences, The Nelson Mandela African Institution of Science and Technology, The Nelson Mandela African Institution of Science and Technology, The Nelson Mandela African Institution of Science and Technology, Sokoine University of Agriculture and Sokoine University of Agriculture

detail.title: Farming Systems, Agronomic Management, And Post-Harvest Practices of Smallholder Cocoa ( Theobroma Cacao L.) Production in Tanzania
detail.abstract: Cocoa (Theobroma cacao L.) is an increasingly important smallholder cash crop in Tanzania, yet evidence on the farming systems underlying its productivity remains limited. This study assessed farming systems, agronomic and post-harvest practices, and production constraints among cocoa smallholders in Muheza (Tanga), Kyela (Mbeya) and Kilombero (Morogoro) districts, using a cross-sectional survey of 143 randomly selected farmers analysed with descriptive statistics, chi-square tests and mean-rank analysis. Most respondents were male (76.9%), aged above 45 years (74.2%) and held only primary education (87.4%). Farms were predominantly small (0.5–5 acres, 66.9%), individually owned (95.8%) and rainfed. Mixed cropping (42.0%) and agroforestry (30.8%) were the dominant systems; farming-system choice differed significantly by region (χ² = 72.78, p < 0.001). Local, unimproved varieties dominated (91.6%), fertiliser use relied almost entirely on organic sources (95.8%), and only 2.1% of farmers had tested their soil. Black pod disease (80.4%) and cocoa pod borer/mirids (55.9% combined) were the leading biotic constraints, and 83.9% of farmers produced 0–500 kg/ha, a yield range consistent with typical smallholder cocoa production. Yield and training receipt both varied significantly with farming system and region (p < 0.01). Farmers ranked pests and diseases, unavailability of quality planting material, and poor storage facilities as the foremost challenges. Findings underscore the need for region-specific extension support, improved planting material, integrated pest and disease management, and strengthened post-harvest infrastructure to enhance smallholder cocoa productivity and livelihoods in Tanzania.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过对坦桑尼亚三个地区143名可可小农户的横断面调查，评估了其种植系统、农艺与收获后管理实践及生产制约因素。研究发现以混作和农林复合为主的小规模雨养农业系统，种植品种多为未改良地方品种，有机肥料为主，黑荚病和可可蛀果螟/盲蝽是主要生物限制因素，多数农户产量仅为0-500公斤/公顷。研究强调需要针对性的推广服务、改良种植材料、病虫害综合治理及收获后基础设施的加强。
AI.research_question: 坦桑尼亚可可小农户的种植系统、农艺及收获后管理实践和产量制约因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 可可作为坦桑尼亚日益重要的小农经济作物，但其生产力背后的种植系统缺乏实证证据，需要填补这一研究空白以指导政策干预。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于农业系统分类框架和小农生产经济学理论，分析种植系统差异、农艺实践与产量和培训的关系。
AI.method: 采用横断面调查法，在Muheza、Kyela和Kilombero三个地区随机选取143名农户，运用描述性统计、卡方检验和平均秩分析进行数据处理。
AI.findings: (1) 多数农户为男性、45岁以上且仅有小学教育；(2) 农场规模小（0.5-5英亩），以混作（42.0%）和农林复合（30.8%）为主，且种植系统选择因地区显著不同（χ²=72.78, p<0.001）；(3) 91.6%使用未改良地方品种，95.8%依赖有机肥，仅2.1%做过土壤测试；(4) 黑荚病（80.4%）和可可蛀果螟/盲蝽（55.9%）为主要生物限制因素；(5) 83.9%农户产量仅0-500公斤/公顷；(6) 产量和培训接收均随种植系统和地区显著变化（p<0.01）；(7) 病虫害、优质种苗不可得性和储藏设施差是农户排名最高的挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 为坦桑尼亚可可小农种植系统提供了系统性实证描述，揭示了种植系统选择与地区差异、产量和培训之间的关联，丰富了小农农业系统转型与发展文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为坦桑尼亚可可产业政策制定提供依据，指出需要区域针对性的推广服务、改良种植材料推广、病虫害综合治理方案和收获后基础设施建设的优先干预方向。

title: Who Pays, Who Benefits? Public Provision and the Service-sector Income Gradient

detail.title: Who Pays, Who Benefits? Public Provision and the Service-sector Income Gradient

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that he has no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants or animal subjects. The analysis uses only published aggregate statistics: the OECD harmonized national input-output tables, OECD annual government and national accounts, World Bank World Development Indicators, and published Chinese provincial finance accounts. No ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: The author declares that he has no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.

detail.abstract: Households devote a larger share of consumption to services as income rises, yet their purchases support a smaller share of service-sector expansion in richer economies. A purchaser account for 76 economies documents this negative household-contribution gradient. I ask how much of that established gradient reflects the convention that national accounts classify publicly financed individual services as government demand. Household demand scale, not its service intensity, accounts for about nine tenths of the payer gradient, whose main accounting counterpart is exports. I then trace government purchases of education, health, and social work through domestic production networks and assign the induced value added to household beneficiaries at recorded cost. On the broader service boundary, this reclassification changes the income slope from-10.4 to-6.2 percentage points per log point of initial income. The adjustment removes 41 percent of the payer gradient, with a cluster-bootstrap interval of 21 to 66 percent; on the market-service boundary it removes only 6 percent. The same accounts applied across Chinese provinces yield a negative payer gradient but a beneficiary correction that is larger in poorer provinces and steepens the level relationship. Public provision attenuates the international gradient, but its magnitude and non-household counterparts differ across settings. These are current-price accounting relationships, not causal income effects or welfare estimates.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了家庭消费与服务部门扩张之间的关系，发现随着收入上升，家庭将更大比例的消费份额用于服务，但在更富裕的经济体中，家庭购买支持的服務業擴張份額卻更小。作者通过76个经济体的购买者账户记录了这一"负的家庭贡献梯度"，并探讨了国民账户中将公共资助的个人服务归类为政府需求这一惯例对该梯度的影响。通过将政府对教育、健康和社会工作的购买通过国内生产网络追踪，并将诱导的增加值按记录成本分配给家庭受益者，作者发现这种重新分类将收入斜率从-10.4个百分点改变为-6.2个百分点（每对数点初始收入），消除了41%的支付者梯度（市场服务边界仅消除6%）。在中国各省的应用也发现了类似模式。作者强调这些是现行价格会计关系，而非因果收入效应或福利估计。
AI.research_question: 家庭消费对服务部门扩张的贡献梯度在多大程度上反映了国民账户中将公共资助的个人服务归类为政府需求的会计惯例？
AI.motivation: 既有文献记录了家庭消费对服务扩张的贡献随收入下降的"负梯度"现象，但作者提出这一梯度可能部分源于国民账户的会计分类惯例——即公共资助的个人服务（如教育、医疗）被归类为政府需求而非家庭需求，从而低估了家庭对服务部门扩张的真实贡献。本文旨在量化这种会计效应的大小。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本研究基于国民核算框架（national accounting framework），运用购买者账户（purchaser accounts）和投入产出分析（input-output analysis）来追踪政府购买通过生产网络产生的增值分配到家庭受益者的过程。
AI.method: 本文使用76个经济体的购买者账户数据，首先量化家庭需求规模而非服务强度对支付者梯度的贡献（约占十分之九）；然后通过投入产出网络追踪政府对教育、健康和社会工作的购买，将诱导的增加值按记录成本重新分配给家庭受益者，比较重新分类前后的收入斜率变化。作者还使用聚类自助法（cluster-bootstrap）估计调整效应的置信区间，并将相同方法应用于中国各省份数据。
AI.findings: （1）家庭需求规模（而非服务密集度）占支付者梯度的约十分之九；（2）在更广泛的服务边界上，重新分类将收入斜率从-10.4变为-6.2个百分点/对数收入点，消除了41%的支付者梯度（置信区间21-66%）；（3）在市场化服务边界上仅消除6%；（4）中国各省的应用显示，较贫困省份的受益者修正更大，使水平关系更陡峭；（5）公共供给削弱了国际梯度，但其幅度和非家庭对应物在不同情境下有所不同。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文对国民核算中家庭消费贡献的测度方法提出了重要修正——揭示了会计分类惯例对"服务业扩张来源"这一核心经验规律的实质性影响，深化了对服务业增长驱动力的理论理解，并区分了支付者视角与受益者视角下的不同结论。
AI.practical_contributions: 本文为政策制定者提供了更准确的家庭对服务部门增长贡献的度量框架，有助于理解政府公共服务供给在经济增长转型中的作用；同时强调了在国际比较和区域比较（如中国各省）中，会计分类选择对经验结论的影响，对经济统计和数据解释具有实践指导意义。

title: Fiscal Trust or Partisanship? Explaining Resistance to Ghana’s E-Levy
affiliations: , University of Cape Coast  and University of Cape Coast - Department of Economics, Students

detail.title: Fiscal Trust or Partisanship? Explaining Resistance to Ghana’s E-Levy
detail.abstract: Ghana’s Electronic Transfer Levy (E-Levy) was repealed in April 2025 after three years of sustained public opposition, yet the revenue shortfall it was designed to address remains unresolved, and proposals for a revised version have since been advanced. Existing research on this episode attributes resistance to partisan alignment: supporters of the party that introduced the levy expressed more favourable attitudes toward it than did others. This paper asks whether that partisan account is complete, or whether resistance also reflected a fiscal-legitimacy dimension, specifically distrust in the institutions responsible for collecting and spending tax revenue, that would be expected to persist independently of partisan change. Using Afrobarometer Round 9 survey data from 2,089 Ghanaian respondents, we estimate a nested ordered logistic regression of E-Levy attitudes on party affiliation, perceived corruption among tax officials, and trust in the Ghana Revenue Authority, net of standard demographic controls. Adding the fiscal-legitimacy variables to a partisanship-only model significantly improves fit (LR chi squared = 38.95, p < .001), and trust in the tax authority remains a statistically significant predictor of resistance across every specification tested, including a binary re-coding with region fixed effects and a broader corruption index. Perceived corruption among tax officials, more narrowly defined, is a less stable predictor across specifications. These findings suggest that proposals to redesign the levy around rate or exemption-threshold adjustments alone, without attending to institutional trust, may not adequately address the attitudinal sources of resistance that characterised the original policy. The design is cross-sectional and identifies association, not a causal effect.

AI.tldr: 本文研究加纳电子转账税（E-Levy）在2025年被废除前公众反对的根源，挑战了仅将抵制归因于党派立场的既有解释。通过分析Afrobarometer第9轮2,089名加纳受访者的调查数据，实证发现财政合法性维度（尤其是对税收机构的信任）是独立于党派立场的重要阻力来源，且在所有模型设定中保持稳健。研究暗示仅调整税率或免税额度的政策重设计，若不解决制度信任问题，可能无法有效化解公众抵制。
AI.research_question: 对加纳E-Levy的公众抵制是否仅仅源于党派立场，还是也包含财政合法性维度（对征税和支出机构的不信任），后者是否会独立于党派变化而持续存在？
AI.motivation: 加纳E-Levy于2025年4月废除，但其旨在解决的收入缺口问题依然存在，且已有修订版提案。既有研究仅将抵制归因于党派立场（支持执政党的群体态度更积极），作者质疑这一解释是否完整，探索财政合法性（制度信任）是否构成独立且持久的抵制来源。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政社会学/财政合法性理论，涉及纳税人对征税与支出机构的制度信任、腐败感知与税收遵从态度的关系。
AI.method: 使用Afrobarometer第9轮调查数据（2,089名加纳受访者），构建嵌套有序logistic回归模型，将E-Levy态度作为因变量，自变量包括党派归属、税务官员腐败感知、对加纳税务局（GRA）的信任，并控制标准人口学变量。通过似然比检验比较仅含党派变量的模型与加入财政合法性变量的模型（LR chi² = 38.95, p < .001），并进行多种稳健性检验（二元重新编码、地区固定效应、更宽泛的腐败指数）。
AI.findings: 加入财政合法性变量显著改善模型拟合；对税务机构的信任在所有模型设定中都是反对E-Levy的显著预测因子；狭义定义的税务官员腐败感知预测力在不同设定中不够稳定。研究设计为横截面，只能识别关联而非因果关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了将税收政策抵制单纯归因于党派立场的既有解释，提供了财政合法性理论在非洲税收政策情境中的实证支持，表明制度信任是理解税收政策公众支持的独立且稳健的维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为加纳及类似发展中经济体重新设计税收政策提供政策启示：仅调整税率或免税额度的技术性方案可能不足以化解公众抵制，需将制度建设与机构信任修复纳入政策议程。

title: Necessary but Not Sufficient: AI Governance Lessons from New York and London's Congestion Pricing
affiliations: Yale University and Yale University - Digital Ethics Center

detail.title: Necessary but Not Sufficient: AI Governance Lessons from New York and London's Congestion Pricing

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflicts of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: The authors received no specific funding for this work.

detail.abstract: We argue that AI governance is necessary but not sufficient for transportation programs: even the best-designed algorithm cannot compensate when policy ignores behavioral adaptation and exemption drift. It improves them only if it outperforms legacy methods and satisfies five governance conditions. We defend this claim by analyzing New York's Congestion Relief Zone, four public-private partnerships (Viva, Blyncsy, GridMatrix, and Hayden AI), and London's twenty-year experience, with procurement data and interviews. Applying Hummel, Braun, and Dabrock's (2021) framework, we find agencies retain nominal ownership while surrendering practical sovereignty. London's trajectory shows that sophisticated AI cannot offset policy failure: a 30 percent congestion reduction in 2003 unwound by 2024, when the city became Europe's most congested as for-hire volumes inside the zone grew from a designed 4,000 to 18,000 a day. Building on European governance frameworks, we close with five recommendations applied to New York's AI Action Plan.

AI.tldr: 本文论证AI治理对于交通项目是必要条件但非充分条件：即使算法设计最优，也无法弥补政策忽视行为适应和豁免漂移所带来的问题。通过分析纽约拥堵缓解区、四个公私合作伙伴关系（Viva、Blyncsy、GridMatrix和Hayden AI）以及伦敦二十年的经验，结合采购数据和访谈证据，论文发现AI治理仅在性能优于传统方法且满足五项治理条件时才能改善交通项目。伦敦的经验表明，复杂的AI无法抵消政策失败——2003年拥堵减少30%的成果到2024年完全逆转，城市成为欧洲最拥堵的城市。
AI.research_question: AI治理是否是交通拥堵收费项目的充分条件？在何种条件下，AI能够真正改善交通项目的效果？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注AI算法的技术能力，而忽视了治理层面的约束。作者发现即使采用最先进的AI算法，如果政策设计忽略了行为适应和豁免漂移，交通项目仍会失败，因此需要系统性地检验AI治理的有效性条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: Hummel、Braun和Dabrock（2021）的AI治理框架；欧洲治理框架；行为适应和政策漂移理论
AI.method: 多案例比较分析：纽约拥堵缓解区、四个公私合作伙伴关系（Viva、Blyncsy、GridMatrix、Hayden AI）以及伦敦二十年交通管理的纵向追踪；采用采购数据和访谈作为实证材料。
AI.findings: 1) 交通机构名义上拥有所有权，但实际放弃了实践主权；2) 伦敦的案例显示，2003年实现30%的拥堵减少，但到2024年完全逆转，成为欧洲最拥堵城市，区域内预约出行量从设计的每天4000次增长到18000次；3) 复杂的AI无法抵消政策失败；4) 提出五项治理条件作为AI有效性的前提。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI治理框架引入交通政策领域，超越单纯的技术视角，提出"AI治理是必要但非充分条件"的核心论点；丰富了行为适应和豁免漂移理论的实证基础；扩展了Hummel等人框架在交通领域的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为交通部门提供了五项具体治理建议，并应用于纽约AI行动计划的制定；为公私合作伙伴关系中的AI部署提供了实践指南；帮助决策者识别AI投资的条件性价值。

title: Interregional Consultative Migration Dialogues and the Abu Dhabi Dialogue in the GCC-Asia Migration Corridor

detail.title: Interregional Consultative Migration Dialogues and the Abu Dhabi Dialogue in the GCC-Asia Migration Corridor
detail.abstract: Over the past half century, the GCC-Asia has become the largest interregional migration corridor in the Global South. However, despite increasing interstate diplomatic engagements and crossborder mobility flows at the interregional level, the GCC host and Asian sending states have yet to fully synchronize their interregional migration policies, directly affecting current and prospective migrants' labor rights and welfare. This GLMM policy brief analyzes the complex roles and contributions of interregional consultative migration dialogues (ICMDs) operating within the GCC-Asia migration corridor. Using the case of the Abu Dhabi Dialogue (ADD), I offer two arguments: firstly, the states' positionalities (sending, host) in the interregional migration system influences their direct capacity to effectively facilitate or implement bilateral and multilateral migration reforms. Secondly, existing power asymmetries between GCC host and Asian sending states, combined with competing national interests and strong domestic sovereignty tensions, often impact interregional collaboration processes, thus producing diverging (or converging) outcomes for ADD member states. Overall, this study emphasizes the complex yet understudied roles of ICMDs in regional and global migration governance systems.

AI.tldr: 本文通过阿布扎比对话（ADD）案例，分析了GCC-亚洲移民走廊中区域间磋商性移民对话（ICMDs）的复杂角色与贡献，指出国家在移民系统中的位置性（派遣国/东道国）影响其改革能力，而权力不对称、竞争性国家利益与主权张力则导致各成员国产生分化或趋同的政策结果。
AI.research_question: GCC-亚洲移民走廊中的区域间磋商性移民对话（ICMDs）如何发挥其作用与贡献？特别是阿布扎比对话（ADD）中各成员国在什么条件下能够有效促进或阻碍双边及多边移民改革？
AI.motivation: 过去半个世纪GCC-亚洲已成为全球南方最大的区域间移民走廊，但尽管各国间外交接触和跨境流动日益频繁，GCC东道国与亚洲派遣国尚未完全协调其区域间移民政策，直接影响移民劳工权益与福利。ICMDs在区域和全球移民治理中的角色被严重忽视，亟需深入研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 移民治理理论、国家位置性（positionality）理论、权力不对称与国际合作理论、主权张力与治理协作框架
AI.method: 以阿布扎比对话（ADD）为案例的政策简报分析（GLMM policy brief），采用定性案例研究方法，分析ICMDs在GCC-亚洲移民走廊中的运作机制。
AI.findings: 第一，国家在区域间移民系统中的位置性（派遣国或东道国）直接影响了其促进或实施双边及多边移民改革的实际能力；第二，GCC东道国与亚洲派遣国之间存在的权力不对称、相互竞争的国家利益以及强烈的主权张力，常常影响区域间协作进程，进而导致ADD成员国产生分化或趋同的政策结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 本研究强调并填补了ICMDs在区域及全球移民治理体系中复杂且被低估的作用这一理论空白，丰富了移民治理研究和区域间对话机制的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于ICMDs在协调GCC-亚洲移民政策中的现实局限与潜力的实证洞察，有助于改进区域间移民对话机制的设计与运作，从而改善移民劳工的权利与福利状况。

title: The Policy, Practice, and Equity Gaps Shaping AI Integration in K-12 Education
affiliations: and Northeastern University

detail.title: The Policy, Practice, and Equity Gaps Shaping AI Integration in K-12 Education
detail.abstract: This convergent mixed-methods study examines K-12 teachers' experiences with AI integration across four domains: policy context, AI familiarity, perceived instructional applications, and professional development needs. Drawing on survey data from 95 teachers and interviews with eight, the study applies the TPACK framework within a sociotechnical systems lens. Findings reveal that the K-12 AI readiness gap is primarily a policy, professional development, and governance problem rather than an individual knowledge problem. Roughly half of teachers lack institutional AI guidance, most report lower to middle AI familiarity, and professional development is widely regarded as inadequate.

AI.tldr: 本研究采用收敛式混合方法，调查了K-12教师在政策背景、AI熟悉度、教学应用感知和专业发展需求四个领域中的AI整合经验。基于95名教师的调查数据和8名教师的访谈，运用TPACK框架和社会技术系统视角，发现K-12 AI就绪差距主要是一个政策、专业发展和治理问题，而非个体知识问题。约半数教师缺乏机构AI指导，多数教师AI熟悉度偏低，专业发展普遍被认为不足。
AI.research_question: K-12教师在AI整合中面临哪些经验与挑战？具体涉及政策背景、AI熟悉度、教学应用感知和专业发展需求四个领域。
AI.motivation: 随着AI技术进入K-12教育领域，教师如何有效整合AI成为关键问题，但现有研究对教师在政策与制度层面所面临的系统性障碍缺乏深入理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: TPACK框架与社会技术系统视角的融合
AI.method: 收敛式混合方法研究：95名教师的问卷调查与8名教师的半结构化访谈
AI.findings: K-12 AI就绪差距主要源于政策、专业发展和治理层面的制度性缺失，而非教师个体知识不足。约半数教师缺乏机构AI指导，大多数教师AI熟悉度处于中低水平，专业发展普遍被认为不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 将TPACK框架与社会技术系统视角结合，将AI整合问题从个体能力层面重新概念化为制度治理层面的问题，拓展了技术整合理论在AI时代的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为学校和政策制定者提供实证依据，表明需要优先完善AI政策指引、专业发展体系和治理机制，而非仅关注教师个体技能培训。

title: Weathering Monetary Shocks: Nonbank Lending and Bank Ownership
affiliations: Imperial College London

detail.title: Weathering Monetary Shocks: Nonbank Lending and Bank Ownership
detail.abstract: I show that nonbank lenders in the US syndicated loan market attenuate the transmission of monetary policy: they expand credit supply relative to banks directly, by increasing risky lending, and indirectly, by amplifying banks’ risk-shifting when monetary policy tightens. Bank-owned nonbank lenders appear to account for a sizeable fraction of nonbank lending, and their lending increases during tightening. This effect is more pronounced when they are owned by highly levered banks. These findings shed light on opaque nonbank behavior and provide evidence of a nonbank lending channel driven by risk-based mechanisms, reducing monetary policy effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文研究表明，美国银团贷款市场中的非银行放贷机构会削弱货币政策的传导效果：在货币政策收紧时，非银行机构直接增加信贷供给（尤其是风险性贷款），并通过放大银行的冒险行为间接扩大信贷，从而降低货币政策的有效性。
AI.research_question: 非银行放贷机构如何影响货币政策在美国银团贷款市场中的传导？其背后的机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 非银行放贷机构在信贷市场中扮演着日益重要的角色，但其行为具有高度不透明性。理解非银行机构在货币政策传导中的作用对于评估货币政策有效性和金融稳定具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于货币政策传导的信贷渠道理论，结合银行风险转移（risk-shifting）机制，提出非银行贷款渠道的概念。
AI.method: 利用美国银团贷款市场的数据，采用实证分析方法，检验非银行放贷机构在货币政策收紧时相对于银行的信贷供给行为及其作用机制。
AI.findings: （1）非银行放贷机构在货币政策收紧时相对于银行直接扩大信贷供给，且集中于风险性贷款；（2）非银行放贷机构通过放大银行的冒险行为间接增加信贷；（3）银行拥有的非银行放贷机构占非银行放贷的相当比例，且其放贷在收紧期增加；（4）当此类机构由高杠杆银行持有时，该效应更为显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地揭示了基于风险机制的非银行贷款渠道，阐明了非银行放贷机构如何削弱货币政策的有效性，丰富了货币政策传导与影子银行领域的理论研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为非银行放贷机构的不透明行为提供了证据，对监管机构和政策制定者理解货币政策有效性的边界、防范金融风险积累具有重要参考价值。

title: NGEU Grants and Sovereign Auction Demand: Evidence from Euro-Area Primary Markets
affiliations: SBE - MILE and Maastricht University

detail.title: NGEU Grants and Sovereign Auction Demand: Evidence from Euro-Area Primary Markets
detail.abstract: Does NextGenerationEU (NGEU) raise private sovereign demand at issuance? We study this question using a panel of sovereign bond auctions, pooling eight euro-area sovereigns exposed to NGEU grants with six non-euro-area placebo issuers. We measure auction demand using the log bid-to-cover ratio as the source of treatment intensity after the July 2020 NGEU agreement. Auction demand rises more strongly for euro-area sovereigns with greater grants exposure: the implied bid-to-cover responses are 7.6% for Italy, 12.6% for Spain, and 13.3% for Portugal. A grants-versus-loans horse race sharpens the interpretation: the grants effect strengthens when loans are co-estimated, the loans component enters with the opposite sign, and the two coefficients are statistically distinguishable at the 1% level. The effect concentrates in the second half of 2022, consistent with a credibility interpretation in which repeated successful disbursement events built market confidence in the joint-borrowing arrangement.

AI.tldr: 本文研究下一代欧盟基金（NGEU）是否提高了主权债券发行时的私人需求。利用八个欧元区主权国家（暴露于NGEU拨款）与六个非欧元区对照发行国的国债拍卖面板数据，以对数投标覆盖率衡量拍卖需求，发现拨款敞口更大的欧元区主权国家拍卖需求上升更强：意大利投标覆盖率隐含响应为7.6%，西班牙12.6%，葡萄牙13.3%。拨款与贷款效应的对比分析表明拨款效应显著，且效应集中于2022年下半年，与市场信心逐步建立的信用解释一致。
AI.research_question: 下一代欧盟基金（NGEU）是否在发行时提高了私人主权债券需求？
AI.motivation: NGEU作为欧盟历史上首次联合借款安排，其设立是否通过信号效应或信用背书机制降低了主权借款成本、提高了投资者需求，是一个重要的政策与学术问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于联合借款的信用背书/信号传递理论，以及市场信心逐步建立的动态信用理论。
AI.method: 使用八个欧元区主权国家与六个非欧元区对照国的国债拍卖面板数据，以对数投标覆盖率作为处理强度来源，采用双重差分框架，并进行拨款与贷款效应的"赛马"对比分析。
AI.findings: NGEU拨款敞口更大的欧元区主权国家拍卖需求上升更强：意大利隐含投标覆盖率响应为7.6%，西班牙12.6%，葡萄牙13.3%。拨款效应在共同估计贷款效应时增强，贷款系数为反号，二者在1%水平统计可区分。效应集中于2022年下半年，与市场信心逐步建立的解释一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 为联合借款安排的信用效应提供了实证证据，支持了市场信心通过重复成功拨款事件逐步建立的理论解释，区分了拨款与贷款的不同市场效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟政策制定者评估NGEU对主权债务市场的实际影响提供量化依据，对理解联合借款安排如何降低成员国借款成本具有政策参考价值。

title: Beyond the Hype: What Teachers and Administrators Actually Need for AI Implementation in K-12 Schools
affiliations: and Northeastern University

detail.title: Beyond the Hype: What Teachers and Administrators Actually Need for AI Implementation in K-12 Schools
detail.abstract: Drawing on survey and interview data from nearly 100 K-12 teachers and two dozen school and district administrators across multiple states, this article examines how schools are navigating artificial intelligence (AI) integration amid an uneven policy landscape. Findings reveal a persistent gap between state-level AI guidance and local implementation, with nearly half of teachers reporting no formal school policy. Teachers want practical, ongoing professional development, while administrators want legal and governance training. An equity thread runs throughout, as AI access and instructional quality vary by teacher and school rather than by coherent policy. Recommendations for practice and policy are offered.

AI.tldr: 本文基于对近100名K-12教师和二十多名学校及学区管理者的调查与访谈数据，考察了在不均衡政策环境下学校如何推进人工智能（AI）整合。研究发现州级AI指导与地方实施之间存在持续差距，近半数教师表示学校没有正式政策。教师需要实用且持续的教师专业发展，而管理者需要法律和治理培训。公平性问题是贯穿全文的主线，AI获取和教学质量因教师和学校而异，而非由连贯的政策驱动。
AI.research_question: 在不均衡的政策环境下，K-12学校如何推进人工智能（AI）整合？州级AI指导与地方实施之间存在怎样的差距？
AI.motivation: 人工智能正在迅速进入K-12教育领域，但政策环境不均衡，缺乏对学校如何实际导航AI整合的系统性理解。理解教师与管理者的不同需求和公平性问题，对于制定有效政策与实践建议至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文主要基于政策实施与教育公平的理论视角，考察AI政策从州级到地方层面的传导机制及其张力。
AI.method: 混合研究方法，包括对近100名K-12教师的调查以及对二十多名学校和学区管理者的访谈，覆盖多个州。
AI.findings: 1. 州级AI指导与地方实施之间存在持续差距，近半数教师报告没有正式的学校AI政策；2. 教师希望获得实用、持续的专业发展，而管理者则希望获得法律和治理方面的培训；3. 公平性问题贯穿始终，AI获取和教学质量因教师和学校而异，而非由连贯的政策驱动。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文通过实证数据揭示了AI政策从州级到学校层面的"最后一公里"传导困境，丰富了教育政策实施理论在AI新兴技术情境下的应用；同时深化了对AI教育公平问题的理解，指出不公平源于分散的实施而非统一政策。
AI.practical_contributions: 针对不同层级的需求（教师需要实用的专业发展，管理者需要法律与治理培训）提出差异化建议，并为州级和学区层面的AI政策制定提供实证依据，有助于弥合政策与实践之间的鸿沟。

title: ESG Disclosure Quality: Measurement, Determinants andStock Liquidity
affiliations: BxSE, University of Bordeaux, University of Lille and University of Lille

detail.title: ESG Disclosure Quality: Measurement, Determinants andStock Liquidity
detail.abstract: This paper constructs a new firm-level measure of ESG disclosure quality(ESGDQ) defined as the proportion of non-missing items in the LSEG (Refinitiv)ESG scoring template. ESGDQ captures the completeness of a firm’s publiclydisclosed ESG information. Using a panel of U.S. listed firms from 2009 to 2022,we validate ESGDQ against established ESG proxies and find it negatively asso-ciated with information asymmetry. Higher ESGDQ is associated with improvedstock liquidity after controlling for firm and industry-by-year fixed effects andthis holds across ESG pillars and categories. Heterogeneity tests show that thisassociation is stronger when retail investor attention and analyst coverage arelower. Finally, an event study further finds that U.S. firms with greater EUexposure exhibit higher environmental disclosure quality prior to 2020 while less-exposed firms converge toward their level afterward, a trend accompanied bycorresponding improvements in stock liquidity.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个新的企业层面ESG披露质量衡量指标（ESGDQ），即LSEG（Refinitiv）ESG评分模板中非缺失项目的比例。利用2009-2022年美国上市公司面板数据验证发现，ESGDQ与信息不对称负相关，更高的ESGDQ与股票流动性改善相关联，且该效应在零售投资者关注和分析师覆盖较低时更强。事件研究发现欧盟暴露程度高的美国企业在2020年前环境披露质量更高，之后低暴露企业向其收敛，并伴随股票流动性的相应改善。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个企业层面的ESG披露质量衡量指标，并检验其对企业信息环境和股票流动性的影响？
AI.motivation: 现有ESG披露衡量指标多关注披露内容的评分或种类，但缺乏对企业ESG信息披露完整性和全面性的系统度量。信息不对称是资本市场的重要摩擦，完整的信息披露有助于降低信息不对称、改善市场流动性，因此需要一个新的框架来衡量ESG披露的完整度及其经济后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息不对称理论；信息披露质量与资本市场流动性关系的理论框架
AI.method: 构建ESGDQ指标（非缺失项目比例）；面板回归（控制企业和行业-年份固定效应）；异质性检验（零售投资者关注与分析师覆盖分组）；欧盟暴露程度的事件研究
AI.findings: （1）ESGDQ与既有ESG代理变量相关，且与信息不对称负相关；（2）更高的ESGDQ显著改善股票流动性，且在各ESG支柱和类别中均成立；（3）零售投资者关注和分析师覆盖越低时，ESGDQ对流动性的正向效应越强；（4）欧盟暴露度高的美国企业在2020年前环境披露质量更高，之后低暴露企业向其收敛，并伴随流动性改善。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）提出了一个新的ESG披露质量衡量维度——披露完整性（completeness），丰富了ESG披露质量的度量框架；（2）提供了ESG披露质量通过降低信息不对称改善资本市场经济后果的实证证据；（3）揭示了投资者信息获取渠道（零售关注与分析师覆盖）在ESG披露质量效应中的替代/互补机制。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为监管者和政策制定者提供了衡量企业ESG披露完整性的简便工具；（2）为投资者评估ESG信息披露质量提供新的参考维度；（3）为理解跨国监管（如欧盟法规）对企业ESG披露行为的溢出效应提供了证据。

title: Evolving the Basel Framework: A Climate-Extended Merton-Vasicek Architecture with Illustrative Application to South African Mining
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Evolving the Basel Framework: A Climate-Extended Merton-Vasicek Architecture with Illustrative Application to South African Mining

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or personal relationships with other people or organizations that could have influenced the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, animals, or sensitive data. Therefore, no ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The research was conducted independently as part of the MSc Financial Engineering program at WorldQuant University.

detail.abstract: Traditional Basel II/III credit risk models rely on the Merton structural framework and Vasicek asymptotic single-factor model, both of which assume that firm asset values are driven solely by market systematic risk. This assumption fails for carbon-intensive sectors facing transition risk. We propose a Climate-Extended Merton-Vasicek architecture that decomposes firm drift into market and climate components, and introduces a second systematic factor Z climate to capture transition risk from carbon pricing, ESG policy, and stranded assets. Using a Bayesian Network to causally estimate firm-level climate beta λ, we provide an illustrative calibration to the South African mining sector using JSE index data from 2019-2023. Simulation results show that incorporating climate risk increases average probability of default by 56.98%, drives asset correlation above the Basel IRB cap from 0.18 to 0.31, and raises 99.9% portfolio loss by 65%. The framework remains compliant with Basel Pillar 1-3 logic and provides a tractable method for banks and regulators to integrate climate stress testing into capital adequacy. We recommend a "Climate RWA Add-on" for prudential authorities in emerging markets. Empirical calibration with firm-level data is ongoing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"气候扩展的Merton-Vasicek架构"，在传统信用风险模型中引入第二个系统性因子（气候因子），以捕捉碳密集型行业面临的转型风险。通过贝叶斯网络估计企业层面的气候beta（λ），并以南非矿业部门2019-2023年JSE指数数据进行校准。模拟结果显示，纳入气候风险使平均违约概率上升56.98%，资产相关性从0.18升至0.31（超过巴塞尔IRB上限），99.9%组合损失上升65%。该框架保持与巴塞尔Pillar 1-3兼容，并提出"气候RWA附加"政策建议。
AI.research_question: 如何将气候转型风险系统地纳入巴塞尔II/III信用风险框架，以准确反映碳密集型行业面临的违约风险？
AI.motivation: 传统Basel II/III信用风险模型（Merton结构框架和Vasicek渐近单因子模型）假设企业资产价值仅由市场系统性风险驱动，这一假设无法适用于面临转型风险的碳密集型行业。需要开发一种能够同时捕捉市场和气候双重系统性风险的扩展框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: Merton结构信用风险模型；Vasicek渐近单因子模型（ASRF）；双系统性因子扩展模型；贝叶斯网络因果推断
