AI.method: 提出Climate-Extended Merton-Vasicek架构，将企业漂移项分解为市场与气候两个组成部分，引入第二个系统性因子Z_climate捕捉碳定价、ESG政策和搁浅资产带来的转型风险；使用贝叶斯网络进行因果推断估计企业层面气候beta（λ）；基于JSE指数2019-2023年南非矿业部门数据进行模拟校准。
AI.findings: （1）纳入气候风险使平均违约概率增加56.98%；（2）资产相关性从0.18升至0.31，超过巴塞尔IRB上限；（3）99.9%组合损失上升65%；（4）框架保持与巴塞尔Pillar 1-3合规。
AI.theory_contributions: 将气候转型风险作为第二系统性因子引入Merton-Vasicek框架，突破了传统单因子模型的局限；提供了一种利用贝叶斯网络进行气候beta因果估计的方法论；扩展了信用风险模型对非市场系统性风险源的建模能力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行和监管机构提供了将气候压力测试纳入资本充足率评估的可行方法；提出"气候RWA附加"（Climate RWA Add-on）政策建议，特别面向新兴市场的审慎监管当局；为碳密集型行业的信用风险评估提供了可操作的校准框架。

title:
The Constitutional Attribution Problem
When Machine-Mediated Judgment Remains the State's Own
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title:
The Constitutional Attribution Problem
When Machine-Mediated Judgment Remains the State's Own
detail.abstract: Constitutional law specifies who may exercise public power, but it has no explicit test for when a machinemediated judgment can be treated as the judgment of the institution that formally acts. This Article asks that question and answers it with a Constitutional Attribution Principle. When an artificial system performs a constitutive decision function at constitutionally significant stakes, the resulting act is attributable to the responsible institution only if that institution retains three capacities: authorship of lawful ends; access to contestable and independently sufficient grounds that it actually adopts; and effective control over material consequences. The Article gives the principle three immediate doctrinal consequences. First, interface artifacts that materially shaped an agency's judgment should be included in the administrative record rather than excluded as collateral technical material. Second, an official signature or authentication does not by itself establish institutional adoption of machine-generated reasons. Third, a shared automated decisional architecture can supply a common mechanism for class-wide review even when individual inputs or remedies differ. German democratic-legitimation doctrine and South Africa's AllPay and Black Sash cases provide comparative structural support: formal public responsibility is insufficient when effective influence or operational capacity has migrated elsewhere. The principle does not require human cognitive parity with AI. Superior machine cognition may justify reliance, but it does not confer public authority. The controlling question is whether the institution to which law assigns power remains able to determine the lawful objective, test and adopt the grounds, and control the material consequences of the act.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"宪法归因原则"（Constitutional Attribution Principle），回答了一个核心问题：在何种条件下，机器介导的判决可以被视为正式行使公共权力的机构的判决。该原则要求机构保留三种能力：对合法目的的 authorship、对可争议且独立充分理由的实际采纳权，以及对物质后果的有效控制。文章还给出了三项直接的法理后果。
AI.research_question: 何时可以将机器介导的判决视为宪法上正式行事机构的判决？换言之，宪法法律规定了谁可以行使公共权力，但缺乏明确的标准来判断何时人工智能系统的决策可归因于该机构。
AI.motivation: 宪法法律明确规定谁可以行使公共权力，但现有法律框架没有明确的测试标准来判断何时机器介导的判决可以被视为正式行动机构的判决。随着人工智能系统越来越多地参与公共决策，这一法律空白亟需填补。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宪法归因原则（Constitutional Attribution Principle）、德国民主正当性理论（democratic-legitimation doctrine）、南非AllPay和Black Sash案例的比较法结构支持。
AI.method: 规范性法律分析，结合宪法理论、比较法（德国与南非）判例分析，提出三位一体的"归因"测试框架（目的authority、理由采纳、后果控制）并推导其法理后果。
AI.findings: （1）当人工智能系统执行构成性决策功能且面临宪法意义上的重大利害关系时，该行为可归因于负责任机构，前提是该机构保留三种能力：合法目的的创造权、可争议且独立充分理由的实际采纳权、对物质后果的有效控制权。（2）该原则产生三项法理后果：界面人工产物应纳入行政记录；官方签名或认证本身不足以确立对机器生成理由的机构采纳；共享自动化决策架构可为类案审查提供共同机制。（3）德国民主正当性学说和南非案例均支持：当有效影响力或操作能力转移他处时，正式公共责任是不够的。（4）该原则不要求人类认知能力与AI对等——优越的机器认知可以证明依赖的合理性，但不赋予公共权威。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出"宪法归因原则"这一系统性测试框架，填补了宪法法律在机器介导判决归因问题上的理论空白；整合德国民主正当性理论与南非判例，建立跨国比较法结构支撑；明确区分机器认知优越性与公共权威，澄清了AI在公共权力行使中的理论地位。
AI.practical_contributions: 为行政记录编制提供明确指导（界面人工产物应纳入记录）；为行政决策的司法审查提供新标准（签名不等于机构采纳）；为涉及AI的集团诉讼提供程序性机制（共享自动化架构可作为共同审查基础）。

title: Collective Wage Bargaining and Horizontal Mergers
affiliations: Compass Lexecon

detail.title: Collective Wage Bargaining and Horizontal Mergers

declarations.declarationOfInterest: consultant, he has represented many companies over the years. He holds no paid or unpaid position as officer, director, or board member of non-profit organizations or profit-making entities whose policy positions, goals, or financial interests relate to the article. The list of his clients can be found at Compass Lexecon Website. This paper does not necessarily represent the views of Compass Lexecon or its clients.
declarations.funderStatement: This paper has not been commissioned or funded by any party, and no party had the right to review the paper prior to its circulation.

detail.abstract: Traditional merger analysis treats marginal costs as technological primitives. This paper argues that, in industries with collective wage bargaining, marginal costs are endogenous and depend on market structure and labor-market institutions. The paper derives three new results. First, under decentralized bargaining, horizontal mergers increase consumer harm through a wage-bargaining multiplier: reduced product-market competition strengthens unions' bargaining positions, increasing wages and further reducing output. This amplification mechanism disappears under centralized industry bargaining. Second, the paper shows that technological merger efficiencies are only partially transmitted into lower marginal costs because workers appropriate part of the efficiency through rent sharing. The magnitude of this effect depends on bargaining power and bargaining institutions. Third, when firms and their bargaining counterparts merge simultaneously, the bargaining problem itself changes. Union integration internalizes cross-unit employment externalities, creating a new category of merger efficiencies or, depending on the sign of the spillovers, additional bargaining market power. These results imply that merger control should account explicitly for labor-market institutions when evaluating unilateral effects and efficiency defenses.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了传统并购分析中将边际成本视为技术性外生变量的假设，提出在集体工资谈判行业中，边际成本是内生的，取决于市场结构和劳动力市场制度。研究得出三个新结果：分散谈判下横向并购通过工资谈判乘数放大消费者损害；技术性并购效率只有部分传导至边际成本（工人通过租金分享获取部分）；工会合并会内化跨单位就业外部性，创造新的并购效率或额外谈判市场势力。研究建议并购控制应明确考虑劳动力市场制度。
AI.research_question: 在存在集体工资谈判的行业中，并购如何通过改变边际成本（工资）的内生性影响消费者福利和并购效率？
AI.motivation: 传统并购分析将边际成本视为技术性外生变量，但在集体工资谈判行业中，工资（边际成本的重要组成部分）取决于市场结构和谈判制度，这一内生性被现有并购分析框架所忽视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 集体工资谈判理论、并购竞争分析理论、租金分享理论、外部性内部化理论
AI.method: 理论建模分析，通过比较分散谈判与集中谈判制度下的并购效应，推导工资谈判乘数、效率传导及合并谈判等问题。
AI.findings: 第一，分散谈判下横向并购产生工资谈判乘数效应，放大消费者损害，而集中谈判下该机制消失；第二，技术性并购效率仅部分传导至边际成本，因工人通过租金分享获取部分效率收益；第三，企业与其谈判对手同时合并时，工会整合内部化跨单位就业外部性，产生新的并购效率或额外的谈判市场势力。
AI.theory_contributions: 将边际成本从外生技术变量重构为内生于市场结构和劳动力市场制度的变量；识别出工资谈判乘数这一新的消费者损害放大机制；区分不同谈判制度（分散vs集中）对并购效应的差异化影响；提出工会合并创造新的并购效率或谈判市场势力这一全新分析维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为并购控制政策提供新视角，建议反垄断执法机构在评估单边效应和效率抗辩时，应明确考虑劳动力市场制度；为行业集中谈判与分散谈判制度下的并购审查提供差异化的政策指引。

title: Governing AI-Based Transaction Monitoring in the EU: Aligning the AI Act with the 2024 AML Package

detail.title: Governing AI-Based Transaction Monitoring in the EU: Aligning the AI Act with the 2024 AML Package
detail.abstract:
In 2024 the European Union adopted two regulatory frameworks that now govern, simultaneously, AI-based transaction monitoring in the banking sector: the Anti-Money Laundering package comprising Regulation (EU) 2024/1624 (AMLR), Directive (EU) 2024/1640 (AMLD6) and Regulation (EU) 2024/1620 (the AMLA Regulation); and the Artificial Intelligence Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689). These instruments pursue overlapping but distinct aims and allocate responsibility along non-identical value chains, producing a compound framework whose internal coherence has not yet been tested in practice. This paper asks how EU financial institutions should govern AI-based transaction monitoring to comply with both regimes while maintaining enforceable accountability in AML/CFT supervision.

The analysis treats accountability as an enforceability condition operating on three layers, institutional, procedural and personal, and evaluates whether the combined framework produces an accountability chain concrete enough for supervisors to test consistently across the Union. Four sub-questions structure the analysis. First, when does an AI-based monitoring tool fall within the AI Act's high-risk perimeter for AML uses? Second, what do the AI Act's lifecycle obligations require once translated into supervisory evidence? Third, how do the organisational and fundamental-rights duties of the AMLR structure the documentation an obliged entity must hold? And fourth, what minimum documentation is required to demonstrate compliance across both regimes in a form supervisors can test?

Using doctrinal legal research grounded in primary Union sources, EBA and FATF policy documents and peer-reviewed scholarship, the paper identifies seven accountability gaps at the intersection of the two frameworks and develops, as a central analytical instrument, an obligation-to-evidence matrix that records, for each lifecycle and AML duty, the artefact a supervisor must be able to request and the accountability layer it serves. The matrix functions as the supervisory-evidence package the paper proposes and is intended for use by AMLA and the national competent authorities to test compliance, and by obliged entities to design it.

AI.tldr: 本文研究欧盟2024年通过的两套同时适用于银行业AI交易监控的监管框架（反洗钱一揽子法案与人工智能法案）之间的衔接问题，基于教义法学研究识别出七个问责缺口，并提出一个"义务到证据矩阵"作为监管检验与合规设计的核心分析工具。
AI.research_question: 欧盟金融机构应如何治理基于AI的交易监控，以同时遵守反洗钱（AML/CFT）监管框架与人工智能法案（AI Act），并维持可执行的问责机制？
AI.motivation: 2024年欧盟同时通过了AMLR/AMLD6/AMLA条例与AI Act两套监管框架，二者目标重叠但视角不同，沿不同的价值链分配责任，产生了复合框架但其内部一致性尚未在实践中得到检验。金融机构面临双重合规的模糊性与不确定性，需要厘清两套制度如何协调运作。
AI.theoretical_framework: 问责（accountability）作为可执行性条件，分为三个层面：制度层面（institutional）、程序层面（procedural）和个人层面（personal）。评估复合框架是否产生足够具体、可供欧盟各成员国监管机构一致检验的问责链条。
AI.method: 教义法学研究（doctrinal legal research），基于欧盟主要法律渊源、EBA和FATF政策文件及同行评审学术文献进行分析。核心分析工具为"义务到证据矩阵"（obligation-to-evidence matrix），记录每项生命周期义务和AML义务对应的监管者可要求的证据物及其归属的问责层面。
AI.findings: 识别出两套框架交叉处的七个问责缺口；提出将"义务到证据矩阵"作为监管证据包，供AMLA和各国主管机构用于检验合规，供义务实体用于设计合规体系。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了三层问责框架（制度、程序、个人）来分析复合监管框架的可执行性；提出了"义务到证据矩阵"这一分析工具，将抽象的法律义务转化为可检验的监管证据，推进了关于监管问责链条理论化的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AMLA和欧盟各国主管机构提供了一套统一的合规检验工具（监督证据包）；为银行等义务实体提供了设计双重合规体系的具体指引，明确了在AI交易监控情境下每项义务所需的最低文件化要求。

title:
FROM SCDI TO ACDI 
Asset-Contingent Debt Instrument for High-Obsolescence AI Infrastructure Financing: Framework, Pricing, and Evidence from Sovereign Borrowers

detail.title:
FROM SCDI TO ACDI 
Asset-Contingent Debt Instrument for High-Obsolescence AI Infrastructure Financing: Framework, Pricing, and Evidence from Sovereign Borrowers

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have influenced the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not Applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: The research received no grant from any funding agencies in the public, commercial or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Sovereign debt models rely on a fragile assumption: financed assets retain their value over the loan term. This works for roads and ports, but fails catastrophically for frontier technology. As hardware costs halve every two years-its economic value plummets far faster than a fixed repayment schedule can adjust. Governments are left paying premium rates for obsolete hardware. To date, no debt instrument addresses this compounding mismatch. To bridge this structural gap, this paper introduces the Tokenized Compute Credit (TCC), the first Asset-Contingent Debt Instrument (ACDI). Guided by a novel pricing formula-the Technology Performance Rate Adjustment (TPRA)-the TCC indexes payment obligations in near-real time to hardware depreciation, verified utilization, and audited social yield, bypassing the data manipulation and verification lags of traditional GDP-linked bonds. Applied to six sovereign borrowers-Zambia, Pakistan, Ethiopia, Kenya, Nigeria, and Bangladesh-the TCC slashes interest payments by 42% to 62%. By shifting state-contingent debt research from macroeconomic to asset-specific indexation, this framework eliminates the pricing premiums that have long stalled adoption. Crucially, the TCC integrates into existing legal and settlement infrastructure without new treaties, making it immediately deployable for the massive AI infrastructure programs now sweeping emerging markets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了代币化计算信贷（TCC），这是首个资产或有债务工具（ACDI），通过技术性能率调整（TPRA）定价公式，将近实时地将主权债务还款与硬件折旧、验证利用率和审计的社会收益挂钩，解决了前沿技术融资中固定还款计划与硬件价值快速贬值之间的结构性错配问题。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种主权债务工具，使其支付义务能够适应前沿技术硬件（特别是AI基础设施）的快速贬值，从而解决融资资产经济价值与固定还款计划之间的结构性错配？
AI.motivation: 传统主权债务模型假设融资资产在整个贷款期内保值，这对道路和港口等基础设施有效，但对前沿技术（如硬件成本每两年减半）则严重失效——政府为过时硬件支付溢价利率。现有债务工具无法解决这一复合性错配，且GDP挂钩债券存在数据操纵和验证滞后问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文基于状态或有债务理论（state-contingent debt theory），将传统宏观层面的或有指数化（如GDP挂钩）推进到资产特定层面的指数化（asset-specific indexation），并引入技术性能率调整（TPRA）定价公式作为核心理论工具。
AI.method: 本文采用理论建模与实证应用相结合的方法：设计TPRA定价公式并构建TCC债务工具，将其应用于赞比亚、巴基斯坦、埃塞俄比亚、肯尼亚、尼日利亚和孟加拉国六个主权借款国进行效果测算。
AI.findings: TCC在六个主权借款国中可将利息支付削减42%至62%；通过资产特定层面的状态或有机制，消除了长期阻碍采用的价格溢价；TCC无需新条约即可融入现有法律和结算基础设施，可立即部署于新兴市场的AI基础设施项目。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文将状态或有债务研究从宏观经济层面的指数化（如GDP挂钩）扩展至资产特定层面的指数化，填补了前沿技术融资中缺乏适配债务工具的理论空白，并提出了TPRA这一新的定价理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: TCC为新兴市场政府提供了切实可用的债务融资工具，可大幅降低AI基础设施融资成本（降息42%-62%），且无需新的国际条约即可整合进现有法律与结算体系，具有即时可部署性。

title: Compliance By Design: GDPR, Cybersecurity, And the AI Act in Extended Reality Platforms for Industry 5.0
affiliations: University of Copenhagen - Centre for Advanced Studies in Bioscience Innovation Law (CeBIL) and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Compliance By Design: GDPR, Cybersecurity, And the AI Act in Extended Reality Platforms for Industry 5.0
detail.abstract: The rapid deployment of Extended Reality (XR) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies in industrial environments raises complex legal, ethical, and regulatory challenges that organisations must navigate with care. This chapter presents the compliance-by-design framework developed within XR5.0, a Horizon Europe initiative deploying human-centric XR and AI tools across six industrial pilot cases, and demonstrates how each major requirement of that framework was concretely implemented in the XR5.0 Training Platform-a cloud-based orchestration system for immersive industrial training. The chapter analyses the EU regulatory landscape-the GDPR, NIS2 Directive, Cybersecurity Act, Cyber Resilience Act, and AI Act-alongside the ethical framework of the High-Level Expert Group (HLEG) Guidelines on Trustworthy AI and the Assessment List for Trustworthy AI (ALTAI). While the XR5.0 Training Platform is not, strictly speaking, a standalone AI system, it incorporates a number of AI-enabled functionalities-including local large language model (LLM) processing, AIassisted chat functionalities, and adaptive personalisation features-which justify a proportionate and context-sensitive application of the HLEG and ALTAI trustworthy AI principles. A central contribution is tracing how these legal and ethical instruments materialise in the platform's architecture. GDPR compliance is operationalised through data minimisation, a lawful basis grounded in contractual necessity, transparency via a structured consent workflow, and data protection by design through session token authentication and pixel streaming. Cybersecurity is ensured through TLS encryption and multi-tenant cloud isolation, while AI governance is supported by an administrator-controlled training authoring model, session audit logging, and device-agnostic Universal Design implementing the seven ALTAI requirements for trustworthy AI. The chapter argues that embedding compliance into design from the outset is both a legal obligation and a prerequisite for responsible innovation, and offers a replicable compliance-by-design model for EU-funded research projects at the intersection of XR, AI, and industrial data processing.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了XR5.0项目中开发的"合规性设计"框架，该框架将欧盟法律法规（GDPR、NIS2等）和可信AI伦理原则（HLEG/ALTAI）嵌入到XR训练平台架构中，展示了合规设计如何在工业XR与AI系统中落地实施，并提供一个可复制的合规设计模型。
AI.research_question: 如何在工业环境中快速部署XR和AI技术时，系统性地应对复杂的法律、伦理和监管挑战？具体而言，合规性设计要求如何在XR5.0训练平台架构中具体实施？
AI.motivation: XR和AI技术在工业环境中的快速部署带来了复杂的法律、伦理和监管挑战，而现有的合规框架缺乏如何在具体系统架构中落地实施的演示。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧盟监管框架（GDPR、NIS2指令、网络安全法案、网络弹性法案、AI法案）以及HLEG可信AI指南和ALTAI评估清单所提出的可信AI七项要求。
AI.method: 案例研究方法：基于Horizon Europe XR5.0项目，分析六个工业试点案例中开发的合规性设计框架，并以XR5.0训练平台（云端沉浸式工业培训编排系统）为具体案例，展示各合规要求的具体技术实现。
AI.findings: GDPR合规通过数据最小化、合同必要性法律依据、结构化同意流程和会话令牌认证+像素流传输实现设计保护；网络安全通过TLS加密和多租户云隔离实现；AI治理通过管理员控制的训练创作模型、会话审计日志和设备无关的通用设计来实施ALTAI七项可信AI要求。
AI.theory_contributions: 将欧盟法律和伦理工具（GDPR、NIS2、AI法案、HLEG/ALTAI）转化为具体系统架构层面可操作的合规设计实践，填补了合规要求与系统实现之间的理论与实践鸿沟。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟资助的XR、AI与工业数据处理交叉领域的研究项目提供了一个可复制的合规性设计模型，并论证了将合规嵌入设计不仅是法律义务，也是负责任创新的前提条件。

title: A General Theory of Economics from Five Axioms
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: A General Theory of Economics from Five Axioms
detail.abstract: Economic fields commonly employ different objects, models, and local behavioral descriptions. This paper reconstructs the principal fields of a closed economy within one ordered axiomatic structure: rational expectations, maximin, certainty equivalent, transaction, and multiple roles. Agents form role-specific certainty equivalents from heterogeneous information, protect the weakest essential condition through a hierarchical choice correspondence, and alter those conditions through transactions that propagate across multiple roles. The essential set is agent-and role-specific rather than fixed. It is formed by accumulated assets, active roles, commitments, and inherited consumption or production structures; current income affects the feasibility of maintaining that set and may alter it indirectly by enabling changes in those structures. The framework thereby connects microeconomic choice, market participation, effective demand and supply, sustainable equilibrium, and endogenous economic cycles within one common structure.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个统一的有序公理体系，将封闭经济中的理性预期、最大最小（maximin）、确定性等价、交易和多角色等主要领域重新整合，通过角色特定的确定性等价、层级选择对应及跨角色传播的交易，将微观选择、市场参与、有效供需、可持续均衡与内生经济周期连接在一个共同结构中。
AI.research_question: 如何在单一有序公理结构内统一重构封闭经济中的多个经济领域（理性预期、maximin、确定性等价、交易与多角色）？
AI.motivation: 经济领域通常使用不同的对象、模型和局部行为描述，缺乏统一的底层结构，难以在共同框架内连接微观选择、市场参与、有效供需、可持续均衡和内生周期等宏观现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 有序公理体系；理性预期；maximin（最大最小）决策准则；确定性等价；层级选择对应；多角色行为理论；交易传播机制。
AI.method: 理论构建与公理化建模方法。通过设定有序公理结构，定义角色特定的确定性等价、层级选择对应以及跨角色传播的交易机制，进而推导出宏观均衡与内生周期。
AI.findings: （1）agent的"基本集"（essential set）是agent和角色特定的而非固定的，由累积资产、活跃角色、承诺以及继承的消费或生产结构构成；（2）当前收入影响基本集的可维持性，并可通过改变结构间接改变基本集；（3）该框架能将微观经济选择、市场参与、有效需求与供给、可持续均衡和内生经济周期统一于一个共同结构之中。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出一个统一的有序公理化框架，将传统上分离的多个经济领域（理性预期、maximin、确定性等价、交易、多角色）整合为一体，并引入"agent与角色特定的基本集"这一更灵活的概念，替代传统固定的约束集设定，从而弥补了多领域间缺乏统一理论桥梁的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解经济周期内生成因、市场参与不足、有效供需失衡等现实问题提供了统一的建模工具；通过角色特定性与层级选择机制，可更好地刻画现实中异质性个体的决策行为，从而提升政策分析与经济预测的精细度和解释力。

title: Limited Commitment under Regime Switching: Optimal Contracts, Free Boundaries, and Endogenous Credit Lines
affiliations: Kyung Hee University - Department of Applied Mathematics

detail.title: Limited Commitment under Regime Switching: Optimal Contracts, Free Boundaries, and Endogenous Credit Lines
detail.abstract: We study a continuous-time financial contracting problem in which a risk-neutral principal can commit, a risk-averse agent can terminate the relationship, and labor income follows a Markov-modulated diffusion. Regime changes alter the growth and risk of future income and thereby revalue the agent's outside option even when current income does not jump. Dynamic participation constraints are summarized by a nondecreasing shadow-price process, reducing the problem to dual singular control and then to regimeswitching optimal stopping. Homogeneity yields a weakly coupled obstacle system on an unbounded domain. We establish existence, uniqueness, regularity, verification, and an endogenous threshold structure without imposing free boundaries ex ante. The solution admits a piecewise Euler-ODE representation and a numerical scheme that validates both boundary orderings and the global variational inequalities. Strong duality recovers the optimal consumption ratchet and the principal's value. The contract can be decentralized through trading accounts and a regime-dependent credit line equal to maximum continuation surplus. A regime change can activate the consumption ratchet by moving the state across the destination boundary, or it can reprice available credit even when current income and consumption remain continuous.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一个连续时间金融合约问题，其中风险中性的委托人可以承诺，风险厌恶的代理人可以终止关系，且劳动收入遵循马尔可夫调制的扩散过程。体制转换改变了未来收入的增长和风险，从而重新估值代理人的外部选项。动态参与约束由非降的影子价格过程概括，将问题简化为对偶奇异控制和体制切换最优停止问题。齐次性产生了无界域上的弱耦合障碍系统。作者建立了存在性、唯一性、正则性、验证和内生阈值结构，并通过分段欧拉-ODE表示和数值方案验证了边界排序和全局变分不等式。强对偶恢复了最优消费棘轮和委托人价值。合约可通过交易账户和依赖于体制的信用额度去中心化。
AI.research_question: 在马尔可夫调制的劳动收入扩散下，当代理人可以终止关系且委托人可以承诺时，如何刻画最优动态合约的结构与性质？
AI.motivation: 现实中的劳动收入存在体制转换（如经济周期的繁荣与衰退），体制变化即使当前收入不跳跃，也会改变未来收入前景，从而影响代理人的外部选项和合约价值。现有文献多假设收入过程为简单扩散或跳跃，缺乏对体制转换下动态参与约束的系统刻画。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态合约理论、对偶奇异控制、体制切换最优停止、障碍问题（变分不等式）、强对偶理论。
AI.method: 将动态参与约束归结为非降影子价格过程，转换为对偶奇异控制问题，再化为体制切换最优停止；利用齐次性将问题化为无界域上弱耦合障碍系统；建立存在性、唯一性、正则性、验证定理，并发展分段欧拉-ODE表示与数值方案。
AI.findings: （1）建立了体制切换合约问题的存在性、唯一性、正则性与验证定理，内生获得阈值结构；（2）得到了分段欧拉-ODE表示和数值方案，验证了边界排序和全局变分不等式；（3）通过强对偶恢复最优消费棘轮和委托人价值；（4）合约可通过交易账户和体制依赖信用额度去中心化；（5）体制变化可通过移动状态跨越目标边界激活消费棘轮，或在收入和消费连续时重新定价可用信用。
AI.theory_contributions: 将马尔可夫体制转换引入连续时间动态合约问题，建立了体制切换下动态参与约束的对偶表征；在无界域弱耦合障碍系统上证明了存在性、唯一性和正则性；内生推导了阈值结构而非外生施加自由边界；建立了体制切换奇异控制与最优停止之间的联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可计算的数值方案（分段欧拉-ODE），可用于实际合约设计；给出了去中心化实施的显式机制（交易账户+体制依赖信用额度）；揭示了体制转换如何通过再定价信用额度和触发消费棘轮来影响合约执行，对劳动力合约、保险和信贷设计具有实际指导意义。

title: Labor Market Competition and Entrepreneurship
affiliations: , National Tsing Hua University - Department of Quantitative Finance,  and The Métis Research Laboratory - EM Normandie

detail.title: Labor Market Competition and Entrepreneurship
detail.abstract: This paper examines how labor market competition shapes local entrepreneurial landscape. We construct a measure of local labor market competition using occupation-level job posting data and study its relation with startup formation across U.S. cities. A more competitive labor market for employers is associated with significantly greater startup activity. To address endogeneity concerns, we exploit large firms' relocations that alter the competitive structure of local human capital markets. Difference-indifferences analyses show that relocation-induced heterogeneous increases in competition lead to more startup formations in more exposed industries. Further mechanism tests show stronger effects in regions with greater knowledge stocks, higher labor mobility, and more favorable financing conditions, suggesting that competitive labor markets facilitate the reallocation of human capital and the commercialization of ideas.

AI.tldr: 本文利用职业层面的职位发布数据构建了本地劳动力市场竞争程度的指标，研究发现雇主面临的劳动力市场竞争越激烈，城市中的创业活动越活跃。通过利用大公司搬迁作为外生冲击，采用双重差分法解决了内生性问题，并进一步探讨了影响机制。
AI.research_question: 劳动力市场竞争如何影响当地的创业活动（初创企业形成）？
AI.motivation: 现有研究较少关注劳动力市场结构对创业活动的影响。劳动力市场是创业者获取人力资本的关键渠道，竞争性劳动力市场可能促进人力资本再配置和创意的商业化，但这一关系缺乏系统的实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人力资本再配置和创意商业化理论，认为竞争性劳动力市场能够促进人才从成熟企业流向新创企业，推动知识溢出和创业活动。
AI.method: 1. 利用职业层面职位发布数据构建本地劳动力市场竞争指标；2. 以大型企业搬迁作为外生冲击，采用双重差分法（DiD）识别因果关系；3. 进行机制检验分析知识存量、劳动力流动性和融资条件的调节作用。
AI.findings: 1. 劳动力市场竞争越激烈的城市，创业活动越活跃；2. 大企业搬迁引起的竞争增加导致受暴露行业产生更多初创企业；3. 效应在知识存量更高、劳动力流动性更强和融资条件更有利的地区更强。
AI.theory_contributions: 将劳动力市场竞争纳入创业研究的理论框架，揭示竞争性劳动力市场通过促进人力资本再配置和创意商业化来驱动创业的机制，拓展了劳动经济学与创业学的交叉研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市和区域政策制定者提供启示：通过吸引知识密集型企业、促进劳动力流动和改善融资环境来增强劳动力市场竞争，有助于激发当地创业活力。

title: What Can Forecast Revisions Reveal About Survey Respondents' Perceptions of Causality?
affiliations: University of Padova and University of Reading

detail.title: What Can Forecast Revisions Reveal About Survey Respondents' Perceptions of Causality?
detail.abstract: Without knowing the precise models used by professional forecasters to generate their expectations, questions concerning their perceptions of how the macroeconomy works, including perceived causal relationships, can only be addressed using their published expectations. This paper explores what can be learnt about their perceptions of causality from their published expectations. We illustrate with the Phillips curve-whether inflation forecasts are made conditional on an assumed path for the unemployment rate, or are instead made independently of unemployment rate forecasts. We show that analyses of revisions to fixed-event forecasts allow us to make some headway.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨如何仅通过专业预测者公开发布的预期数据来推断他们对宏观经济运行机制的认知，特别是因果关系认知，并以菲利普斯曲线为例说明方法。
AI.research_question: 在不了解专业预测者所用模型的情况下，如何从其公开发布的预期数据中推断他们对宏观经济因果关系的认知？
AI.motivation: 专业预测者用于生成预期的精确模型往往不可观测，但理解他们对宏观经济如何运作（包括感知到的因果关系）的认知具有重要意义，因此需要一种仅基于公开预期数据的方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 菲利普斯曲线理论，固定事件预期（fixed-event forecasts）修订分析框架。
AI.method: 对固定事件预期的修订进行分析（revisions to fixed-event forecasts analysis），通过考察通货膨胀预测是否以失业率预测路径为条件，来判断预测者是否感知到二者之间的因果关系。
AI.findings: 对固定事件预期的修订分析可以揭示预测者是否将通货膨胀预测与失业率路径相关联，从而推断其是否认同菲利普斯曲线所隐含的因果关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出一种仅基于公开预期数据来推断预测者因果关系认知的分析方法，丰富了关于预期形成机制的研究视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究人员和政策制定者提供一种无需获取预测者内部模型即可理解其宏观经济判断的工具。

title: Artificial Intelligence and the Labour Market: Expected Effects and the Role of Policy Intervention
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence and the Labour Market: Expected Effects and the Role of Policy Intervention
detail.abstract: This paper examines how AI is changing labour markets and how policies can help shape the way its effects are distributed. Based on a qualitative review of recent empirical and policy literature, it argues that the impact of AI is not the same for all groups of workers, that the rapid adoption of AI requires timely policy intervention, and that regulation can influence its effects on labour markets. The argument draws on evidence from comparative, task-based, and field studies. Since AI-specific policy measures are still too new for their effects on labour markets to be measured clearly, the paper looks at two existing approaches to illustrate how such policies can work in practice: the multilevel regulation of automated decision-making systems in California and South Korea's national retraining strategy. Based on this analysis, the paper identifies three main policy priorities: (i) developing transition support before workers are displaced; (ii) ensuring transparency and accountability for AI systems used in hiring and recruitment; and (iii) promoting international cooperation to establish minimum standards.

AI.tldr: 本文基于对近期实证和政策文献的定性回顾，探讨AI如何改变劳动力市场以及政策如何影响其效应分配。论文认为AI的影响因工人群体而异，需要及时的政策干预，并以加州自动决策系统监管和韩国全国再培训战略为例，提出三大政策优先事项：提前过渡支持、招聘AI透明问责、国际合作建立最低标准。
AI.research_question: AI如何改变劳动力市场？政策如何影响AI效应的分配？
AI.motivation: AI的快速采用正在改变劳动力市场，但其影响因人而异且政策干预需要及时性，而AI特定政策措施太新，其劳动力市场效应尚无法清晰衡量，因此需要通过现有政策案例来理解如何有效调控。
AI.theoretical_framework: 比较研究、基于任务的研究（task-based approach）、实地研究（field studies）
AI.method: 定性文献回顾（qualitative review），综合近期实证和政策文献，辅以两个政策案例（加州多层级自动决策系统监管、韩国全国再培训战略）的分析
AI.findings: AI对劳动力市场的影响因工人群体而异；快速采用需要及时政策干预；监管可以影响AI对劳动力市场的作用。提出三大政策优先事项：（i）在工人被替代前制定过渡支持；（ii）确保招聘与雇佣中AI系统的透明度与问责性；（iii）促进国际合作制定最低标准。
AI.theory_contributions: 整合比较研究、任务基础和实地研究视角，系统论证政策干预在AI劳动力市场效应分配中的关键作用，并将AI政策效应分析从理论层面落实到具体政策实践框架中。
AI.practical_contributions: 通过加州和韩国案例展示AI劳动力市场政策的具体操作模式，为政策制定者提供三个可操作的优先政策方向，包括提前过渡支持、AI招聘透明度和国际最低标准合作。

title: Higher Verification Costs Can Support More Disclosure
affiliations: Berlin School of Economics

detail.title: Higher Verification Costs Can Support More Disclosure
detail.abstract: In a voluntary certification game with covert, costly verification, a higher verification cost can support more disclosure of favorable evidence. When the sender's private signal is imprecise, two mixed-equilibrium branches overlap over an intermediate range of verification costs. Over this range, they support a family of strictly increasing disclosure selections, one for every cutoff in their overlap. Each selection follows the high-signal branch below its cutoff and the low-signal branch from that cutoff onward. The mixing type verifies more often within each branch. Beliefs after silence sustain these increasing selections, while constant-disclosure selections coexist.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一个自愿认证博弈，其中验证是隐蔽且有成本的。研究发现，当发送者的私人信号不精确时，更高的验证成本反而可以支持更多有利证据的披露。在中间范围的验证成本上，两个混合均衡分支重叠，支持一族严格递增的披露选择。
AI.research_question: 在隐蔽且成本高昂的验证条件下，验证成本的变化如何影响自愿认证博弈中的信息披露决策和均衡结构？
AI.motivation: 传统的认证博弈文献通常关注验证成本对披露的抑制作用，但本文发现一个反直觉的结果：更高的验证成本可以支持更多有利证据的披露，这对理解自愿认证机制的设计具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自愿认证博弈理论、信号传递理论、混合策略均衡分析
AI.method: 理论建模与均衡分析，通过构建隐蔽且昂贵验证的自愿认证博弈模型，刻画不同验证成本区间下的混合策略均衡结构。
AI.findings: （1）更高的验证成本可以支持更多有利证据的披露；（2）当发送者私人信号不精确时，两个混合均衡分支在中间验证成本区间重叠；（3）重叠区间支持一族严格递增的披露选择，每个披露选择对应一个截止点；（4）沉默后的信念支撑这些递增披露选择，同时恒定披露选择与之共存。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了验证成本与信息披露之间的非单调关系，拓展了自愿认证博弈理论中对均衡多重性的理解，为混合策略均衡分支重叠提供新的理论刻画。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计披露机制提供参考，表明在某些情况下提高验证成本可能反而促进信息披露，对认证制度设计具有实践指导意义。

title: The Normal Log-Normal Distribution: Properties and Applications
affiliations: Georgia  Institute  of  Technology

detail.title: The Normal Log-Normal Distribution: Properties and Applications
detail.abstract: The normal log-normal (NLN) distribution is a probability distribution defined as the product of a normal random variable and a log-normal random variable that may be correlated. Although its use dates back to the 1970s as a model for price shocks in speculative assets, it has recently gained renewed attention for its ability to capture skewness and leptokurtosis in data that previously lacked a proper fit with any distribution. This paper reviews the mathematical properties of the NLN distribution, its development, and its applications. After that the NLN distribution is applied to find a model for the value created by Panamanian companies.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了正态-对数正态（NLN）分布的数学性质、发展历程及其应用，并将其应用于巴拿马公司创造价值的建模。
AI.research_question: NLN分布具有哪些数学性质？其发展及应用如何？如何将其应用于巴拿马公司创造价值的建模？
AI.motivation: NLN分布能够捕捉数据的偏度和尖峰厚尾特征，而这些特征在以往无法用任何分布很好地拟合；此外，该分布虽自1970年代起被用作投机资产价格冲击的模型，但近期才重新获得关注。
AI.theoretical_framework: 正态-对数正态（NLN）分布理论，即一个正态随机变量与一个可能相关的对数正态随机变量之积所构成的概率分布。
AI.method: 本文采用综述方法回顾NLN分布的数学性质、发展历程和应用，随后将该分布应用于巴拿马公司创造价值的实证建模。
AI.findings: NLN分布能够有效捕捉数据的偏度和尖峰厚尾特征，并成功应用于巴拿马公司创造价值的分布拟合建模。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统性地综述了NLN分布的数学性质与发展脉络，重新唤起了学术界对该分布的理论关注，并拓展了其在公司价值建模领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴拿马公司创造价值的分布建模提供了新的工具，解决了以往数据无法用任何现有分布进行良好拟合的问题。

title: Manager Selection vs. Strategy Labels: How Investment Process Explains Performance Dispersion Across Asset Classes

detail.title: Manager Selection vs. Strategy Labels: How Investment Process Explains Performance Dispersion Across Asset Classes
detail.abstract: Institutional portfolios are organized around asset class and strategy labels that facilitate governance, benchmarking, and communication. However, these categories describe where capital is allocated rather than how returns are generated. Evidence across asset classes shows substantial performance dispersion among managers operating within the same strategies, indicating that manager-specific investment processes are a primary driver of outcomes. This paper argues that while strategy labels remain necessary for institutional portfolio construction, they provide only a partial explanation of performance. A process-oriented perspective focused on sourcing, underwriting, portfolio construction, value creation capabilities, and risk management offers a more granular framework for manager selection and portfolio analysis. Integrating strategy classification with process evaluation and underlying risk exposures improves decision-making and provides a clearer understanding of how capital compounds.

AI.tldr: 本文认为机构投资组合虽按资产类别和策略标签组织，但策略标签仅描述资本配置位置而非收益产生方式。作者提出以流程为导向的视角（包括项目来源、承销、组合构建、价值创造能力和风险管理）作为更精细的经理人筛选与组合分析框架，将策略分类与流程评估及底层风险暴露相结合，以改善决策并更清晰地理解资本如何复利增长。
AI.research_question: 策略标签在机构投资组合中究竟能解释多少业绩差异？以流程为导向的评估框架能否比单纯依赖策略分类更好地指导经理人选择和组合分析？
AI.motivation: 证据显示同一策略内经理人之间的业绩离散度很大，表明经理人特定的投资流程是结果的主要驱动因素，而策略标签只提供部分解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机构投资组合理论；策略分类理论；经理人选择与业绩归因理论
AI.method: 概念性/论证性论文，基于跨资产类别证据的归纳分析，提出流程导向的框架性视角。
AI.findings: 策略标签是机构组合构建的必要条件但不充分条件；流程导向视角（项目来源、承销、组合构建、价值创造、风险管理）提供了更精细的经理人筛选框架；将策略分类与流程评估和风险暴露整合可改善投资决策。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了从"资本配置位置"转向"收益生成过程"的分析范式转变，丰富了对经理人业绩差异来源的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为机构投资者提供了更精细的经理人筛选与评估框架，帮助其超越策略标签进行深层尽职调查和投资决策。

title: Transparency on the Wrong Margin: Evidence from the Physician Payments Sunshine Act
affiliations: London School of Economics,  and

detail.title: Transparency on the Wrong Margin: Evidence from the Physician Payments Sunshine Act

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no personal or financial relationships with individuals or organizations that could have influenced, or could reasonably be perceived to have influenced, this study.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant or other external funding.

detail.abstract: Transparency is widely viewed as a means of improving accountability. Yet when principals assess agents based on observed actions rather than realized outcomes, greater transparency can distort behavior by inducing agents to conform to publicly defensible norms rather than act on private information, even when such conformity reduces welfare. We examine this prediction using the Physician Payments Sunshine Act, which made physicians’ financial relationships with pharmaceutical manufacturers public and raised the reputational stakes of decisions involving opioids. Relative to physicians already subject to comparable disclosure requirements, newly exposed physicians reduce opioid purchasing and are more likely to exit opioid activity. Consistent with the proposed mechanism, these responses are stronger when reputational exposure is greater and weaker when opioid use is more readily justified by clinical need. Among physicians who remain active, purchasing shifts away from more publicly salient opioids and converges toward local practice norms. Yet physician-level contraction does not reduce aggregate opioid purchasing: pharmacy purchases rise, leaving total county volume unchanged on average. Opioid-related mortality likewise does not improve on average. Collectively, our findings point to transparency on the wrong margin—one that induces conformity without improving welfare.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用《医生薪酬阳光法案》作为自然实验，考察透明度如何影响代理人的行为。研究发现，当委托人基于可观察行为而非结果来评估代理人时，更大的透明度会诱导代理人顺从公众可辩护的规范而非依据私人信息行事，即使这种顺从降低了福利。具体而言，新暴露于披露要求的医生减少了阿片类药物购买并更可能退出阿片类药物相关业务，但这种行为收缩并未降低总体阿片类药物购买量或相关死亡率——药房购买量上升填补了缺口。
AI.research_question: 当透明度提高时，代理人是否会产生扭曲行为——即迎合公众可辩护的规范而非基于私人信息行动，从而导致福利下降？透明度在错误边际上施加影响是否会诱导顺从而不改善福利？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为透明度能改善问责制，但本文提出一个反直觉的预测：当委托人基于观察到的行为（而非结果）评估代理人时，更大的透明度会诱导代理人追求"行为看似正当"而非"结果最优"，可能造成福利损害。作者利用《医生薪酬阳光法案》这一自然实验来检验这一理论预测。
AI.theoretical_framework: 委托-代理理论；透明度与问责制的关系；行为经济学中的声誉机制与合规行为理论
AI.method: 利用《医生薪酬阳光法案》作为准自然实验，采用差异中的差异（DID）方法，比较新暴露于披露要求的医生与已受类似披露约束的医生在阿片类药物购买行为上的差异。同时分析医生个体层面、药房层面和县级总量层面的数据，检验异质性效应。
AI.findings: （1）新暴露的医生减少阿片类药物购买，更可能退出阿片类药物活动；（2）声誉暴露更大时响应更强，临床需要更能正当化阿片使用时响应更弱；（3）仍在活跃的医生从高公众关注度阿片类药物转向当地实践规范；（4）医生层面的收缩并未降低总量：药房购买上升，县级总量不变；（5）阿片相关死亡率无平均改善。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文挑战了"透明度必然改善问责制"的传统观点，揭示了透明度在错误边际上可能诱导代理人顺从规范而非依据信息行动，从而损害福利。为委托-代理理论中关于行为评估与结果评估的区分提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 对政策制定者有重要启示：设计透明度政策时需考虑代理人是否会策略性地调整行为以迎合公众观感而非追求实际福利改进；也为医疗政策、药物监管及一般性问责制度改革提供了实证依据。

title: Optimal Market Making: The Avellaneda-Stoikov Framework

detail.title: Optimal Market Making: The Avellaneda-Stoikov Framework
detail.abstract: We give an expository treatment of the Avellaneda-Stoikov (2008) model of optimal market making under inventory risk. We start from a mid-price driven by arithmetic Brownian motion and Poisson order arrivals with exponentially decaying fill intensities. Then we derive the Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation for a market maker maximizing constant-absolute-risk-aversion utility of terminal wealth. We solve it in closed asymptotic form via a CARA ansatz. The solution yields a reservation price that shifts linearly with inventory and an optimal bid-ask spread that decomposes cleanly into an inventory-risk premium and a liquidity-driven market-making edge. We show that the resulting inventory-dependent quote skew acts as a mean-reverting control on the dealer's position. We then confirm in a common-random-number Monte Carlo study that it reduces terminal-inventory variance by an order of magnitude relative to a symmetric-quoting benchmark. It delivers a higher certainty equivalent despite lower mean profit. We close by discussing calibration of the arrival parameters. And, finally, we situate the model against its exact treatment in Guéant-Lehalle-Fernández-Tapia (2013) and the adverse-selection channels it omits.

AI.tldr: 本文对Avellaneda-Stoikov（2008）做市商模型进行了教学性阐述，推导出在算术布朗运动中间价和泊松订单到达假设下的Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman方程，并通过CARA假设求得了闭式渐近解，得到随存货线性偏移的保留价格和最优买卖价差。蒙特卡洛研究证实该存货依赖性报价偏斜能将终端存货方差降低一个数量级，并提高确定性等价。
AI.research_question: 如何系统地阐述和求解Avellaneda-Stoikov最优做市模型，并评估其在实际做市中的表现与局限？
AI.motivation: Avellaneda-Stoikov模型是做市领域的基础性工作，但原始论文的推导较为简洁，本文旨在提供更完整的教学性处理，并通过数值研究验证模型的有效性，同时将其与更精确的处理（Guéant-Lehalle-Fernández-Tapia 2013）进行对比，说明其所忽略的逆向选择渠道。
AI.theoretical_framework: 最优控制理论（Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman方程）、常绝对风险厌恶（CARA）效用理论、最优做市理论、存货风险管理理论
AI.method: HJB方程推导与CARA ansatz渐近求解；公共随机数蒙特卡洛模拟对比研究；与精确解的文献对比分析
AI.findings: （1）最优解给出随存货线性偏移的保留价格和可分解为存货风险溢价与流动性做市利差的最优买卖价差；（2）存货依赖性报价偏斜作为存货的均值回复控制，在蒙特卡洛研究中将终端存货方差降低一个数量级；（3）尽管平均利润更低，但该方法提供了更高的确定性等价。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了Avellaneda-Stoikov模型更完整的教学性推导路径；阐明了存货风险溢价与流动性做市利差之间的清晰分解；建立了CARA渐近解与精确解（GLFT 2013）之间的联系，并指出了模型的边界条件（未考虑逆向选择渠道）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为做市商提供了可操作的存货依赖性报价策略框架；给出了到达参数的标定方法；通过数值证据表明该策略在降低存货风险方面具有显著优势，对实际做市系统的设计具有直接借鉴意义。

title: Bayesian Transfer Learning and Source Selection
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and

detail.title: Bayesian Transfer Learning and Source Selection
detail.abstract: Multi-source transfer learning asks which auxiliary studies should be borrowed from. The Bayesian answer is to place a prior on the informative set and average over it. We study the resulting posterior on source-inclusion configurations and show it is more delicate than the pairwise Bayes factor asymptotics suggest. The informative set admits a predictive definition through partial exchangeability, with a Sanov rate function equal to a design-weighted contrast norm plus a covariate-shift term that the contrast parameterization cannot represent. The Bayes factor for including a source compares two ways of explaining that source's data rather than the source against its absence, so the nuisance specification for excluded sources governs consistency: pooling excluded sources into one coefficient vector gives inclusion probabilities for noninformative sources that do not decay with sample size, while assigning each excluded source its own vector restores consistency once n k exceeds p. Compatibility is moreover unidentified when the informative pool has one member, since a p-dimensional contrast absorbs any single source's deviation. We establish all three by exact enumeration of the 2 K posterior in a conjugate Gaussian model, which separates the statistical question from Markov chain mixing, and show that integrating out the block variances aggravates rather than repairs the pooled specification, in one case inverting the ordering so that noninformative sources are preferred. Whether any of this reaches the target depends sharply on the target sample size. At the n 0 used in published benchmarks the contrast absorbs the contamination and the choice of nuisance specification moves target error by 0.03%; at an n 0 one third as large, naive pooling produces genuine negative transfer and the same choice is the difference between attaining the oracle and tripling its error. Selection is load-bearing precisely where transfer learning is used rather than benchmarked. We close with a collapsed marginal likelihood for logistic transfer learning under Pólya-Gamma augmentation, a Thorin-class characterization of admissible mixing measures, and a generative computation that never instantiates the configuration vector.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多源迁移学习中的源选择问题，通过贝叶斯方法对源包含配置集合进行后验推断。研究发现，在共轭高斯模型中精确枚举2^K后验表明：信息源集合的预测性定义对应Sanov速率函数（含设计加权对比范数与协变量偏移项）；排除源的处理方式（合并系数向量vs.各自独立向量）决定了一致性；当信息池仅含单一成员时对比参数化不可识别。整合掉块方差会加剧合并规范的问题，甚至颠倒排序使非信息源更受青睐。目标样本量大小对结果影响显著——在基准测试所用的n0下对比参数化吸收了污染，而在较小的n0下朴素合并会产生真正的负迁移。
AI.research_question: 在多源迁移学习中，应如何借入哪些辅助研究？贝叶斯方法下源包含配置的后验分布性质及其一致性条件是什么？
AI.motivation: 多源迁移学习需要决定借用哪些辅助数据源，但现有研究主要依赖逐对贝叶斯因子渐近分析，忽略了后验在源包含配置上的精细结构；同时排除源的处理方式（pooling规范）对一致性的影响未被充分认识。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝叶斯模型平均、部分可交换性、Sanov大偏差理论、共轭高斯模型、Pólya-Gamma增广、Thorin类混合测度
AI.method: 在共轭高斯模型下对2^K种源包含配置进行精确枚举计算后验；推导预测性定义下的Sanov速率函数；分析两种排除源规范（合并系数向量vs.各自独立系数向量）下的一致性；提出逻辑迁移学习的折叠边际似然（Pólya-Gamma增广）及生成式计算方法。
AI.findings: (1) 合并排除源系数向量的规范导致非信息源的包含概率不随样本量衰减，而各自独立向量在nk超过p时恢复一致性；(2) 当信息池仅有一个成员时，p维对比参数可吸收任意单一源的偏差导致不可识别；(3) 整合块方差会加剧合并规范的问题，甚至使非信息源更受偏好；(4) 在基准测试的n0下选择影响仅0.03%，而在n0缩小为三分之一时，朴素合并产生真正的负迁移，选择是达到oracle还是三倍误差的关键。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了贝叶斯源选择后验比逐对Bayes因子渐近分析更精细；给出了信息源集合的预测性定义和精确速率函数；识别了排除源规范化对一致性的关键作用；建立了不可识别性与信息池大小的联系；提供了Thorin类混合测度的特征刻画。
AI.practical_contributions: 指出源选择在真实迁移学习场景（小样本目标）中至关重要，而在基准测试的大样本条件下影响可忽略；提供了不实例化配置向量的生成式计算方法和逻辑迁移学习的折叠边际似然，为实际多源迁移选择提供了可行的计算工具。

title: The Guinand-Weil Explicit Formula and Riemann's Incomplete Gamma Continuation of Ξ
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: The Guinand-Weil Explicit Formula and Riemann's Incomplete Gamma Continuation of Ξ
detail.abstract: Riemann's second proof of the functional equation continues the completed zeta function to the whole plane by an everywhere convergent series of incomplete gamma functions. The Guinand-Weil explicit formula pairs the nontrivial zeros against prime powers. We show that these are the additive and multiplicative faces of one construction, namely the fold of the multiplicative half line by x → 1/x, applied to the theta kernel in the first case and to the von Mangoldt measure in the second, with the Mellin transform as intertwiner. The comparison is made through a cut point a > 0 at which the Mellin integral is split. We prove that the vanishing of the flow in a is exactly the theta transformation formula, that a is Mellin dual to a symmetrised translation of the Fourier variable in the explicit formula, and hence that there is a cut point family of explicit formulas whose trivial terms carry the coefficients a 1/4 and a-1/4 produced by the poles of Λ at s = 0 and s = 1. The cut point does not merely dilate the prime sum but localises it to a multiplicative window about n = √ a, matching the effective range n ≲ √ a of the reflected bracket of the expansion. Letting the smoothing time tend to zero closes the window onto a point and recovers Λ vM pointwise from a zero sum twisted by cos(γ ρ log x), the limit being supported exactly on the prime powers. Along the way we put the archimedean term into two closed integral forms and obtain the small time expansion of the heat trace of the zeros.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了黎曼ζ函数函数方程的第二个证明与Guinand-Weil显式公式实际上是同一构造的两个面向（加性与乘性），即通过x→1/x折叠乘性半直线，分别作用于theta核与von Mangoldt测度，以Mellin变换作为交织算子。通过切割点a > 0处拆分Mellin积分，证明流的消失等价于theta变换公式，并构造了一族显式公式，其平凡项携带Λ在s=0和s=1处极点产生的系数a^{1/4}和a^{-1/4}。当平滑时间趋于零时，窗口闭合为一个点，从零和（由cos(γ ρ log x)扭转）逐点恢复Λ_{vM}，极限恰好支撑在素数幂上。
AI.research_question: 黎曼ζ函数函数方程的第二个证明（通过不完全伽马函数级数）与Guinand-Weil显式公式之间是否存在统一的数学结构？具体而言，切割点a > 0如何在Mellin积分拆分中同时连接theta核变换公式与显式公式中的Fourier变量对称平移？
AI.motivation: 黎曼函数方程与显式公式分别从加性与乘性角度研究ζ函数的零点，二者看似独立。本文旨在揭示它们源于同一构造（折叠乘性半直线），从而为理解ζ函数零点分布与素数幂之间深层联系提供统一框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 黎曼ζ函数解析延拓理论、Mellin变换的调和分析框架、Guinand-Weil显式公式、theta变换公式、不完全伽马函数级数展开、素数幂测度（von Mangoldt测度）理论
AI.method: 通过折叠映射x→1/x将乘性半直线折叠，分别作用于theta核与von Mangoldt测度；在切割点a处拆分Mellin积分；引入平滑化时间参数并令其趋于零以闭合窗口；利用热迹展开与闭式积分形式分析archimedean项。
AI.findings: (1) 函数方程第二证明与显式公式是同一折叠构造的两面；(2) 流的消失等价于theta变换公式；(3) a是显式公式中Fourier变量对称平移的Mellin对偶；(4) 存在切割点族显式公式，其平凡项携带a^{1/4}和a^{-1/4}系数；(5) 切割点将素数求和局部化到n≈√a的乘法窗口；(6) 平滑时间趋于零时，从扭转零和逐点恢复von Mangoldt测度，极限恰好支撑在素数幂上；(7) 获得archimedean项的两种闭式积分形式及零点热迹的小时间展开。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次建立了黎曼函数方程第二证明与Guinand-Weil显式公式之间的统一构造性框架，揭示了加性与乘性分析在ζ函数理论中的内在同一性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了显式公式的切割点族构造，为素数分布的数值计算提供了窗口化、局部化的新工具；热迹小时间展开可用于零点分布的高精度数值研究。

title: Horseshoe Layer Transfer and Generative Bayesian Computation for Pre-Trained Transformers
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and George Mason University

detail.title: Horseshoe Layer Transfer and Generative Bayesian Computation for Pre-Trained Transformers
detail.abstract: Generative pre-training followed by discriminative fine-tuning is the dominant paradigm for transfer in language understanding. We show that the two-stage procedure of Radford et al. [2018] is a maximum a posteriori procedure in disguise: the auxiliary language modeling term in the fine-tuning objective is a log-prior and its weight λ is a global shrinkage parameter set by hand. Our main contribution is to replace the manual sweep over the number of transferred layers with a global-local shrinkage model. We place a horseshoe prior on per-layer contributions κ 1 ,. .. , κ L , derive the induced shrinkage profile, define an effective number of transferred layers L eff = ℓ (1-E[ϱ ℓ | y]), and give tail-robustness and concentration results for the layer weights. Polya-Gamma augmentation renders the softmax head conditionally Gaussian, so the full conditional for κ is available in closed form and supplies an exact benchmark. We then give a Generative Bayesian Computation construction in which the horseshoe prior admits an explicit quantile map κ ℓ = tan(πτ 0 /2) tan(πτ ℓ /2) Φ-1 (τ ′ ℓ) with independent uniform inputs, so that posterior draws are obtained by forward evaluation of a single trained network rather than by re-optimization. A simulation study in the frozen-backbone model confirms the resulting prediction: the log-loss gain of the posterior predictive over the plug-in falls as 3/n across three orders of magnitude, calibration error at n = 250 is cut by 38%, and the validation-selected sweep depth proves a far noisier estimator of transfer depth than L eff. Three further consequences are developed: the small-sample failure on RTE is plug-in overconfidence; the four ad hoc zero-shot heuristics of the original analysis are functionals of one predictive; and in-context learning is the GBC evaluation step under exchangeability. We state precisely what is proved, what is simulated, what is conjectured, and what remains to be measured on real data.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示生成式预训练+判别式微调的两阶段范式本质上是最大后验（MAP）估计，并将人工扫描迁移层数的做法替换为全局-局部收缩模型（马蹄形先验）。作者提出了有效迁移层数Leff的概念，并构建了生成式贝叶斯计算（GBC）框架，使得后验采样可以通过前向评估单次训练的网络获得，而非重新优化。模拟研究验证了后验预测的对数损失增益按3/n速度衰减、校准误差显著降低等理论预测。
AI.research_question: 如何将语言理解中生成式预训练+判别式微调的两阶段流程从统计推断的视角重新形式化，并消除对人工选择的超参数（如迁移层数）的依赖？
AI.motivation: 现有范式（Radford et al., 2018）中，微调目标的辅助语言建模项被视为正则化，其权重λ是手工设定的全局收缩参数，同时迁移层数的选择依赖繁琐的人工扫描（validation sweep）。作者希望通过严格的贝叶斯推断框架，自动、稳健地确定迁移深度并改善不确定性量化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 最大后验（MAP）估计框架、全局-局部收缩模型（horseshoe prior）、生成式贝叶斯计算（GBC）、Polya-Gamma增广、可交换性。
AI.method: 作者将辅助语言建模项解释为对数先验，其权重λ为全局收缩参数；对每层贡献κ1,...,κL放置horseshoe先验，推导诱导收缩剖面和有效迁移层数Leff。通过Polya-Gamma增广使softmax头条件高斯化，获得闭式全条件分布作为精确基准。进一步构建GBC构造，使horseshoe先验具有显式分位数映射，后验样本可通过单次训练网络的前向评估获得。在冻结骨干（frozen-backbone）模型中开展模拟研究验证理论预测。
AI.findings: （1）后验预测相对plug-in的对数损失增益按3/n衰减（跨越三个数量级）；（2）在n=250时校准误差降低38%；（3）validation-selected的扫描深度比Leff是更嘈杂的迁移深度估计器；（4）RTE上的小样本失败源于plug-in过度自信；（5）四种ad hoc零样本启发式是单一预测的功能泛函；（6）上下文学习（ICL）是对称可交换性下的GBC评估步骤。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）将预训练-微调的两阶段流程重新解读为MAP过程，建立了语言迁移与贝叶斯推断之间的理论桥梁；（2）引入马蹄形先验对逐层贡献进行建模，推导了收缩剖面和有效层数的理论性质（尾部稳健性、集中性）；（3）提出GBC构造，使得复杂后验可通过解析分位数映射实现高效采样；（4）以统计学语言精确刻画了plug-in过拟合、零样本启发式和上下文学习等现象的本质。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）消除了对迁移层数的人工扫描，提供自动化的有效迁移深度估计器Leff；（2）后验预测改善了小样本下的校准性能，可缓解过置信问题；（3）GBC框架允许在不重新优化的情况下获得后验样本，大幅降低计算成本；（4）为理解上下文学习和零样本推理提供了统一视角，有助于指导实际模型设计。

title: AI-Driven ESG Frame Analysis Through Interactive Dashboards for Sustainable Finance
affiliations: , University of Luxembourg, University of Luxembourg, University of Luxembourg, University of Luxembourg, Universite du Luxembourg - Luxembourg School of Finance and Universite du Luxembourg - Luxembourg School of Finance

detail.title: AI-Driven ESG Frame Analysis Through Interactive Dashboards for Sustainable Finance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing financial interests. This study reports results from the ESG Frame Analysis project developed jointly by the Interdisciplinary Centre for Security, Reliability and Trust (SnT), University of Luxembourg, and the Luxembourg House of Financial Technology (LHoFT). Two co-authors are affiliated with LHoFT.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required because the study analyses publicly available corporate ESG reports and does not involve human participants, interventions, or the collection of personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The work was carried out within the collaborative ESG Frame Analysis project between SnT, University of Luxembourg, and LHoFT.

detail.abstract: This study develops and demonstrates an AI-driven framework for analysing the narrative construction of corporate environmental, social, and governance (ESG) disclosures. Unlike tools centred on quantitative indicators and ratings, it classifies claims using a 12-frame taxonomy spanning epistemic, agency, valence and legitimacy families. A document-to-dashboard workflow converts report text into claim-level frame assignments, semantic triples, materiality links, and evidence records, which are then aggregated across four professional perspectives. The prototype is demonstrated with reports from Shell plc, DWS Group GmbH & Co. KGaA, Nestlé S.A., Deutsche Bank AG, Société Générale and BNP Paribas SA. The cases show how the commitmentachievement ratio, positivity skew and disclosure credibility can support Sustainable Finance Disclosure Regulation (SFDR) including Principal Adverse Impact (PAI) indicators, Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive (CSRD) and sustainability-linked finance analysis. Results suggest that frame analysis can surface promise-delivery gaps and selective narrative emphasis without verifying underlying ESG performance. The study contributes a transparent design framework and identifies validation, robustness and governance requirements for deployment.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发并展示了一个基于AI的框架，用于分析企业ESG披露的叙事构建。不同于依赖定量指标的评级工具，该框架使用包含认知、能动性、效价和合法性四大类别的12个框架分类法对声明进行分类，并通过文档到仪表板的工作流程将报告文本转化为声明级别的框架分配、语义三元组、实质性联系和证据记录。原型在六家公司的报告中得到验证，结果显示承诺-成就比率、正向偏差和披露可信度可以支持SFDR、CSRD和可持续金融分析，同时无需验证底层ESG绩效即可揭示承诺-交付差距和选择性叙事强调。
AI.research_question: 如何利用AI驱动框架从叙事构建角度分析企业ESG披露，而非依赖传统的定量指标和评级？
AI.motivation: 现有ESG分析工具主要集中于定量指标和评级，忽略了ESG披露中叙事构建的重要性。企业可能通过选择性叙事强调和承诺-交付差距来影响利益相关者认知，因此需要一套能够系统分析ESG叙事框架的工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 框架分析理论（frame analysis），结合12框架分类法，涵盖认知（epistemic）、能动性（agency）、效价（valence）和合法性（legitimacy）四个类别。
AI.method: 开发文档到仪表板（document-to-dashboard）工作流程，将报告文本转换为声明级别的框架分配、语义三元组、实质性联系和证据记录，并在四个专业视角下进行聚合分析。原型在Shell、DWS、Nestlé、Deutsche Bank、Société Générale和BNP Paribas六家公司的报告中得到验证。
AI.findings: 承诺-成就比率、正向偏差和披露可信度能够有效支持SFDR（包括PAI指标）、CSRD和可持续金融分析。框架分析可以在不验证底层ESG绩效的情况下，揭示承诺-交付差距和选择性叙事强调。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个透明的ESG披露叙事分析设计框架，将框架分析理论应用于ESG披露语境中，扩展了叙事分析在可持续金融领域中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管合规（SFDR、CSRD）、可持续金融分析和ESG披露评估提供了可操作的工具和流程，同时识别了部署所需的验证、稳健性和治理要求。

title: A Glossary of Statistical Terms for Artificial Intelligence
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and George Mason University

detail.title: A Glossary of Statistical Terms for Artificial Intelligence
detail.abstract: Modern artificial intelligence is nonparametric statistics executed at scale. We give a glossary that translates the vocabulary of deep learning into the vocabulary of statistics, and we develop one entry in full: the attention mechanism of the transformer is a Nadaraya-Watson kernel smoother. The identification is exact when keys are norm-constrained, in which case softmax attention is kernel regression with a von Mises-Fisher kernel of concentration √ d, values are responses, and the attention matrix is a row-stochastic smoother matrix. Four readings of the same weights follow: maximum entropy, exponential tilting of the empirical measure, selfnormalized importance sampling, and the E-step for a mixture with fixed scale. From the smoother matrix we recover leverage, effective degrees of freedom, effective sample size, and a closed-form leave-one-token-out formula. Depth is a product of Markov operators, so rank collapse is Perron-Frobenius and the mean-shift algorithm, while the residual path is twicing and the composite is a boosting operator with an explicit eigencomponent shrinkage. The feedforward block is a hinge basis expansion of the MARS type, which locates the extrapolation failure precisely. Exponential tilting recurs three times, in attention, in temperature decoding, and in alignment, where the optimal policy is an Esscher transform of the reference model, and the three share one failure mode and one diagnostic. Two further entries are treated at length because they are routinely misattributed. Backpropagation is reverse-mode accumulation of the chain rule and not an optimizer, the optimizer being Robbins-Monro stochastic approximation, and it should be kept distinct from both the derivative-free simplex method of Nelder and Mead and the iteratively reweighted least squares of Nelder and Wedderburn. The 1-Wasserstein distance is the Mallows metric, which is the earth mover's distance, and reading attention as a one-sided entropic transport problem explains what Sinkhorn normalization changes. We state where the correspondences fail, in particular that classical kernel regression suffers the curse of dimensionality at rate n-4/(4+d) while attention escapes it by learning the metric, which places it nearer to projection pursuit, sliced inverse regression, and the dimension-free approximation rates of Barron than to fixed-bandwidth smoothing.

AI.tldr: 本文提供了一个将深度学习词汇翻译为统计学词汇的术语表，并深入展开了一个核心条目：Transformer的注意力机制本质上是一种Nadaraya-Watson核平滑器。论文还探讨了深度、残差路径、前馈模块、反向传播等深度学习概念与统计概念的对应关系，并指出现代AI本质上是大规模非参数统计。
AI.research_question: 如何将深度学习的核心概念（注意力机制、深度、残差连接、前馈模块、反向传播等）系统地翻译为经典统计学的概念框架，并明确哪些对应关系成立、在哪里失效？
AI.motivation: 深度学习与统计学之间存在大量概念对应关系，但缺乏系统的术语对照。许多概念被反复误解或错误归因（如反向传播被误认为优化器），需要建立一个严谨的翻译框架来澄清这些对应关系及其局限性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 核回归（Nadaraya-Watson）、von Mises-Fisher分布、最大熵原理、指数倾斜（exponential tilting）、重要性采样、EM算法、Perron-Frobenius理论、马尔可夫算子、MARS（多元自适应回归样条）、Esscher变换、Robbins-Monro随机逼近、Mallows度量（1-Wasserstein距离）、Sinkhorn正则化
AI.method: 概念映射与理论分析：通过严格的数学对应关系建立深度学习与统计学的术语翻译，包括（1）注意力机制与核平滑的精确等价证明；（2）注意力矩阵的四种统计解读；（3）深度与马尔可夫算子乘积的对应；（4）残差路径与boosting算子的对应；（5）反向传播与链式法则反向累加、优化器与Robbins-Monro算法的区分；（6）Wasserstein距离与Mallows度量的等同。
AI.findings: （1）当键被范数约束时，softmax注意力精确等于带von Mises-Fisher核（浓度√d）的核回归；（2）注意力权重可被解读为最大熵、经验测度的指数倾斜、自助标准化重要性采样、以及固定尺度混合模型的E步；（3）深层网络是马尔可夫算子的乘积，秩坍缩对应Perron-Frobenius和均值漂移算法；（4）残差路径对应twicing，整体是带显式特征值收缩的boosting算子；（5）前馈模块是MARS型铰链基展开；（6）指数倾斜在注意力、温度解码和对齐中重复出现三次；（7）经典核回归受维度诅咒（收敛率n^(-4/(4+d))），而注意力通过学习度量逃脱了维度诅咒。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）建立了Transformer注意力机制与核回归之间的精确数学等价性；（2）统一了注意力、温度解码与对齐中的指数倾斜结构，揭示其共同失效模式与诊断方法；（3）澄清了反向传播与优化器的概念区分，纠正了常见误解；（4）阐明了注意力如何通过学习度量规避经典核回归的维度诅咒，将其置于投影追踪、切片逆回归和Barron近似率的理论框架中。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）提供了从注意力矩阵恢复杠杆值、有效自由度、有效样本量以及留一法预测的闭式公式；（2）精确定位了前馈模块的外推失败机制；（3）为注意力机制的温度解码和对齐提供统一的失效诊断工具；（4）为深度学习实践者提供了一套用经典统计工具理解和诊断现代AI模型的术语框架。

title: Pricing Intelligence: Task-Based Learning and Labor Displacement in the AI Economy
affiliations: University of Bonn

detail.title: Pricing Intelligence: Task-Based Learning and Labor Displacement in the AI Economy
detail.abstract: What determines the speed and direction of AI learning? I analyse this question from a microeconomic perspective by studying a model in which AI providers sell access to users who must complete tasks using either AI or labor. Users differ in the share of complex tasks they face. When complex tasks are delegated to AI, it learns to perform them better. In an initial technological state where AI has a comparative advantage at easy tasks, users with many complex tasks have low willingness to pay for access. This gives rise to a tension between profit maximization and complex-task learning. I characterize when this tension gives rise to a convex path of labor displacement or a learning trap in a monopoly benchmark. Competition between AI providers increases the speed of labor displacement if it is intense. Asymmetric competition can increase the speed of labor displacement by promoting endogenous specialization of AI providers.

AI.tldr: 本文从微观经济学视角构建模型，研究AI提供商向用户出售访问权限的市场结构如何影响AI学习的速度与方向，以及劳动力替代的动态路径。
AI.research_question: 什么决定了AI学习的速度和方向？具体而言，AI提供商的市场结构与竞争如何影响AI在复杂任务上的学习和劳动力替代的进程？
AI.motivation: AI学习不仅取决于技术本身，还取决于经济激励和市场结构。当用户面临的任务复杂度不同时，AI提供商的利润最大化动机可能与复杂任务的学习需求产生冲突，这可能延缓AI的发展或劳动力替代进程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 微观经济学中的比较优势理论、垄断与竞争市场理论、内生专业化理论。
AI.method: 理论建模分析：构建AI提供商向异质性用户（按其面临复杂任务比例区分）出售访问权限的模型，分析垄断基准下和竞争条件下的均衡结果。
AI.findings: （1）利润最大化与复杂任务学习之间存在张力；（2）垄断下该张力可能导致凸形的劳动力替代路径或学习陷阱；（3）AI提供商之间的激烈竞争会加速劳动力替代；（4）不对称竞争可通过促进AI提供商的内生专业化来加速劳动力替代。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI学习的内生过程与市场结构联系起来，揭示了利润动机对AI技术学习路径的影响机制，并刻画了垄断与竞争条件下劳动力替代路径的差异，补充了关于AI与劳动力替代的微观经济学理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解AI学习速度和劳动力替代的决定因素提供理论依据；为AI产业的市场结构设计与竞争政策提供参考，说明竞争强度和不对称竞争对AI技术进步的潜在影响。

title: Diversify the Decisions, Not just the Assets: A Practical Architecture for Dynamic Asset Allocation When Strategy Choice is Uncertain

detail.title: Diversify the Decisions, Not just the Assets: A Practical Architecture for Dynamic Asset Allocation When Strategy Choice is Uncertain

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study uses financial-market and publicly available data and involves no human participants or animals.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

keywords: Strategy Ensembles Provide your feedback on BizChat

detail.abstract:
Diversification usually starts with assets. This paper asks whether it should also reach the decisions that choose them. Dynamic asset allocation can respond to changing market evidence without requiring a precise forecast of the next regime, but many practical rules descend from the same momentum intuition. A portfolio can therefore hold several strategies and still depend on one broad decision.

We examine diversification at the decision level: What does each rule own? When does it change? How much risk does it take? This project uses the name Autonomous Dynamic Asset Allocation (ADAA) for the rule-governed architecture studied here. ADAA is a modular framework rather than a timeless recipe: the number of sleeves is not a design target, and the five current sleeves form one reference implementation built from practitioner adaptations of public rule families. The analysis separates source-family selection from sleeve engineering.

In a June 2008-July 2026 historical simulation on a common ETF sample, the current sleeves make meaningfully different portfolio decisions even when some return correlations are high. A separate performance-free decision check reconstructs a 16-rule 2023 reference pool: the documented historical five-family set ranks above most feasible five-rule combinations in that pool, while the same check also exposes redundancy inside the original design. The later practitioner weights lie within a broad near-optimal region rather than at a unique backtest optimum. ADAA does not beat the hindsight-best sleeve and does not protect in every stress episode. The evidence supports a narrower proposition: diversify reasonable decision rules, avoid precision unsupported by the data, make failure modes visible, and treat sleeves as replaceable components.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"决策层面多元化"的概念，认为资产配置组合即使持有多种策略，仍可能依赖单一决策逻辑。作者构建了名为ADAA（自主动态资产配置）的模块化框架，包含五个从公开规则族实践化改造的策略袖子，并通过2008年6月至2026年7月的ETF历史模拟和16条规则基准池检验，证明决策层面的多元化比资产层面的多元化更能有效分散风险。
AI.research_question: 资产配置多元化是否应从资产层面延伸到决策层面？在同一动量直觉衍生出的多种策略中，决策层面的独立性如何影响投资组合的稳健性？
AI.motivation: 传统多元化聚焦于资产类别，但实践中许多动态配置规则都源于相同的动量逻辑，导致组合表面分散实则依赖同一决策。因此需要审视决策层面的多元化以提升组合稳健性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 决策层面多元化（Decision-level diversification）；模块化策略架构；规则族分离与策略袖子工程（sleeve engineering）
AI.method: ADAA模块化框架构建（五个策略袖子）；2008年6月至2026年7月ETF样本的历史模拟；无绩效决策检查（performance-free decision check）重建16条规则2023年参考池，评估五族配置方案在组合空间中的排名与冗余度；近最优区域分析
AI.findings: 1. 五个当前袖子即使在收益率相关度较高时也做出显著不同的组合决策；2. 五族配置在16条规则参考池中排名靠前，但原始设计中存在冗余；3. 实践权重位于较宽近最优区域而非唯一回测最优点；4. ADAA不优于事后最优袖子，也不能在所有压力情境中提供保护
AI.theory_contributions: 将多元化概念从资产层面拓展到决策层面，提出策略决策独立性是组合稳健性的关键维度；论证规则族分离与袖子工程是两个可独立优化的层面
AI.practical_contributions: 提供ADAA参考实现供实践者借鉴；提出实用原则：分散合理的决策规则、避免数据无法支撑的精度追求、使失败模式可见、将策略袖子视为可替换组件

title: Platform as Importer: Rethinking Customs Responsibility in Cross-Border E-Commerce

detail.title: Platform as Importer: Rethinking Customs Responsibility in Cross-Border E-Commerce
detail.abstract: The end of de minimis treatment and the rise in tariffs are exposing a mismatch in U.S. customs law between the party legally responsible for an import entry and the party best-positioned to ensure its accuracy. Under 19 U.S.C. § 1484, importer-of-record status may be allocated among eligible parties even when another participant possesses greater information access and operational control over the transaction. This Article traces the historical development of the importer-of-record framework and shows how platform-mediated commerce fragments the functions that customs law traditionally assumed would reside in a single importer. It then proposes a control-based rule under which platforms exercising substantial control over an import transaction would be deemed importers of record, while platforms below that threshold would owe a limited duty to preserve and transmit customs-relevant information. The proposal would better align customs responsibility with institutional capacity while accounting for differences among platform business models.

AI.tldr: 本文指出现行美国海关法中进口记录方的法定责任与实际信息掌控能力之间存在错配，尤其是在平台中介贸易背景下。文章提出以"控制"为基础的规则，将行使实质性控制权的平台认定为进口记录方，低于该门槛的平台则承担有限的保存和传递海关信息义务，以更好地将海关责任与制度能力对齐。
AI.research_question: 在取消de minimis待遇和关税上升的背景下，法律上应承担进口记录义务的一方与最有能力确保申报准确性的主体不一致时，应如何重构进口记录方的认定规则以适应平台中介贸易的新格局？
AI.motivation: 关税和de minimis政策的调整使美国海关法的内在缺陷暴露：法定责任承担者与实际信息掌控者分离。平台中介的兴起进一步碎片化了传统海关法预设的单一进口商所应具备的功能，导致责任与能力错配，亟需新的法律框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文基于19 U.S.C. § 1484对进口记录方制度的历史演变分析，以及平台中介贸易对传统海关法律功能假设的挑战为理论视角，提出以"控制"为核心标准的责任分配理论框架。
AI.method: 本文采用规范法学研究方法，通过历史分析法梳理进口记录方制度的发展脉络，结合平台经济商业模式的分析，提出立法与规则设计方案。
AI.findings: 本文发现：现行法律允许在合格主体之间分配进口记录方身份，但可能将身份赋予信息获取能力和运营控制权较弱的一方；平台中介贸易导致传统海关法预设的单一进口商所承担的各项功能（信息、控制、责任）被碎片化；据此提出"控制导向"新规则。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文对海关法中进口记录方制度提出新的理论框架，将制度能力（institutional capacity）原则引入责任分配标准，并以平台商业模式的差异性为基础区分责任层级，丰富了海关合规责任分配的理论研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 本文为美国海关法改革提供具体的规则建议：对行使实质性控制的平台施加进口记录方责任，对未达门槛的平台施加有限的信息保存与传递义务，有助于提升海关申报准确性并适应跨境电商发展，也为立法者和监管机构提供可操作的改革方向。

detail.abstract: For almost 60 years, the Canadian Tax Foundation published an annual monograph, Finances of the Nation, and its predecessor, The National Finances. In a change of format, the 2014 Canadian Tax Journal introduced a new “Finances of the Nation” feature, which presents annual surveys of provincial and territorial budgets and topical articles on taxation and public expenditures in Canada. This article surveys the 2025-26 provincial and territorial budgets. The underlying data for the Finances of the Nation monographs and for the articles in this journal will be published online in the near future.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了加拿大税务局基金会近60年来发布的年度专著《国家财政》及其前身《国家财政》，并介绍了2014年《加拿大税务杂志》推出的新"国家财政"栏目，该栏目提供各省和地区预算的年度调查以及关于加拿大税收和公共支出的专题文章。本文具体调查了2025-26年度各省和地区的预算。
AI.research_question: 加拿大2025-26年度各省和地区的预算情况如何？
AI.motivation: 延续加拿大税务基金会近60年的传统，以新的格式继续提供加拿大各省和地区财政状况的年度调查，为政策制定者和研究人员提供参考。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政学/公共财政分析框架，涉及税收和公共支出分析。
AI.method: 省级和地区预算的年度调查与综述，属于描述性/综述性研究方法。
AI.findings: 调查了2025-26年度加拿大各省和地区的预算内容，包括税收和公共支出方面的主要变化和趋势。
AI.theory_contributions: 延续并更新了加拿大公共财政研究的年度数据和分析传统，为后续研究提供系统性的财政数据基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、研究人员和公众提供了加拿大各省和地区2025-26年度财政预算的系统性概述和参考数据。
