detail.title: Taxing Data as the New Oil

publicationDetails.detailsText: Canadian Tax Journal/Revue fiscale canadienne, Vol. 74, No. 1, 2026, pp. 1  -  38
publicationDetails.journalName: Canadian Tax Foundation (CTF) Research Paper Series

publicationDetails.detailsText: Canadian Tax Journal/Revue fiscale canadienne, volume 74, issue 1, 2026[10.32721/ctj.2026.74.1.dourado]

detail.abstract: This article explains why the comparison between oil and data is valid not only with regard to the wealth generated by oil companies and digital giants but also with regard to the legitimate taxation of that income by source states. The author focuses on the parallels between the transformation of crude oil into a wide array of profitable products and the processing of raw data into valuable information (data mining). The author contends that both oil and data are natural resources whose overexploitation leads to negative externalities in communities and territories where those resources are collected. The negative externalities justify the imposition of specific taxes with compensatory purposes— based on Pigouvian and Coasean theories—on oil extraction and data mining. Negative externalities also provide indisputable legitimacy to tax by the state where oil and data are collected. A specific tax with compensatory purposes on data mining would be independent of any general international solution granting taxing rights to market states and encompassing most economic sectors, and is not recommended as a means of circumventing tax treaties.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了石油与数据在财富创造和税收合法性方面的可比性，提出基于庇古和科斯理论对数据挖掘征收具有补偿目的的特殊税，以应对数据过度开采造成的负外部性，并主张资源收集国（来源国）对此类收入拥有合法征税权。
AI.research_question: 石油与数据的比较是否不仅适用于二者创造的财富，还适用于来源国对其收入进行合法征税？具体而言，数据挖掘是否应像石油开采一样被征收具有补偿目的的特殊税？
AI.motivation: 数字巨头通过数据挖掘创造了巨大财富，但数据过度开采对社区和领土产生负外部性，现有国际税收体系尚未充分解决来源国对数据收入的征税合法性问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 庇古税理论（Pigouvian theory）和科斯定理（Coasean theory），用于论证负外部性为特殊税提供正当性基础；同时借鉴自然资源（石油）的开采与税收比较框架。
AI.method: 比较分析方法，将石油开采与数据挖掘在经济转化过程、资源属性及负外部性方面进行平行比较，并结合税收理论进行规范性论证。
AI.findings: （1）石油和数据都是自然资源，过度开采均会产生负外部性；（2）负外部性为征收补偿性特殊税提供合法性依据；（3）数据收集国（来源国）对此类收入享有合法征税权；（4）该特殊税应独立于解决市场国征税权的一般性国际方案，且不宜作为规避税收协定的手段。
AI.theory_contributions: 将庇古和科斯理论引入数字经济税收领域，为数据挖掘的补偿性征税提供理论正当性；拓展了石油与数据比较的理论框架，从财富创造延伸至税收合法性维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数据收集国（尤其是发展中国家）对数字巨头数据收入征税提供政策依据；提出独立于国际税收改革方案的具体征税路径，并明确其不应成为规避税收协定的工具。

title: All Sizzle, No Steak? Do Macro Predictors and Sample Choices Improve Machine Learning Portfolio Performance?
affiliations: Roskilde University, Roskilde University, Roskilde University and Roskilde University

detail.title: All Sizzle, No Steak? Do Macro Predictors and Sample Choices Improve Machine Learning Portfolio Performance?
detail.abstract: Recent studies suggest that machine learning (ML) methods are useful to predict stock returns. Yet, it has been suggested that this usefulness relies on research design choices. Furthermore, few studies explore the specific usefulness of macro predictors in ML methods. Revisiting two representative models, the elastic net and neural network presented in recent seminal work, we compare alternative macro predictor specifications with no macro benchmarks, isolating the incremental predictive power of the macros over firm characteristics. Moreover, we show that most gains in risk-adjusted returns come from small and illiquid stocks and in older subsamples. Macro predictors only add marginally to the models. We also find weaker out-of-sample predictive signal after 2020, with generally decreasing market-relative Sharpe ratios and alphas over time. We finally observe a disconnect between predictor signal strength and forecasting importance. Moreover, once realistic restrictions are imposed, the performance gap between elastic net and neural network models shrinks considerably. Thus, sampling choices may matter more than model complexity for performance.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了机器学习方法在预测股票收益中的实用性，重点考察宏观预测因子在弹性网络和神经网络两种代表模型中的增量预测能力。研究发现宏观因子对模型的贡献有限，主要收益来自小盘和流动性差的股票及较早的样本区间。2020年之后样本外预测信号减弱，且预测因子信号强度与预测重要性之间存在脱节。在施加现实约束后，弹性网络和神经网络的性能差距显著缩小，表明采样选择可能比模型复杂度更重要。
AI.research_question: 机器学习方法预测股票收益的实用性是否依赖于研究设计选择？宏观预测因子在机器学习模型中是否具有增量预测能力？
AI.motivation: 近年研究表明机器学习方法对股票收益预测有用，但已有研究质疑这一有用性取决于研究设计选择。此外，很少有研究探讨宏观预测因子在机器学习方法中的具体作用，需要系统地隔离和评估宏观因子的增量预测贡献。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于弹性网络（elastic net）和神经网络（neural network）两种代表性机器学习模型，结合资产定价理论框架，考察宏观预测因子与公司特征变量的预测能力。
AI.method: 对比包含宏观预测因子的模型规格与不含宏观因子的基准模型，隔离宏观因子的增量预测能力；分析风险调整后收益在不同股票规模、流动性及时间子样本中的表现；评估2020年后样本外预测信号变化；比较弹性网络与神经网络在施加现实约束前后的性能差异。
AI.findings: （1）宏观预测因子对模型仅贡献边际增量；（2）风险调整后收益的大部分增益来自小盘和低流动性股票及较早样本区间；（3）2020年后样本外预测信号减弱，市场相对夏普比率和alpha随时间整体下降；（4）预测因子信号强度与预测重要性之间存在脱节；（5）施加现实限制后，弹性网络与神经网络性能差距显著缩小，采样选择比模型复杂度更重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对机器学习方法在资产定价中适用条件的理解，系统性地隔离并评估了宏观预测因子的增量价值，揭示了采样选择与模型选择对预测性能的相对重要性，为机器学习在金融预测领域的有效性边界提供了新的理论证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为量化投资策略中机器学习模型的设计提供了实践指导：宏观因子价值有限，应关注小盘和低流动性股票中的机会；需注意到2020年后预测信号衰减的现实；在模型选择上，简单的弹性网络在现实约束下可能与复杂神经网络性能相当，应优先关注数据采样策略。

title: AI Investment Is not an Accounting Variable: Evidence from Hyperscaler Disclosures

detail.title: AI Investment Is not an Accounting Variable: Evidence from Hyperscaler Disclosures
detail.abstract: U.S. financial statements contain no standardized "AI investment" line item, although market commentary routinely compares firms' AI spending. This paper studies the resulting measurement problem using 40 earnings events for Amazon, Alphabet, Meta, Microsoft, and Oracle from September 2024 through July 2026. Cash capital expenditure is observable in all 40 events; numeric forward capitalexpenditure guidance appears in 14, comparable same-target-year revisions in nine, and lease-liability balances in 32. Attribution is substantially less stable than the underlying numbers. The author positively attributes all 14 guidance events to AI-related investment, whereas a label-blind independent languagemodel recoding identifies positive support in nine. Exact grade agreement is 6 of 14 (42.9 percent; Cohen's kappa = 0.026), and high-versus-not-high agreement is 7 of 14 (50.0 percent; kappa = 0.109). The disagreement is reported as a human-model classification-stability diagnostic, not conventional human inter-coder reliability. The paper introduces an AI Investment Observability Lattice that separates recognition, attribution, horizon, and consolidation boundaries. A formal non-additivity result shows that cash flows, liability stocks, forecasts, and contractual schedules cannot be combined into a presentationinvariant scalar without explicit transformations to a common valuation date, allocation rule, and perimeter. No standardized event-level AI-specific payoff is observed. The evidence is descriptive and intensive rather than representative or causal.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了美国财务报表中缺乏标准化"AI投资"科目所导致的度量问题，通过对五大科技公司40个收益事件的分析，发现AI投资的归因判断远比底层数字本身更不稳定，并提出了一个"AI投资可观测性格子"来系统化分析该问题。
AI.research_question: 美国财务报表中不存在标准化的"AI投资"行项目，那么AI投资支出应如何在财务报告中进行度量和归因？
AI.motivation: 市场评论普遍比较各公司AI支出，但财务报表中并无标准化的"AI投资"科目，缺乏统一度量标准，导致AI投资的可观测性和可比性存在严重问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI投资可观测性格子（AI Investment Observability Lattice），区分识别（recognition）、归因（attribution）、时间跨度（horizon）和整合边界（consolidation boundaries）四个维度；以及一个形式化的不可加性分析框架。
AI.method: 对Amazon、Alphabet、Meta、Microsoft、Oracle五家公司从2024年9月到2026年7月的40个收益事件进行描述性分析，使用人工归因与标签盲法的独立语言模型编码进行对比，并引入Cohen's kappa检验分类稳定性。
AI.findings: 现金资本支出在40个事件中均可观测；14个事件有数字化的远期资本支出指引，9个有可比较的同目标年份修订，32个有租赁负债余额。作者将所有14个指引事件归因为AI相关投资，而标签盲法的语言模型仅在9个事件中找到正面支持。两者评级一致性极低（42.9%，kappa=0.026）。形式化的不可加性结果表明，现金流、负债存量、预测和合同时间表无法被整合为保持呈现不变性的标量。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AI投资可观测性格子这一新的分析框架；通过形式化不可加性结果证明现有财务数据无法直接整合为统一的AI投资度量指标。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了AI投资度量中人类判断与模型判断的显著不一致性，为投资者和分析师理解AI投资数据的局限性和不确定性提供了诊断性工具和警示。

title: Capitalized Productivity and the Dollar's Exorbitant Privilege: The Real Exchange Rate as an Asset Price

detail.title: Capitalized Productivity and the Dollar's Exorbitant Privilege: The Real Exchange Rate as an Asset Price

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is founder of Innovation Strategy Consulting LLC, whose service lines include quantitative-finance and macro-strategy advisory. All research, code, and numerical work were conducted by the author in a personal capacity; the views are the author's own and do not constitute investment advice. The author declares no other competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: We treat the real exchange rate as a forward-looking asset price, the present discounted value of expected future cross-country productivity differentials, rather than the price clearing a contemporaneous currency flow. A two-country model combines a Balassa-Samuelson real side with an asset-market condition; the rate solves forward to a present value of expected productivity, nesting Balassa-Samuelson and the Engel-West disconnect as limits of one discount factor. A productivity leader funds itself cheaply while its currency is strong, the textbook symptom of "exorbitant privilege"; here it is the rational capitalization of anticipated productivity, earned rather than exorbitant. On Penn World Table data for 22 economies, 1954-2019, productivity explains 58% of the cross-section of real exchange-rate levels, the series are cointegrated, the productivity gap forecasts future changes with R-squared rising to 0.36 at eight years, and US relative productivity explains 63% of the dollar's real premium, a measured convenience yield adding about ten points: the privilege is mostly earned, with a minority rent. The forecasting claim is held to modern predictive-inference standards. A pooled real-time out-of-sample race beats the random walk from three years out; conformal bands hold their promised coverage; an anytime-valid e-process ranks the anchor signals above every rival; and error-correction loadings make the exchange rate the adjusting variable, productivity the trend. All 231 cross pairs among the non-US economies, where everything dollar-specific differences out, reproduce the anchor (elasticity 0.37, R-squared 0.60). Mechanism tests agree: the pair-spread half-life doubles after 1999 for euro pairs only, the sectoral traded-minus-non-traded differential prices the rate and forecasts it, and across 126 unseen economies the ordering survives while the slope flattens off the frontier. Marshall-Lerner holds on the flow side; the trade balance forecasts nothing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将实际汇率视为前瞻性资产价格——即预期未来跨国生产率差异的折现值，而非清算当期货币流动的价格。通过结合巴拉萨-萨缪尔森实体面与资产市场条件的双国模型，将汇率向前求解为预期生产率的现值，并以贝塔-萨缪尔森和Engel-West脱钩作为折现因子的极限情形嵌套统一。实证研究发现生产率可解释58%的实际汇率水平截面差异，系列具有协整关系，生产率缺口对未来变化具有预测力，美国的相对生产率解释了其实际溢价的63%，即"过高的特权"大部分是赚来的而非租金。
AI.research_question: 实际汇率是否应被视为前瞻性资产价格（即预期未来生产率差异的折现值）而非当期货币流动的价格？生产率差异能否实质性地解释实际汇率水平、预测其变化，以及解释美元的"过高特权"现象？
AI.motivation: 传统的实际汇率分析将其视为清算当期货币流动的价格，而资产定价视角认为汇率是前瞻性资产价格。作者试图将贝塔-萨缪尔森的生产率视角与Engel-West的折现因子脱钩现象统一在一个理论框架内，并实证检验生产率假设对实际汇率水平解释力和预测力的实质贡献。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝塔-萨缪尔森模型（Balassa-Samuelson）作为实体面基础；Engel-West脱钩理论（作为折现因子的极限情形）；资产定价的前瞻性折现框架；购买力平价与利率平价等传统汇率理论作为对照。
AI.method: 两国内生模型推导（结合贝塔-萨缪尔森实体面与资产市场条件）；使用Penn World Table数据（22个经济体，1954-2019）进行实证分析；协整分析、误差修正模型、预测回归；池化实时样本外预测比赛（对抗随机游走）、符合覆盖率的保形区间、随时有效e过程；全231个非美国经济体跨境配对稳健性检验；机制检验（欧元区对半衰期变化、行业可贸易-不可贸易差异）及126个未知经济体的外推测试。
AI.findings: 生产率可解释22个经济体实际汇率水平跨截面差异的58%；系列存在协整关系；生产率缺口对汇率未来变化的预测力在8年时R²达到0.36；美国相对生产率解释美元实际溢价（约10个百分点的便利收益）的63%，即"特权"大多为挣得而非租金。预测能力在样本外比赛中从三年起击败随机游走；全231对非美国经济体跨境配对中，弹性为0.37、R²为0.60；欧元区配对在1999年后半衰期翻倍；贸易余额对汇率无预测力，Marshall-Lerner条件在流量侧成立。
AI.theory_contributions: 将贝塔-萨缪尔森生产率理论与Engel-West资产定价折现框架统一为单一嵌套模型，以折现因子为连续参数连接两个经典理论极限；重新概念化"过高特权"——将其解释为预期生产率的理性资本化（挣得）而非单纯的货币特权租金；将实际汇率分析从当期流量清算范式转向前瞻性资产定价视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实际汇率水平与变动提供了可操作的生产率基础预测框架；证实了美元溢价中约三分之二源于生产率优势而非纯粹特权租金；为汇率预测提供符合现代推断标准的实证方法（保形区间、随时有效e过程、实时样本外比赛）；为政策制定者理解汇率长期趋势与短期偏离提供了实证工具。

title:
Two basis Points.
India's Sovereign Green Bonds: Did Investors Actually Pay a Premium for Green?

detail.title:
Two basis Points.
India's Sovereign Green Bonds: Did Investors Actually Pay a Premium for Green?
detail.abstract:
Across seven auctions where a conventional Government of India comparator could be matched, India’s sovereign green bonds
priced an average of 2.0 basis points below the conventional curve. The programme has therefore lowered the government’s
borrowing cost, but by an amount worth roughly ₹29 crore a year against an interest bill of ₹9.28 lakh crore. The more
consequential finding is how that pricing was held: between May 2024 and June 2025 the Reserve Bank cancelled two green
auctions outright, truncated a third, and let two more devolve on primary dealers, leaving a ₹10,302.602 crore shortfall in the
year’s green borrowing.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了印度主权绿色债券的定价及其对政府借款成本的影响，发现绿色债券平均比常规债券低2.0个基点，每年节省约29亿卢比。但更重要的发现是，2024年5月至2025年6月期间，印度储备银行两次直接取消绿色债券拍卖、一次缩减拍卖规模、两次让拍卖在主要经销商处流标，导致当年绿色借款缺口达10,302.602亿卢比。
AI.research_question: 印度主权绿色债券的定价表现如何？其对政府借款成本有何影响？绿色债券拍卖机制的实际运作状况如何？
AI.motivation: 评估印度主权绿色债券项目作为可持续金融工具的实际效果，特别是其在降低政府借款成本方面是否有效，以及拍卖运作中出现的实际问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 绿色溢价理论、主权债券定价理论、拍卖机制理论
AI.method: 基于七次可比拍卖的实证对比分析，将印度主权绿色债券定价与常规政府债券曲线进行比较。
AI.findings: （1）印度主权绿色债券平均定价低于常规债券2.0个基点，每年节省约29亿卢比（相对于9.28万亿卢比的利息支出而言微不足道）；（2）更重要的发现是2024年5月至2025年6月间，印度储备银行两次取消绿色拍卖、一次缩减、两次流标，造成10,302.602亿卢比的绿色借款缺口。
AI.theory_contributions: 为绿色债券是否存在绿色溢价提供了来自新兴市场主权债券的证据，并揭示了绿色债券市场在拍卖实施层面面临的结构性挑战。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度及类似新兴市场的主权绿色债券设计提供了政策启示，指出需要关注绿色债券拍卖的可执行性和市场接受度，而不仅仅是定价层面的微薄收益。

title: From Rating Consumers to Rating Influencers: The Investor's Role in Corporate Loan Ratings
affiliations: and

detail.title: From Rating Consumers to Rating Influencers: The Investor's Role in Corporate Loan Ratings
detail.abstract: Credit ratings not only inform investors about default risk, but also serve as verifiable quality signals in asset management contracts, giving institutional investors a stake in the ratings. We show that when this stake is high, investors may influence rating outcomes to favor their portfolio positions and managerial compensation. Using a proprietary dataset of Collateralized Loan Obligations (CLOs), we examine the incentives of CLO managers to resist rating downgrades that could trigger overcollateralization test failures, which would reduce the managers' own payoffs. We find, and confirm using a novel instrumental variable, that loans facing greater resistance from CLO managers exhibit a significantly lower likelihood of downgrades in the near term. This effect is more pronounced when managers are above their incentive fee hurdles and when deteriorating loans are harder to liquidate preemptively. The delayed downgrades materialize as multi-notch downgrades within two to three years. Our results demonstrate that beyond fixed-income issuers, investors - typically viewed as rating consumers - can exert strategic influence on rating agencies.

AI.tldr: 本文利用CLO专有数据集，发现当机构投资者（CLO经理）在信用评级中有重大利益时，他们可能影响评级结果以维护自身投资组合和薪酬利益。面临CLO经理强烈抵抗的贷款在短期内被降级的概率显著更低，但这种延迟的降级最终会在2-3年内以多档降级的形式呈现。
AI.research_question: 机构投资者（而非仅固定收益发行人）是否以及如何对评级机构施加策略性影响，以延迟不利的信用评级下调？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为投资者是评级的消费者而非影响者，但信用评级在资产管理合同（如CLO）中可作为可验证的质量信号，使投资者对评级结果产生利益关联。当评级下调可能触发超额抵押测试失败并损害经理薪酬时，投资者就有动机影响评级结果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信用评级的信息功能与合同功能相结合的理论框架，涉及委托代理理论（CLO经理与投资者的代理关系）、评级捕获理论与评级机构激励结构。
AI.method: 使用CLO专有数据集进行实证分析，采用新颖的工具变量方法来解决内生性问题，验证CLO经理抵抗评级下调对贷款降级概率的影响。同时进行异质性分析（经理激励费门槛、贷款流动性）和动态分析（多档降级的时间分布）。
AI.findings: （1）面临CLO经理更强抵抗的贷款短期内被降级概率显著更低；（2）当经理超过激励费门槛时以及贷款难以提前清算时，该效应更显著；（3）延迟的降级在2-3年内以多档降级形式集中爆发。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了评级影响主体的理论框架，首次系统论证了投资者（评级消费者）而非仅发行人可对评级机构施加策略性影响，丰富了信用评级市场利益冲突与评级捕获理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 对投资者、监管者和评级机构具有重要启示：警示评级延迟降级可能导致的风险积累，为监管政策（如评级公正性、利益冲突披露）提供实证依据，也有助于市场参与者识别评级的潜在偏倚。

title: The New Forever Rule For Record Retention
affiliations: Texas Tech University School of Law

detail.title: The New Forever Rule For Record Retention

declarations.funderStatement: My salary.

detail.abstract:
In Murrin v. Commissioner the Third Circuit held that taxpayers cannot rely on the general three year period of limitations if anyone else is involved in preparing their tax return.  That is because §6501(c)(1) provides that “in the case of a false or fraudulent return with the intent to evade tax” the IRS has an unlimited time to assess.  Writes the Third Circuit: “the obvious construction of the statutory text is that the intent to evade tax must be present in a false or fraudulent return, irrespective of who possess that intent.” Thus, “whether a taxpayer, accountant, lawyer, or tax preparer evidenced such intent is beside the point.”  After Murrin, I must now advise taxpayers to keep their records forever, if anyone other than the taxpayer has participated in the preparation of the return. 

This article explains how Murrin has changed the law and why it means taxpayers can no longer predict if and when the IRS will audit a return they have filed with help from a third party.  They must keep their records....forever.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了第三巡回上诉法院在Murrin诉税务专员案中的裁决，该裁决改变了税法领域对《国内税收法典》第6501(c)(1)条的解释——即使纳税人本人无逃税意图，只要参与申报的任何第三方（如会计师、律师或税务准备人）存在虚假或欺诈申报的意图，纳税人的纳税评估时效即不受三年一般限制，国税局可无限期追缴税款。这意味着纳税人若借助第三方协助报税，必须无限期保存税务记录。
AI.research_question: Murrin案如何改变了税法中关于纳税评估时效的法律解释，以及第三方参与纳税申报对纳税人记录保存义务产生了何种影响？
AI.motivation: 第三巡回上诉法院在Murrin案中作出了突破性裁决，将第6501(c)(1)条中"逃税意图"的主体解释扩展为任何参与申报的人员，而非仅限于纳税人本人。这一法律变更使纳税人无法预测国税局何时审查其申报，对纳税人的合规义务产生了深远影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于《国内税收法典》第6501(c)(1)条的法定解释理论，该条款规定"存在虚假或欺诈申报且具有逃税意图"的情况下，国税局的评估不受三年时效限制。第三巡回法院采用文本主义解释方法，将"逃税意图"视为申报文件本身的属性，而非特定主体的主观状态。
AI.method: 案例分析法，通过对Murrin诉税务专员案的司法裁决进行法律文本解读与法理分析，探讨其对现有法律框架的修改及其对纳税人合规实践的影响。
AI.findings: Murrin案确立的规则是：只要纳税申报表中存在逃税意图（无论该意图来自纳税人本人还是任何第三方参与者），国税局即可无限期追缴税款。这意味着如果纳税人聘请了会计师、律师或其他税务专业人员协助报税，且这些第三方存在任何欺诈意图，纳税人将失去三年时效保障，必须无限期保存税务记录以备审查。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文对税法中法定时效条款的解释理论作出了重要分析贡献，揭示了文本主义解释方法在税务诉讼中的具体运用及其对纳税人权利保护的影响，扩展了对"虚假或欺诈申报"概念的理解边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为税务从业者和纳税人提供了明确的操作指引：在涉及第三方协助报税的情况下，应无限期保存所有税务记录以防范潜在的无限期税务审查风险；同时提醒税务专业人士注意其参与申报行为可能为纳税人带来的额外法律风险。

title: TikTok Triage, Disclaimers, and the Reasonable Follower: A Unified Framework for Medical Influencer Liability
affiliations: and

detail.title: TikTok Triage, Disclaimers, and the Reasonable Follower: A Unified Framework for Medical Influencer Liability

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.funderStatement: None.

detail.abstract: Credentialed healthcare influencers on social media often provide services functionally indistinguishable from clinical care. Yet they escape malpractice liability because no formal physician-patient relationship was ever established. This Article argues that current doctrine errs in permitting this outcome. Fowler, Helveston, and Robinson's landmark Influencer Speech-Torts framework establishes that health influencers can face negligence liability, but it operates in general negligence rather than medical malpractice, leaving the physician-patient relationship formation question unaddressed. Nor does it analyze the interactive engagement tier of comment replies, direct messages, monetized livestreams, and paid subscriber communities as a distinct doctrinal problem. This Article fills these gaps and extends the framework to cover two further questions: whether the "not medical advice" disclaimer defeats liability, and how courts should assess foreseeability of reliance harm in the broadcast tier where most health influencing occurs. Drawing on the foreseeability standard of Warren v. Dinter, the undertaking doctrine of Restatement (Second) of Torts § 323, and the Physician Payments Sunshine Act, this Article proposes three doctrinal tools: the undertaking-by-interaction standard, the reliance-limitation test, and the reasonable follower standard. Parasocial relationship theory and the positive law of telemedicine supply the supporting framework. Together, these tools address the full spectrum of medical influencer liability, from interactive malpractice to broadcast negligence.

AI.tldr: 本文主张，在社交媒体上提供与临床诊疗功能无异的服务却因缺乏正式医患关系而逃避医疗事故责任的认证医疗网红，应承担法律责任。文章在Fowler等学者提出的Influencer Speech-Torts框架基础上进行延伸，填补了该框架未处理医患关系形成及互动层级（评论回复、私信、付费直播、订阅社区）问题的空白，并提出三项教义工具（互动式承担标准、信赖限制测试、合理粉丝标准）以全面覆盖医疗网红责任范围——从互动性医疗事故到广播性过失。
AI.research_question: 认证医疗网红在社交媒体上提供与临床治疗功能无异的服务时，因未建立正式医患关系而逃避医疗事故责任，这一法律漏洞应如何通过教义工具加以填补？
AI.motivation: 医疗网红提供的服务在功能上与临床诊疗难以区分，但现行法理因缺乏正式医患关系而允许其逃避医疗事故责任，这造成了明显的法律漏洞和责任分配的严重不公。
AI.theoretical_framework: Fowler、Helveston和Robinson的Influencer Speech-Torts框架、Warren v. Dinter案中的可预见性标准、《侵权法重述（第二版）》第323条的承担义务原则、《医师报酬阳光法案》、准社会关系理论与远程医疗实证法。
AI.method: 法律教义分析与理论延伸，在既有Influencer Speech-Torts框架基础上扩展至互动层级和广播层级，结合判例法、侵权法重述和制定法提出新型法律标准。
AI.findings: 本文提出三项教义工具：一是"互动式承担标准"（undertaking-by-interaction standard），依据§ 323认定通过互动建立责任；二是"信赖限制测试"（reliance-limitation test），评估免责声明是否能否定信赖；三是"合理粉丝标准"（reasonable follower standard），用于评估广播层级中可预见性的信赖损害。这三项工具共同覆盖从互动性医疗事故到广播性过失的完整责任谱系。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文填补了Influencer Speech-Torts框架的两大空白：一是未解决医患关系形成问题，二是未将互动层级（评论回复、私信、付费直播、订阅社区）作为独立教义问题分析。同时拓展该框架至免责声明有效性和广播层级可预见性评估两个新问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法院审理医疗网红责任案件提供了具体可操作的判定标准，涵盖互动性与广播性两大责任类型；为立法者和监管者完善医疗网红执业规范提供了教义基础，同时对"非医疗建议"免责声明的司法效力给出明确指引。

title: Equilibrium Existence in Wolinsky (1986)
affiliations: Shandong University

detail.title: Equilibrium Existence in Wolinsky (1986)
detail.abstract: This paper revisits the consumer search and price competition model of Wolinsky (1986). Suppose that the market has a finite number of firms, match values between firms and consumers have log-concave densities, the reservation match value lies in the interior of the support, and the outside option is sufficiently low to induce active search. This paper proves that there is a unique symmetric equilibrium in pure strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了Wolinsky（1986）的消费者搜索与价格竞争模型，在有限企业数量、匹配值服从对数凹密度、保留匹配值在支撑内部且外部选项足够低以激励主动搜索的条件下，证明了纯策略对称均衡的唯一性。
AI.research_question: 在Wolinsky（1986）消费者搜索与价格竞争模型中，纯策略对称均衡是否唯一存在？其成立的条件是什么？
AI.motivation: Wolinsky（1986）的经典模型在消费者搜索与价格竞争领域具有基础性地位，但均衡的唯一性此前尚未得到严格证明。本文旨在填补这一理论空白，为后续研究者提供坚实的理论基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: Wolinsky（1986）消费者搜索与价格竞争模型；匹配值分布的对数凹性假设；保留匹配值（reservation match value）理论；均衡存在性与唯一性的博弈论分析框架。
AI.method: 数学证明方法，通过对数凹密度函数的性质分析、保留匹配值的内部支撑假设以及外部选项约束，构建并证明纯策略对称均衡的唯一性定理。
AI.findings: 在有限企业数量、匹配值服从对数凹密度、保留匹配值位于支撑内部且外部选项足够低的条件下，该模型中存在唯一的纯策略对称均衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次严格证明了Wolinsky（1986）消费者搜索与价格竞争模型中纯策略对称均衡的唯一性，明确了均衡唯一存在所需的具体条件，完善了该经典模型的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者使用Wolinsky模型进行消费者搜索和价格竞争相关的实证分析或政策评估时提供了理论保障，确保在该条件下模型的均衡预测是确定且可靠的。

title: State AI Governance under Constitutional Constraint: An Architecture for Deployer-centered, Process-based AI Accountability Designed to Survive Dormant Commerce Clause and Preemption Scrutiny

detail.title: State AI Governance under Constitutional Constraint: An Architecture for Deployer-centered, Process-based AI Accountability Designed to Survive Dormant Commerce Clause and Preemption Scrutiny

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing personal or financial interests. AI-use disclosure: Artificial intelligence tools were used to support the research for this Article: locating and retrieving primary legal sources, organizing and verifying the evidence base, and assisting with drafting and formatting. The ideas, analytical framework, arguments, insights, and conclusions are the original work of the author. AI-assisted output, including cited authorities and quotations, was reviewed and verified against primary sources before use under the author's direction. Generative AI output may contain unintended errors. A fuller note on method appears in the Article's front matter.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
Federal AI policy has remade itself three times in twenty-six months. An executive order built on safety commitments gave way to one built on removing them; a preemption-minded successor now directs the Justice Department to litigate against state AI statutes while conceding, in its own carve-outs, that whole domains of state authority will remain. States told to wait for stable federal ground are waiting for ground that is not coming.
This Article argues that the constitutional doctrines usually framed as obstacles to state AI regulation, the dormant Commerce Clause and federal preemption, are better understood as design inputs that select a particular regulatory architecture. States should not regulate AI as a technology category. They should regulate the AI-mediated decision environments inside domains they already control (employment, housing, insurance, healthcare, education, public benefits, criminal justice) by imposing process-based obligations on deployers and anchoring those obligations in authorities the federal political branches have not displaced and could not displace in one stroke without unraveling multiple foundational federal-state settlements: consumer protection, civil rights enforcement, sector licensing, and public procurement.
The Article makes three contributions. First, a constitutional design move: it derives the deployer-centered architecture from the doctrine itself, showing why model-centric statutes draw extraterritoriality and obstacle-preemption fire that decision-environment statutes largely avoid. Second, a concept: regulatory resilience, durability achieved through enduring authorities rather than preemption-proofing. Third, a translation: it translates the NIST AI Risk Management Framework and ISO/IEC 42001 from voluntary management constructs into legally cognizable deployer duties, with worked statutory text for four governance primitives (procurement-first controls, deployer-centered impact assessments, audit-trail mandates, and dispute-and-remedy pathways) and worked sector applications for hospital AI, hiring AI, and insurance underwriting AI.

AI.tldr: 本文主张各州不应将AI作为技术类别进行监管，而应在其已控制领域（就业、住房、保险、医疗、教育、公共福利、刑事司法）内监管AI中介的决策环境，通过对部署者施加基于流程的义务来实现。作者从宪法学说（休眠商业条款和联邦优先权）中推导出以部署者为中心的监管架构，提出"监管韧性"概念，并将NIST AI风险管理框架和ISO/IEC 42001转化为具有法律效力的部署者义务。
AI.research_question: 在联邦AI政策反复变动且不稳定（26个月内三次重塑）的背景下，各州应如何设计AI监管架构，才能既符合宪法约束又具有持久效力？
AI.motivation: 联邦AI政策在26个月内三次重塑，从基于安全承诺的行政令转向移除承诺，进而转向预先占有的行政令——指示司法部起诉各州AI法规，但又在豁免条款中承认各州权力领域将保留。各州被要求等待稳定的联邦基础，但等待的地面不会到来。因此需要为各州提供可持续的AI监管设计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 休眠商业条款（Dormant Commerce Clause）、联邦优先权（Federal Preemption）、宪法设计理论、监管韧性（Regulatory Resilience）概念
AI.method: 法律-宪法分析：从宪法学说（休眠商业条款和联邦优先权）推导监管架构；将NIST AI风险管理框架和ISO/IEC 42001从自愿管理工具转化为法律认知的部署者义务；提供四项治理原语的成文法规文本及三个行业的应用分析（医院AI、招聘AI、保险核保AI）。
AI.findings: 1）以模型为中心的法规会招致域外适用和障碍优先权的攻击，而以决策环境为中心的法规在很大程度上可以避免这些攻击；2）各州应通过消费保护、民权执法、行业许可和公共采购等持久权力来源监管AI，而非试图预先排除联邦优先；3）NIST和ISO框架可以转化为法律上可认知的部署者义务。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）宪法设计论证：证明以部署者为中心的架构本身源自宪法学说；2）提出"监管韧性"概念——通过持久权力而非排除优先权实现的持久性；3）将国际/国家标准转化为法律义务的翻译机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为各州提供具体的监管设计蓝图：四项治理原语（采购优先控制、以部署者为中心的影响评估、审计追踪义务、争议与救济途径）的成文法规文本，以及医院AI、招聘AI、保险核保AI三个具体行业的应用方案。

title: An Explainable Machine Learning Analysis of Retail Renewable Premiums
affiliations: Ohio State University (OSU), Ohio State University (OSU), John Glenn College of Public Affairs, Ohio State University (OSU), Ohio State University (OSU), Exeter Associates, Lehigh University and Lehigh University

detail.title: An Explainable Machine Learning Analysis of Retail Renewable Premiums
detail.abstract: Estimating the supplier's margin on retail renewable energy is persistently challenging. 14 U.S. states and several international jurisdictions have implemented retail restructuring (i.e., 'retail choice') through which consumers can shop for electricity supply from marketers. These marketers often offer plans with varying compositions of renewable energy supplied by renewable energy certificates (RECs). This study quantifies the renewable energy margin on residential electricity offers using comprehensive data from Ohio's retail choice market (2014-2023). We develop an algorithm that matches renewable and non-renewable offers by the same supplier on the same day, with virtually identical offer details (e.g., maturity, monthly fee, termination fee) over 120,000 matched contracts. Using a gradient boosting model with SHAP (Shapley Additive Explanations), we estimate the influence of contract features and wholesale market conditions (e.g., forward hub prices) on the renewable energy margin of renewable offers. On average, renewable contracts include a markup of 7.67% (price difference of 0.642 cents/kWh). However, results also indicate that longer contract maturities and higher early termination fees are associated with lower renewable energy premiums, suggesting that renewable premiums vary systematically across contract structures. Importantly, we find robust empirical evidence for the presence of a trigger price: when forward wholesale energy prices are below $47.9/MWh, marketers obtain renewable energy premiums through higher marginal prices. Above this trigger, marketers no longer obtain a higher premium on renewable offers and instead manipulate maturities and early termination fees. Policy implications for market design and societal environmental objectives are presented.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用俄亥俄州零售选择市场2014-2023年的综合数据，通过匹配同一供应商同一天提供的可再生与非可再生电力合约（超过12万份合约），使用梯度提升模型结合SHAP方法，量化了居民零售电力中可再生能源的溢价。研究发现可再生合约平均加价7.67%（0.642美分/kWh），但溢价随合约期限和提前终止费变化，并发现存在触发价格（$47.9/MWh），低于此价格时营销商通过高价获取可再生能源溢价，高于此价格时则通过操纵合约条款获取收益。
AI.research_question: 如何量化美国零售选择市场中居民电力合约的可再生能源溢价，以及该溢价如何受合约特征和批发市场条件的影响？
AI.motivation: 估算零售可再生能源供应商的利润空间一直具有挑战性，而理解这部分溢价对市场设计和环境政策制定至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 零售选择（Retail Choice）理论、可再生能源证书（RECs）机制、触发价格理论
AI.method: 开发匹配算法将同一供应商同一天提供的可再生与非可再生合约进行配对（超过12万份匹配合约），使用梯度提升模型（Gradient Boosting）结合SHAP（Shapley Additive Explanations）方法分析合约特征和批发市场条件对可再生能源溢价的影响。
AI.findings: （1）可再生能源合约平均加价7.67%（价格差0.642美分/kWh）；（2）较长合约期限和较高提前终止费与较低的可再生能源溢价相关；（3）存在触发价格阈值$47.9/MWh：低于此价格时营销商通过更高边际价格获取可再生能源溢价，高于此价格时则转而操纵合约期限和提前终止费。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地量化了零售选择市场中可再生能源溢价，发现了可再生能源溢价的触发价格机制，揭示了营销商在不同批发价格环境下调整定价策略的行为规律。
AI.practical_contributions: 为市场设计者和政策制定者提供了关于零售电力市场定价机制的实证证据，有助于理解消费者支付的可再生能源溢价结构，并为环境政策与市场监管提供参考。

title: Execution-Verified Scientific Reasoning for Autonomous Finite-Element Solver Synthesis with Domain-Adapted Large Language Models
affiliations: and University of Maryland at Baltimore County

detail.title: Execution-Verified Scientific Reasoning for Autonomous Finite-Element Solver Synthesis with Domain-Adapted Large Language Models
detail.abstract: Partial differential equation (PDE)-based simulation is central to engineering analysis and design, yet constructing reliable finite element method (FEM) solvers from high-level physical descriptions remains labor intensive. This workflow requires physical interpretation, governing-equation formulation, weak-form derivation, numerical discretization, implementation, and runtime validation; an error at any stage can produce code that appears plausible but represents an incorrect or non-executable model. This paper presents an execution-verified framework for autonomous PDE-to-FEM solver synthesis using domain-adapted large language models (LLMs). The framework formulates solver synthesis as a structured reasoning process linking physical-semantic parsing, operator-level PDE assembly, boundary and initialcondition specification, variational formulation, finite-element discretization, executable FEniCSx/Gmsh code generation, and runtime verification. An execution-verified synthetic data factory generates reasoningto-code trajectories and a physics-aware correction corpus, enabling a compact 2-billion-parameter opensource model to learn relationships among physical assumptions, numerical formulation, solver implementation, and execution outcome. Evaluation on 75 unseen PDE problems across canonical, intermediate, and complex tiers shows that the adapted model achieves 100.0%, 93.3%, and 60.0% execution success, respectively, and obtains the strongest weighted ReasoningScore, SpecScore, execution rate, and RuntimeQualityScore among all baselines under a single-pass, no-repair protocol. These results show that reliable AI-assisted physics-based simulation depends not only on model scale, but also on structured domain supervision and execution-based validation. This work contributes a structured, execution-verified reasoning-supervision method for LLMs, applied here to automate FEM solver generation for PDE-based engineering simulations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于领域自适应大语言模型的执行验证框架，用于自动从物理描述生成经过验证的有限元法（FEM）求解器。该框架将PDE到FEM求解器的合成建模为结构化推理过程，并通过执行验证的合成数据工厂训练一个20亿参数的紧凑开源模型，在75个未见过的PDE问题上实现了显著优于基线的执行成功率。
AI.research_question: 如何利用大语言模型自动、可靠地将高层物理描述转化为可执行且经过验证的有限元法（FEM）求解器代码？
AI.motivation: 基于PDE的仿真在工程分析和设计中至关重要，但从高层物理描述构建可靠的FEM求解器极为耗时费力，流程中任一环节出错都可能导致看似合理但实际错误或不可执行的代码。现有工作缺乏结构化的推理监督和执行验证机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构化推理过程框架（物理语义解析、算子级PDE组装、边界/初始条件指定、变分公式化、有限元离散化、可执行FEniCSx/Gmsh代码生成、运行时验证）以及执行验证的合成数据生成方法。
AI.method: 提出执行验证的PDE到FEM求解器合成框架：(1) 将求解器合成建模为结构化多阶段推理流程；(2) 构建执行验证的合成数据工厂，生成推理到代码的轨迹和物理感知纠错语料库；(3) 使用领域自适应训练一个20亿参数的紧凑开源LLM；(4) 在75个未见过的PDE问题（规范、中级、复杂三档）上进行单次通过、无修复协议评估。
AI.findings: 该模型在规范、中级和复杂三档任务上分别达到100.0%、93.3%和60.0%的执行成功率，并在所有基线中取得最强的加权ReasoningScore、SpecScore、执行率和RuntimeQualityScore。结果表明可靠的AI辅助物理仿真不仅依赖模型规模，更依赖结构化领域监督和执行验证。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种结构化、执行验证的推理监督方法用于LLM，证明了紧凑模型通过领域适配和基于执行结果的验证训练可以在特定工程任务上超越更大规模的通用模型，深化了对LLM在科学计算领域能力边界与提升路径的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为工程仿真领域提供了自动化、可靠的PDE到FEM求解器生成方案，大幅降低手动编写有限元求解器的人力成本，提升了仿真建模的效率和可靠性，具有直接工程应用价值。

title: Bridges and Gaps: Operationalizing EU-CPTPP Cooperation

detail.title: Bridges and Gaps: Operationalizing EU-CPTPP Cooperation
detail.abstract: This note explores how the 39 members of the Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership (CPTPP) and the European Union (EU) can move towards a more structured relationship given their mutual interests in preserving rules-based trade as "middle powers" in geopolitical terms and as "small open economies" in economic terms, at a time of "rupture" in the international political and economic system. The note is premised on four propositions. measures such as cumulation in rules of origin to promote a deepening of mutual trade on a WTO-consistent basis. • Fourth, use the review of the CPTPP digital economy chapter to fill the gap in the WTO framework for the digital economy; this will involve parsing "electronic transmissions" into GATT-governed digital products that are "like" goods; GATS-governed digital products that are "like" services; and data, whose value is explicitly captured in trade accounts and reflected in estimated trade balances, with measures that enable sovereignty in governance of the digital economy. Ultimately, the EU-CPTPP "bridge" can promote the development of a market with the scale to compete with China and the United States while retaining the perspectives and values of small open economies.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了CPTPP（全面与进步跨太平洋伙伴关系协定）的39个成员与欧盟如何建立更结构化的关系，以应对国际政治经济体系的"断裂"时期。文章提出四项主张，包括利用原产地规则累积、审查CPTPP数字经济章节并解析"电子传输"概念等，最终构建欧盟-CPTPP"桥梁"以形成具有规模竞争力且保留小开放经济体价值观的市场。
AI.research_question: 在当今国际政治经济体系"断裂"的时代背景下，CPTPP与欧盟这两大"中等强国"和"小型开放经济体"集团如何建立更结构化的关系以维护基于规则的多边贸易体系？
AI.motivation: 国际政治经济体系正经历"断裂"（rupture），中美竞争格局下，CPTPP成员与欧盟作为"中等强国"和"小型开放经济体"，在维护基于规则的贸易方面具有共同利益，但两者之间缺乏结构化的制度连接机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于"中等强国"地缘政治理论和"小型开放经济体"经济理论，结合WTO框架下的贸易规则理论（GATT/GATS分类），以及数字经济治理理论。
AI.method: 政策分析笔记（policy note），基于四项命题进行规范性论证和分析，包括原产地规则累积机制、WTO一致性基础上的贸易深化，以及对CPTPP数字经济章节的审查。
AI.findings: 提出四项核心主张：（1）利用原产地规则中的累积措施在WTO一致基础上促进相互贸易深化；（2）通过审查CPTPP数字经济章节来填补WTO数字经济框架的空白；（3）将"电子传输"解析为GATT管辖的"类似货物"的数字产品、GATS管辖的"类似服务"的数字产品，以及数据三类；（4）通过数据治理主权措施反映数字贸易价值。最终形成欧盟-CPTPP"桥梁"以构建足以与中国和美国竞争的市场规模，同时保留小型开放经济体的视角和价值观。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将"电子传输"概念细分为GATT管辖的数字产品、GATS管辖的数字服务和数据三个维度的分析框架，为WTO数字经济治理提供了新的理论解析路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为CPTPP与欧盟构建结构化关系提供了具体政策路径，包括原产地规则累积机制和数字经济章节审查方案，有助于两大贸易集团形成对抗中美规模的竞争性市场规模，同时维护小开放经济体的制度性利益。

title: The Variance Risk Premium: Model-Free Measurement, Term Structure, and the Economics of Selling Volatility

detail.title: The Variance Risk Premium: Model-Free Measurement, Term Structure, and the Economics of Selling Volatility
detail.abstract: Option-implied variance on the S&P 500 tends to run higher than the variance that ends up realized. In this paper, we derive the model-free measurement apparatus underlying that fact from first principles. The derivation starts with log-contract replication of realized variance via Itô's lemma. We then prove the Carr-Madan spanning identity. Finally, we build the exact discretization bridge to the CBOE's VIX formula. We then measure the resulting variance risk premium over 22 years of daily S&P 500 and VIX data (2004-2026). To do this, we use a forward-window realized-variance convention argued to be the only construction consistent with the premium's economic meaning. The premium averages approximately 3.5 volatility points. It is positive on 84% of sample days, and has a left-skewed distribution (skewness-7 in variance units). Additionally, its sign inverts during the global financial crisis, though not in every crisis regime in the sample. A VIX futures term structure built over 2007-2026 shows contango on 82% of days. It mirrors the same premium from a second instrument. A short-volatility strategy constructed from that curve illustrates the premium's economic payoff profile which is steady accumulated gains punctuated by catastrophic single-day losses. Section 6 relates these findings to a companion paper on rough volatility. It draws the line between what path roughness explains about this premium and what it leaves untouched.

AI.tldr: 本文从第一性原理推导出期权隐含方差与已实现方差之差（方差风险溢价）的完整测量框架，基于22年（2004-2026）标普500和VIX日度数据，发现方差风险溢价平均约3.5个波动率点，84%的样本日为正，呈左偏分布，并在全球金融危机期间发生符号反转。通过VIX期货期限结构（2007-2026）验证了同样的溢价特征，短期做空波动率策略呈现"稳定累积收益+偶发灾难性单日损失"的收益特征。
AI.research_question: 如何从第一性原理出发构建S&P 500期权隐含方差与已实现方差之间差异（方差风险溢价）的无模型测量框架，并系统量化其22年间的统计特征与经济含义？
AI.motivation: 方差风险溢价是资产定价的核心议题之一，但现有测量方法缺乏从第一性原理出发的系统推导。作者旨在通过严格数学推导建立完整的测量体系，并利用长样本数据（2004-2026）量化该溢价的统计特征及其在不同危机情境下的表现，从而为理解风险补偿和波动率策略提供坚实基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: Itô引理（对数合约复制已实现方差）、Carr-Madan跨期恒等式（spanning identity）、CBOE VIX公式的精确离散化桥接、远期窗口已实现方差约定
AI.method: 采用推导+实证的混合方法。首先从Itô引理出发推导对数合约复制已实现方差，证明Carr-Madan跨期恒等式，构建到VIX公式的精确离散化桥梁；然后在22年S&P 500和VIX日度数据上，使用远期窗口已实现方差约定测量方差风险溢价，并通过VIX期货期限结构进行交叉验证；最后构建短期做空波动率策略展示其经济收益特征。
AI.findings: （1）方差风险溢价平均约3.5个波动率点；（2）84%的样本日溢价为正；（3）溢价呈左偏分布（方差单位下偏度-7）；（4）在全球金融危机期间符号反转，但并非所有危机制度都出现反转；（5）VIX期货期限结构82%的日呈现升水（contango），与方差风险溢价形成交叉验证；（6）做空波动率策略表现出"稳定累积收益+偶发灾难性单日损失"的收益剖面。
AI.theory_contributions: 从第一性原理（Itô引理、Carr-Madan恒等式、VIX公式离散化）系统推导出方差风险溢价测量的完整理论链条，并论证远期窗口已实现方差约定是唯一与该溢价经济含义一致的构造，为后续研究提供了严谨的测量基础。同时将发现与粗糙波动率（rough volatility）伴生论文建立联系，界定了路径粗糙性对该溢价的解释边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了方差风险溢价的长样本统计画像（幅度、频率、分布形态、危机表现），通过VIX期货期限结构验证了该溢价的稳健性，为做空波动率策略的收益-风险特征提供了22年实证依据（稳定正收益但伴灾难性尾部损失），帮助风险管理者理解波动率风险暴露的真实代价。

title: Is Botswana Working for All Batswana? From Industrial Development to Inclusive Participation in a Changing Economy
affiliations: Regional Integration & Trade Governance Professional

detail.title: Is Botswana Working for All Batswana? From Industrial Development to Inclusive Participation in a Changing Economy
detail.abstract: For six decades, the Republic of Botswana has stood as an exemplary paradigm of African development, transitioning from one of the poorest protectorates in 1966 to an upper-middle-income country. This trajectory was constructed upon a highly institutionalized developmental state model, prudent mineral rent management, macroeconomic stability, and substantial social investments. However, as the nation enters its seventh decade, this mineral-dependent, capital-intensive growth model has reached its structural limits. Despite the high gross domestic product (GDP) per capita, structural inequalities remain deeply entrenched. Women, youth and persons with disabilities (PWDs) continue to face systemic exclusion and uneven integration into Botswana's socioeconomic and political architecture. This paper presents a systematic policy coherence audit of Botswana's major developmental strategies, demonstrating that existing policy instruments have generated transactional programmes rather than transformative participation. With the contemporary structural decline in global diamond markets acting as an economic accelerant of inequality, Botswana faces an urgent structural crossroads. The paper argues that the convergence of domestic policy reform and emerging continental frameworks, particularly the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA) presents a historic opportunity to shift from growth-centered to inclusive development. To operationalize this transition, we introduce an Inclusive Industrial Transformation Framework (IITF) designed to move beyond distributive welfare toward a capability-enhancing, co-creative economy that guarantees sustainable, democratic participation for all Batswana by 2066.

AI.tldr: 本文对博茨瓦纳的发展战略进行了系统性政策一致性审计，指出其以矿产依赖和资本密集型为基础的增长模式已触及结构性极限，尽管GDP人均水平高但结构性不平等根深蒂固。文章提出"包容性产业转型框架"（IITF），主张利用国内政策改革与非洲大陆自由贸易区（AfCFTA）的融合机遇，从增长中心型转向包容性发展，确保到2066年所有博茨瓦纳人获得可持续的民主参与。
AI.research_question: 博茨瓦纳现有的发展政策工具为何未能实现妇女、青年和残障人士的变革性包容参与？如何通过政策改革与非洲大陆框架（尤其是AfCFTA）的协同，推动从增长中心型向包容性发展的结构性转型？
AI.motivation: 博茨瓦纳虽被誉为非洲发展的典范，但六十年后其矿产依赖、资本密集型增长模式已达到结构性极限，全球钻石市场衰退加剧了不平等。现有政策工具仅产生交易性方案而非变革性参与，亟需探索一条超越分配性福利、通向能力增强型共创经济的转型路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 发展型国家理论、政策一致性审计框架、包容性发展理论、能力方法（capability approach）、结构性转型理论
AI.method: 系统性的政策一致性审计（policy coherence audit），对博茨瓦纳主要发展战略进行定性与比较分析，并结合非洲大陆自由贸易区等大陆框架进行制度与政策的融合分析。
AI.findings: 博茨瓦纳现有政策工具产生了交易性方案而非变革性参与；妇女、青年和残障人士在经济社会政治架构中面临系统性排斥与不均衡融入；全球钻石市场结构性衰退成为不平等的经济加速器；国内政策改革与AfCFTA等大陆框架的融合提供了历史性转型机遇。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"包容性产业转型框架"（IITF），将包容性发展与产业转型理论相结合，超越了传统的分配性福利范式，构建了能力增强型、共创型经济的分析框架，为资源依赖型国家的发展转型提供了新的理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为博茨瓦纳及类似资源依赖型非洲国家提供了政策一致性审计的方法论工具和IITF操作化框架，为利用AfCFTA机遇实现包容性发展提供了可落地的政策路径指引，助力实现到2066年所有公民可持续民主参与的目标。

title: On the Macroeconomic Dynamics of the Circular Economy: A Stock-Flow Consistent Model
affiliations: and Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile

detail.title: On the Macroeconomic Dynamics of the Circular Economy: A Stock-Flow Consistent Model
detail.abstract: This paper develops a dynamic ecological-macroeconomic model of the circular economy that integrates the core strategies of reducing, reusing, and recycling within a unified intertemporal framework. The model treats produced capital, available material stocks, waste liabilities, and dissipated residuals as physically interconnected stocks subject to material-balance constraints. Its central contribution is to show how capital depreciation, when interpreted as deferred residual generation rather than only as a loss of productive services, changes the optimal growth problem. Two macroeconomic mechanisms emerge from the analysis: a circular capital discount, reflecting the shadow cost of future residuals embodied in current investment, and a wasteliability drag, through which depreciation-related and production-related residuals lower the effective intertemporal return to capital and reduce sustainable consumption relative to a linear benchmark. We show analytically that these mechanisms imply a liability-adjusted golden rule of capital accumulation and a lower socially optimal steady-state capital stock than in the standard neoclassical model. The paper also maps the planner's allocation into a decentralized system of circular Pigouvian incentives, derives a circularly adjusted accounting identity for comprehensive wealth, and provides calibrated transition exercises showing how Reduce, Reuse, and Recycle operate through distinct macroeconomic channels. The results suggest that circular strategies reshape growth not by eliminating intertemporal trade-offs, but by changing the shadow valuation of capital accumulation, residual generation, and material recovery.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个将减量化、再利用和再循环策略整合到统一跨期框架中的动态生态-宏观经济循环经济模型，通过将资本折旧解释为延迟的残余物产生而非仅是生产性服务损失，揭示了两个宏观经济机制——循环资本贴现和废物负债拖累效应，并推导出负债调整后的黄金法则和低于新古典模型的稳态资本存量。
AI.research_question: 资本折旧作为延迟的残余物产生如何改变最优增长问题？循环经济策略（减量化、再利用、再循环）如何通过不同的宏观经济渠道重塑增长路径？
AI.motivation: 现有循环经济模型缺乏统一的跨期框架来分析Reduce、Reuse、Recycle三大核心策略，且忽视了资本折旧与残余物产生之间的物理联系对最优增长问题的根本性影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态生态-宏观经济模型（dynamic ecological-macroeconomic model）；材料平衡约束（material-balance constraints）；新古典增长理论的扩展；最优控制理论；庇古税/激励理论
AI.method: 理论建模与解析推导，结合校准后的转型动态模拟（calibrated transition exercises）。模型将生产资本、可用材料存量、废物负债和耗散残余物作为在材料平衡约束下物理互联的存量处理。
AI.findings: （1）识别出两个宏观经济机制：循环资本贴现（反映当前投资中蕴含的未来残余物的影子成本）和废物负债拖累（通过折旧相关和生产相关的残余物降低资本的有效跨期回报，相对于线性基准降低可持续消费）；（2）推导出负债调整的黄金法则，社会最优稳态资本存量低于标准新古典模型；（3）将规划者的配置映射为去中心化的循环庇古激励体系；（4）推导出综合财富的循环调整会计恒等式。校准结果表明Reduce、Reuse和Recycle通过不同的宏观经济渠道运作。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次将资本折旧重新解释为延迟的残余物产生，改变了标准最优增长问题的设定；（2）提出循环资本贴现和废物负债拖累两个新机制，拓展了新古典增长理论；（3）推导出负债调整的黄金法则，为循环经济提供了新的理论基准；（4）将循环策略映射到庇古激励体系，桥接了生态经济学和宏观经济学的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为政策制定者提供了循环经济下最优资本积累的指导原则；（2）提供了去中心化的循环庇古激励设计框架，可用于实施循环经济政策；（3）提供了循环调整的综合财富会计恒等式，改善国民财富核算；（4）通过校准转型练习，阐明Reduce、Reuse、Recycle各自独立的经济传导渠道，有助于针对性地制定差异化政策。

title: Performance Is Not Value Creation: A Capital-Aware Framework for Evaluating Hedge Fund Managers
affiliations: Pernas Research

detail.title: Performance Is Not Value Creation: A Capital-Aware Framework for Evaluating Hedge Fund Managers
detail.abstract:
The hedge fund industry primarily evaluates managers using capital-agnostic performance measures such as annualized return, alpha, Sharpe ratio, and related return statistics. While these measures remain useful for evaluating investment performance, they are not designed to measure a different and arguably more economically important concept: benchmark-adjusted wealth creation on the capital investors actually entrusted to a manager. As managers attract more capital over time, strong early returns earned on a small asset base can continue to dominate the track record even if much larger pools of capital later receive mediocre or benchmark-lagging results.

This paper argues that investment performance and economic value creation are distinct concepts, and that both should be measured. To address this measurement gap, it introduces Excess Wealth Added (EWA), a capital-aware measure of cumulative benchmark-adjusted wealth creation, and Excess Wealth Efficiency (EWE), a complementary asset-weighted measure of value creation efficiency relative to the capital entrusted to the manager.

The purpose of EWA and EWE is not to replace traditional performance statistics, but to complement them by measuring something they were never intended to measure: the economic value created for investors. Together, these measures provide a broader framework for evaluating active managers based not only on how well they performed, but on how much benchmark-adjusted wealth they created and how efficiently they created it relative to the capital entrusted to them.

AI.tldr: 本文提出对冲基金行业应同时衡量投资业绩和经济价值创造两个不同概念，并引入两个新的资本敏感型指标：超额财富增加值（EWA）衡量累计基准调整财富创造，超额财富效率（EWE）衡量相对于受托资本的财富创造效率。这些指标并非取代传统绩效统计，而是对其补充。
AI.research_question: 如何衡量基金经理在投资者实际委托资本基础上创造的基准调整后的经济价值？
AI.motivation: 传统绩效指标（年化收益、alpha、夏普比率等）是资本无关（capital-agnostic）的，无法衡量资本敏感的经济价值创造。早期在小规模资本上获得的优异收益可能在后期大规模资本表现平庸时仍主导业绩记录，导致投资者被误导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 投资绩效与经济价值创造是两个不同概念的论点；资本敏感（capital-aware）的财富创造衡量框架。
AI.method: 提出两个新指标：超额财富增加值（EWA），一种资本敏感的累计基准调整财富创造衡量指标；超额财富效率（EWE），一种互补的资产加权价值创造效率衡量指标。
AI.findings: EWA和EWE旨在补充而非取代传统绩效统计，共同构成更广泛的主动基金经理评估框架，同时衡量"表现如何"与"创造了多少基准调整财富及创造效率如何"。
AI.theory_contributions: 将投资业绩与经济价值创造在概念上明确区分，提出新的理论框架（EWA和EWE）来填补传统绩效衡量无法覆盖的经济价值创造衡量空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为对冲基金投资者、基金行业和监管者提供资本敏感的财富创造衡量工具，帮助更准确评估基金经理在受托资本基础上创造的实际经济价值，避免被早期小规模资本上的优异业绩所误导。

title: National Determinants of Coffee Prices in Italy: An Econometric Analysis

detail.title: National Determinants of Coffee Prices in Italy: An Econometric Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study, as it relies exclusively on secondary data and does not involve human participants.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Coffee is one of the most widespread and culturally significant consumer goods in Italy: the domestic market is currently worth around €5.2 billion, with per capita consumption of approximately 5.5 kg per year. This paper analyses the determinants of coffee consumer prices in Italy over the period 2013-2025, using a monthly dataset constructed by integrating Eurostat, ECB, World Bank and national sources. The estimated multiple OLS regression model includes both national variables energy costs, general inflation, interest rates and labour costs and international variables oil prices and the euro/dollar exchange rate with the discussion of results focused on national determinants. Complementing the analysis with a multicollinearity test (VIF), an endogeneity test using instrumental variables, and the Hausman test, the study shows that electricity prices and the interest rate are the most robust determinants of coffee prices in Italy. The analysis is completed by an ARIMA-GARCH model of the Italian coffee price time series, which reveals a significant seasonal structure and high volatility persistence (α+β ≈ 0.95). The results provide useful insights for understanding the domestic transmission of inflationary pressures on coffee prices and for assessing the adaptation strategies of households and the national supply chain.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2013-2025年意大利咖啡消费价格的决定因素，通过整合Eurostat、ECB、World Bank等数据源的月度数据集，运用多元OLS回归模型、VIF多重共线性检验、工具变量内生性检验和Hausman检验，发现电价和利率是最稳健的价格决定因素。此外，ARIMA-GARCH模型揭示了咖啡价格时间序列存在显著的季节性结构和较高的波动持续性。
AI.research_question: 2013-2025年期间意大利咖啡消费价格的决定因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 咖啡是意大利最具广泛性和文化意义的消费品之一，国内市场价值约52亿欧元，人均年消费约5.5公斤。理解咖啡价格的驱动因素对评估通胀压力的国内传导机制及家庭和供应链的适应策略具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 成本推动型通胀理论、价格传导机制理论、利率-价格关系理论
AI.method: 整合Eurostat、ECB、World Bank及国内来源构建月度数据集，采用多元OLS回归模型，辅以VIF多重共线性检验、工具变量内生性检验和Hausman检验，并运用ARIMA-GARCH模型分析时间序列特征。
AI.findings: 电价和利率是咖啡价格最稳健的决定因素；意大利咖啡价格时间序列存在显著季节性结构，波动持续性高（α+β≈0.95）；国内变量（能源成本、通胀、利率、劳动力成本）与国际变量（油价、欧元/美元汇率）均被纳入模型，但讨论聚焦于国内决定因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 为理解国内通胀压力向特定消费品（咖啡）价格传导的机制提供了实证证据，丰富了成本推动型价格决定因素的理论文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为家庭消费策略的调整和国内咖啡供应链的适应策略提供了决策参考，有助于评估宏观经济变量对消费品价格的传导效应。

title: Business, Commodity, And Financial Cycles in Nigeria: The Role of Macroeconomic Policy
affiliations: Central Bank of Nigeria

detail.title: Business, Commodity, And Financial Cycles in Nigeria: The Role of Macroeconomic Policy
detail.abstract: The paper examines the role of macroeconomic policy in stabilising the fluctuations generated by the simultaneous interactions between business, commodity and financial cycles in a small open resource-rich economy. The results reveal that both fiscal and monetary policy are important stabilising tools for the economic cycles. However, both policies counteract each other, resulting in an overall neutral policy stance. The results further show that the policy instruments have weak influence on the commodity cycle. These findings imply that even though the policy instruments are important in stabilising the economy, achieving the appropriate policy mix is equally important, and that macroeconomic policy alone may be insufficient to stabilise the shocks from commodity price fluctuations. By examining the impact of fiscal and monetary policy on business, commodity, and financial cycles in Nigeria, the study contributes to the understanding the role of macroeconomic policy in economic stabilisation in resource-rich developing countries.

AI.tldr: 本文考察了宏观经济政策在稳定小型开放资源丰富经济体中商业周期、大宗商品周期和金融周期相互作用所产生的波动中的作用。研究发现财政政策和货币政策都是重要的稳定工具，但两者相互抵消，导致总体政策立场中性；政策工具对大宗商品周期影响较弱。这意味着即使政策工具对稳定经济很重要，实现适当的政策组合同样重要，且仅靠宏观经济政策可能不足以稳定大宗商品价格波动的冲击。
AI.research_question: 宏观经济政策（财政和货币政策）在稳定小型开放资源丰富经济体中商业周期、大宗商品周期和金融周期同时相互作用产生的波动方面发挥什么作用？
AI.motivation: 资源丰富发展中国家面临大宗商品价格波动带来的经济不稳定挑战，而现有文献对宏观经济政策在稳定这一类型经济体多重周期方面作用的理解有限，尤其是对政策工具影响各周期程度的系统评估不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于商业周期、大宗商品周期和金融周期相互作用的宏观经济稳定理论框架，考察财政政策与货币政策在小型开放资源丰富经济体中的稳定作用。
AI.method: 以尼日利亚为研究对象，采用实证分析方法，考察财政政策和货币政策对商业周期、大宗商品周期和金融周期的影响。
AI.findings: （1）财政政策和货币政策都是重要的经济周期稳定工具；（2）两种政策相互抵消，导致总体政策立场呈中性；（3）政策工具对大宗商品周期的影响较弱；（4）仅靠宏观经济政策可能不足以稳定大宗商品价格波动带来的冲击。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过考察财政和货币政策对商业、大宗商品和金融三重周期的影响，深化了对资源丰富发展中国家宏观经济政策在经济稳定中作用的理解，填补了该领域实证研究的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为资源丰富发展中国家制定宏观经济政策组合提供启示，强调适当的政策搭配（policy mix）对经济稳定的重要性，并提醒政策制定者宏观经济政策单靠自身无法完全对冲大宗商品价格波动的冲击。

title: Strong Alignment and Contract Form in Robust Teams Linear Sharing under Risk Neutrality and Utility-Affine Contracts under Risk Aversion
affiliations: The University of Sydney

detail.title: Strong Alignment and Contract Form in Robust Teams Linear Sharing under Risk Neutrality and Utility-Affine Contracts under Risk Aversion
detail.abstract: This note connects two ingredients in robust team moral hazard that are individually insufficient to determine contract form. Primal-dual analysis yields a weighted aggregate identity for the agents' compensation schedules, but that identity admits many nonlinear contracts. Alignment restricts the agents to rank distributions of aggregate performance in the same direction, but alignment alone permits a nonlinear common incentive index. We distinguish the strict-to-weak condition of Dai and Toikka [2022], called Dai-Toikka alignment, from a weak-to-weak condition, called strong alignment. On a convex and Dirac-rich distribution domain, strong alignment makes every nonconstant compensation schedule a positive affine transformation of any other in the payoff space relevant to the agents. For risk-neutral agents, this is wage space; combining the resulting wage-affine property with the aggregate identity and two-sided limited liability proves that every full-contact optimum is a vector of positive linear sharing contracts. For risk-averse agents, alignment must instead be imposed on expected Bernoulli utility from compensation. It then implies that the gross utility schedules u i • w i are positive affine transformations of one another. The risk-averse aggregate dual identity determines a common utility index and generally produces nonlinear monetary wages. Risk neutrality is recovered as the special case in which this index and all wages are linear. We also recover the closed-form robust team shares in a separable risk-neutral environment. An appendix extends the structural argument to multi-member supply-chain contracts and states its risk-averse counterpart.

AI.tldr: 本文在稳健团队道德风险框架下，结合对偶分析与两类校准条件，证明了强校准结合风险中性可将所有全接触最优合同刻画为严格正的线性共享合同；对风险厌恶代理人则须在期望伯努利效用层面施加校准，并导致非线性工资。
AI.research_question: 在稳健团队道德风险中，哪些条件能够共同决定合同的具体形式（尤其是将合同形式从非线性压缩到线性）？
AI.motivation: 稳健团队道德风险中，原始-对偶分析得到的加权总量恒等式允许大量非线性合同，而校准条件本身也仅允许非线性共同激励指数；二者单独均不足以确定合同形式，需要更强条件来刻画合同结构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 稳健团队道德风险、原始-对偶分析、校准条件（Dai-Toikka校准与强校准）、风险中性/风险厌恶效用理论、有限责任约束
AI.method: 凸且Dirac-rich的分布域上，采用原始-对偶分析与校准条件的组合论证；对风险中性施加工资空间仿射性质，对风险厌恶在期望伯努利效用层面施加约束；结合总量恒等式与双侧有限责任进行推导。
AI.findings: （1）强校准使任何非常数补偿计划在代理人相关支付空间中互为严格正仿射变换；（2）风险中性下，全接触最优合同均为正线性共享合同；（3）风险厌恶下，总效用计划互为仿射变换，且一般产生非线性货币工资；（4）风险中性是效用指数与工资均线性的特例；（5）在可分离风险中性环境中恢复闭式稳健团队份额。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Dai-Toikka的严格-弱校准区分为强校准（弱-弱），并证明强校准与总量恒等式结合可严格刻画合同形式；为稳健团队道德风险的合同形式确定提供了统一的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为多成员供应链合同的结构性扩展提供了理论依据，并给出风险中性可分离环境下团队的闭式稳健份额，有助于实际合约设计。

title: Do Litter Cleanups Benefit Wildlife? Evidence from U.S. Birds
affiliations: University of Illinois, Urbana-Champaign and Old Dominion University - Economics

detail.title: Do Litter Cleanups Benefit Wildlife? Evidence from U.S. Birds

declarations.declarationOfInterest: We declare that we have no relevant or material financial interests that relate to the research described in this paper. This project received no external financial support. No party had the right to review the paper prior to circulation.

detail.abstract: Improperly discarded litter poses ecological risks, yet little evidence documents whether cleanup activities generate measurable environmental benefits. We provide the first causal estimates of the effects of nonprofit litter cleanup events on bird abundance in the United States. We combine cleanup-event-level data from the Ocean Conservancy's International Coastal Cleanup program with county-level abundance indices derived from eBird from 2015-2022 and estimate staggered-adoption event-study models using both two-way fixed effects and bias-corrected estimators. Cleanup events increase bird abundance by 0.026 index points, or 0.67 percent of the county mean, with effects that accumulate over three years and persist. Cleanup activity does not affect birder effort, indicating the results are not driven by changes in bird detection. Heterogeneity analyses show that landbirds and non-scavenger species drive the positive average effects, whereas scavenger species that feed on litter decrease in abundance after litter removal. Given the modest cost of volunteer cleanups and their broader ecological benefits, these findings highlight that litter removal efforts can serve as a cost-effective tool for improving bird abundance.

AI.tldr: 本文首次提供因果证据表明，非营利性垃圾清理活动能显著增加美国鸟类丰度（提升0.67%），效果随时间累积并持续三年，且由陆鸟和非食腐物种驱动，而食腐鸟类因垃圾移除而减少。
AI.research_question: 非营利性垃圾清理活动是否能为鸟类丰度带来可测量的环境效益？
AI.motivation: 不当丢弃的垃圾对生态环境构成风险，但此前几乎没有因果证据表明清理活动能产生可测量的环境效益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 垃圾清理通过移除生态危害物（如塑料、有毒废弃物）改善栖息地质量，从而影响鸟类种群丰度；不同鸟类物种（陆鸟vs水鸟、食腐vs非食腐）对垃圾的生态依赖程度不同，因而对清理活动的反应存在异质性。
AI.method: 该研究结合海洋保护协会国际海岸清理计划的清理活动数据与eBird县级鸟类丰度指数（2015-2022年），采用交错采纳事件研究模型，运用双向固定效应和偏差校正估计量进行因果推断。
AI.findings: 清理活动使鸟类丰度增加0.026个指数点（占县均值的0.67%），效果在三年内累积并持续存在；清理活动不影响观鸟者努力程度，排除检测偏差；陆鸟和非食腐物种驱动了正向平均效应，而依赖垃圾为食的食腐物种在垃圾移除后丰度下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供垃圾清理活动对鸟类丰度的因果估计证据，填补了干净活动环境效益文献中的空白；揭示了不同鸟类物种（食腐vs非食腐）对垃圾清理的异质性反应，深化了对垃圾生态功能双重性的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 鉴于志愿者清理成本低廉且具有广泛生态效益，研究表明垃圾清理可作为改善鸟类丰度的一种成本效益高的政策工具，为环境保护组织和非营利机构的资源分配提供实证依据。

title: Exposing the Value of Receiving and Giving Help across 12 European Countries: a Longitudinal Analysis of Self-Perceived Health

detail.title: Exposing the Value of Receiving and Giving Help across 12 European Countries: a Longitudinal Analysis of Self-Perceived Health
detail.abstract: The act of receiving and giving help is commonly expected to improve older people's health. In this article, this expectation is explored through a longitudinal analysis of a representative sample of 29,995 respondents aged 59 to 89 in 2011 from 12 European countries documented in the Survey of Health, Ageing and Retirement in Europe (SHARE) for the period 2011 to 2022. An unordered correlated random-effects (CRE), an ordered fixed-effects logistic (FEO), as well as an ordered random-effects logistic panel estimator (REO), all with longitudinal calibrated weights, are used to estimate the relationship between self-perceived health, receiving, and giving help. Additionally, a stereotype ordered logistic estimator (SO) is included to support the detected interaction effect between receiving and giving help. Overall, the study documents the positive impact on self-reported health status of income, doing activities and being satisfied with life, as well as the negative impact of age and having limitations. The Danish older people report the best health status, followed by the Swedes and the Swiss. Moreover, the study highlights that receiving help relates to worse self-perceived health, and that giving help relates to better self-perceived health. Above all, the study reveals the potential of the act of giving help to improve the self-perceived health status, in particular of those who receive help.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用欧洲健康、老龄化和退休调查（SHARE）2011至2022年12个欧洲国家29,995名59至89岁老年人的纵向数据，探讨接受和给予帮助对自评健康的影响。研究发现接受帮助与较差的自评健康相关，而给予帮助则与较好的自评健康相关，且给予帮助尤其能改善那些接受帮助者的自评健康状况。
AI.research_question: 接受和给予帮助如何影响欧洲老年人的自评健康状况？特别是给予帮助是否能够改善接受帮助者的健康？
AI.motivation: 社会常识普遍预期接受和给予帮助能改善老年人健康，但这一预期缺乏系统的纵向实证检验，需要通过大规模代表性样本进行严谨验证。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于社会支持理论和社会交换理论，探讨社会支持方向（接受vs.给予）对老年人健康的差异化影响。
AI.method: 使用SHARE数据（2011-2022年），采用无序相关随机效应模型（CRE）、有序固定效应Logistic模型（FEO）、有序随机效应Logistic面板估计量（REO）及刻板有序Logistic估计量（SO），均搭配纵向校准权重，以检验接受与给予帮助及其交互效应对自评健康的影响。
AI.findings: （1）收入、参与活动和生活满意度对自评健康有正向影响，年龄和功能限制有负向影响；（2）丹麦老年人自评健康最好，其次为瑞典和瑞士；（3）接受帮助与较差的自评健康相关；（4）给予帮助与较好的自评健康相关；（5）给予帮助尤其能改善那些接受帮助者的自评健康状态。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了社会支持方向（接受vs.给予）对老年人健康的非对称效应，发现给予帮助具有超越接受的健康增益潜力，特别是对受助者群体，为理解社会交换与健康关系提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为老年人健康干预和政策制定提供实证依据，建议在老年人照护体系中不仅关注接受帮助的保障功能，更应创造条件鼓励老年人给予帮助（如志愿服务、互助活动），以实现健康促进目标。

title: Are Pensions and Disability Benefits concordant with Means and Health? A Tobit Approach to SHARE data from 50-to-89-year-olds covering 12 European Countries from 2015 to 2022

detail.title: Are Pensions and Disability Benefits concordant with Means and Health? A Tobit Approach to SHARE data from 50-to-89-year-olds covering 12 European Countries from 2015 to 2022
detail.abstract: Public pensions and benefits are a cornerstone for safeguarding citizens' standard of living. This study focuses on the determinants of old-age pensions as well as disability pensions and benefits. The data is provided by the Survey of Health, Ageing and Retirement in Europe (SHARE), and covers people aged 50 to 89 years old for the period 2015 to 2022 in 12 European countries. The relationship between the determinants and old-age as well as disability pensions is estimated using Multi-effects and Random-Effects Tobit estimators with a minimum of 106,240 observations of minimum 47,832 respondents. The results indicate that both old-age and disability pensions appear to be limited complementary across countries. Old-age pensions are lower at lower self-reported health levels, while disability pensions and benefits appear to be higher. Moreover, the public payment schemes appear to account for the remaining available income of the beneficiary, implying that a given fairness is incorporated in the payment policies. Remarkably, both payments reveal the presence of a pension gender gap, potentially arising from a preceding wage gap. Overall, the study illustrates on a high level the fair allocation of available means to old-age as well as disability pensions across a substantial part of Europe.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用欧洲健康、老龄化和退休调查（SHARE）2015-2022年12个欧洲国家50-89岁人群的数据（至少106,240个观测值），采用多效应和随机效应Tobit估计器研究老年养老金与残疾养老金的决定因素。研究发现两种养老金在欧洲各国呈有限互补关系，健康状况较差者老年养老金更低但残疾养老金更高，支付政策体现了收入公平性，且两种养老金均存在源于工资差距的性别差距。
AI.research_question: 老年养老金以及残疾养老金和福利的决定因素是什么？这些因素如何影响不同类型养老金的分配？
AI.motivation: 公共养老金和福利是保障公民生活水平的重要基石，理解其分配的决定因素对于评估养老金制度的公平性和有效性至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多效应（Multi-effects）与随机效应Tobit估计框架
AI.method: 使用欧洲健康、老龄化和退休调查（SHARE）数据，覆盖2015-2022年12个欧洲国家50-89岁人群，采用多效应和随机效应Tobit估计器，最低包含106,240个观测值、47,832名受访者。
AI.findings: （1）老年养老金和残疾养老金在欧洲各国呈有限互补关系；（2）自评健康水平越低，老年养老金越低，而残疾养老金和福利越高；（3）公共支付方案考虑了受益人剩余可用收入，体现了支付政策的公平性；（4）两种养老金均存在养老金性别差距，可能源于此前的工资差距。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统性地识别了健康水平、收入状况和性别等关键决定因素对老年养老金与残疾养老金的不同影响机制，揭示了两种养老金制度之间的互补关系及内在公平性设计。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧洲多国养老金政策制定提供实证依据，有助于政策制定者理解养老金分配中的健康关联性和性别差距问题，推动更公平的公共养老金制度设计。

title: Financial Distress and Homeownership: Evidence from SHARE Data covering 50-to 90-year-old Citizens of the Nordic and Baltic States from 2020 to 2022

detail.title: Financial Distress and Homeownership: Evidence from SHARE Data covering 50-to 90-year-old Citizens of the Nordic and Baltic States from 2020 to 2022
detail.abstract: Homeownership is a societal and financial stronghold for people across the world. However, achieving or sustaining homeownership may come with a given cost. This study focuses on financial distress in relation to homeownership and other relevant factors like health. It relies on data from the Survey of Health, Ageing, and Retirement in Europe (SHARE) for citizens of the Nordic and Baltic States aged 50 to 90 years old. The analysis is completed with a logistic (N = 2,878) and ordered logistic (N = 7,030) estimator, which both model the change in the regressed variables from 2020 to 2022. The main findings reveal that homeownership exit alone does not relieve financial distress, yet results in an improvement in combination with a budget-for-food and income improvement. In contrast, a liabilities relief and a change in job situation appear to hinder a financial distress improvement. Overall, the findings can be regarded as relevant for policymakers' quest for appropriate governmental action to handle citizens' difficulties with making end meets which arise from sustaining homeownership.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于欧洲健康、老龄化与退休调查（SHARE）数据，分析北欧和波罗的海国家50至90岁公民在2020至2022年间住房所有权与财务困境之间的关系。研究发现，仅退出房屋所有权并不能缓解财务困境，但若同时伴随食品预算和收入的改善则有效；而债务减免和工作状况变化反而阻碍财务困境的改善。
AI.research_question: 房屋所有权退出及相关的健康、收入、债务等因素如何影响中老年人的财务困境改善？
AI.motivation: 房屋所有权是全球范围内重要的社会和财务支柱，但维持或取得房屋所有权可能带来财务成本，导致公民面临入不敷出的困难。需要探究哪些因素组合才能真正缓解与房屋所有权相关的财务困境，为政策制定提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于住房所有权与财务困境关系的理论视角，整合健康、收入、债务及就业状况等多元因素的综合分析框架。
AI.method: 使用欧洲健康、老龄化与退休调查（SHARE）数据，覆盖北欧和波罗的海国家50至90岁公民。采用Logistic回归（N=2,878）和有序Logistic回归（N=7,030）两种计量模型，分析2020至2022年间各变量的变化。
AI.findings: （1）仅退出房屋所有权并不能单独缓解财务困境；（2）退出房屋所有权与食品预算改善及收入改善相结合时，才能有效缓解财务困境；（3）债务减免和工作状况变化反而阻碍财务困境的改善。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了房屋所有权退出并非单独有效缓解财务困境的因素，需要与其他生活条件改善（如食品预算和收入）协同作用，拓展了对住房与财务困境关系的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供实证依据，表明政府在帮助公民应对因维持房屋所有权而产生的入不敷出困难时，需要采取综合性的干预措施，而非单一的政策工具。

title: The Effect of a Global Health Shock on Preventive Drug Intake: Evidence from SHARE 2020-2022 for 15 European Countries

detail.title: The Effect of a Global Health Shock on Preventive Drug Intake: Evidence from SHARE 2020-2022 for 15 European Countries
